units.id: mission:Courier 4|name|1811|0
units.english: Lizard to <planet>
units.italian: Una lucertola per <planet>

units.id: mission:Courier 4|description|1813|0
units.english: Deliver an exotic pet (weighing <tons>) to <destination> by <date>. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Consegna un animale esotico (<tons>) a <destination> entro <date>. Il compenso è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Courier 4|A man wearing a very complicated hat waves to you from the other side of a landing pad. "Yoo-hoo, Captain!" he says. "I have a courier mission for you if you're interested."|1826|0
units.english: A man wearing a very complicated hat waves to you from the other side of a landing pad. "Yoo-hoo, Captain!" he says. "I have a courier mission for you if you're interested."
units.italian: Un uomo con un cappello molto complicato ti saluta agitando la mano dall'altra parte di una piazzola di atterraggio. "Yoo-hoo, Capitano!" dice. "Ho una missione di consegna per te, se ti interessa."

units.id: mission:Courier 4|	(Find out what he wants.)|1828|0
units.english: (Find out what he wants.)
units.italian: (Scopri che cosa vuole.)

units.id: mission:Courier 4|	(Ignore him.)|1829|0
units.english: (Ignore him.)
units.italian: (Ignalo.)

units.id: mission:Courier 4|	"My name is Alphonse," he says. "I am a breeder of exotic lizards. A new client on <planet> has just ordered one, and will pay you <payment> to transport it. Naturally, being a live animal, it's a rush delivery; it needs to be done by <day>. What do you say?"|1831|0
units.english: "My name is Alphonse," he says. "I am a breeder of exotic lizards. A new client on <planet> has just ordered one, and will pay you <payment> to transport it. Naturally, being a live animal, it's a rush delivery; it needs to be done by <day>. What do you say?"
units.italian: "Mi chiamo Alphonse," dice. "Sono un allevatore di lucertole esotiche. Un nuovo cliente su <planet> ne ha appena ordinata una e ti pagherà <payment> per trasportarla. Naturalmente, trattandosi di un animale vivo, la consegna è urgente: deve arrivare entro <day>. Che ne dici?"

units.id: mission:Courier 4|	"I'd be glad to."|1833|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to."
units.italian: "Con piacere."

units.id: mission:Courier 4|	"Sorry, I'm not interested in that sort of work."|1834|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not interested in that sort of work."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non mi interessa questo tipo di lavoro."

units.id: mission:Courier 4|	"Excellent!" he says. "Come, let me introduce you to your cargo." He leads you to a supply shed where an enormous lizard, taller than you and probably weighing several tons, is being held in a cage that looks far too flimsy for it. "I'll have my men load her aboard your ship at once," says the man, "along with some meat for her to eat on the journey. Watch out for your fingers when you feed her, by the way. Thank you!"|1836|0
units.english: "Excellent!" he says. "Come, let me introduce you to your cargo." He leads you to a supply shed where an enormous lizard, taller than you and probably weighing several tons, is being held in a cage that looks far too flimsy for it. "I'll have my men load her aboard your ship at once," says the man, "along with some meat for her to eat on the journey. Watch out for your fingers when you feed her, by the way. Thank you!"
units.italian: "Eccellente!" dice. "Vieni, lascia che ti presenti il tuo carico." Ti guida verso un magazzino dove un'enorme lucertola, più alta di te e probabilmente del peso di diverse tonnellate, è tenuta in una gabbia che sembra fin troppo fragile per lei. "Ordinerò ai miei uomini di caricarla subito sulla tua nave," dice l'uomo, "insieme a un po' di carne da darle durante il viaggio. A proposito, attento alle dita quando la nutri. Grazie!"

units.id: mission:Courier 4|dialog|1844|0
units.english: Somehow, you have managed to bring the large lizard to <planet> without it breaking loose and eating you. You unload it and wait for its new owner to come. When he does, he pays you <payment>.
units.italian: In qualche modo sei riuscito a portare la grossa lucertola su <planet> senza che si liberasse e ti divorasse. La scarichi e aspetti che arrivi il nuovo proprietario. Quando arriva, ti paga <payment>.

units.id: mission:Migrant Workers 1|name|1849|0
units.english: Migrant Workers
units.italian: Lavoratori migranti

units.id: mission:Migrant Workers 1|description|1850|0
units.english: Bring a group of <bunks> migrant workers to <planet>. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Porta un gruppo di <bunks> lavoratori migranti su <planet>. Il compenso è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Migrant Workers 1|In the spaceport, you can't help but notice a group of six or seven men in ragged farm clothing, sitting by the edge of one of the launch pads. They are probably migrant workers looking for a lift.|1863|0
units.english: In the spaceport, you can't help but notice a group of six or seven men in ragged farm clothing, sitting by the edge of one of the launch pads. They are probably migrant workers looking for a lift.
units.italian: Nello spazioporto non puoi fare a meno di notare un gruppo di sei o sette uomini in abiti da lavoro logori, seduti sul bordo di una delle piazzole di lancio. Probabilmente sono lavoratori migranti in cerca di un passaggio.

units.id: mission:Migrant Workers 1|	(Approach them.)|1865|0
units.english: (Approach them.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati.)

units.id: mission:Migrant Workers 1|	(Ignore them.)|1866|0
units.english: (Ignore them.)
units.italian: (Ignali.)

units.id: mission:Migrant Workers 1|	You strike up a conversation with the workers. They say that they are tired of the seasonal fluctuations of farm work, and are looking for something a bit steadier and better paying. "We hear there's always work to be had in the mines on <planet>," they say. "Can you take us there? We've pooled together our savings, and can pay you <payment>."|1868|0
units.english: You strike up a conversation with the workers. They say that they are tired of the seasonal fluctuations of farm work, and are looking for something a bit steadier and better paying. "We hear there's always work to be had in the mines on <planet>," they say. "Can you take us there? We've pooled together our savings, and can pay you <payment>."
units.italian: Attacchi discorso con i lavoratori. Dicono di essere stanchi delle oscillazioni stagionali del lavoro nei campi e di cercare qualcosa di più stabile e meglio pagato. "Sentiamo dire che nelle miniere su <planet> c'è sempre lavoro," dicono. "Puoi portarci là? Abbiamo messo insieme i nostri risparmi e possiamo pagarti <payment>."

units.id: mission:Migrant Workers 1|	"Sure!"|1870|0
units.english: "Sure!"
units.italian: "Certo!"

units.id: mission:Migrant Workers 1|	"No, sorry, I'm not headed in that direction."|1872|0
units.english: "No, sorry, I'm not headed in that direction."
units.italian: "No, spiacente, non vado in quella direzione."

units.id: mission:Migrant Workers 1|dialog|1880|0
units.english: The migrant workers thank you for transporting them, and hand you <payment>. You hope that they will be able to find better work here than they had on <origin>.
units.italian: I lavoratori migranti ti ringraziano per il trasporto e ti consegnano <payment>. Speri che riescano a trovare qui un lavoro migliore di quello che avevano su <origin>.

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 1|name|1885|0
units.english: Vaccine to <planet>
units.italian: Vaccini per <planet>

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 1|description|1886|0
units.english: Bring <tons> of flu vaccines to the lawless world of <planet>. Be sure the medicine gets into the right hands.
units.italian: Porta <tons> di vaccini antinfluenzali sul mondo senza legge di <planet>. Assicurati che le medicine finiscano nelle mani giuste.

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 1|While you are sitting at a table in a local cafe, a woman sits down across from you and says, "Pardon me, Captain. I wonder if you would be interested in helping with a humanitarian mission."|1901|0
units.english: While you are sitting at a table in a local cafe, a woman sits down across from you and says, "Pardon me, Captain. I wonder if you would be interested in helping with a humanitarian mission."
units.italian: Mentre sei seduto a un tavolo in un caffè del posto, una donna si siede di fronte a te e dice: "Mi scusi, Capitano. Mi chiedevo se Le interesserebbe aiutare in una missione umanitaria."

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 1|	"Tell me more."|1903|0
units.english: "Tell me more."
units.italian: "Mi dica di più."

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 1|	"Sorry, I'm too busy."|1904|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm too busy."
units.italian: "Spiacente, sono troppo impegnato."

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 1|	"There's a flu epidemic on <planet>," she says. "It's a lawless world, so they have not been able to find any merchants willing to bring them medicine. But if they don't get a shipment of vaccine soon, the epidemic could become much worse, and even spread to other worlds."|1906|0
units.english: "There's a flu epidemic on <planet>," she says. "It's a lawless world, so they have not been able to find any merchants willing to bring them medicine. But if they don't get a shipment of vaccine soon, the epidemic could become much worse, and even spread to other worlds."
units.italian: "Su <planet> c'è un'epidemia di influenza," dice. "È un mondo senza legge, quindi non sono riusciti a trovare nessun mercante disposto a portare loro le medicine. Ma se non ricevono presto una partita di vaccini, l'epidemia potrebbe peggiorare molto, e diffondersi anche su altri mondi."

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 1|	"I'd be glad to help."|1908|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help."
units.italian: "Sarei lieto di aiutare."

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 1|	"Sorry, I don't believe in helping pirates."|1909|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't believe in helping pirates."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non credo nell'aiutare i pirati."

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 1|	"Thank you," she says. "Your contact on <planet> will be a man named 'Raven Hunter.' Don't let anyone but him trick you into giving them the supplies."|1911|0
units.english: "Thank you," she says. "Your contact on <planet> will be a man named 'Raven Hunter.' Don't let anyone but him trick you into giving them the supplies."
units.italian: "Grazie," dice. "Il tuo contatto su <planet> sarà un uomo di nome 'Raven Hunter'. Non lasciare che altri ti raggirino per farsi dare le forniture."

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 1|After several shady characters have offered to buy the vaccines off you, or threatened to rob you, "Raven Hunter" finally shows up and collects them. He thanks you, and pays you <payment>.|1920|0
units.english: After several shady characters have offered to buy the vaccines off you, or threatened to rob you, "Raven Hunter" finally shows up and collects them. He thanks you, and pays you <payment>.
units.italian: Dopo che diversi loschi figuri ti hanno offerto di comprare i vaccini, o ti hanno minacciato di derubarti, "Raven Hunter" si presenta finalmente e li ritira. Ti ringrazia e ti paga <payment>.

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 2|name|1925|0
units.english: Food to <planet>
units.italian: Cibo per <planet>

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 2|description|1926|0
units.english: Bring <tons> of food to the lawless world of <planet>, to help alleviate a famine.
units.italian: Porta <tons> di cibo sul mondo senza legge di <planet>, per aiutare ad alleviare una carestia.

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 2|As you are walking through the local market, a man says, "Captain, do you have room in your hold to bring food to a starving planet?"|1941|0
units.english: As you are walking through the local market, a man says, "Captain, do you have room in your hold to bring food to a starving planet?"
units.italian: Mentre attraversi il mercato locale, un uomo dice: "Capitano, ha spazio nella stiva per portare cibo su un pianeta che muore di fame?"

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 2|	"Yes, but I hadn't heard news of a famine recently."|1943|0
units.english: "Yes, but I hadn't heard news of a famine recently."
units.italian: "Sì, ma non avevo sentito parlare di nessuna carestia, di recente."

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 2|	"Sorry, not today."|1944|0
units.english: "Sorry, not today."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non oggi."

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 2|	"No, this one wouldn't be in the news," he says. "It's <planet>, a lawless world. They're desperately in need of food, although it's mostly due to corruption and mismanagement of resources."|1946|0
units.english: "No, this one wouldn't be in the news," he says. "It's <planet>, a lawless world. They're desperately in need of food, although it's mostly due to corruption and mismanagement of resources."
units.italian: "No, di questo non si parlerebbe nei notiziari," dice. "Si tratta di <planet>, un mondo senza legge. Hanno un disperato bisogno di cibo, anche se la colpa è soprattutto della corruzione e della cattiva gestione delle risorse."

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 2|	"Well, it sounds like they're getting exactly what they deserve. And, I have no intention of risking my life to land on a pirate world."|1948|0
units.english: "Well, it sounds like they're getting exactly what they deserve. And, I have no intention of risking my life to land on a pirate world."
units.italian: "Beh, sembra che stiano ricevendo esattamente quello che si meritano. E non ho alcuna intenzione di rischiare la vita per atterrare su un mondo di pirati."

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 2|	"Well, even so, no one deserves to starve to death. I'll help them."|1950|0
units.english: "Well, even so, no one deserves to starve to death. I'll help them."
units.italian: "Beh, anche così, nessuno merita di morire di fame. Li aiuterò."

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 2|	"Thank you," he says. "We'll load the food into your cargo hold immediately. The sooner you can drop it off on <planet>, the better."|1951|0
units.english: "Thank you," he says. "We'll load the food into your cargo hold immediately. The sooner you can drop it off on <planet>, the better."
units.italian: "Grazie," dice. "Caricheremo subito il cibo nella tua stiva. Prima lo scarichi su <planet>, meglio è."

units.id: mission:Humanitarian 2|It takes a while to figure out who exactly is in charge here. You sell off parts of your shipment of food to a few different local leaders, receiving <payment> in exchange.|1960|0
units.english: It takes a while to figure out who exactly is in charge here. You sell off parts of your shipment of food to a few different local leaders, receiving <payment> in exchange.
units.italian: Ci vuole un po' per capire chi comanda davvero, qui. Vendi parte del tuo carico di cibo a diversi capi locali, ricevendo in cambio <payment>.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 1|name|1965|0
units.english: Terraforming Rand
units.italian: Terraformare Rand

units.id: mission:Terraforming 1|description|1966|0
units.english: Bring a delegation of two people from Rand to the Academy of Planetary Sciences on Glory.
units.italian: Porta una delegazione di due persone da Rand all'Academy of Planetary Sciences su Glory.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 1|You stop in to the spaceport bar for a drink. The bar seems to be frequented mostly by the managers of the mining corporation; you suspect the workers don't earn enough to visit a bar very frequently. In one corner, two of the managers are having a very animated discussion. When they see you, they say, "Hello there, Captain! Interested in taking us on a business trip?"|1979|0
units.english: You stop in to the spaceport bar for a drink. The bar seems to be frequented mostly by the managers of the mining corporation; you suspect the workers don't earn enough to visit a bar very frequently. In one corner, two of the managers are having a very animated discussion. When they see you, they say, "Hello there, Captain! Interested in taking us on a business trip?"
units.italian: Entri nel bar dello spazioporto per bere qualcosa. Il locale sembra frequentato soprattutto dai dirigenti della compagnia mineraria; sospetti che gli operai non guadagnino abbastanza per permettersi un bar con regolarità. In un angolo, due dei dirigenti stanno discutendo animatamente. Quando ti vedono, dicono: "Salve, Capitano! Le interessa portarci in viaggio d'affari?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 1|	"What sort of trip?"|1981|0
units.english: "What sort of trip?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di viaggio?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 1|	"Sorry, I'm just in here for the drinks."|1982|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm just in here for the drinks."
units.italian: "Spiacente, sono qui solo per bere qualcosa."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 1|	"To Glory, to the Academy of Planetary Sciences," he says. "This world is rich in resources, and we're thinking that if we could only cool down the deserts a bit and get more plants to grow here, it would be a decent place to live. We've been dreaming about this for years, and I think it's time to go pay a terraforming consultant to tell us whether it's actually possible or not."|1984|0
units.english: "To Glory, to the Academy of Planetary Sciences," he says. "This world is rich in resources, and we're thinking that if we could only cool down the deserts a bit and get more plants to grow here, it would be a decent place to live. We've been dreaming about this for years, and I think it's time to go pay a terraforming consultant to tell us whether it's actually possible or not."
units.italian: "Su Glory, all'Academy of Planetary Sciences," dice. "Questo mondo è ricco di risorse, e pensiamo che, se solo riuscissimo a raffreddare un po' i deserti e a far crescere più piante, sarebbe un posto decente dove vivere. Ci sogniamo questo da anni, e credo che sia ora di andare a pagare un consulente per la terraformazione che ci dica se è davvero possibile."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 1|	"Sure, I'd be glad to take you there."|1986|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to take you there."
units.italian: "Certo, sarei lieto di portarvi là."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 1|	"Sorry, that's way too far away for me to travel right now."|1988|0
units.english: "Sorry, that's way too far away for me to travel right now."
units.italian: "Spiacente, è troppo lontano perché io possa andarci adesso."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 1|dialog|1991|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the managers hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con a bordo i dirigenti non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|name|1997|0
units.english: Terraforming Rand
units.italian: Terraformare Rand

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|description|1998|0
units.english: Return to Rand with the delegation and a student who thinks she can terraform the planet cheaply.
units.italian: Torna su Rand con la delegazione e con una studentessa convinta di poter terraformare il pianeta a basso costo.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|blocked|2002|0
units.english: You have reached <origin>, but you need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <origin>, ma ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai liberato lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|log|2007|0
units.english: Brought Eric and Alaric to Glory, two managers of a mining corporation on Rand hoping to terraform the planet. Terraforming Rand would be immensely expensive, but a girl named Amy has a theory that may make the process cheap.
units.italian: Ho portato su Glory Eric e Alaric, due dirigenti di una compagnia mineraria di Rand che sperano di terraformare il pianeta. Terraformare Rand costerebbe moltissimo, ma una ragazza di nome Amy ha una teoria che potrebbe rendere il procedimento economico.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|You drop off the two managers from Rand, whose names are Eric and Alaric, at the Academy. While you wait for their meeting to end, you look around the lobby. The students have apparently just had some sort of science symposium, and poster boards are on display all along the walls. One of them catches your eye: the title is "Affordable Terraforming through Equilibrium Mapping."|2009|0
units.english: You drop off the two managers from Rand, whose names are Eric and Alaric, at the Academy. While you wait for their meeting to end, you look around the lobby. The students have apparently just had some sort of science symposium, and poster boards are on display all along the walls. One of them catches your eye: the title is "Affordable Terraforming through Equilibrium Mapping."
units.italian: Scarichi all'Accademia i due dirigenti di Rand, che si chiamano Eric e Alaric. Mentre aspetti che la loro riunione finisca, ti guardi intorno nell'atrio. Gli studenti hanno evidentemente appena tenuto una sorta di simposio scientifico, e lungo tutte le pareti sono esposti dei cartelloni. Uno attira la tua attenzione: il titolo è "Terraformazione a basso costo mediante mappatura degli equilibri".

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|	The basic concept of the poster seems to be that instead of altering the climate of a planet through brute force, it ought to instead be feasible to use a properly timed nudge in the right direction to cause the climate to shift toward a new equilibrium point that supports greater biological complexity. This student seems to think that planets naturally "want" to grow more complex and support more life, but that they sometimes get "stuck" in less optimum states.|2010|0
units.english: The basic concept of the poster seems to be that instead of altering the climate of a planet through brute force, it ought to instead be feasible to use a properly timed nudge in the right direction to cause the climate to shift toward a new equilibrium point that supports greater biological complexity. This student seems to think that planets naturally "want" to grow more complex and support more life, but that they sometimes get "stuck" in less optimum states.
units.italian: Il concetto di base del cartellone sembra essere questo: invece di alterare il clima di un pianeta con la forza bruta, dovrebbe essere possibile usare una spinta ben calibrata nel momento giusto per far scivolare il clima verso un nuovo punto di equilibrio che sostenga una maggiore complessità biologica. Questa studentessa sembra convinta che i pianeti "vogliano" naturalmente diventare più complessi e sostenere più vita, ma che a volte restino "bloccati" in stati meno ottimali.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|	It's an intriguing idea. On the other hand, at the bottom of the paper, the professor has written, "Very poor scholarship. Do not anthropomorphize planets."|2011|0
units.english: It's an intriguing idea. On the other hand, at the bottom of the paper, the professor has written, "Very poor scholarship. Do not anthropomorphize planets."
units.italian: È un'idea intrigante. D'altra parte, in fondo al foglio, il professore ha scritto: "Lavoro molto scadente. Non antropomorfizzare i pianeti."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|	Just then, Eric and Alaric return, looking disappointed.|2012|0
units.english: Just then, Eric and Alaric return, looking disappointed.
units.italian: Proprio in quel momento tornano Eric e Alaric, con l'aria delusa.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|	"No luck?"|2014|0
units.english: "No luck?"
units.italian: "Niente da fare?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|	They shake their heads. "It would cost fifteen million just to bring a specialist out for an initial consultation," says Eric, "and besides, the cost of terraforming machinery and upkeep is prohibitive. I think this whole Academy is just a money-making racket."|2015|0
units.english: They shake their heads. "It would cost fifteen million just to bring a specialist out for an initial consultation," says Eric, "and besides, the cost of terraforming machinery and upkeep is prohibitive. I think this whole Academy is just a money-making racket."
units.italian: Scuotono la testa. "Solo per far venire uno specialista per una prima consulenza ci vorrebbero quindici milioni," dice Eric, "e per di più il costo dei macchinari per la terraformazione e della loro manutenzione è proibitivo. Secondo me questa Accademia è solo una macchina per fare soldi."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|	"Have a look at this poster. Maybe this student would help us. We could bill it as a sort of internship for her."|2017|0
units.english: "Have a look at this poster. Maybe this student would help us. We could bill it as a sort of internship for her."
units.italian: "Date un'occhiata a questo cartellone. Magari questa studentessa potrebbe aiutarci. Potremmo presentarlo come una sorta di tirocinio per lei."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|	"Indeed. They gave this student a failing grade just for suggesting it could be done more cheaply."|2018|0
units.english: "Indeed. They gave this student a failing grade just for suggesting it could be done more cheaply."
units.italian: "Esatto. Hanno dato un voto insufficiente a questa studentessa solo per aver suggerito che si potesse fare a costi minori."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|	They look at the poster. "Sounds almost too good to be true," says Alaric. "Hang on, I'll look her up in the campus directory." A few minutes later, he is on the phone with the student who made the poster. Her name is Amy. It turns out she is about to flunk out anyway, and is more than willing to travel back to Rand with you when offered a tiny fraction of what the consultant would have received.|2020|0
units.english: They look at the poster. "Sounds almost too good to be true," says Alaric. "Hang on, I'll look her up in the campus directory." A few minutes later, he is on the phone with the student who made the poster. Her name is Amy. It turns out she is about to flunk out anyway, and is more than willing to travel back to Rand with you when offered a tiny fraction of what the consultant would have received.
units.italian: Guardano il cartellone. "Sembra quasi troppo bello per essere vero," dice Alaric. "Aspettate, la cerco nell'elenco del campus." Pochi minuti dopo è al telefono con la studentessa che ha fatto il cartellone. Si chiama Amy. Scopri che sta comunque per essere espulsa, e che è più che disposta a tornare su Rand con te quando le offri una frazione irrisoria di quanto avrebbe ricevuto il consulente.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|	An hour later, you meet up with Amy, and arrange for her to join you on your ship before it takes off. Eric and Alaric are very excited, but you are a bit worried about the wisdom of entrusting their planet's future to someone so young and inexperienced.|2021|0
units.english: An hour later, you meet up with Amy, and arrange for her to join you on your ship before it takes off. Eric and Alaric are very excited, but you are a bit worried about the wisdom of entrusting their planet's future to someone so young and inexperienced.
units.italian: Un'ora dopo ti incontri con Amy e combini perché si unisca a te sulla nave prima del decollo. Eric e Alaric sono entusiasti, ma tu sei un po' preoccupato della saggezza di affidare il futuro del loro pianeta a qualcuno così giovane e inesperta.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|dialog|2025|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Eric, Alaric, and Amy hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con a bordo Eric, Alaric e Amy non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 2|dialog|2028|0
units.english: On the entire return journey, Eric and Alaric have been busy showing Amy geological survey maps of Rand and asking her for ideas. The moment you land, they hurry out of the ship. "I'm going to show Amy around," says Eric, "but meet us in the spaceport bar later if you want to help out with whatever we do next." Alaric hands you <payment> as payment for your services, and then follows after them.
units.italian: Durante tutto il viaggio di ritorno, Eric e Alaric sono stati impegnati a mostrare ad Amy le mappe dei rilevamenti geologici di Rand e a chiederle idee. Nel momento in cui atterri, si precipitano fuori dalla nave. "Faccio vedere ad Amy in giro," dice Eric, "ma raggiungici più tardi nel bar dello spazioporto, se vuoi dare una mano con quello che faremo dopo." Alaric ti consegna <payment> come compenso per i tuoi servizi, poi si allontana dietro di loro.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|name|2061|0
units.english: Terraforming Rand
units.italian: Terraformare Rand

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|description|2062|0
units.english: Plant a thruster on an asteroid to guide it into a collision with the northern pole of Rand.
units.italian: Installa un propulsore su un asteroide per guidarlo a schiantarsi contro il polo nord di Rand.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|blocked|2063|0
units.english: You'll need more cargo space in order to take the next mission from Eric and Alaric. Return here when you have <capacity>.
units.italian: Ti servirà più spazio di carico per accettare la prossima missione di Eric e Alaric. Torna qui quando avrai <capacity>.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|Alaric, Eric, and Amy are having a heated conversation at a table in the bar. When they see you, Alaric says, "Okay, let's let Captain <last> be the tie breaker." He motions to you to join them.|2071|0
units.english: Alaric, Eric, and Amy are having a heated conversation at a table in the bar. When they see you, Alaric says, "Okay, let's let Captain <last> be the tie breaker." He motions to you to join them.
units.italian: Alaric, Eric e Amy stanno discutendo animatamente a un tavolo del bar. Quando ti vedono, Alaric dice: "Bene, lasciamo che il Capitano <last> faccia da ago della bilancia." Ti fa cenno di unirti a loro.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|	Amy explains, "Based on my data, it appears that Rand once had a cooler, more moist climate. But the trouble is, it has almost no axial tilt."|2072|0
units.english: Amy explains, "Based on my data, it appears that Rand once had a cooler, more moist climate. But the trouble is, it has almost no axial tilt."
units.italian: Amy spiega: "In base ai miei dati, sembra che Rand un tempo avesse un clima più fresco e più umido. Il problema è che non ha quasi nessuna inclinazione assiale."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|	"That means no changing seasons," explains Eric.|2073|0
units.english: "That means no changing seasons," explains Eric.
units.italian: "Il che significa nessun cambio di stagione," spiega Eric.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|	"The result is that much of the planet is very hot, but the poles are very cold. Nearly all the planet's water has migrated to the poles and ended up frozen into the ice caps. Because the weather is so unchanging here, nothing ever prompts that water to melt and rejoin the hydrological cycle."|2074|0
units.english: "The result is that much of the planet is very hot, but the poles are very cold. Nearly all the planet's water has migrated to the poles and ended up frozen into the ice caps. Because the weather is so unchanging here, nothing ever prompts that water to melt and rejoin the hydrological cycle."
units.italian: "Il risultato è che gran parte del pianeta è molto caldo, ma i poli sono freddissimi. Quasi tutta l'acqua del pianeta è migrata verso i poli ed è finita congelata nelle calotte. Siccome il clima qui non cambia mai, nulla spinge quell'acqua a sciogliersi e a rientrare nel ciclo idrologico."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|	"Well, that seems impossible to fix. It's not like you can rotate a planet's axis."|2076|0
units.english: "Well, that seems impossible to fix. It's not like you can rotate a planet's axis."
units.italian: "Beh, sembra impossibile rimediare. Non è che si possa far ruotare l'asse di un pianeta."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|	"Are you suggesting melting the ice caps somehow?"|2078|0
units.english: "Are you suggesting melting the ice caps somehow?"
units.italian: "Stai suggerendo di sciogliere le calotte in qualche modo?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|	"Of course not," she says. "But what we can do is introduce a sudden variation in the planet's climate that will allow water to be distributed more evenly across the surface again."|2081|0
units.english: "Of course not," she says. "But what we can do is introduce a sudden variation in the planet's climate that will allow water to be distributed more evenly across the surface again."
units.italian: "Certo che no," dice. "Ma quello che possiamo fare è introdurre una variazione improvvisa nel clima del pianeta, che permetta all'acqua di distribuirsi di nuovo più uniformemente sulla superficie."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|	"That would be the traditional terraforming approach," she says, "using orbital mirrors, or geothermal power, or something similar to evaporate the ice caps at a faster rate than new ice is being deposited. That approach would take a century or so."|2084|0
units.english: "That would be the traditional terraforming approach," she says, "using orbital mirrors, or geothermal power, or something similar to evaporate the ice caps at a faster rate than new ice is being deposited. That approach would take a century or so."
units.italian: "Sarebbe l'approccio classico alla terraformazione," dice, "usare specchi orbitali, o energia geotermica, o qualcosa del genere per far evaporare le calotte più in fretta di quanto si depositi nuovo ghiaccio. Un approccio del genere richiederebbe un secolo circa."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|	"This is where Amy's plan gets a bit scary," says Alaric.|2087|0
units.english: "This is where Amy's plan gets a bit scary," says Alaric.
units.italian: "È qui che il piano di Amy fa un po' paura," dice Alaric.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|	"I'm proposing crashing a medium-sized asteroid into the ice cap," she says. "If we pick the right asteroid, we can control the amount of dust that is created. The result will be a sudden influx of variability, that may allow the planet to revert to a wetter, more biodiverse state."|2088|0
units.english: "I'm proposing crashing a medium-sized asteroid into the ice cap," she says. "If we pick the right asteroid, we can control the amount of dust that is created. The result will be a sudden influx of variability, that may allow the planet to revert to a wetter, more biodiverse state."
units.italian: "Propongo di far schiantare un asteroide di medie dimensioni sulla calotta polare," dice. "Se scegliamo l'asteroide giusto, possiamo controllare la quantità di polvere che si solleva. Il risultato sarà un'improvvisa ondata di variabilità, che potrebbe permettere al pianeta di tornare a uno stato più umido e più ricco di forme di vita."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|	"That is a stupid idea, and I want nothing to do with it."|2090|0
units.english: "That is a stupid idea, and I want nothing to do with it."
units.italian: "È un'idea stupida, e non voglio avere niente a che fare con questa storia."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|	"Well, if you think it will work, I'm willing to try it!"|2092|0
units.english: "Well, if you think it will work, I'm willing to try it!"
units.italian: "Beh, se pensi che funzionerà, sono disposto a provarci!"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|	"Great!" says Amy. "I'll mark the asteroid on your radar. You just need to board it, install a small ion thruster, and return here."|2093|0
units.english: "Great!" says Amy. "I'll mark the asteroid on your radar. You just need to board it, install a small ion thruster, and return here."
units.italian: "Ottimo!" dice Amy. "Ti segnerò l'asteroide sul radar. Devi solo abbordarlo, installare un piccolo propulsore a ioni e tornare qui."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|	Eric contacts some spaceport workers and has them load a small thruster onto your ship, along with the equipment you will need to mount it on the asteroid.|2094|0
units.english: Eric contacts some spaceport workers and has them load a small thruster onto your ship, along with the equipment you will need to mount it on the asteroid.
units.italian: Eric contatta alcuni operai dello spazioporto e fa caricare sulla tua nave un piccolo propulsore, insieme all'attrezzatura che ti servirà per montarlo sull'asteroide.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|dialog|2103|0
units.english: You return to the spaceport to the confused looks of Eric, Alaric, and Amy. "You didn't put the thrusters on the asteroid," Amy says. "Just board the asteroid to attach the thrusters." Amy begins pushing you back to your ship, clearly eager to see the results of this experiment.
units.italian: Torni allo spazioporto sotto gli sguardi confusi di Eric, Alaric e Amy. "Non hai messo i propulsori sull'asteroide," dice Amy. "Abborda l'asteroide e basta, per attaccare i propulsori." Amy comincia a spingerti verso la tua nave, chiaramente impaziente di vedere i risultati dell'esperimento.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|log|2106|0
units.english: Agreed with Amy's idea to steer an asteroid into Rand's polar ice cap in order to change the planet's climate. Hopefully this ends well.
units.italian: Ho accettato l'idea di Amy di guidare un asteroide contro la calotta polare di Rand per cambiare il clima del pianeta. Speriamo che finisca bene.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 3|When you land, the sky already seems noticeably darker than before. Eric runs up to your ship. "You did it!" he says, excited. "A perfect hit. Now we just have to wait and see what the results are. Meet us in the spaceport bar again in a few hours, and Amy will have her initial measurements ready." He hands you a credit chip for <payment>.|2108|0
units.english: When you land, the sky already seems noticeably darker than before. Eric runs up to your ship. "You did it!" he says, excited. "A perfect hit. Now we just have to wait and see what the results are. Meet us in the spaceport bar again in a few hours, and Amy will have her initial measurements ready." He hands you a credit chip for <payment>.
units.italian: Quando atterri, il cielo sembra già visibilmente più scuro di prima. Eric corre verso la tua nave. "Ce l'hai fatta!" dice, eccitato. "Un colpo perfetto. Ora non ci resta che aspettare e vedere che risultati dà. Ripassaci a trovare nel bar dello spazioporto fra qualche ora, e Amy avrà pronti i primi rilevamenti." Ti porge un chip di credito da <payment>.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 4|name|2113|0
units.english: Terraforming Rand
units.italian: Terraformare Rand

units.id: mission:Terraforming 4|description|2114|0
units.english: Bring Amy to <destination> to collect some hardy plants that can grow in a low-light environment.
units.italian: Porta Amy su <destination> per raccogliere alcune piante resistenti che crescono con poca luce.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 4|By the time you meet up with Eric, Alaric, and Amy, the cloud cover already seems to have visibly increased. Amy is very enthusiastic. "Atmospheric water vapor is on the rise," she says. "The impact vaporized enough ice to form a small ocean. I wouldn't be surprised if we get a rainstorm here in a day or two."|2123|0
units.english: By the time you meet up with Eric, Alaric, and Amy, the cloud cover already seems to have visibly increased. Amy is very enthusiastic. "Atmospheric water vapor is on the rise," she says. "The impact vaporized enough ice to form a small ocean. I wouldn't be surprised if we get a rainstorm here in a day or two."
units.italian: Quando ti incontri con Eric, Alaric e Amy, la copertura nuvolosa sembra già aumentata visibilmente. Amy è entusiasta. "Il vapore acqueo nell'atmosfera sta aumentando," dice. "L'impatto ha vaporizzato abbastanza ghiaccio da formare un piccolo oceano. Non mi stupirei se fra un giorno o due arrivasse un temporale."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 4|	"What's next?" you ask.|2124|0
units.english: "What's next?" you ask.
units.italian: "E adesso?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 4|	She says, "I'd like to travel with you to <planet>, and collect some seeds and cuttings from plants that can handle a cooler world with dimmer light, since that's what we'll have here until the dust settles down. I'd say we'll need about ten tons of cargo space."|2125|0
units.english: She says, "I'd like to travel with you to <planet>, and collect some seeds and cuttings from plants that can handle a cooler world with dimmer light, since that's what we'll have here until the dust settles down. I'd say we'll need about ten tons of cargo space."
units.italian: Dice: "Vorrei viaggiare con te fino a <planet> e raccogliere semi e talee di piante capaci di vivere su un mondo più freddo e con meno luce, visto che sarà così qui finché la polvere non si depositerà. Direi che ci serviranno una decina di tonnellate di spazio di carico."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 4|	"I'd be glad to take you there."|2127|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to take you there."
units.italian: "Sarei lieto di portarti là."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 4|	"Sorry, I need to move on to some other work now."|2129|0
units.english: "Sorry, I need to move on to some other work now."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ora devo passare ad altro lavoro."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 4|dialog|2133|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Amy hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con a bordo Amy non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 4|dialog|2135|0
units.english: As soon as you land, Amy heads off to meet with some local biologists who she contacted during the trip over here. "We'll be back in the spaceport in two hours," she says. "Be sure to have ten tons of cargo space free."
units.italian: Appena atterri, Amy si allontana per incontrare alcuni biologi del posto che aveva contattato durante il viaggio. "Torniamo allo spazioporto fra due ore," dice. "Assicurati di avere dieci tonnellate di spazio di carico libere."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|name|2140|0
units.english: Terraforming Rand
units.italian: Terraformare Rand

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|description|2141|0
units.english: Bring Amy and <tons> of hardy plants that can grow in a low-light environment back to <destination>.
units.italian: Riporta Amy e <tons> di piante resistenti, capaci di crescere con poca luce, su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|You meet up with Amy, and load the seeds and plant cuttings onto your ship.|2151|0
units.english: You meet up with Amy, and load the seeds and plant cuttings onto your ship.
units.italian: Ti incontri con Amy e carichi i semi e le talee sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|	"Looks good, let's head back to Rand."|2153|0
units.english: "Looks good, let's head back to Rand."
units.italian: "Bene, torniamo su Rand."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|	"So, how do you plan to seed the whole planet with these, anyway?"|2155|0
units.english: "So, how do you plan to seed the whole planet with these, anyway?"
units.italian: "E come pensi di seminare tutto il pianeta con queste piante?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|	She says, "My idea is to just disperse them in a few different locations, and trust that they will spread out over the next decade or so. We picked plants that are hardy and can spread very rapidly."|2156|0
units.english: She says, "My idea is to just disperse them in a few different locations, and trust that they will spread out over the next decade or so. We picked plants that are hardy and can spread very rapidly."
units.italian: Dice: "L'idea è spargerle in qualche punto diverso e confidare che si diffondano nei prossimi dieci anni o giù di lì. Abbiamo scelto piante resistenti e capaci di propagarsi molto in fretta."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|	"Sounds good to me."|2158|0
units.english: "Sounds good to me."
units.italian: "Mi sembra una buona idea."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|	"What happens if the plants are too invasive, and choke out all the local wildlife?"|2160|0
units.english: "What happens if the plants are too invasive, and choke out all the local wildlife?"
units.italian: "Che succede se le piante sono troppo invasive e soffocano tutta la fauna locale?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|	"Well," she says, "in order to keep the climate on <planet> dynamic, they're going to need regular asteroid impacts every few decades. If these plants are too invasive, they can just wait an extra decade or so in between impacts and let the desert creep back in and kill off the invasive plants."|2161|0
units.english: "Well," she says, "in order to keep the climate on <planet> dynamic, they're going to need regular asteroid impacts every few decades. If these plants are too invasive, they can just wait an extra decade or so in between impacts and let the desert creep back in and kill off the invasive plants."
units.italian: "Beh," dice, "per mantenere dinamico il clima su <planet>, avranno bisogno di impatti di asteroidi a cadenza regolare, ogni qualche decennio. Se queste piante sono troppo invasive, basta aspettare un decennio in più fra un impatto e l'altro e lasciare che il deserto riconquisti terreno e uccida le piante invasive."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|	"Okay, I guess that would work."|2163|0
units.english: "Okay, I guess that would work."
units.italian: "Va bene, immagino che potrebbe funzionare."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|	"Wait, they're going to have to keep smashing asteroids into their world in perpetuity to maintain the new environment?"|2165|0
units.english: "Wait, they're going to have to keep smashing asteroids into their world in perpetuity to maintain the new environment?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, dovranno continuare a far schiantare asteroidi sul loro mondo in eterno per mantenere il nuovo ambiente?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|	"For a century or so, yes," she says. "But that's a whole lot more economical than vaporizing the ice caps using traditional terraforming equipment. Come on, let's get back to <planet>."|2166|0
units.english: "For a century or so, yes," she says. "But that's a whole lot more economical than vaporizing the ice caps using traditional terraforming equipment. Come on, let's get back to <planet>."
units.italian: "Per un secolo circa, sì," dice. "Ma è molto più economico che vaporizzare le calotte con le attrezzature tradizionali per la terraformazione. Su, torniamo su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|dialog|2170|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Amy and the seeds hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con a bordo Amy e i semi non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|log|2174|0
units.english: Amy's theory to terraform Rand seems to have worked. Precipitation around the planet has greatly increased with the introduction of new water into the water cycle.
units.italian: La teoria di Amy per terraformare Rand sembra aver funzionato. Le precipitazioni sul pianeta sono molto aumentate con l'immissione di nuova acqua nel ciclo.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|When you get back to <planet>, Amy has you fly in a random path a few kilometers above the surface while she periodically dumps loads of seeds and plant material out the airlock. In the process, you fly through several rainstorms. This world's climate has indeed been altered. But you can't help wonder how a few tons of seed spread out over the entire surface of a planet is really going to help anything.|2176|0
units.english: When you get back to <planet>, Amy has you fly in a random path a few kilometers above the surface while she periodically dumps loads of seeds and plant material out the airlock. In the process, you fly through several rainstorms. This world's climate has indeed been altered. But you can't help wonder how a few tons of seed spread out over the entire surface of a planet is really going to help anything.
units.italian: Quando torni su <planet>, Amy ti fa volare lungo un percorso casuale a qualche chilometro dalla superficie mentre lei, a intervalli, scarica carichi di semi e materiale vegetale dalla camera stagna. Nel frattempo attraversi diversi temporali. Il clima di questo mondo è davvero cambiato. Ma non puoi fare a meno di chiederti come qualche tonnellata di semi sparsa su tutta la superficie di un pianeta possa servire davvero a qualcosa.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|	Then you meet up with Eric and Alaric. Eric is elated. "We just got a massive rainstorm here!" he says. "We haven't had that much precipitation in a decade!"|2177|0
units.english: Then you meet up with Eric and Alaric. Eric is elated. "We just got a massive rainstorm here!" he says. "We haven't had that much precipitation in a decade!"
units.italian: Poi ti incontri con Eric e Alaric. Eric è raggiante. "Qui è appena arrivato un temporale violentissimo!" dice. "Non avevamo così tante precipitazioni da un decennio!"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|	Alaric is less enthusiastic. "Flash floods washed out the road through the canyon," he says, "and very nearly flooded one of the mines, too."|2178|0
units.english: Alaric is less enthusiastic. "Flash floods washed out the road through the canyon," he says, "and very nearly flooded one of the mines, too."
units.italian: Alaric è meno entusiasta. "Le inondazioni improvvise hanno spazzato via la strada che attraversa il canyon," dice, "e hanno quasi allagato una delle miniere."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|	Amy says, "It will take a year or two for things to begin to settle down. Then we can figure out what our next steps should be."|2179|0
units.english: Amy says, "It will take a year or two for things to begin to settle down. Then we can figure out what our next steps should be."
units.italian: Amy dice: "Ci vorranno un anno o due perché le cose comincino a stabilizzarsi. Poi potremo capire quali sono i prossimi passi."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 5|	"I just hope we haven't made things worse than they were," says Alaric. He hands you your payment of <payment>. "Anyway, thanks for your help, <first>. It sounds like there's nothing more to be done here for the time being."|2180|0
units.english: "I just hope we haven't made things worse than they were," says Alaric. He hands you your payment of <payment>. "Anyway, thanks for your help, <first>. It sounds like there's nothing more to be done here for the time being."
units.italian: "Spero solo che non abbiamo peggiorato le cose," dice Alaric. Ti consegna il compenso di <payment>. "Comunque grazie per l'aiuto, <first>. Sembra che per ora non ci sia altro da fare qui."

units.id: event:terraforming Rand|add|2187|0
units.english: Recent terraforming experiments have caused an increase in precipitation. Flash floods have scoured the landscape in some areas, but sandstorms are also less frequent, and the locals say the heat is a bit less oppressive than it used to be.
units.italian: I recenti esperimenti di terraformazione hanno fatto aumentare le precipitazioni. In alcune zone le inondazioni improvvise hanno eroso il paesaggio, ma anche le tempeste di sabbia sono meno frequenti, e la gente del posto dice che il caldo è un po' meno opprimente di un tempo.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|name|2193|0
units.english: Unlawful Use of an Asteroid
units.italian: Uso illecito di un asteroide

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|description|2194|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> by <date> for questioning on your "unlawful use of an asteroid."
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> entro <date> per essere interrogato sul tuo "uso illecito di un asteroide".

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|When you land on <origin> and exit your ship, you are stopped by a Navy officer with a group of guards. "Captain <last>. You are wanted for..." The officer pauses and looks down at the tablet in his hand. "The 'unlawful use of an asteroid.' You are to travel to <destination> immediately for questioning."|2212|0
units.english: When you land on <origin> and exit your ship, you are stopped by a Navy officer with a group of guards. "Captain <last>. You are wanted for..." The officer pauses and looks down at the tablet in his hand. "The 'unlawful use of an asteroid.' You are to travel to <destination> immediately for questioning."
units.italian: Quando atterri su <origin> ed esci dalla nave, ti ferma un ufficiale della Marina con un gruppo di guardie. "Capitano <last>. È ricercato per..." L'ufficiale si interrompe e guarda il tablet che ha in mano. "Per l'uso illecito di un asteroide. Deve raggiungere subito <destination> per l'interrogatorio."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|	"Understood, officer."|2214|0
units.english: "Understood, officer."
units.italian: "Ho capito, ufficiale."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|	"I'm wanted for what?"|2216|0
units.english: "I'm wanted for what?"
units.italian: "Sono ricercato per che cosa?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|	(Run away.)|2217|0
units.english: (Run away.)
units.italian: (Scappa.)

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|	"The unlawful use of an asteroid, Captain. I'm not entirely sure what that means, but I've been told to send you to <planet> by <day>. Your compliance would be much appreciated."|2220|0
units.english: "The unlawful use of an asteroid, Captain. I'm not entirely sure what that means, but I've been told to send you to <planet> by <day>. Your compliance would be much appreciated."
units.italian: "Per l'uso illecito di un asteroide, Capitano. Non sono del tutto sicuro di cosa significhi, ma mi è stato ordinato di mandarla su <planet> entro <day>. La sua collaborazione sarebbe molto apprezzata."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|	"Alright. Hopefully I can get an answer as to what this is about."|2222|0
units.english: "Alright. Hopefully I can get an answer as to what this is about."
units.italian: "Va bene. Spero di riuscire a capire di che cosa si tratta."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|	(Run away.)|2224|0
units.english: (Run away.)
units.italian: (Scappa.)

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|dialog|2231|0
units.english: You receive a message from the Republic itself. "Captain <last>. You have not arrived on Earth for your trial on the 'unlawful use of an asteroid' in the time provided to you and therefore are now a criminal of the Republic."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio dalla Repubblica stessa. "Capitano <last>. Non si è presentato sulla Terra per il processo sull'uso illecito di un asteroide entro il termine che Le era stato concesso, e pertanto è ora un criminale della Repubblica."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|log|2233|0
units.english: Had to travel to Earth to answer for crashing an asteroid into Rand. Luckily, thanks to Alaric and Eric's lawyer, the case was dropped.
units.italian: Ho dovuto raggiungere la Terra per rispondere di aver fatto schiantare un asteroide su Rand. Per fortuna, grazie all'avvocato di Alaric e Eric, il caso è stato archiviato.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|You are quickly escorted from the crowded <planet> spaceport to a court building in a wealthy district of the city and asked multiple questions pertaining to the events on Rand. "Why did you purposefully crash an asteroid into a planet? What did you expect to happen? Do you know how many people could have died?" You answer to the best of your ability, and after roughly an hour of questioning you are transferred to a different room where you find Eric, Alaric, and Amy.|2235|0
units.english: You are quickly escorted from the crowded <planet> spaceport to a court building in a wealthy district of the city and asked multiple questions pertaining to the events on Rand. "Why did you purposefully crash an asteroid into a planet? What did you expect to happen? Do you know how many people could have died?" You answer to the best of your ability, and after roughly an hour of questioning you are transferred to a different room where you find Eric, Alaric, and Amy.
units.italian: Vieni rapidamente scortato dall'affollato spazioporto di <planet> a un tribunale in un quartiere ricco della città, e ti vengono rivolte molte domande sugli eventi di Rand. "Perché hai fatto schiantare di proposito un asteroide su un pianeta? Cosa pensavi che sarebbe successo? Sai quante persone sarebbero potute morire?" Rispondi come puoi, e dopo circa un'ora di domande vieni portato in un'altra stanza dove trovi Eric, Alaric e Amy.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|	"What are we going to do?"|2237|0
units.english: "What are we going to do?"
units.italian: "Che cosa facciamo?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|	"Do you know what we're doing here?"|2239|0
units.english: "Do you know what we're doing here?"
units.italian: "Sai che cosa ci facciamo qui?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|	"Apparently someone had a problem with us terraforming Rand," Amy says, looking rather disappointed.|2241|0
units.english: "Apparently someone had a problem with us terraforming Rand," Amy says, looking rather disappointed.
units.italian: "A quanto pare qualcuno ha avuto da ridire sulla nostra terraformazione di Rand," dice Amy, con aria piuttosto delusa.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|	"Don't worry," Alaric says. "Our lawyer is on his way right now. We'll all be out of here by the end of the day."|2244|0
units.english: "Don't worry," Alaric says. "Our lawyer is on his way right now. We'll all be out of here by the end of the day."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti," dice Alaric. "Il nostro avvocato sta arrivando. Ce ne andremo tutti da qui entro fine giornata."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|	Alaric's optimism turns out to be justified, as the lawyer quickly finds that there are no actual laws on the books that define lawful or unlawful uses of an asteroid. Since no one was hurt by the asteroid impact and data that Amy had been collecting shows that Rand's climate has changed for the better so far, the case is quickly dropped and you are escorted back to your ship.|2245|0
units.english: Alaric's optimism turns out to be justified, as the lawyer quickly finds that there are no actual laws on the books that define lawful or unlawful uses of an asteroid. Since no one was hurt by the asteroid impact and data that Amy had been collecting shows that Rand's climate has changed for the better so far, the case is quickly dropped and you are escorted back to your ship.
units.italian: L'ottimismo di Alaric si rivela fondato: l'avvocato scopre in fretta che non esistono leggi che definiscano l'uso lecito o illecito di un asteroide. Dato che nessuno è rimasto ferito dall'impatto e che i dati raccolti da Amy mostrano che finora il clima di Rand è migliorato, il caso viene archiviato rapidamente e vieni riaccompagnato alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 6|	Before you are able to leave, Amy stops you. "Could you meet me in the spaceport bar, Captain? I have some good news to share with you."|2246|0
units.english: Before you are able to leave, Amy stops you. "Could you meet me in the spaceport bar, Captain? I have some good news to share with you."
units.italian: Prima che tu possa andartene, Amy ti ferma. "Capitano, puoi raggiungermi nel bar dello spazioporto? Ho una buona notizia da darti."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|name|2251|0
units.english: Terraforming Research
units.italian: Ricerca sulla terraformazione

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|description|2252|0
units.english: Bring Amy and Nolan to <destination>, where they will research and publish Amy's terraforming methods.
units.italian: Porta Amy e Nolan su <destination>, dove studieranno e pubblicheranno i metodi di terraformazione di Amy.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|blocked|2256|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai liberato lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|You find Amy in heated discussion with someone about her academy project, "Affordable Terraforming through Equilibrium Mapping." She takes a sip of her drink and invites you to sit down with them.|2262|0
units.english: You find Amy in heated discussion with someone about her academy project, "Affordable Terraforming through Equilibrium Mapping." She takes a sip of her drink and invites you to sit down with them.
units.italian: Trovi Amy che discute animatamente con qualcuno del suo progetto accademico, "Terraformazione a basso costo mediante mappatura degli equilibri". Prende un sorso dalla sua bevanda e ti invita a sederti con loro.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|	"Hello, Captain! This is Nolan. He works in the Deep's Department of Terraforming Research and Application, and he contacted me after hearing about how we started terraforming Rand."|2263|0
units.english: "Hello, Captain! This is Nolan. He works in the Deep's Department of Terraforming Research and Application, and he contacted me after hearing about how we started terraforming Rand."
units.italian: "Salve, Capitano! Lui è Nolan. Lavora al Dipartimento di ricerca e applicazione della terraformazione del Deep, e mi ha contattato dopo aver sentito come abbiamo iniziato a terraformare Rand."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|	Nolan outstretches his hand to you. "Nice to meet you, Captain."|2264|0
units.english: Nolan outstretches his hand to you. "Nice to meet you, Captain."
units.italian: Nolan ti tende la mano. "Piacere di conoscerla, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|	"Nice to meet you too."|2266|0
units.english: "Nice to meet you too."
units.italian: "Piacere mio."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|	"I take it you're interested in Amy's ideas."|2268|0
units.english: "I take it you're interested in Amy's ideas."
units.italian: "Immagino che le idee di Amy ti interessino."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|	"Absolutely. It's an extraordinary concept, and no offense to you Amy, but it's spectacular that someone of such little experience would imagine such a method of terraforming."|2270|0
units.english: "Absolutely. It's an extraordinary concept, and no offense to you Amy, but it's spectacular that someone of such little experience would imagine such a method of terraforming."
units.italian: "Assolutamente. È un concetto straordinario, e senza offesa, Amy, è straordinario che qualcuno con così poca esperienza abbia immaginato un metodo di terraformazione del genere."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|	Amy continues. "Nolan wants to help pursue research of my terraforming techniques. Would you be able to give us a lift to <destination>? I'll pay you <payment>."|2273|0
units.english: Amy continues. "Nolan wants to help pursue research of my terraforming techniques. Would you be able to give us a lift to <destination>? I'll pay you <payment>."
units.italian: Amy continua. "Nolan vuole aiutare a portare avanti la ricerca sulle mie tecniche di terraformazione. Potresti darci un passaggio fino a <destination>? Ti pagherò <payment>."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|	"Sure, I'd be glad to take you there."|2275|0
units.english: "Sure, I'd be glad to take you there."
units.italian: "Certo, sarei lieto di portarvi là."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|	"Sorry, I have other places to be."|2277|0
units.english: "Sorry, I have other places to be."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ho altri posti dove devo andare."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|dialog|2281|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Amy and Nolan hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con a bordo Amy e Nolan non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|log|2285|0
units.english: Amy has been noticed by the Deep's Department of Terraforming Research. She will be spending time researching her terraforming theories in the hopes that there are more worlds that can be helped.
units.italian: Amy è stata notata dal Dipartimento di ricerca sulla terraformazione del Deep. Passerà del tempo a studiare le sue teorie, nella speranza che ci siano altri mondi che si possono aiutare.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 7|dialog|2286|0
units.english: The whole journey to <planet>, Amy and Nolan discussed the multiple planets within the Dirt Belt that would be perfect candidates for terraforming. "Nolan and I will spend the next few months here researching my theories," Amy says as she steps off of your ship. "I'll make sure to contact you once we're ready to try terraforming another planet." She hands you <payment>, then follows Nolan out of the spaceport.
units.italian: Durante tutto il viaggio verso <planet>, Amy e Nolan hanno discusso dei molti pianeti della Dirt Belt che sarebbero candidati perfetti per la terraformazione. "Nolan e io passeremo i prossimi mesi qui a studiare le mie teorie," dice Amy scendendo dalla tua nave. "Ti contatterò appena saremo pronti a provare a terraformare un altro pianeta." Ti consegna <payment>, poi segue Nolan fuori dallo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 8|name|2294|0
units.english: Terraforming Research
units.italian: Ricerca sulla terraformazione

units.id: mission:Terraforming 8|description|2295|0
units.english: Meet with Amy and Nolan on <destination> to talk about experimentally terraforming another planet.
units.italian: Incontra Amy e Nolan su <destination> per parlare di una terraformazione sperimentale su un altro pianeta.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 8|dialog|2303|0
units.english: You receive a message from Amy: "Hello, Captain <last>. I just wanted to tell you that Nolan and I have recently published our work on 'Reducing Terraforming Expenses Through Equilibrium Mapping,' and we've received a grant from the Deep for it! We're going to begin experiments with terraforming on a different world. Don't worry, the Republic has approved our experiment this time, so we won't get dragged off for any more cases of an 'unlawful use of an asteroid.' If you're interested in helping, pick us up on <destination>."
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio da Amy: "Salve, Capitano <last>. Volevo solo dirle che Nolan e io abbiamo appena pubblicato il nostro lavoro su 'Ridurre i costi della terraformazione con la mappatura degli equilibri', e abbiamo ricevuto un finanziamento dal Deep! Cominceremo gli esperimenti di terraformazione su un altro mondo. Non si preoccupi, questa volta la Repubblica ha approvato il nostro esperimento, quindi non ci trascineranno più in tribunale per un uso illecito di un asteroide. Se Le interessa aiutare, ci venga a prendere su <destination>."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 9|name|2309|0
units.english: Terraforming Tundra
units.italian: Terraformare Tundra

units.id: mission:Terraforming 9|description|2310|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> with Amy, Nolan, and four others.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> con Amy, Nolan e altre quattro persone.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 9|blocked|2315|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai liberato lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 9|The spaceport is crowded with ships and people when you land. Amy's publication must have stirred up quite the commotion among terraforming scientists.|2321|0
units.english: The spaceport is crowded with ships and people when you land. Amy's publication must have stirred up quite the commotion among terraforming scientists.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto è affollato di navi e di gente quando atterri. La pubblicazione di Amy deve aver suscitato un bel trambusto fra gli scienziati della terraformazione.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 9|	Spaceport security clears a path to your ship for Amy, Nolan, and four people you do not recognize. You notice that a few among the crowd of people are jeering and holding signs, one reading "Don't asteroid my planet!" and a half-eaten sandwich gets thrown in Amy's path as she approaches.|2322|0
units.english: Spaceport security clears a path to your ship for Amy, Nolan, and four people you do not recognize. You notice that a few among the crowd of people are jeering and holding signs, one reading "Don't asteroid my planet!" and a half-eaten sandwich gets thrown in Amy's path as she approaches.
units.italian: La sicurezza dello spazioporto apre un varco verso la tua nave per Amy, Nolan e quattro persone che non riconosci. Noti che alcuni nella folla gridano insulti e tengono dei cartelli, uno dei quali recita "Non asteroidate il mio pianeta!", e un panino mezzo mangiato viene lanciato sul percorso di Amy mentre si avvicina.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 9|	"Not everyone is as happy with the prospect of affordable terraforming as we are," Amy says to you as she boards your ship along with suitcases full of scientific supplies. "But that's no reason to stop, now is it?"|2323|0
units.english: "Not everyone is as happy with the prospect of affordable terraforming as we are," Amy says to you as she boards your ship along with suitcases full of scientific supplies. "But that's no reason to stop, now is it?"
units.italian: "Non tutti sono contenti come noi all'idea di una terraformazione a basso costo," ti dice Amy mentre sale sulla tua nave con valigie piene di materiale scientifico. "Ma non è un buon motivo per fermarsi, vero?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 9|	Amy introduces you to the four others that she brought on board. Two of them are terraforming experts who helped Amy and Nolan with their research. The other two are representatives: one sent by the Republic Parliament in order to oversee the project, and another from Tundra.|2324|0
units.english: Amy introduces you to the four others that she brought on board. Two of them are terraforming experts who helped Amy and Nolan with their research. The other two are representatives: one sent by the Republic Parliament in order to oversee the project, and another from Tundra.
units.italian: Amy ti presenta le altre quattro persone che ha portato a bordo. Due sono esperti di terraformazione che hanno aiutato Amy e Nolan nella ricerca. Gli altri due sono rappresentanti: uno inviato dal Parlamento della Repubblica per seguire il progetto, e uno di Tundra.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 9|	"Once you're ready, Captain, please bring us to <destination>. Tundra was a tropical world millions of years ago, but became cold after a cataclysmic event of some sort. There's a good chance that we may be able to nudge the planet back toward a warmer climate if we do this right."|2325|0
units.english: "Once you're ready, Captain, please bring us to <destination>. Tundra was a tropical world millions of years ago, but became cold after a cataclysmic event of some sort. There's a good chance that we may be able to nudge the planet back toward a warmer climate if we do this right."
units.italian: "Quando sei pronto, Capitano, portaci su <destination>. Tundra era un mondo tropicale milioni di anni fa, ma è diventato freddo dopo un qualche evento cataclismico. Ci sono buone probabilità che possiamo riportare il pianeta verso un clima più caldo, se facciamo le cose per bene."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 9|dialog|2329|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the scientists and their equipment hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con a bordo gli scienziati e la loro attrezzatura non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 9|The journey to Tundra was spent by your passengers discussing the possible methods of terraforming the planet. The Republic representative was none too pleased when Nolan, perhaps jokingly, suggested crashing an asteroid into it.|2332|0
units.english: The journey to Tundra was spent by your passengers discussing the possible methods of terraforming the planet. The Republic representative was none too pleased when Nolan, perhaps jokingly, suggested crashing an asteroid into it.
units.italian: Il viaggio verso Tundra è stato speso dai tuoi passeggeri a discutere dei possibili metodi per terraformare il pianeta. Il rappresentante della Repubblica non è stato affatto contento quando Nolan, forse scherzando, ha suggerito di farci schiantare un asteroide.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 9|	Everyone except for the Tundra native begins to shiver after stepping out of your ship onto the planet, even while inside a protective dome. "Meet us in the spaceport bar in a few hours. We need to finalize our plans of how we're going to execute this experiment."|2333|0
units.english: Everyone except for the Tundra native begins to shiver after stepping out of your ship onto the planet, even while inside a protective dome. "Meet us in the spaceport bar in a few hours. We need to finalize our plans of how we're going to execute this experiment."
units.italian: Tutti tranne il nativo di Tundra cominciano a tremare appena escono dalla nave sul pianeta, anche all'interno di una cupola protettiva. "Ci vediamo fra qualche ora nel bar dello spazioporto. Dobbiamo definire i nostri piani su come eseguire questo esperimento."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|name|2338|0
units.english: Terraforming Tundra
units.italian: Terraformare Tundra

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|description|2339|0
units.english: Bring the Republic representative overseeing the terraforming project to <destination>, where he will attempt to find an alternative solution to terraforming Tundra that does not involve an asteroid.
units.italian: Porta il rappresentante della Repubblica che segue il progetto di terraformazione su <destination>, dove cercherà una soluzione alternativa per terraformare Tundra che non preveda un asteroide.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|log|2347|0
units.english: Began the process of trying to terraform Tundra with new research from Amy and Nolan. Nolan has suggested that another asteroid be used, but the representative for the Republic overseeing the project is displeased with this approach.
units.italian: Ho iniziato il processo per cercare di terraformare Tundra con le nuove ricerche di Amy e Nolan. Nolan ha suggerito di usare un altro asteroide, ma il rappresentante della Repubblica che segue il progetto disapprova questo approccio.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|Amy, Nolan, and the other two scientists tell you the known history of Tundra's climate. Millions of years ago, an asteroid impact or large volcanic eruption altered the planet's atmosphere. Now, the planet no longer retains enough heat from its host star in order to stay warm.|2349|0
units.english: Amy, Nolan, and the other two scientists tell you the known history of Tundra's climate. Millions of years ago, an asteroid impact or large volcanic eruption altered the planet's atmosphere. Now, the planet no longer retains enough heat from its host star in order to stay warm.
units.italian: Amy, Nolan e gli altri due scienziati ti raccontano la storia nota del clima di Tundra. Milioni di anni fa, un impatto di asteroide o una grande eruzione vulcanica alterò l'atmosfera del pianeta. Ora il pianeta non trattiene più abbastanza calore dalla sua stella per restare caldo.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	"Tundra's snow covered surface only exacerbates the problem, reflecting most of the star's light back into space," Nolan explains. "This means that we need to both alter the atmosphere in order for it to retain more heat and alter the surface in order for it to reflect less heat."|2350|0
units.english: "Tundra's snow covered surface only exacerbates the problem, reflecting most of the star's light back into space," Nolan explains. "This means that we need to both alter the atmosphere in order for it to retain more heat and alter the surface in order for it to reflect less heat."
units.italian: "La superficie innevata di Tundra non fa che peggiorare il problema, riflettendo gran parte della luce della stella nello spazio," spiega Nolan. "Questo significa che dobbiamo sia alterare l'atmosfera perché trattenga più calore, sia alterare la superficie perché ne rifletta meno."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	Amy rolls out a map of the entire planet onto the table. Different regions of the surface are color coded, and a large red spot in the planet's southern hemisphere sticks out to you.|2351|0
units.english: Amy rolls out a map of the entire planet onto the table. Different regions of the surface are color coded, and a large red spot in the planet's southern hemisphere sticks out to you.
units.italian: Amy stende sul tavolo una mappa dell'intero pianeta. Le diverse regioni della superficie sono codificate a colori, e una grande macchia rossa nell'emisfero meridionale attira la tua attenzione.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	"Tundra has very low volcanic activity, but seismic mapping has led us to this area." Amy circles the red spot with her finger. "Magma from the planet's mantle is building up under this area of the crust, which, lucky for us, is unusually thin. Still, it could be another ten thousand years before the magma builds up enough pressure under the surface to cause a supereruption, melting the snow around it and releasing greenhouse gases into the atmosphere that over time will raise the global temperatures."|2352|0
units.english: "Tundra has very low volcanic activity, but seismic mapping has led us to this area." Amy circles the red spot with her finger. "Magma from the planet's mantle is building up under this area of the crust, which, lucky for us, is unusually thin. Still, it could be another ten thousand years before the magma builds up enough pressure under the surface to cause a supereruption, melting the snow around it and releasing greenhouse gases into the atmosphere that over time will raise the global temperatures."
units.italian: "Tundra ha un'attività vulcanica molto bassa, ma la mappatura sismica ci ha portato in questa zona." Amy circonda la macchia rossa con il dito. "Il magma del mantello si sta accumulando sotto questa area della crosta, che per nostra fortuna è insolitamente sottile. Può comunque volerci un altro diecimila anni prima che il magma raggiunga una pressione sufficiente a provocare una supereruzione, sciogliendo la neve intorno e liberando nell'atmosfera gas serra che col tempo alzeranno la temperatura globale."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	"So are we going to wait ten thousand years for it to erupt?"|2354|0
units.english: "So are we going to wait ten thousand years for it to erupt?"
units.italian: "E allora aspettiamo diecimila anni che erutti?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	"How does this help our situation?"|2355|0
units.english: "How does this help our situation?"
units.italian: "In che modo questo ci aiuta?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	The Republic representative scoffs at your comment. "If we were then we wouldn't be here, now would we, Captain?"|2358|0
units.english: The Republic representative scoffs at your comment. "If we were then we wouldn't be here, now would we, Captain?"
