units.italian: Il rappresentante della Repubblica sbuffa alla tua osservazione. "Se dovessimo aspettare, non saremmo qui, non crede, Capitano?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	One of the other scientists responds, "What we plan to do is encourage the eruption of this volcano by making the crust above the volcano thinner. When the pressure of the magma is able to overcome the pressure of the crust, an eruption will occur."|2361|0
units.english: One of the other scientists responds, "What we plan to do is encourage the eruption of this volcano by making the crust above the volcano thinner. When the pressure of the magma is able to overcome the pressure of the crust, an eruption will occur."
units.italian: Risponde uno degli altri scienziati: "Quello che vogliamo fare è favorire l'eruzione di questo vulcano rendendo più sottile la crosta sopra di esso. Quando la pressione del magma riuscirà a vincere quella della crosta, ci sarà un'eruzione."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	"How exactly do you plan to do that?" the Tundra representative responds. "And what will happen to the people who live near that area?"|2362|0
units.english: "How exactly do you plan to do that?" the Tundra representative responds. "And what will happen to the people who live near that area?"
units.italian: "E come pensate di farlo, esattamente?" ribatte il rappresentante di Tundra. "E che ne sarà delle persone che vivono in quella zona?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	Nolan answers, "The people who live near the volcano will need to evacuate the area with all their belongings. The Republic should provide any assistance needed for the evacuation. As for how we will cause the volcano to erupt, we need something energetic enough to crack the planet's crust in the location of the volcano, releasing the pressure that the magma is causing to spark an eruption. That's where we bring in another asteroi--"|2363|0
units.english: Nolan answers, "The people who live near the volcano will need to evacuate the area with all their belongings. The Republic should provide any assistance needed for the evacuation. As for how we will cause the volcano to erupt, we need something energetic enough to crack the planet's crust in the location of the volcano, releasing the pressure that the magma is causing to spark an eruption. That's where we bring in another asteroi--"
units.italian: Nolan risponde: "Le persone che vivono vicino al vulcano dovranno evacuare la zona con tutti i loro averi. La Repubblica dovrebbe fornire tutto l'aiuto necessario per l'evacuazione. Quanto a come provocare l'eruzione, ci serve qualcosa di abbastanza energetico da incrinare la crosta del pianeta nel punto del vulcano, liberando la pressione che il magma sta accumulando e innescando l'eruzione. Ed è qui che entra in gioco un altro asteroi--"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	"No, no, no!" the Republic representative exclaims, cutting Nolan off mid-sentence. "The Republic will not gain a reputation for crashing asteroids into its own planets. The consequences of such an action could be disastrous should it go wrong! And in what way will this warm the planet when the resulting volcanic winter could last decades and only result in an even colder climate? Are you not even old enough to remember how a supereruption on Hope caused the evacuation of the entire planet? If the people of Tundra are this desperate to terraform their planet then normal techniques should be employed, none of this 'equilibrium mapping' nonsense."|2364|0
units.english: "No, no, no!" the Republic representative exclaims, cutting Nolan off mid-sentence. "The Republic will not gain a reputation for crashing asteroids into its own planets. The consequences of such an action could be disastrous should it go wrong! And in what way will this warm the planet when the resulting volcanic winter could last decades and only result in an even colder climate? Are you not even old enough to remember how a supereruption on Hope caused the evacuation of the entire planet? If the people of Tundra are this desperate to terraform their planet then normal techniques should be employed, none of this 'equilibrium mapping' nonsense."
units.italian: "No, no, no!" esclama il rappresentante della Repubblica, interrompendo Nolan a metà frase. "La Repubblica non si guadagnerà la fama di far schiantare asteroidi sui propri pianeti. Le conseguenze di un'azione del genere potrebbero essere disastrose, se andasse male! E in che modo questo riscalderebbe il pianeta, quando l'inverno vulcanico che ne seguirebbe potrebbe durare decenni e portare solo a un clima ancora più freddo? Non è nemmeno abbastanza vecchio da ricordare che una supereruzione su Hope ha costretto all'evacuazione l'intero pianeta? Se la gente di Tundra è così disperata da voler terraformare il proprio pianeta, si usino le tecniche normali, e basta con queste sciocchezze della 'mappatura degli equilibri'."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	"Sir," Amy speaks up with a stern tone of voice, "we have already been authorized by the Republic to undergo this terraforming experiment, so unless you have half a teraton of cheap explosives, we're going to need to use an asteroid. The volcanic winter can be easily avoided by having a fleet of freighters sweep the volcanic ash out of the atmosphere, meaning we'll get the benefits of the greenhouse gases without the detriments of volcanic ash reflecting Cebalrai's heat back into space. No one knew the volcano on Hope was going to erupt, but we can prepare for this eruption and take steps to mitigate the problems." Amy looks the representative straight in the eyes and smirks. "We're scientists, we have this handled."|2365|0
units.english: "Sir," Amy speaks up with a stern tone of voice, "we have already been authorized by the Republic to undergo this terraforming experiment, so unless you have half a teraton of cheap explosives, we're going to need to use an asteroid. The volcanic winter can be easily avoided by having a fleet of freighters sweep the volcanic ash out of the atmosphere, meaning we'll get the benefits of the greenhouse gases without the detriments of volcanic ash reflecting Cebalrai's heat back into space. No one knew the volcano on Hope was going to erupt, but we can prepare for this eruption and take steps to mitigate the problems." Amy looks the representative straight in the eyes and smirks. "We're scientists, we have this handled."
units.italian: "Signore," interviene Amy con voce severa, "la Repubblica ci ha già autorizzato a fare questo esperimento di terraformazione, quindi a meno che non abbia mezzo teratone di esplosivo a buon mercato, dovremo usare un asteroide. L'inverno vulcanico si può evitare facilmente facendo spazzare via la cenere dall'atmosfera da una flotta di mercantili: così avremo i benefici dei gas serra senza il danno della cenere che riflette nello spazio il calore di Cebalrai. Nessuno sapeva che il vulcano di Hope sarebbe eruttato, ma a questa eruzione possiamo prepararci e possiamo prendere provvedimenti per limitare i problemi." Amy guarda il rappresentante dritto negli occhi e sorride. "Siamo scienziati, sappiamo come gestirla."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	The representative falls silent. After a moment of thinking, he says "Captain, I need you to take me to Parliament. I may be able to authorize the use of explosives that should suffice, but it may not be as cheap as Ms. Amy is hoping. We're not about to turn asteroids into our single solution for everything."|2366|0
units.english: The representative falls silent. After a moment of thinking, he says "Captain, I need you to take me to Parliament. I may be able to authorize the use of explosives that should suffice, but it may not be as cheap as Ms. Amy is hoping. We're not about to turn asteroids into our single solution for everything."
units.italian: Il rappresentante tace. Dopo un momento di riflessione dice: "Capitano, devo chiederle di portarmi al Parlamento. Potrei riuscire ad autorizzare l'uso di esplosivi sufficienti, ma potrebbe non essere economico come spera la signorina Amy. Non stiamo per fare degli asteroidi la nostra unica soluzione per tutto."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	"I'll get my ship ready to launch."|2368|0
units.english: "I'll get my ship ready to launch."
units.italian: "Preparo la nave al decollo."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	"Sorry, I have other things I could be doing."|2369|0
units.english: "Sorry, I have other things I could be doing."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ho altre cose da fare."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|	The representative leaves the bar. "We'll wait here," Amy says to you. "I'll speak with the Tundra government about evacuating the area around where the impact site will be so that we can start when you get back."|2372|0
units.english: The representative leaves the bar. "We'll wait here," Amy says to you. "I'll speak with the Tundra government about evacuating the area around where the impact site will be so that we can start when you get back."
units.italian: Il rappresentante esce dal bar. "Noi aspettiamo qui," ti dice Amy. "Parlerò con il governo di Tundra dell'evacuazione della zona intorno al punto d'impatto, così potremo iniziare quando torni."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 10|dialog|2375|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying the representative hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con a bordo il rappresentante non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 11|name|2381|0
units.english: Terraforming Tundra
units.italian: Terraformare Tundra

units.id: mission:Terraforming 11|description|2382|0
units.english: Return to <destination> with the Republic representative.
units.italian: Torna su <destination> con il rappresentante della Repubblica.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 11|"Wait here," the Republic representative says curtly. Several hours later, he returns, not looking very happy. "What a waste of time. Parliament has declined my request. I don't much agree with this, but you will need to crash an asteroid into Tundra if you wish to achieve your goal." Before you ready for launch, you send a message to Amy and Nolan telling them that an asteroid will be used after all. You don't receive an immediate response.|2391|0
units.english: "Wait here," the Republic representative says curtly. Several hours later, he returns, not looking very happy. "What a waste of time. Parliament has declined my request. I don't much agree with this, but you will need to crash an asteroid into Tundra if you wish to achieve your goal." Before you ready for launch, you send a message to Amy and Nolan telling them that an asteroid will be used after all. You don't receive an immediate response.
units.italian: "Aspetta qui," dice seccamente il rappresentante della Repubblica. Diverse ore dopo torna, con un'aria tutt'altro che soddisfatta. "Che spreco di tempo. Il Parlamento ha respinto la mia richiesta. Non sono molto d'accordo, ma dovrete far schiantare un asteroide su Tundra se volete raggiungere il vostro obiettivo." Prima di prepararti al decollo, mandi un messaggio ad Amy e Nolan per dirgli che alla fine si userà un asteroide. Non ricevi risposta immediata.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 11|Your ship is targeted by pirate fleets when you enter the system. Before you engage, you receive a message from Amy.|2396|0
units.english: Your ship is targeted by pirate fleets when you enter the system. Before you engage, you receive a message from Amy.
units.italian: La tua nave viene presa di mira da flotte pirata quando entri nel sistema. Prima di attaccare battaglia, ricevi un messaggio da Amy.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 11|	"Captain, these pirate ships have been occupying the system for days. They must be taken out if we are to safely crash an asteroid into Tundra. If you aren't able to fight them, distract them until backup arrives."|2397|0
units.english: "Captain, these pirate ships have been occupying the system for days. They must be taken out if we are to safely crash an asteroid into Tundra. If you aren't able to fight them, distract them until backup arrives."
units.italian: "Capitano, queste navi pirata occupano il sistema da giorni. Devono essere eliminate se vogliamo far schiantare un asteroide su Tundra in sicurezza. Se non sei in grado di combatterle, distraile finché non arrivano i rinforzi."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 11|dialog|2399|0
units.english: You return to <planet>, but not all of the pirates have been fought off. They don't look like they're leaving any time soon either. Better depart and finish them off for good.
units.italian: Torni su <planet>, ma non tutti i pirati sono stati eliminati. E non sembrano intenzionati ad andarsene presto. Meglio ripartire e finirli per bene.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|name|2426|0
units.english: Terraforming Tundra
units.italian: Terraformare Tundra

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|description|2427|0
units.english: Plant a thruster on an asteroid to guide it into a collision with the dormant supervolcano on Tundra.
units.italian: Installa un propulsore su un asteroide per guidarlo a schiantarsi contro il supervulcano dormiente di Tundra.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|blocked|2430|0
units.english: You need <capacity> in order to take on the next mission. Return here when you have the required space free.
units.italian: Ti serve <capacity> per accettare la missione successiva. Torna qui quando avrai liberato lo spazio necessario.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|The pirates that occupied the system did not make an effort to land on Tundra, but they did harass any merchant ships that passed through the system. The government of Tundra pays you <payment> for helping in ridding the system of the pirates, a pleasantly unexpected reward.|2437|0
units.english: The pirates that occupied the system did not make an effort to land on Tundra, but they did harass any merchant ships that passed through the system. The government of Tundra pays you <payment> for helping in ridding the system of the pirates, a pleasantly unexpected reward.
units.italian: I pirati che occupavano il sistema non hanno cercato di atterrare su Tundra, ma hanno molestato tutte le navi mercantili che lo attraversavano. Il governo di Tundra ti paga <payment> per aver contribuito a liberare il sistema dai pirati: una ricompensa inattesa e gradita.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|	You gather with the scientists in the spaceport bar. The Tundra native informs you that all residents close enough to the volcano to be in danger have been evacuated. "All we need to do now is find the right asteroid," Amy says, and after only a short time of searching, she finds the perfect candidate. "Just like last time, Captain."|2438|0
units.english: You gather with the scientists in the spaceport bar. The Tundra native informs you that all residents close enough to the volcano to be in danger have been evacuated. "All we need to do now is find the right asteroid," Amy says, and after only a short time of searching, she finds the perfect candidate. "Just like last time, Captain."
units.italian: Ti riunisci con gli scienziati nel bar dello spazioporto. Il nativo di Tundra ti informa che tutti i residenti abbastanza vicini al vulcano da essere in pericolo sono stati evacuati. "Ora ci resta solo da trovare l'asteroide giusto," dice Amy, e dopo una breve ricerca trova il candidato perfetto. "Proprio come l'altra volta, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|	Spaceport workers load a small thruster and the equipment you will need to mount it on the asteroid into your ship.|2439|0
units.english: Spaceport workers load a small thruster and the equipment you will need to mount it on the asteroid into your ship.
units.italian: Gli operai dello spazioporto caricano sulla tua nave un piccolo propulsore e l'attrezzatura che ti servirà per montarlo sull'asteroide.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|dialog|2448|0
units.english: You return to the spaceport to the confused looks of Amy and the rest of the scientists. "You didn't put the thrusters on the asteroid," Amy says. "Just board the asteroid to attach the thrusters." Amy begins pushing you back to your ship, clearly eager to see the results of this experiment.
units.italian: Torni allo spazioporto sotto gli sguardi confusi di Amy e degli altri scienziati. "Non hai messo i propulsori sull'asteroide," dice Amy. "Abborda l'asteroide e basta, per attaccare i propulsori." Amy comincia a spingerti verso la tua nave, chiaramente impaziente di vedere i risultati dell'esperimento.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|log|2453|0
units.english: Fought off a fleet of pirates preventing the terraforming of Tundra, then maneuvered an asteroid into Tundra to trigger the eruption of a supervolcano. Tundra's global temperatures will initially drop, but the increased volume of greenhouse gases in the atmosphere will eventually improve Tundra's climate.
units.italian: Ho respinto una flotta di pirati che impediva la terraformazione di Tundra, poi ho guidato un asteroide su Tundra per innescare l'eruzione di un supervulcano. All'inizio le temperature globali di Tundra caleranno, ma l'aumento dei gas serra nell'atmosfera finirà per migliorare il clima del pianeta.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|A plume of debris has formed in a mushroom cloud shape above where the asteroid hit. The scientists are viewing their instruments in anticipation for what happens next.|2455|0
units.english: A plume of debris has formed in a mushroom cloud shape above where the asteroid hit. The scientists are viewing their instruments in anticipation for what happens next.
units.italian: Una colonna di detriti si è alzata a forma di fungo sopra il punto in cui è caduto l'asteroide. Gli scienziati osservano i loro strumenti in attesa di quello che succederà.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|	Almost an hour after the impact, the ground begins to shake slightly, even though the volcano is located hundreds of kilometers away. "This might be it!" Nolan exclaims as he closely watches a seismometer receiving readings from near the impact site. Suddenly the seismometer spikes, and another plume, much larger than the asteroid impact, rises from the impact site. Half an hour later, the low sound of the massive eruption can be heard in the spaceport, triggering another burst of cheers from the scientists. "It actually worked!" one of them yells out.|2456|0
units.english: Almost an hour after the impact, the ground begins to shake slightly, even though the volcano is located hundreds of kilometers away. "This might be it!" Nolan exclaims as he closely watches a seismometer receiving readings from near the impact site. Suddenly the seismometer spikes, and another plume, much larger than the asteroid impact, rises from the impact site. Half an hour later, the low sound of the massive eruption can be heard in the spaceport, triggering another burst of cheers from the scientists. "It actually worked!" one of them yells out.
units.italian: Quasi un'ora dopo l'impatto, il terreno comincia a tremare leggermente, anche se il vulcano si trova a centinaia di chilometri. "Potrebbe essere il momento!" esclama Nolan, fissando un sismometro che riceve le letture da vicino al punto d'impatto. All'improvviso il sismometro impazzisce, e un'altra colonna, molto più grande di quella dell'impatto, si alza dal sito. Mezz'ora dopo, nello spazioporto si sente il boato sordo della gigantesca eruzione, che scatena un'altra ondata di esultanza fra gli scienziati. "Ha funzionato davvero!" grida uno di loro.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|	You fly the scientists over top of the volcano, allowing them to take readings of the air and surface. "Greenhouse gas levels are off the charts!" Amy exclaims. "Once these gases disperse across the planet's atmosphere, they should begin warming the entire planet."|2457|0
units.english: You fly the scientists over top of the volcano, allowing them to take readings of the air and surface. "Greenhouse gas levels are off the charts!" Amy exclaims. "Once these gases disperse across the planet's atmosphere, they should begin warming the entire planet."
units.italian: Sorvoli il vulcano con gli scienziati a bordo, permettendo loro di rilevare l'aria e la superficie. "I livelli di gas serra sono fuori scala!" esclama Amy. "Quando questi gas si saranno dispersi nell'atmosfera del pianeta, dovrebbero cominciare a riscaldarlo tutto quanto."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|	The heat has formed a huge circle of melted snow around the volcano, revealing the green color of trees and the dull grays and browns of rock. Closer to the center of the eruption you spot dozens of lava flows emanating from the center of the impact crater.|2458|0
units.english: The heat has formed a huge circle of melted snow around the volcano, revealing the green color of trees and the dull grays and browns of rock. Closer to the center of the eruption you spot dozens of lava flows emanating from the center of the impact crater.
units.italian: Il calore ha formato un enorme cerchio di neve sciolta intorno al vulcano, rivelando il verde degli alberi e i grigi e i bruni spenti della roccia. Più vicino al centro dell'eruzione scorgi decine di colate di lava che si dipartono dal centro del cratere d'impatto.

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|	"What do we do now?"|2460|0
units.english: "What do we do now?"
units.italian: "Che cosa facciamo adesso?"

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|	"It looks beautiful from up here."|2462|0
units.english: "It looks beautiful from up here."
units.italian: "Da quassù è bellissimo."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|	"Yes it does, Captain," the Republic representative says. "Yes it does."|2464|0
units.english: "Yes it does, Captain," the Republic representative says. "Yes it does."
units.italian: "Già, Capitano," dice il rappresentante della Repubblica. "Proprio bello."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|	"First we need to clear all this volcanic ash out of the atmosphere, as otherwise the planet's temperature will drop, then we wait," Amy says to you. "We should be able to tell how this will affect Tundra's climate in a year or two."|2468|0
units.english: "First we need to clear all this volcanic ash out of the atmosphere, as otherwise the planet's temperature will drop, then we wait," Amy says to you. "We should be able to tell how this will affect Tundra's climate in a year or two."
units.italian: "Prima dobbiamo ripulire l'atmosfera da tutta questa cenere vulcanica, altrimenti la temperatura del pianeta calerà, poi aspettiamo," ti dice Amy. "Dovremmo essere in grado di capire come questo influirà sul clima di Tundra entro un anno o due."

units.id: mission:Terraforming 12|	You steer your ship back to the spaceport. Amy pays you <payment> after you land. "Thanks for your help, Captain. We're going to stay here and monitor Tundra's climate as it shifts, so there's nothing more that we need you for."|2471|0
units.english: You steer your ship back to the spaceport. Amy pays you <payment> after you land. "Thanks for your help, Captain. We're going to stay here and monitor Tundra's climate as it shifts, so there's nothing more that we need you for."
units.italian: Riporti la nave allo spazioporto. Amy ti paga <payment> dopo l'atterraggio. "Grazie per l'aiuto, Capitano. Restiamo qui a monitorare il cambiamento del clima di Tundra, quindi non ci serve altro da te."

units.id: event:terraforming Tundra|description|2477|0
units.english: Millions of years ago, this was a warm world, perhaps even tropical. But some cataclysmic event, perhaps a meteor strike or a massive volcanic eruption, altered the planet's atmosphere enough to turn it into the nearly lifeless, frozen planet it is today. Recent experiments in terraforming the planet have attempted to remedy the climate by causing a supervolcano to prematurely erupt.
units.italian: Milioni di anni fa era un mondo caldo, forse addirittura tropicale. Ma un qualche evento cataclismico, forse l'impatto di un meteorite o una gigantesca eruzione vulcanica, alterò l'atmosfera del pianeta abbastanza da trasformarlo nel mondo quasi privo di vita e ghiacciato che è oggi. Recenti esperimenti di terraformazione hanno tentato di rimediare al clima provocando l'eruzione prematura di un supervulcano.

units.id: event:terraforming Tundra|description|2478|0
units.english: The first settlers came here to drill for the oil trapped deep under the surface, a relic of Tundra's former, more lively days. Instead of refining the oil into plastic, which sells relatively cheap in this region, they have developed an industry in synthetic fabrics and clothing.
units.italian: I primi coloni vennero qui per estrarre il petrolio intrappolato in profondità, reliquia dei giorni più vivi di Tundra. Invece di raffinarlo in plastica, che in questa regione si vende a poco, hanno sviluppato un'industria di tessuti e abiti sintetici.

units.id: mission:Terraforming Follow-up|When you land, you receive a message from Amy, the girl you helped to terraform Rand and Tundra.|2495|0
units.english: When you land, you receive a message from Amy, the girl you helped to terraform Rand and Tundra.
units.italian: Quando atterri, ricevi un messaggio da Amy, la ragazza che hai aiutato a terraformare Rand e Tundra.

units.id: mission:Terraforming Follow-up|	"I hope everything is going well, Captain. I just wanted to give you an update on what has occurred in the past year.|2496|0
units.english: "I hope everything is going well, Captain. I just wanted to give you an update on what has occurred in the past year.
units.italian: "Spero che vada tutto bene, Capitano. Volevo solo aggiornarla su quello che è successo nell'ultimo anno.

units.id: mission:Terraforming Follow-up|	"Tundra's climate has drastically improved. Areas around the equator are starting to become completely snow-free, and I was amazed when I was able to walk outside without a heavy coat on. The Republic has placed a halt on any more experiments, as they wish to see how the situations on Tundra and Rand turn out.|2497|0
units.english: "Tundra's climate has drastically improved. Areas around the equator are starting to become completely snow-free, and I was amazed when I was able to walk outside without a heavy coat on. The Republic has placed a halt on any more experiments, as they wish to see how the situations on Tundra and Rand turn out.
units.italian: "Il clima di Tundra è migliorato drasticamente. Le zone intorno all'equatore cominciano a essere del tutto prive di neve, e sono rimasta stupita quando sono riuscita a camminare fuori senza un cappotto pesante. La Repubblica ha bloccato ogni altro esperimento, perché vuole vedere come si evolvono le situazioni su Tundra e su Rand.

units.id: mission:Terraforming Follow-up|	"Speaking of Rand, last month I got to catch up with Eric and Alaric when I visited the planet. They've told me that Rand is becoming a far better place to live on now. It's even becoming a popular tourist destination. They wanted me to relay their gratitude to you for making their dream come true.|2498|0
units.english: "Speaking of Rand, last month I got to catch up with Eric and Alaric when I visited the planet. They've told me that Rand is becoming a far better place to live on now. It's even becoming a popular tourist destination. They wanted me to relay their gratitude to you for making their dream come true.
units.italian: "A proposito di Rand, il mese scorso ho incontrato Eric e Alaric durante una visita al pianeta. Mi hanno detto che Rand sta diventando un posto molto migliore in cui vivere. Sta persino diventando una meta turistica apprezzata. Volevano che Le trasmettessi la loro gratitudine per aver realizzato il loro sogno.

units.id: mission:Terraforming Follow-up|	"That's all I have to say. Thanks again for all the help. I don't know where I would be without it."|2499|0
units.english: "That's all I have to say. Thanks again for all the help. I don't know where I would be without it."
units.italian: "È tutto quello che avevo da dire. Grazie ancora per tutto l'aiuto. Non so dove sarei senza di te."

units.id: event:terraforming follow-up|description|2507|0
units.english: Rand is a desert world, too dry for much farming and with gravity low enough to be uncomfortable for most human beings. It is, however, the best source of heavy metals in the galactic south. Aside from the managers of the mining companies, nearly all the people here are migrant workers from elsewhere in the Dirt Belt, who have come to spend a season working for the relatively high wages that uranium mining offers, either to send money off-world or to save it up in order to build a better life for themselves.
units.italian: Rand è un mondo desertico, troppo arido per l'agricoltura e con una gravità abbastanza bassa da risultare scomoda ai più. È però la migliore fonte di metalli pesanti del sud galattico. A parte i dirigenti delle compagnie minerarie, quasi tutti quelli che vivono qui sono lavoratori migranti arrivati da altre parti della Dirt Belt per passare una stagione a lavorare con i salari relativamente alti che offre l'estrazione dell'uranio, per mandare soldi fuori dal pianeta o metterli da parte e costruirsi una vita migliore.

units.id: event:terraforming follow-up|description|2508|0
units.english: Due to the results of recent terraforming experiments, Rand has become a moderately more habitable place. Fascination with this change in climate has led to Rand becoming a semi-popular tourist destination of the Dirt Belt.
units.italian: Grazie ai risultati dei recenti esperimenti di terraformazione, Rand è diventato un posto moderatamente più abitabile. Il fascino per questo cambiamento climatico ha reso Rand una meta turistica semi-popolare della Dirt Belt.

units.id: event:terraforming follow-up|spaceport|2509|0
units.english: The landing pads here are poured concrete, raised up slightly above the level of the desert to keep them from being buried in sand. A few workers are constantly driving brush sweepers across the unoccupied pads. The air is filled with sand particles and dust. Aside from the storage sheds, there are only two buildings, each with a large sign out front: "Labor" and "Trade."
units.italian: Le piazzole di atterraggio qui sono di cemento colato, leggermente rialzate rispetto al livello del deserto per non essere sepolte dalla sabbia. Alcuni operai passano di continuo con degli spazzatori sulle piazzole libere. L'aria è piena di particelle di sabbia e polvere. A parte i magazzini, ci sono solo due edifici, ciascuno con un grande cartello sulla facciata: "Lavoro" e "Commercio".

units.id: event:terraforming follow-up|spaceport|2510|0
units.english: For once, the spaceport is lively during Remembrance Day. It appears that more and more people are choosing to invite their family over to Rand to commemorate the day instead of traveling to another planet.
units.italian: Per una volta lo spazioporto è vivace durante il Remembrance Day. Sembra che sempre più persone scelgano di invitare la propria famiglia su Rand per commemorare la giornata invece di viaggiare su un altro pianeta.

units.id: event:terraforming follow-up|spaceport|2515|0
units.english: The spaceport village consists of several large domes, which keep out the wind and driving snow; ships enter and exit the largest of the domes through a hatch that closes as soon as they have come through. Before the planet was terraformed, enough snow would pile up on top of one of the domes every decade or so that it became a danger of collapsing under its own weight; the locals would simply move out of that dome and build another one higher up on the snowpack, but the changing climate has reduced the amount of snow enough that the locals may never need to build another dome again.
units.italian: Il villaggio dello spazioporto è fatto di diverse grandi cupole, che tengono fuori il vento e la neve; le navi entrano ed escono dalla più grande attraverso un portello che si chiude appena sono passate. Prima che il pianeta fosse terraformato, ogni decennio circa si accumulava tanta neve sopra una delle cupole da far temere che cedesse sotto il proprio peso; la gente del posto si limitava a trasferirsi da quella cupola e a costruirne un'altra più in alto sul manto nevoso, ma il cambiamento del clima ha ridotto la neve abbastanza che forse non dovranno mai costruirne un'altra.

units.id: event:terraforming follow-up|spaceport|2516|0
units.english: For Remembrance Day, several stalls have been set up to showcase items of clothing made with the planet's synthetic fabrics. A new addition to the event is a group of stalls dedicated to presenting clothing tailored here on Tundra.
units.italian: Per il Remembrance Day sono stati allestiti diversi banchi per mostrare capi d'abbigliamento fatti con i tessuti sintetici del pianeta. Una novità di quest'anno è un gruppo di banchi dedicati ad abiti confezionati qui su Tundra.

units.id: mission:A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage|description|2525|0
units.context: mission:A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage
units.english: Transport a wolf, a goat, and a cabbage to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>.
units.italian: Trasporta un lupo, una capra e un cavolo su <destination>. Il compenso sarà <payment>.

units.id: mission:A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage|You hear a strange crunching sound coming from your cargo hold.|2540|0
units.context: mission:A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage
units.english: You hear a strange crunching sound coming from your cargo hold.
units.italian: Senti uno strano rumore di scricchiolio venire dalla stiva.

units.id: mission:A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage|The worrisome munching sound in your ship's hold is followed by a horrific shrieking bleating noise and then an equally horrific silence. Turning on your cargo hold's security camera, you discover that there is nothing left of the goat and the cabbage that you were transporting except a few scraps of cabbage, some bones, and a lot of blood.|2543|0
units.context: mission:A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage
units.english: The worrisome munching sound in your ship's hold is followed by a horrific shrieking bleating noise and then an equally horrific silence. Turning on your cargo hold's security camera, you discover that there is nothing left of the goat and the cabbage that you were transporting except a few scraps of cabbage, some bones, and a lot of blood.
units.italian: Al preoccupante rumore di masticazione nella stiva segue uno spaventoso belato stridulo e poi un silenzio altrettanto spaventoso. Accendendo la telecamera di sicurezza della stiva, scopri che della capra e del cavolo che trasportavi non è rimasto altro che qualche brandello di cavolo, delle ossa e molto sangue.

units.id: mission:A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage|	Meanwhile, the wolf is calmly gnawing on what you suspect is the goat's femur, with a rather self-satisfied look in its eyes. Apparently the goat ate the cabbage, and shortly after that the wolf ate the goat.|2544|0
units.context: mission:A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage
units.english: Meanwhile, the wolf is calmly gnawing on what you suspect is the goat's femur, with a rather self-satisfied look in its eyes. Apparently the goat ate the cabbage, and shortly after that the wolf ate the goat.
units.italian: Nel frattempo il lupo rosicchia con calma quello che sospetti sia il femore della capra, con un'aria piuttosto soddisfatta. A quanto pare la capra ha mangiato il cavolo, e poco dopo il lupo ha mangiato la capra.

units.id: mission:A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage|The man who collects the wolf from you on the landing pad is furious. "I told the shipping company not to put the goat in the same ship as the wolf or the cabbage," he says, "but I guess they tried to save money by subcontracting it all to the same captain."|2549|0
units.context: mission:A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage
units.english: The man who collects the wolf from you on the landing pad is furious. "I told the shipping company not to put the goat in the same ship as the wolf or the cabbage," he says, "but I guess they tried to save money by subcontracting it all to the same captain."
units.italian: L'uomo che ritira il lupo sulla piazzola di atterraggio è furioso. "Avevo detto alla compagnia di spedizioni di non mettere la capra sulla stessa nave del lupo o del cavolo," dice, "ma immagino che abbiano cercato di risparmiare subappaltando tutto allo stesso capitano."

units.id: mission:A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage|	Because you only delivered a third of the cargo safely, he only pays you <payment>.|2550|0
units.context: mission:A wolf, a goat, and a cabbage
units.english: Because you only delivered a third of the cargo safely, he only pays you <payment>.
units.italian: Dato che hai consegnato sano e salvo solo un terzo del carico, ti paga solo <payment>.

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|name|2555|0
units.english: Missing drone
units.italian: Drone disperso

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|description|2556|0
units.english: Travel to the <waypoints> system to see if you can find any sign of a probe drone that had been launched by a team of scientists before they were attacked by pirates and forced to flee.
units.italian: Raggiungi il sistema <waypoints> per vedere se riesci a trovare traccia di un drone sonda lanciato da una squadra di scienziati prima che venissero attaccati dai pirati e costretti alla fuga.

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|As you are exploring the marketplace, a man wearing comically thick glasses comes over to talk to you. "Captain <last>?" he asks. You nod. "I hear that you're not averse to taking on risks," he says. "I'm the lead scientist on a project studying a spatial anomaly in an uninhabited system nearby. We had just launched a probe to study the anomaly more closely when a band of pirates arrived and forced us to flee the system. Would you be willing to travel there and see if you can retrieve the drone's data?"|2565|0
units.english: As you are exploring the marketplace, a man wearing comically thick glasses comes over to talk to you. "Captain <last>?" he asks. You nod. "I hear that you're not averse to taking on risks," he says. "I'm the lead scientist on a project studying a spatial anomaly in an uninhabited system nearby. We had just launched a probe to study the anomaly more closely when a band of pirates arrived and forced us to flee the system. Would you be willing to travel there and see if you can retrieve the drone's data?"
units.italian: Mentre giri per il mercato, un uomo con occhiali di uno spessore comico si avvicina a parlarti. "Capitano <last>?" chiede. Annuisti. "Ho sentito che non sei contrario a correre qualche rischio," dice. "Sono lo scienziato capo di un progetto che studia un'anomalia spaziale in un sistema disabitato qui vicino. Avevamo appena lanciato una sonda per studiarla più da vicino quando è arrivata una banda di pirati che ci ha costretti a fuggire dal sistema. Saresti disposto ad andare là e vedere se riesci a recuperare i dati del drone?"

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"Sure, I would be glad to."|2567|0
units.english: "Sure, I would be glad to."
units.italian: "Certo, con piacere."

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"How strong of a threat is the pirate fleet?"|2569|0
units.english: "How strong of a threat is the pirate fleet?"
units.italian: "Quanto è pericolosa la flotta pirata?"

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"Sorry, I don't have time to help you."|2570|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't have time to help you."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non ho tempo per aiutarti."

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"Just a couple of interceptors," he says. "We were in a scout ship, with no real weapons to speak of, and none of us on the ship have any combat experience. So, we felt it was safer to run away than to try to fight, even though we were leaving valuable equipment behind."|2572|0
units.english: "Just a couple of interceptors," he says. "We were in a scout ship, with no real weapons to speak of, and none of us on the ship have any combat experience. So, we felt it was safer to run away than to try to fight, even though we were leaving valuable equipment behind."
units.italian: "Solo un paio di intercettori," dice. "Eravamo su una nave da ricognizione, senza vere armi di cui parlare, e nessuno di noi ha esperienza di combattimento. Quindi ci è sembrato più sicuro scappare che provare a combattere, anche se lasciavamo dietro attrezzatura di valore."

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"That doesn't sound like much of a threat. I'd be glad to help."|2574|0
units.english: "That doesn't sound like much of a threat. I'd be glad to help."
units.italian: "Non mi sembra una gran minaccia. Sarei lieto di aiutare."

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"Sorry, I don't want to help with this."|2575|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't want to help with this."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non voglio aiutare in questa faccenda."

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"Thank you so much!" he says. "All I need you to do is board the drone and download its database. Unless the pirates have already stripped out the computer, of course. The drone is in the Terminus system, a few jumps away from here. We'll be waiting on <destination> for your return."|2578|0
units.english: "Thank you so much!" he says. "All I need you to do is board the drone and download its database. Unless the pirates have already stripped out the computer, of course. The drone is in the Terminus system, a few jumps away from here. We'll be waiting on <destination> for your return."
units.italian: "Grazie mille!" dice. "Devi solo abbordare il drone e scaricare il suo database. A meno che i pirati non abbiano già smontato il computer, naturalmente. Il drone è nel sistema Terminus, a qualche salto da qui. Ti aspetteremo su <destination> al ritorno."

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|dialog|2585|0
units.english: You board the science drone and discover that the pirates have stripped just about everything of value from it: the engines, the sensors, and the fuel cell that powered it. But the computer system is either too deeply integrated into the drone, or too specialized, to be of any value to the pirates. You transfer enough power to the drone's batteries to reactivate it, and are able to retrieve the data that the scientist was looking for. But it's clear that this drone, or what's left of it, is not going anywhere. You'll have to leave it behind.
units.italian: Abbordi il drone scientifico e scopri che i pirati hanno portato via quasi tutto ciò che aveva valore: i motori, i sensori e la cella a combustibile che lo alimentava. Il sistema informatico però è o troppo integrato nel drone, o troppo specialistico, per avere valore per i pirati. Trasferisci energia sufficiente alle batterie del drone per riattivarlo e riesci a recuperare i dati che lo scienziato cercava. Ma è chiaro che questo drone, o quel che ne resta, non andrà da nessuna parte. Dovrai lasciarlo qui.

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|dialog|2592|0
units.english: You've returned to <planet>, but you don't have the drone's data. Go to Terminus and board the science drone to retrieve the data.
units.italian: Sei tornato su <planet>, ma non hai i dati del drone. Vai su Terminus e abborda il drone scientifico per recuperarli.

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|log|2595|0
units.english: Recovered data from a derelict science drone for a team of scientists who were studying a strange red anomaly in the Terminus system. The lead scientist on the team, Ivan, suggested that it may be a partially collapsed wormhole.
units.italian: Ho recuperato i dati di un drone scientifico abbandonato per una squadra di scienziati che studiava una strana anomalia rossa nel sistema Terminus. Lo scienziato capo, Ivan, ha suggerito che potrebbe essere un wormhole parzialmente collassato.

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|The scientist is overjoyed that you were able to retrieve the data from the drone. Almost in tears, he says, "We were worried that all our planning and fundraising had been for nothing. These measurements will help us to understand that spatial anomaly far better than we do right now." He hands you a credit chip worth <payment>. "And by the way, my name is Ivan. I have an office near the spaceport on Valhalla that you can visit if ever you're wanting to help, or just curious."|2597|0
units.english: The scientist is overjoyed that you were able to retrieve the data from the drone. Almost in tears, he says, "We were worried that all our planning and fundraising had been for nothing. These measurements will help us to understand that spatial anomaly far better than we do right now." He hands you a credit chip worth <payment>. "And by the way, my name is Ivan. I have an office near the spaceport on Valhalla that you can visit if ever you're wanting to help, or just curious."
units.italian: Lo scienziato è felicissimo che tu sia riuscito a recuperare i dati dal drone. Quasi in lacrime, dice: "Temevamo che tutta la nostra pianificazione e la raccolta di fondi fosse stata inutile. Queste misurazioni ci aiuteranno a capire quell'anomalia spaziale molto meglio di adesso." Ti porge un chip di credito del valore di <payment>. "E a proposito, mi chiamo Ivan. Ho un ufficio vicino allo spazioporto su Valhalla, dove puoi passare se mai volessi aiutare, o solo per curiosità."

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"Can you tell me more about this anomaly you are studying?"|2599|0
units.english: "Can you tell me more about this anomaly you are studying?"
units.italian: "Puoi dirmi qualcosa di più su questa anomalia che stai studiando?"

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"I'm glad I was able to help."|2600|0
units.english: "I'm glad I was able to help."
units.italian: "Sono contento di aver aiutato."

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	Ivan says, "It seems to be a partially collapsed wormhole, something that once linked this part of the galaxy to somewhere else. But, we haven't succeeded in sending anything through it. Maybe the wormhole is no longer passable. Or maybe there's some way to make it open more fully. Or maybe only ships that are specially attuned to its energy signature can travel through it. We don't even know if the wormhole is a natural phenomenon or some sort of alien artifact. Honestly, we aren't sure if it's even a wormhole at all. We'll need to study the data you've recovered to understand it further."|2602|0
units.english: Ivan says, "It seems to be a partially collapsed wormhole, something that once linked this part of the galaxy to somewhere else. But, we haven't succeeded in sending anything through it. Maybe the wormhole is no longer passable. Or maybe there's some way to make it open more fully. Or maybe only ships that are specially attuned to its energy signature can travel through it. We don't even know if the wormhole is a natural phenomenon or some sort of alien artifact. Honestly, we aren't sure if it's even a wormhole at all. We'll need to study the data you've recovered to understand it further."
units.italian: Ivan dice: "Sembra un wormhole parzialmente collassato, qualcosa che un tempo collegava questa parte della galassia a chissà dove. Ma non siamo riusciti a farci passare nulla. Forse il wormhole non è più attraversabile. O forse c'è un modo per farlo aprire del tutto. O forse solo le navi sintonizzate in modo speciale sulla sua firma energetica possono attraversarlo. Non sappiamo nemmeno se il wormhole sia un fenomeno naturale o una sorta di manufatto alieno. Sinceramente, non siamo sicuri che sia davvero un wormhole. Dovremo studiare i dati che hai recuperato per capirne di più."

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"A wormhole? Those actually exist?"|2604|0
units.english: "A wormhole? Those actually exist?"
units.italian: "Un wormhole? Esistono davvero?"

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"What makes you think it's a wormhole? Have you found anomalies similar to this before?"|2605|0
units.english: "What makes you think it's a wormhole? Have you found anomalies similar to this before?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ti fa pensare che sia un wormhole? Hai già trovato anomalie simili?"

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"Well of course. The existence of wormholes has been proven for some time now. The Deep managed to create wormholes on the atomic scale before the Republic was even founded." He lowers his voice. "But I suspect that you're asking about wormholes large enough for a ship to pass through."|2607|0
units.english: "Well of course. The existence of wormholes has been proven for some time now. The Deep managed to create wormholes on the atomic scale before the Republic was even founded." He lowers his voice. "But I suspect that you're asking about wormholes large enough for a ship to pass through."
units.italian: "Beh, certo. L'esistenza dei wormhole è dimostrata da tempo. Il Deep è riuscito a crearne su scala atomica prima ancora che la Repubblica fosse fondata." Abbassa la voce. "Ma sospetto che tu stia chiedendo dei wormhole abbastanza grandi da farci passare una nave."

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	Ivan looks around the spaceport, as if checking to see if he's being watched. He then looks back to you and motions for you to lean in. Whispering, he says, "The Republic doesn't like when people share this information, but there is one stable wormhole just beyond the Republic's borders."|2609|0
units.english: Ivan looks around the spaceport, as if checking to see if he's being watched. He then looks back to you and motions for you to lean in. Whispering, he says, "The Republic doesn't like when people share this information, but there is one stable wormhole just beyond the Republic's borders."
units.italian: Ivan si guarda intorno nello spazioporto, come per controllare di non essere osservato. Poi torna a guardarti e ti fa cenno di avvicinarti. Sussurrando, dice: "Alla Repubblica non piace che si condividano queste informazioni, ma c'è un wormhole stabile appena fuori dai confini della Repubblica."

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|log|2613|0
units.english: Ivan said that although he's not sure if the anomaly is a wormhole or not, it does bear a striking resemblance to the wormhole that leads to the Hai.
units.italian: Ivan ha detto che, anche se non è sicuro che l'anomalia sia un wormhole, somiglia in modo impressionante al wormhole che porta agli Hai.

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"You mean the wormhole to the Hai?" you ask.|2614|0
units.english: "You mean the wormhole to the Hai?" you ask.
units.italian: "Vuoi dire il wormhole per gli Hai?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	"Interesting, you know of it," Ivan responds. "The anomaly in Terminus bears a striking resemblance to it in some of our readings, although it is very different in others."|2615|0
units.english: "Interesting, you know of it," Ivan responds. "The anomaly in Terminus bears a striking resemblance to it in some of our readings, although it is very different in others."
units.italian: "Interessante, ne sei al corrente," risponde Ivan. "L'anomalia di Terminus gli somiglia in modo impressionante in alcune delle nostre letture, anche se in altre è molto diversa."

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|log|2619|0
units.english: Ivan said that although he's not sure if the anomaly is a wormhole or not, there is a wormhole "just beyond the Republic's borders" that the Republic doesn't like people sharing information on.
units.italian: Ivan ha detto che, anche se non è sicuro che l'anomalia sia un wormhole, esiste un wormhole "appena fuori dai confini della Repubblica" su cui alla Repubblica non piace che si diffondano informazioni.

units.id: mission:Terminus exploration|	He looks around again and stands up straight. He then raises his voice, almost projecting it for anyone around you to hear. "But of course, the Deep never figured out how to make wormholes big enough for anything useful, otherwise we wouldn't even need hyperdrives," he says with a wink. "Anyway, thank you again for helping me. Hopefully we meet again in the future."|2621|0
units.english: He looks around again and stands up straight. He then raises his voice, almost projecting it for anyone around you to hear. "But of course, the Deep never figured out how to make wormholes big enough for anything useful, otherwise we wouldn't even need hyperdrives," he says with a wink. "Anyway, thank you again for helping me. Hopefully we meet again in the future."
units.italian: Si guarda di nuovo intorno e si raddrizza. Poi alza la voce, quasi per farsi sentire da chiunque vi stia intorno. "Ma naturalmente il Deep non ha mai capito come creare wormhole abbastanza grandi per qualcosa di utile, altrimenti non avremmo nemmeno bisogno degli iperpropulsori," dice con un occhiolino. "Comunque, grazie ancora per l'aiuto. Spero che ci rivedremo."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|name|2639|0
units.english: Rescue Tod
units.italian: Salvare Tod

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|description|2640|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> in search for Tod, the son of a single mother from <origin>.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> in cerca di Tod, il figlio di una madre single di <origin>.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|Wandering around the spaceport to see what it has to offer, you make your way into one of the dimly lit restaurants to avoid the crowded streets and metallic-tasting air outside. The restaurant is mostly empty. One of its only inhabitants is a dirty-looking woman crying with her head down in one of the booths.|2648|0
units.english: Wandering around the spaceport to see what it has to offer, you make your way into one of the dimly lit restaurants to avoid the crowded streets and metallic-tasting air outside. The restaurant is mostly empty. One of its only inhabitants is a dirty-looking woman crying with her head down in one of the booths.
units.italian: Girando per lo spazioporto per vedere che cosa offre, entri in uno dei ristoranti in penombra per evitare le strade affollate e l'aria che sa di metallo. Il ristorante è quasi vuoto. Uno dei pochi avventori è una donna dall'aria sporca che piange, con la testa china, in uno dei separé.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|	(Approach the woman and ask why she is crying.)|2650|0
units.english: (Approach the woman and ask why she is crying.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati alla donna e chiedile perché piange.)

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|	(Ignore her and leave the restaurant.)|2651|0
units.english: (Ignore her and leave the restaurant.)
units.italian: (Ignala e lascia il ristorante.)

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|	As you walk close to the woman, she raises her head from her arms and brushes her hair out of her face to look at you. Tears run down her cheeks and her nose is running. "Wh-wh-what do you w-want?" she asks in a quiet voice, trying to speak through sobs.|2654|0
units.english: As you walk close to the woman, she raises her head from her arms and brushes her hair out of her face to look at you. Tears run down her cheeks and her nose is running. "Wh-wh-what do you w-want?" she asks in a quiet voice, trying to speak through sobs.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini, la donna alza la testa dalle braccia e si scosta i capelli dal viso per guardarti. Le lacrime le rigano le guance e ha il naso che cola. "C-cosa v-vuoi?" chiede con voce flebile, cercando di parlare fra i singhiozzi.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|	"Can I help you?"|2656|0
units.english: "Can I help you?"
units.italian: "Posso aiutarla?"

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|	"Why are you crying?"|2657|0
units.english: "Why are you crying?"
units.italian: "Perché piange?"

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|	You ask the woman if she needs help. She wipes away the tears with the sleeve of her shirt and tells you that she is looking for her son, Tod. "I sent him away to a mining job on Placer because I don't have the money to support him myself, but on the way the ship he was on was attacked and boarded by pirates." She begins to sob again. "I d-don't know if he's d-dead or a slave. I tried t-talking to someone from the Syndicate, but they said that saving him wouldn't be w-worth it.|2659|0
units.english: You ask the woman if she needs help. She wipes away the tears with the sleeve of her shirt and tells you that she is looking for her son, Tod. "I sent him away to a mining job on Placer because I don't have the money to support him myself, but on the way the ship he was on was attacked and boarded by pirates." She begins to sob again. "I d-don't know if he's d-dead or a slave. I tried t-talking to someone from the Syndicate, but they said that saving him wouldn't be w-worth it.
units.italian: Chiedi alla donna se ha bisogno di aiuto. Si asciuga le lacrime con la manica della camicia e ti dice che sta cercando suo figlio, Tod. "L'ho mandato a lavorare in una miniera su Placer perché non ho i soldi per mantenerlo, ma durante il viaggio la nave su cui era è stata attaccata e abbordata dai pirati." Ricomincia a singhiozzare. "N-non so se è morto o se è diventato uno schiavo. Ho provato a p-parlare con qualcuno del Sindacato, ma hanno detto che salvarlo non v-valeva la pena.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|	"W-would you be able to help? Please do if you c-can."|2660|0
units.english: "W-would you be able to help? Please do if you c-can."
units.italian: "P-potresti aiutarmi? Ti prego, se p-puoi."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|	"Alright, I'll help you. Where should I look for him?"|2662|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll help you. Where should I look for him?"
units.italian: "Va bene, ti aiuterò. Dove devo cercarlo?"

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|	"Sorry, I'm not going to risk my life for someone I don't know."|2664|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not going to risk my life for someone I don't know."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non rischio la vita per uno che non conosco."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|	The woman begins crying even louder than she was before. A waiter walks up to you and suggests that you leave before making the situation worse, and one of the few customers in the restaurant gives you a dirty look for making his meal experience even worse.|2666|0
units.english: The woman begins crying even louder than she was before. A waiter walks up to you and suggests that you leave before making the situation worse, and one of the few customers in the restaurant gives you a dirty look for making his meal experience even worse.
units.italian: La donna comincia a piangere ancora più forte di prima. Un cameriere si avvicina e ti suggerisce di andartene prima di peggiorare la situazione, e uno dei pochi clienti ti lancia un'occhiataccia per aver reso ancora peggiore la sua esperienza al ristorante.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|	You wait for the streets to become less crowded before leaving the restaurant. As you look back through the windows of the restaurant, you catch a glimpse of the woman still crying in the booth before the crowd blocks your line of sight and you continue walking.|2669|0
units.english: You wait for the streets to become less crowded before leaving the restaurant. As you look back through the windows of the restaurant, you catch a glimpse of the woman still crying in the booth before the crowd blocks your line of sight and you continue walking.
units.italian: Aspetti che le strade si svuotino prima di uscire dal ristorante. Mentre ti volti verso le vetrate, intravedi la donna che piange ancora nel separé, prima che la folla ti nasconda la vista e tu riprenda a camminare.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 1|	"Thank you s-so much! The closest pirate planet to here is <destination>. If he's still alive then I'm sure he would be there. I can feel it." The woman gives you a description of Tod Copper so that you may find him and thanks you again for agreeing to help her. She asks that if you find him to bring him to a location in the <origin> spaceport where she will be waiting.|2673|0
units.english: "Thank you s-so much! The closest pirate planet to here is <destination>. If he's still alive then I'm sure he would be there. I can feel it." The woman gives you a description of Tod Copper so that you may find him and thanks you again for agreeing to help her. She asks that if you find him to bring him to a location in the <origin> spaceport where she will be waiting.
units.italian: "Grazie m-mille! Il pianeta pirata più vicino da qui è <destination>. Se è ancora vivo, sono sicura che sia là. Lo sento." La donna ti dà una descrizione di Tod Copper perché tu possa trovarlo e ti ringrazia di nuovo per aver accettato di aiutarla. Ti chiede, se lo trovi, di portarlo in un punto dello spazioporto di <origin> dove lei aspetterà.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|name|2680|0
units.english: Rescue Tod
units.italian: Salvare Tod

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|description|2681|0
units.english: Locate the <npc> and board it to rescue Tod, then bring him to <destination> so that he may reunite with his mother.
units.italian: Trova <npc> e abbordala per salvare Tod, poi portalo su <destination> perché possa ricongiungersi con sua madre.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|The air in the <origin> spaceport smells of tobacco and tastes of the salt from the world's vast oceans. You receive sideways looks from rough-looking pirates, but none make a move to cause any trouble. As lawless as pirates can be, they still adhere to a form of honor code when in a planet's main spaceport. At least generally.|2689|0
units.english: The air in the <origin> spaceport smells of tobacco and tastes of the salt from the world's vast oceans. You receive sideways looks from rough-looking pirates, but none make a move to cause any trouble. As lawless as pirates can be, they still adhere to a form of honor code when in a planet's main spaceport. At least generally.
units.italian: L'aria nello spazioporto di <origin> sa di tabacco e ha il sapore del sale dei vasti oceani del mondo. Ricevi sguardi obliqui da pirati dall'aria ruvida, ma nessuno si muove per creare problemi. Per quanto possano essere senza legge, i pirati rispettano comunque una sorta di codice d'onore quando si trovano nello spazioporto principale di un pianeta. Almeno in genere.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	You ask a bartender for directions to the local slave traders, as that is the likely place that Tod would be if he was taken here. He points you to a slave trader by the name of Cygnet Brig who "runs the slave trade 'round these parts."|2690|0
units.english: You ask a bartender for directions to the local slave traders, as that is the likely place that Tod would be if he was taken here. He points you to a slave trader by the name of Cygnet Brig who "runs the slave trade 'round these parts."
units.italian: Chiedi a un barista come arrivare ai trafficanti di schiavi del posto, perché è lì che Tod sarebbe finito se l'avessero portato qui. Ti indica un trafficante di nome Cygnet Brig che "gestisce il commercio di schiavi da queste parti".

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	Cygnet owns a large warehouse building located on the edge of the spaceport island where he keeps all his slaves packed together in groups of three in small holding cells. Some slaves are rattling the bars on their cell or screaming in protest, but many have seemed to accept their fate. Cygnet, a tall, thin, mustachioed man, notices you gazing at the cells. "Can't keep 'em too packed together, oth'wise they's get each otha sick," he remarks in a thick accent of unknown origin to you. "What can I get ya?"|2691|0
units.english: Cygnet owns a large warehouse building located on the edge of the spaceport island where he keeps all his slaves packed together in groups of three in small holding cells. Some slaves are rattling the bars on their cell or screaming in protest, but many have seemed to accept their fate. Cygnet, a tall, thin, mustachioed man, notices you gazing at the cells. "Can't keep 'em too packed together, oth'wise they's get each otha sick," he remarks in a thick accent of unknown origin to you. "What can I get ya?"
units.italian: Cygnet possiede un grande magazzino sul bordo dell'isola dello spazioporto, dove tiene tutti i suoi schiavi ammassati in gruppi di tre in piccole celle. Alcuni schiavi scuotono le sbarre o urlano per protesta, ma molti sembrano aver accettato il loro destino. Cygnet, un uomo alto e magro con i baffi, ti nota mentre guardi le celle. "Non li posso tenere troppo ammassati, sennò si passano le malattie l'uno con l'altro," commenta con un accento marcato di origine per te ignota. "Che cosa ti servo?"

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	"I'm here to buy a slave."|2693|0
units.english: "I'm here to buy a slave."
units.italian: "Sono qui per comprare uno schiavo."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	"Do you have a boy by the name of Tod Copper?"|2695|0
units.english: "Do you have a boy by the name of Tod Copper?"
units.italian: "Hai un ragazzo di nome Tod Copper?"

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	Cygnet strokes his mustache. "Tod Copper. Tod Copper. Tell you what, that name doesn' ring a bell. Heck, I don' even keep track of names 'less I get someone impor'ant. If ya lookin' for someone in particular to buy, can I get a description?"|2697|0
units.english: Cygnet strokes his mustache. "Tod Copper. Tod Copper. Tell you what, that name doesn' ring a bell. Heck, I don' even keep track of names 'less I get someone impor'ant. If ya lookin' for someone in particular to buy, can I get a description?"
units.italian: Cygnet si liscia i baffi. "Tod Copper. Tod Copper. Ti dico com'è: quel nome non mi dice niente. Cavoli, io non tengo nemmeno il conto dei nomi, a meno che non sia qualcuno di importante. Se cerchi qualcuno in particolare da comprare, mi sai dare una descrizione?"

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	You provide Cygnet with the description of Tod that his mother gave you, then explain to him that Tod would have been taken from a ship bound for Placer.|2700|0
units.english: You provide Cygnet with the description of Tod that his mother gave you, then explain to him that Tod would have been taken from a ship bound for Placer.
units.italian: Dai a Cygnet la descrizione di Tod che ti ha fatto sua madre, poi gli spieghi che Tod sarebbe stato prelevato da una nave diretta su Placer.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	"Oh yeah, that bugger! That little rebel was causin' me trouble so I sold him off soon as I could. If ya looking for him, then you're gonna need to look for a ship by the name of <npc>. They bought your boy Tod 'bout four days ago. Might be hangin' around a system nearby."|2701|0
units.english: "Oh yeah, that bugger! That little rebel was causin' me trouble so I sold him off soon as I could. If ya looking for him, then you're gonna need to look for a ship by the name of <npc>. They bought your boy Tod 'bout four days ago. Might be hangin' around a system nearby."
units.italian: "Ah, eccolo quel disgraziato! Quel piccolo ribelle mi dava problemi, così l'ho venduto appena ho potuto. Se lo cerchi, devi trovare una nave che si chiama <npc>. Hanno comprato il tuo Tod circa quattro giorni fa. Potrebbe essere ancora in giro in qualche sistema qui vicino."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	You thank Cygnet, who has been surprisingly polite for a slave trader, for the information. "If ya ever need a slave, just come talk to me," he remarks as you walk back to your ship. "I've got the cheapest slaves this side of Sol."|2702|0
units.english: You thank Cygnet, who has been surprisingly polite for a slave trader, for the information. "If ya ever need a slave, just come talk to me," he remarks as you walk back to your ship. "I've got the cheapest slaves this side of Sol."
units.italian: Ringrazi Cygnet, che è stato sorprendentemente gentile per essere un trafficante di schiavi, per le informazioni. "Se mai ti serve uno schiavo, vieni a parlare con me," commenta mentre torni alla tua nave. "Ho gli schiavi più a buon mercato di questa parte di Sol."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|dialog|2705|0
units.english: You've landed on <planet>, but you haven't yet found Tod. Keep looking for the <npc> and then board the ship; it can't be far from Deadman's Cove.
units.italian: Sei atterrato su <planet>, ma non hai ancora trovato Tod. Continua a cercare <npc> e poi abbordala; non può essere lontana da Deadman's Cove.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|When you breach the ship's hull, you find the crew of the <npc> more concerned with containing the fires caused by your weapons than with you walking onto their ship. Almost every one of the crew members is a teenager. One looks at you and the pistol in your hand with mortal fear in his eyes.|2714|0
units.english: When you breach the ship's hull, you find the crew of the <npc> more concerned with containing the fires caused by your weapons than with you walking onto their ship. Almost every one of the crew members is a teenager. One looks at you and the pistol in your hand with mortal fear in his eyes.
units.italian: Quando apri una breccia nello scafo della nave, trovi l'equipaggio della <npc> più preoccupato di contenere gli incendi causati dalle tue armi che di te che cammini sulla loro nave. Quasi tutti i membri dell'equipaggio sono adolescenti. Uno ti guarda, e guarda la pistola nella tua mano, con terrore mortale negli occhi.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	Through the smoke and steam, you see a boy running toward you who fits the description of Tod Copper.|2715|0
units.english: Through the smoke and steam, you see a boy running toward you who fits the description of Tod Copper.
units.italian: Attraverso il fumo e il vapore, vedi un ragazzo correre verso di te che corrisponde alla descrizione di Tod Copper.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	"Get on my ship!"|2717|0
units.english: "Get on my ship!"
units.italian: "Sali sulla mia nave!"

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	"Are you Tod?"|2719|0
units.english: "Are you Tod?"
units.italian: "Sei Tod?"

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	"Yeah! Are you here to save me?"|2721|0
units.english: "Yeah! Are you here to save me?"
units.italian: "Sì! Sei qui per salvarmi?"

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	"Get on my ship!" you yell, motioning for him to come toward you.|2722|0
units.english: "Get on my ship!" you yell, motioning for him to come toward you.
units.italian: "Sali sulla mia nave!" gridi, facendogli cenno di venire verso di te.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	The boy runs past you and into your ship. Following closely behind Tod is a large bearded man holding a laser rifle in one hand and a fragmentation grenade in the other.|2725|0
units.english: The boy runs past you and into your ship. Following closely behind Tod is a large bearded man holding a laser rifle in one hand and a fragmentation grenade in the other.
units.italian: Il ragazzo ti passa accanto e corre nella tua nave. Subito dietro Tod c'è un uomo grande e barbuto, con un fucile laser in una mano e una granata a frammentazione nell'altra.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	"That's my crew member, you no-good piece of sh--"|2726|0
units.english: "That's my crew member, you no-good piece of sh--"
units.italian: "Quello è un mio uomo, pezzo di me--"

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 2|	Before the captain is able to finish his sentence, pipes in the wall next to him explode, blasting hot steam all over the right side of his body, causing him to begin rolling on the floor in horrible screeches of pain. Not wanting to stay connected to the ship any longer than you need to be, you run back into your ship and fly away.|2727|0
units.english: Before the captain is able to finish his sentence, pipes in the wall next to him explode, blasting hot steam all over the right side of his body, causing him to begin rolling on the floor in horrible screeches of pain. Not wanting to stay connected to the ship any longer than you need to be, you run back into your ship and fly away.
units.italian: Prima che il capitano riesca a finire la frase, le tubature nel muro accanto a lui esplodono, investendo tutto il lato destro del suo corpo con vapore bollente e facendolo rotolare a terra fra urla di dolore atroci. Senza voler restare collegato alla nave più del necessario, corri di nuovo nella tua e voli via.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|name|2734|0
units.english: Bring Tod to <planet>
units.italian: Porta Tod su <planet>

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|description|2735|0
units.english: Now that Tod's mother knows he is safe, bring him to <destination> so that he may start his mining job to support him and his mother.
units.italian: Ora che la madre di Tod sa che è al sicuro, portalo su <destination> perché possa iniziare il lavoro in miniera e mantenere sé stesso e sua madre.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|blocked|2739|0
units.english: This mission requires that you have at least one free bunk. Return once you have the space.
units.italian: Questa missione richiede almeno un posto letto libero. Torna quando avrai lo spazio.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|Tod's mother almost tears up at the sight of him as you approach. "Oh, my baby boy is alive!" she exclaims, running up and hugging Tod as his face reddens with embarrassment. "Are you hurt? Are you okay? Do you think you'll be fine?" Tod's mother asks, kissing his cheeks between each question.|2745|0
units.english: Tod's mother almost tears up at the sight of him as you approach. "Oh, my baby boy is alive!" she exclaims, running up and hugging Tod as his face reddens with embarrassment. "Are you hurt? Are you okay? Do you think you'll be fine?" Tod's mother asks, kissing his cheeks between each question.
units.italian: La madre di Tod quasi si commuove alla sua vista mentre vi avvicinate. "Oh, il mio bambino è vivo!" esclama, correndo ad abbracciare Tod mentre lui arrossisce per l'imbarazzo. "Ti sei fatto male? Stai bene? Pensi che starai bene?" chiede la madre di Tod, baciandogli le guance fra una domanda e l'altra.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|	"I'm fine, Mom," Tod says in an annoyed tone of voice. Some things never change.|2746|0
units.english: "I'm fine, Mom," Tod says in an annoyed tone of voice. Some things never change.
units.italian: "Sto bene, mamma," dice Tod con voce seccata. Certe cose non cambiano mai.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|	The mother gives you a handful of credit chips. At a glance, you guess that they couldn't be worth more than 1,000 credits. "I know it isn't much for the work you've done, Captain, but it's all I have to give you in return."|2747|0
units.english: The mother gives you a handful of credit chips. At a glance, you guess that they couldn't be worth more than 1,000 credits. "I know it isn't much for the work you've done, Captain, but it's all I have to give you in return."
units.italian: La madre ti dà una manciata di chip di credito. A occhio, non valgono più di 1.000 crediti. "So che non è molto per il lavoro che hai fatto, Capitano, ma è tutto quello che ho da darti in cambio."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|	"Don't worry about it."|2749|0
units.english: "Don't worry about it."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|	"I'm sorry but I can't take this from you."|2750|0
units.english: "I'm sorry but I can't take this from you."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non posso accettarlo."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|	"This is just so wonderful. There aren't many people around here who would do such a thing for such little pay."|2755|0
units.english: "This is just so wonderful. There aren't many people around here who would do such a thing for such little pay."
units.italian: "È semplicemente meraviglioso. Non c'è molta gente qui in giro disposta a fare una cosa del genere per così poco."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|	You hand the credits back to the mother as she begins to tear up again. "Thank you so much, Captain."|2759|0
units.english: You hand the credits back to the mother as she begins to tear up again. "Thank you so much, Captain."
units.italian: Restituisci i crediti alla madre, che ricomincia a commuoversi. "Grazie mille, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|	"Hold on," Tod chimes in. "I still need to get to <planet>."|2762|0
units.english: "Hold on," Tod chimes in. "I still need to get to <planet>."
units.italian: "Un momento," interviene Tod. "Devo ancora arrivare su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|	"Of course!" his mother yells out. "Captain, would you please make sure that Tod has a safe passage to <destination>?"|2763|0
units.english: "Of course!" his mother yells out. "Captain, would you please make sure that Tod has a safe passage to <destination>?"
units.italian: "Certo!" esclama sua madre. "Capitano, potrebbe assicurarsi che Tod arrivi sano e salvo su <destination>?"

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|	"And make sure I don't become a slave this time," Tod quips jokingly.|2764|0
units.english: "And make sure I don't become a slave this time," Tod quips jokingly.
units.italian: "E assicurati che questa volta non finisca schiavo," aggiunge Tod, scherzando.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|	"Okay, I'll take Tod to <planet>."|2766|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll take Tod to <planet>."
units.italian: "Va bene, porto Tod su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|	"Sorry, I'm not headed in that direction."|2768|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm not headed in that direction."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non vado in quella direzione."

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|dialog|2778|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but remember that Tod is in one of your escorts that has yet to enter the system. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ricordi che Tod è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Lost Boy 3|dialog|2780|0
units.english: You wish Tod the best of luck on <planet>. "Thank you, Captain. Hopefully I can repay you one day. As cliche as it sounds, I owe you my life."
units.italian: Auguri a Tod ogni bene su <planet>. "Grazie, Capitano. Spero di poterti ripagare un giorno. Per quanto suoni da cliché, ti devo la vita."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 1|name|2786|0
units.english: Flee to <planet>
units.italian: Fuga su <planet>

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 1|description|2787|0
units.english: Flee from <origin> to <destination> with the girl you let on to your ship.
units.italian: Fuggi da <origin> a <destination> con la ragazza che hai fatto salire sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 1|As with all Paradise Worlds, the air is just the right temperature when you step out of your ship, and a light breeze rustles the leaves of the trees planted around the spaceport. While taking a moment to breathe in the fresh air, you hear yelling coming from the entrance to the <origin> shipyard. Looking over, you spot a young girl with a backpack running from two spaceport security guards. "Get back here!" they yell at the girl, chasing her with no success.|2800|0
units.english: As with all Paradise Worlds, the air is just the right temperature when you step out of your ship, and a light breeze rustles the leaves of the trees planted around the spaceport. While taking a moment to breathe in the fresh air, you hear yelling coming from the entrance to the <origin> shipyard. Looking over, you spot a young girl with a backpack running from two spaceport security guards. "Get back here!" they yell at the girl, chasing her with no success.
units.italian: Come in tutti i Mondi Paradisiaci, l'aria ha la temperatura giusta quando esci dalla nave, e una brezza leggera fa frusciare le foglie degli alberi piantati intorno allo spazioporto.
