Mentre ti prendi un momento per respirare l'aria fresca, senti delle urla venire dall'ingresso del cantiere di <origin>. Guardando da quella parte, scorgi una ragazzina con uno zaino che corre inseguita da due guardie dello spazioporto. "Torna qui!" le gridano, inseguendola senza successo.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 1|	"Someone help me!" the girl shrieks out. As she runs, a credit chip falls out of her backpack.|2801|0
units.english: "Someone help me!" the girl shrieks out. As she runs, a credit chip falls out of her backpack.
units.italian: "Qualcuno mi aiuti!" strilla la ragazza. Mentre corre, un chip di credito le cade dallo zaino.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 1|	(Let her onto my ship.)|2803|0
units.english: (Let her onto my ship.)
units.italian: (Falla salire sulla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 1|	(Ignore the scene.)|2805|0
units.english: (Ignore the scene.)
units.italian: (Ignora la scena.)

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 1|	The girl looks you in the eyes as she approaches, expecting help that will never come. Air rushes past you as she and the security guards run by. After a few meters, the security guards catch up to the girl, tackling her to the ground and detaining her as they remove her backpack full of credit chips.|2807|0
units.english: The girl looks you in the eyes as she approaches, expecting help that will never come. Air rushes past you as she and the security guards run by. After a few meters, the security guards catch up to the girl, tackling her to the ground and detaining her as they remove her backpack full of credit chips.
units.italian: La ragazza ti guarda negli occhi mentre si avvicina, aspettandosi un aiuto che non arriverà mai. L'aria ti passa accanto mentre lei e le guardie corrono oltre. Dopo qualche metro le guardie la raggiungono, la bloccano a terra e la trattengono mentre le tolgono lo zaino pieno di chip di credito.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 1|	You open the hatch to your ship and yell "Get on!" as the girl approaches. "Thank you, Captain," she says while getting closer, to much protest from the approaching security guards.|2811|0
units.english: You open the hatch to your ship and yell "Get on!" as the girl approaches. "Thank you, Captain," she says while getting closer, to much protest from the approaching security guards.
units.italian: Apri il portello della nave e gridi "Sali!" mentre la ragazza si avvicina. "Grazie, Capitano," dice, facendosi più vicina, fra le vibrate proteste delle guardie che sopraggiungono.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 1|	As she enters your ship, she grabs your arm and pulls you in with her before closing the hatch. "Launch and go to <destination>, now! I'll explain when we get there."|2812|0
units.english: As she enters your ship, she grabs your arm and pulls you in with her before closing the hatch. "Launch and go to <destination>, now! I'll explain when we get there."
units.italian: Mentre entra nella nave, ti afferra il braccio e ti tira dentro con lei prima di chiudere il portello. "Decolla e vai su <destination>, subito! Ti spiego quando arriviamo."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 1|dialog|2815|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that the girl is in one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la ragazza è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|name|2821|0
units.english: Escaping Paradise
units.italian: Fuga dal Paradiso

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|description|2822|0
units.english: Escape the Paradise Worlds and travel to <destination> where Diana Howl will give over part of her family's fortune to the local government of <planet>.
units.italian: Fuggi dai Mondi Paradisiaci e raggiungi <destination>, dove Diana Howl consegnerà parte della fortuna della sua famiglia al governo locale di <planet>.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|"You need to explain what is going on here," you say just after setting your ship down.|2832|0
units.english: "You need to explain what is going on here," you say just after setting your ship down.
units.italian: "Devi spiegarmi che cosa sta succedendo qui," dici appena posata la nave.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"Alright, alright, I'll explain." You notice that the girl has a strange mix between a posh Paradise World accent and a Dirt Belt or possibly even Rim accent. "My name is Diana Howl. My father is the CEO of a large marketing firm. And this," Diana opens her backpack, revealing its full contents of thousands of credit chips, "this is part of my family fortune, about half a billion credits of it. Don't worry, my father should be able to make this back in a few months' time."|2833|0
units.english: "Alright, alright, I'll explain." You notice that the girl has a strange mix between a posh Paradise World accent and a Dirt Belt or possibly even Rim accent. "My name is Diana Howl. My father is the CEO of a large marketing firm. And this," Diana opens her backpack, revealing its full contents of thousands of credit chips, "this is part of my family fortune, about half a billion credits of it. Don't worry, my father should be able to make this back in a few months' time."
units.italian: "Va bene, va bene, ti spiego." Noti che la ragazza ha uno strano mix fra l'accento snob dei Mondi Paradisiaci e quello della Dirt Belt, o forse persino del Rim. "Mi chiamo Diana Howl. Mio padre è l'amministratore delegato di una grande agenzia di marketing. E questo," Diana apre lo zaino, rivelando tutto il contenuto di migliaia di chip di credito, "questo è parte della fortuna di famiglia, circa mezzo miliardo di crediti. Non preoccuparti, mio padre dovrebbe riuscire a recuperarli in qualche mese."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	You faintly recall the name "Howl" as belonging to the owners of a large island on Mainsail.|2834|0
units.english: You faintly recall the name "Howl" as belonging to the owners of a large island on Mainsail.
units.italian: Ti torna vagamente in mente il nome "Howl", quello dei proprietari di una grande isola su Mainsail.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"Why have you stolen all this?"|2838|0
units.english: "Why have you stolen all this?"
units.italian: "Perché hai rubato tutto questo?"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"I'm calling the spaceport authorities."|2840|0
units.english: "I'm calling the spaceport authorities."
units.italian: "Chiamo le autorità dello spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"No, wait! Let me explain!" Diana protests.|2842|0
units.english: "No, wait! Let me explain!" Diana protests.
units.italian: "No, aspetta! Lascia che ti spieghi!" protesta Diana.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"All my life I've been fascinated with the world outside my little bubble of the Paradise Planets. My father met my mother on Heartland in the Cor Caroli system while he was on a business trip, so my mother would often take me on trips to the Dirt Belt. The last time I went was before the war though; my mother didn't want me anywhere near the 'Free Loafers,' as she called them. Back then life in the Dirt Belt didn't seem anywhere near comparable to life in the Paradise Worlds, and I can only imagine how much worse it might be after being so close to a war, so I decided that I needed to do something to help.|2845|0
units.english: "All my life I've been fascinated with the world outside my little bubble of the Paradise Planets. My father met my mother on Heartland in the Cor Caroli system while he was on a business trip, so my mother would often take me on trips to the Dirt Belt. The last time I went was before the war though; my mother didn't want me anywhere near the 'Free Loafers,' as she called them. Back then life in the Dirt Belt didn't seem anywhere near comparable to life in the Paradise Worlds, and I can only imagine how much worse it might be after being so close to a war, so I decided that I needed to do something to help.
units.italian: "Per tutta la vita sono stata affascinata dal mondo fuori dalla mia piccola bolla dei Pianeti Paradisiaci. Mio padre ha conosciuto mia madre su Heartland, nel sistema Cor Caroli, durante un viaggio di lavoro, così mia madre mi portava spesso in viaggio nella Dirt Belt. L'ultima volta, però, è stato prima della guerra: mia madre non voleva che stessi vicino ai 'Free Loafers', come li chiamava lei. All'epoca la vita nella Dirt Belt non sembrava neanche lontanamente paragonabile a quella dei Mondi Paradisiaci, e posso solo immaginare quanto sia peggiorata dopo essere stata così vicina a una guerra, così ho deciso che dovevo fare qualcosa per aiutare.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"Now, can you take me to <destination>? I wish to hand this over to the government there to help them. It may not seem like much in the grand scheme of how many credits go into running a planet, but it should be a huge boost to their economy."|2846|0
units.english: "Now, can you take me to <destination>? I wish to hand this over to the government there to help them. It may not seem like much in the grand scheme of how many credits go into running a planet, but it should be a huge boost to their economy."
units.italian: "Ora, puoi portarmi su <destination>? Voglio consegnare questo al governo locale per aiutarli. Può non sembrare molto rispetto a quanti crediti servono per mandare avanti un pianeta, ma dovrebbe dare una spinta enorme alla loro economia."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"Alright, I'll help you."|2848|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll help you."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti aiuto."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"What makes you think they won't hand it over to your father?"|2850|0
units.english: "What makes you think they won't hand it over to your father?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ti fa pensare che non lo consegnino a tuo padre?"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"This is a crime. I don't want to get in trouble helping you."|2851|0
units.english: "This is a crime. I don't want to get in trouble helping you."
units.italian: "Questo è un reato. Non voglio mettermi nei guai aiutandoti."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	Diana pauses. "I hadn't thought of that," she says in a downtrodden tone, "but I at least have to try! Please just bring me to <planet>. Please!" Diana looks up at you with puppy dog eyes, quivering her lip with the backpack of credit chips held against her chest.|2854|0
units.english: Diana pauses. "I hadn't thought of that," she says in a downtrodden tone, "but I at least have to try! Please just bring me to <planet>. Please!" Diana looks up at you with puppy dog eyes, quivering her lip with the backpack of credit chips held against her chest.
units.italian: Diana si ferma. "Non ci avevo pensato," dice con tono abbattuto, "ma almeno devo provarci! Ti prego, portami su <planet>. Ti prego!" Diana alza su di te due occhi da cucciolo, con il labbro che trema e lo zaino di chip di credito stretto al petto.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"Alright, I'll bring you to <planet>."|2856|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll bring you to <planet>."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti porto su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"Sorry, but I'm not putting myself on the line for this."|2857|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not putting myself on the line for this."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non mi metto in gioco per questa storia."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"Excellent!" Diana yells out. She drops the bag of credits on the floor and gives you a hug. "We'll have to leave immediately, for I fear that the spaceport authorities here might be searching for us."|2864|0
units.english: "Excellent!" Diana yells out. She drops the bag of credits on the floor and gives you a hug. "We'll have to leave immediately, for I fear that the spaceport authorities here might be searching for us."
units.italian: "Eccellente!" esclama Diana. Lascia cadere a terra la borsa dei crediti e ti abbraccia. "Dobbiamo partire subito, perché temo che le autorità dello spazioporto qui ci stiano cercando."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|label|2867|0
units.english: paradise accept
units.italian: paradise accept

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"Excellent!" Diana yells out. She drops the bag of credits on the floor and gives you a hug. "Thank you so much, Captain <last>."|2868|0
units.english: "Excellent!" Diana yells out. She drops the bag of credits on the floor and gives you a hug. "Thank you so much, Captain <last>."
units.italian: "Eccellente!" esclama Diana. Lascia cadere a terra la borsa dei crediti e ti abbraccia. "Grazie mille, Capitano <last>."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"No need to thank me."|2870|0
units.english: "No need to thank me."
units.italian: "Non devi ringraziarmi."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"Wait, how do you know my name?"|2872|0
units.english: "Wait, how do you know my name?"
units.italian: "Aspetta, come fai a sapere il mio nome?"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"I saw you on the news," Diana replies. "They said that, even though you were born on Mainsail, you decided to join the Free Worlds and fight against the Paradise Planets."|2873|0
units.english: "I saw you on the news," Diana replies. "They said that, even though you were born on Mainsail, you decided to join the Free Worlds and fight against the Paradise Planets."
units.italian: "Ti ho visto al notiziario," risponde Diana. "Dicevano che, anche se sei nato su Mainsail, hai deciso di unirti ai Free Worlds e combattere contro i Mondi Paradisiaci."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	Eventually, Diana pulls herself away and says, "We'll have to leave immediately, for I fear that the spaceport authorities here might be searching for us."|2875|0
units.english: Eventually, Diana pulls herself away and says, "We'll have to leave immediately, for I fear that the spaceport authorities here might be searching for us."
units.italian: Alla fine Diana si stacca e dice: "Dobbiamo partire subito, perché temo che le autorità dello spazioporto qui ci stiano cercando."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	You call the spaceport authorities and tell them that Diana Howl is on your ship. Moments later when they arrive, they take Diana kicking and screaming off of your ship. She yells harsh profanities at you as she is taken away, one among them being "Syndicate lover." As a reward for "catching" Diana, the spaceport authorities transfer 150,000 credits to your account.|2882|0
units.english: You call the spaceport authorities and tell them that Diana Howl is on your ship. Moments later when they arrive, they take Diana kicking and screaming off of your ship. She yells harsh profanities at you as she is taken away, one among them being "Syndicate lover." As a reward for "catching" Diana, the spaceport authorities transfer 150,000 credits to your account.
units.italian: Chiami le autorità dello spazioporto e dici loro che Diana Howl è sulla tua nave. Pochi minuti dopo, quando arrivano, portano Diana giù dalla nave tra calci e urla. Ti grida insulti pesanti mentre la portano via, uno dei quali è "amante del Sindacato". Come ricompensa per aver "catturato" Diana, le autorità dello spazioporto ti trasferiscono 150.000 crediti.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	You move to re-enter your cockpit and call the authorities, but Diana thrusts her arms out, blocking your way. "Wait! You're <first> <last>, aren't you? The war hero who fought and defeated the Pug?"|2886|0
units.english: You move to re-enter your cockpit and call the authorities, but Diana thrusts her arms out, blocking your way. "Wait! You're <first> <last>, aren't you? The war hero who fought and defeated the Pug?"
units.italian: Fai per rientrare nell'abitacolo e chiamare le autorità, ma Diana allarga le braccia e ti sbarra la strada. "Aspetta! Tu sei <first> <last>, vero? L'eroe di guerra che ha combattuto e sconfitto i Pug?"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"Yes, I am."|2888|0
units.english: "Yes, I am."
units.italian: "Sì, sono io."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"Sorry, but you have the wrong person."|2890|0
units.english: "Sorry, but you have the wrong person."
units.italian: "Spiacente, hai sbagliato persona."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"No, I know you're <first>! You look just like the videos in all the news reports!"|2891|0
units.english: "No, I know you're <first>! You look just like the videos in all the news reports!"
units.italian: "No, so che sei <first>! Sei identico ai video di tutti i notiziari!"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"And what of it?" you reply.|2892|0
units.english: "And what of it?" you reply.
units.italian: "E allora?" rispondi.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"The news said that, even though you were born and raised on Mainsail, you decided to join the Free Worlds and fight the Republic for the sake of the people!" Diana balls her hands into fists. "When I first heard about you, I thought that, maybe, I could make my own difference in the galaxy, and use my privilege for good instead of evil. But now you're acting like that never happened! Like the Republic is suddenly the best thing ever, and that everyone in poverty deserves to be that way!"|2895|0
units.english: "The news said that, even though you were born and raised on Mainsail, you decided to join the Free Worlds and fight the Republic for the sake of the people!" Diana balls her hands into fists. "When I first heard about you, I thought that, maybe, I could make my own difference in the galaxy, and use my privilege for good instead of evil. But now you're acting like that never happened! Like the Republic is suddenly the best thing ever, and that everyone in poverty deserves to be that way!"
units.italian: "Il notiziario diceva che, anche se sei nato e cresciuto su Mainsail, hai deciso di unirti ai Free Worlds e combattere la Repubblica per il bene della gente!" Diana stringe le mani a pugno. "Quando ho sentito parlare di te per la prima volta, ho pensato che forse anch'io avrei potuto fare la differenza nella galassia, e usare i miei privilegi per il bene invece che per il male. Ma ora ti comporti come se non fosse mai successo! Come se la Repubblica fosse improvvisamente la cosa migliore del mondo, e come se chiunque viva in povertà meritasse di restarci!"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"Yes, I fought against the Republic, and I almost died several times because of that. I don't want to put you in danger."|2897|0
units.english: "Yes, I fought against the Republic, and I almost died several times because of that. I don't want to put you in danger."
units.italian: "Sì, ho combattuto contro la Repubblica, e per questo sono quasi morto diverse volte. Non voglio metterti in pericolo."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"That's because I was fighting a war of independence. What you're doing is a random, poorly planned robbery."|2899|0
units.english: "That's because I was fighting a war of independence. What you're doing is a random, poorly planned robbery."
units.italian: "È perché stavo combattendo una guerra d'indipendenza. Quello che stai facendo tu è una rapina improvvisata e mal pianificata."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"I was only ever in the Free Worlds for the fame and glory. I'm not about to have that ruined by helping some wannabe Robin Hood."|2901|0
units.english: "I was only ever in the Free Worlds for the fame and glory. I'm not about to have that ruined by helping some wannabe Robin Hood."
units.italian: "Sono stato nei Free Worlds solo per la fama e la gloria. Non ho intenzione di rovinare tutto aiutando una specie di Robin Hood da strapazzo."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	Diana is left stunned by your bitter words, giving you an opportunity to push her aside and flick on your ship's speakers to call for help. Moments later, when the spaceport authorities arrive, they take Diana kicking and screaming off of your ship. She yells harsh profanities at you as she is taken away, one among them being "Syndicate lover." As a reward for "catching" Diana, the spaceport authorities transfer 150,000 credits to your account.|2903|0
units.english: Diana is left stunned by your bitter words, giving you an opportunity to push her aside and flick on your ship's speakers to call for help. Moments later, when the spaceport authorities arrive, they take Diana kicking and screaming off of your ship. She yells harsh profanities at you as she is taken away, one among them being "Syndicate lover." As a reward for "catching" Diana, the spaceport authorities transfer 150,000 credits to your account.
units.italian: Le parole amare lasciano Diana di stucco, e ne approfitti per spingerla da parte e accendere gli altoparlanti della nave per chiedere aiuto. Pochi minuti dopo, quando arrivano le autorità dello spazioporto, portano Diana giù dalla nave tra calci e urla. Ti grida insulti pesanti mentre la portano via, uno dei quali è "amante del Sindacato". Come ricompensa per aver "catturato" Diana, le autorità dello spazioporto ti trasferiscono 150.000 crediti.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	She grits her teeth. "And what if I don't care? If risking my life means bettering the lives of thousands more, then why shouldn't I take that risk?"|2907|0
units.english: She grits her teeth. "And what if I don't care? If risking my life means bettering the lives of thousands more, then why shouldn't I take that risk?"
units.italian: Stringe i denti. "E se non mi importasse? Se rischiare la vita significa migliorare quella di migliaia di altre persone, perché non dovrei correre il rischio?"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	Diana stutters. "S-so what? Every change needs to start from somewhere, and even if things aren't going well right now, this could eventually lead to a real difference! Please, just give me a chance."|2911|0
units.english: Diana stutters. "S-so what? Every change needs to start from somewhere, and even if things aren't going well right now, this could eventually lead to a real difference! Please, just give me a chance."
units.italian: Diana balbetta. "E-e allora? Ogni cambiamento deve cominciare da qualche parte, e anche se le cose adesso non vanno bene, questo potrebbe portare a un cambiamento vero! Ti prego, dammi una possibilità."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"Okay, you've convinced me. I'll take you to <planet>."|2915|0
units.english: "Okay, you've convinced me. I'll take you to <planet>."
units.italian: "Va bene, mi hai convinto. Ti porto su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	"That's not good enough. I'm turning you in."|2916|0
units.english: "That's not good enough. I'm turning you in."
units.italian: "Non basta. Ti consegno alle autorità."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	Diana turns her face in a poor attempt to hide her relief. "We'll have to leave immediately," she says, "for I fear that the spaceport authorities here might be searching for us."|2919|0
units.english: Diana turns her face in a poor attempt to hide her relief. "We'll have to leave immediately," she says, "for I fear that the spaceport authorities here might be searching for us."
units.italian: Diana gira il viso nel tentativo maldestro di nascondere il sollievo. "Dobbiamo partire subito," dice, "perché temo che le autorità dello spazioporto qui ci stiano cercando."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|label|2922|0
units.english: final decline
units.italian: final decline

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|	You push Diana aside and call the spaceport authorities. Moments later, they take Diana kicking and screaming off of your ship. She yells harsh profanities at you as she is taken away, one among them being "Syndicate lover." As a reward for "catching" Diana, the spaceport authorities transfer 150,000 credits to your account.|2923|0
units.english: You push Diana aside and call the spaceport authorities. Moments later, they take Diana kicking and screaming off of your ship. She yells harsh profanities at you as she is taken away, one among them being "Syndicate lover." As a reward for "catching" Diana, the spaceport authorities transfer 150,000 credits to your account.
units.italian: Spingi Diana da parte e chiami le autorità dello spazioporto. Pochi minuti dopo, portano Diana giù dalla nave tra calci e urla. Ti grida insulti pesanti mentre la portano via, uno dei quali è "amante del Sindacato". Come ricompensa per aver "catturato" Diana, le autorità dello spazioporto ti trasferiscono 150.000 crediti.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|log|2928|0
units.english: A teenager who stole half a billion credits from her family's wealth, you turned her in to the authorities for a meagre reward.
units.italian: Una ragazzina che aveva rubato mezzo miliardo di crediti dalla ricchezza della sua famiglia: l'hai consegnata alle autorità per una ricompensa misera.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 2|dialog|2930|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that Diana is in one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che Diana è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|name|2936|0
units.english: Last Hope
units.italian: Ultima speranza

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|description|2937|0
units.english: Escape from the Navy and travel to <destination> where Diana Howl hopes that the Free Worlds will help her.
units.italian: Fuggi dalla Marina e raggiungi <destination>, dove Diana Howl spera che i Free Worlds la aiutino.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|Diana is eager to get going as soon as you land. "This is going to be great! I'm going to do so much good with this! I can't wait to see the look on their faces when I open up my backpack in front of them!" Diana says rapidly as she bounces up and down with the backpack of credit chips on her back.|2945|0
units.english: Diana is eager to get going as soon as you land. "This is going to be great! I'm going to do so much good with this! I can't wait to see the look on their faces when I open up my backpack in front of them!" Diana says rapidly as she bounces up and down with the backpack of credit chips on her back.
units.italian: Diana è impaziente di partire appena atterri. "Sarà fantastico! Farò così tanto bene con questo! Non vedo l'ora di vedere la loro faccia quando apro lo zaino davanti a loro!" dice Diana in fretta, saltellando su e giù con lo zaino di chip di credito sulle spalle.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	As you gather a few credits to bring with you in case you see something you want to buy, Diana bounces off the ship. Suddenly, her crazed rambling stops. Diana comes running back onto the ship yelling "We need to go! Fly to <destination>! The Free Worlds should protect me!"|2946|0
units.english: As you gather a few credits to bring with you in case you see something you want to buy, Diana bounces off the ship. Suddenly, her crazed rambling stops. Diana comes running back onto the ship yelling "We need to go! Fly to <destination>! The Free Worlds should protect me!"
units.italian: Mentre prendi qualche credito da portare con te in caso vedessi qualcosa da comprare, Diana schizza fuori dalla nave. All'improvviso il suo farneticare si interrompe. Diana torna di corsa sulla nave gridando "Dobbiamo andare! Vola su <destination>! I Free Worlds dovrebbero proteggermi!"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	"What is it? What's happening?"|2948|0
units.english: "What is it? What's happening?"
units.italian: "Che cosa succede? Che sta succedendo?"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	(Launch immediately.)|2949|0
units.english: (Launch immediately.)
units.italian: (Decolla subito.)

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	"Look outside," Diana says with a ghastly look on her face. You check your ship's external cameras, and roaming around your ship is a group of men in Navy uniforms. One of them raises a megaphone to his mouth.|2952|0
units.english: "Look outside," Diana says with a ghastly look on her face. You check your ship's external cameras, and roaming around your ship is a group of men in Navy uniforms. One of them raises a megaphone to his mouth.
units.italian: "Guarda fuori," dice Diana con un'espressione spettrale. Controlli le telecamere esterne della nave: intorno alla tua nave si aggira un gruppo di uomini in uniforme della Marina. Uno di loro alza un megafono alla bocca.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	"Hand over the girl and her credits and we can all walk away from this peacefully, Captain."|2953|0
units.english: "Hand over the girl and her credits and we can all walk away from this peacefully, Captain."
units.italian: "Consegnaci la ragazza e i suoi crediti e ce ne andremo tutti da qui in pace, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	"Why do you need her?"|2955|0
units.english: "Why do you need her?"
units.italian: "Perché vi serve?"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	"Over my dead body!"|2956|0
units.english: "Over my dead body!"
units.italian: "Solo sul mio cadavere!"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	"Alright, I'll bring her out."|2958|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll bring her out."
units.italian: "Va bene, la porto fuori."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	"In case you haven't noticed, Captain, that girl is in possession of over half a billion stolen credits. She's a criminal, and helping her makes you a criminal too. Given your status, Captain <last>, I'd appreciate it if you didn't make me the officer that put <first> <last> behind bars."|2961|0
units.english: "In case you haven't noticed, Captain, that girl is in possession of over half a billion stolen credits. She's a criminal, and helping her makes you a criminal too. Given your status, Captain <last>, I'd appreciate it if you didn't make me the officer that put <first> <last> behind bars."
units.italian: "Nel caso non l'abbia notato, Capitano, quella ragazza è in possesso di oltre mezzo miliardo di crediti rubati. È una criminale, e aiutarla rende criminale anche lei. Considerata la sua posizione, Capitano <last>, Le sarei grato se non mi costringesse a essere l'ufficiale che mette <first> <last> dietro le sbarre."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	"I'm sorry officer, but I can't help you."|2963|0
units.english: "I'm sorry officer, but I can't help you."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ufficiale, ma non posso aiutarla."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	"Okay, I'll hand her over."|2965|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll hand her over."
units.italian: "Va bene, gliela consegno."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	Diana looks to you in shock. "You wouldn't!" she screeches. "You can't! Fly me to <planet> right now!"|2968|0
units.english: Diana looks to you in shock. "You wouldn't!" she screeches. "You can't! Fly me to <planet> right now!"
units.italian: Diana ti guarda scioccata. "Non lo faresti mai!" strilla. "Non puoi! Portami su <planet> adesso!"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	"I'm not going to become a criminal to fulfill your crazy dream."|2970|0
units.english: "I'm not going to become a criminal to fulfill your crazy dream."
units.italian: "Non diventerò un criminale per realizzare il tuo sogno assurdo."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	"Okay, we'll fly to <planet>."|2971|0
units.english: "Okay, we'll fly to <planet>."
units.italian: "Va bene, voliamo su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	You allow the Navy officer and his troops onto your ship, where they apprehend Diana and her stolen credits. They take her kicking and screaming off of your ship. She yells harsh profanities at you as she is taken away, one among them being "Syndicate lover."|2974|0
units.english: You allow the Navy officer and his troops onto your ship, where they apprehend Diana and her stolen credits. They take her kicking and screaming off of your ship. She yells harsh profanities at you as she is taken away, one among them being "Syndicate lover."
units.italian: Lasci salire sulla nave l'ufficiale della Marina e i suoi uomini, che fermano Diana e sequestrano i crediti rubati. La portano giù dalla nave tra calci e urla. Ti grida insulti pesanti mentre la portano via, uno dei quali è "amante del Sindacato".

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	"Thank you for not causing any more trouble, Captain," the officer says to you. He then hands you 500,000 credits for "playing nice" and leaves.|2975|0
units.english: "Thank you for not causing any more trouble, Captain," the officer says to you. He then hands you 500,000 credits for "playing nice" and leaves.
units.italian: "Grazie per non aver creato altri problemi, Capitano," ti dice l'ufficiale. Poi ti consegna 500.000 crediti per aver "fatto il bravo" e se ne va.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|	You activate your repulsor engines, sending the Navy troops recoiling away from your ship. As you ascend into space, your computers detect multiple ships targeting you.|2979|0
units.english: You activate your repulsor engines, sending the Navy troops recoiling away from your ship. As you ascend into space, your computers detect multiple ships targeting you.
units.italian: Attivi i motori repulsori, facendo indietreggiare le truppe della Marina lontano dalla nave. Mentre sali nello spazio, i tuoi computer rilevano più navi che ti prendono di mira.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|log|2988|0
units.english: A teenager who stole half a billion credits from her family's wealth, you turned her in to the authorities for a moderate reward.
units.italian: Una ragazzina che aveva rubato mezzo miliardo di crediti dalla ricchezza della sua famiglia: l'hai consegnata alle autorità per una ricompensa moderata.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 3|dialog|2991|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that Diana is in one of your escorts that hasn't entered the system yet. Better depart and wait for it to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che Diana è su una delle tue scorte che non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivi.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|name|3002|0
units.english: Exchange of Goods
units.italian: Scambio di merci

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|description|3003|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> and hand the backpack of credits and Diana Howl's note over to the Navy.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> e consegna alla Marina lo zaino di crediti e il biglietto di Diana Howl.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|While in flight, Diana tells you the stories that she heard of the war. In the Paradise Planets region, they were told that declaring independence and bombing Geminus and Martini was the Free Worlds' first step in overthrowing the Republic.|3011|0
units.english: While in flight, Diana tells you the stories that she heard of the war. In the Paradise Planets region, they were told that declaring independence and bombing Geminus and Martini was the Free Worlds' first step in overthrowing the Republic.
units.italian: Durante il volo, Diana ti racconta le storie di guerra che ha sentito. Nella regione dei Pianeti Paradisiaci dicevano che dichiarare l'indipendenza e bombardare Geminus e Martini era stato il primo passo dei Free Worlds per rovesciare la Repubblica.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	"We should talk to Alondo," Diana says. "He'll be able to handle this situation."|3012|0
units.english: "We should talk to Alondo," Diana says. "He'll be able to handle this situation."
units.italian: "Dovremmo parlare con Alondo," dice Diana. "Lui saprà come gestire questa situazione."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	As you're coming in for a landing on Bourne, you receive a message from Alondo. "<first>!" he says. "I just heard that you were in system. Want to meet up for a drink and talk about old times?"|3016|0
units.english: As you're coming in for a landing on Bourne, you receive a message from Alondo. "<first>!" he says. "I just heard that you were in system. Want to meet up for a drink and talk about old times?"
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini per atterrare su Bourne, ricevi un messaggio da Alondo. "<first>!" dice. "Ho appena saputo che eri nel sistema. Ti va di vederci per un drink e parlare dei vecchi tempi?"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	"I'd be glad to any other time, but I need your help at the moment."|3018|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to any other time, but I need your help at the moment."
units.italian: "Con piacere un'altra volta, ma adesso mi serve il tuo aiuto."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	As you're coming in for a landing, you contact Alondo, who is luckily on Bourne. "What have you gotten yourself into?" he responds after you mention that you need his help.|3022|0
units.english: As you're coming in for a landing, you contact Alondo, who is luckily on Bourne. "What have you gotten yourself into?" he responds after you mention that you need his help.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini per atterrare, contatti Alondo, che per fortuna è su Bourne. "In che guaio ti sei cacciato?" risponde dopo che gli dici che ti serve il suo aiuto.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	"I'll explain the situation when we meet."|3024|0
units.english: "I'll explain the situation when we meet."
units.italian: "Ti spiego la situazione quando ci vediamo."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	You meet with Alondo at his office in the Free Worlds Senate building. After he and Diana exchange greetings, you explain the situation to him.|3027|0
units.english: You meet with Alondo at his office in the Free Worlds Senate building. After he and Diana exchange greetings, you explain the situation to him.
units.italian: Ti incontri con Alondo nel suo ufficio, nel palazzo del Senato dei Free Worlds. Dopo che lui e Diana si sono salutati, gli spieghi la situazione.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	"You what?" Alondo responds. "You have to turn her in. The war may be over, Captain, but there is still tension between the Republic and Free Worlds that we cannot have a situation like this exacerbating."|3028|0
units.english: "You what?" Alondo responds. "You have to turn her in. The war may be over, Captain, but there is still tension between the Republic and Free Worlds that we cannot have a situation like this exacerbating."
units.italian: "Hai fatto che cosa?" risponde Alondo. "Devi consegnarla. La guerra sarà anche finita, Capitano, ma fra Repubblica e Free Worlds c'è ancora tensione, e non possiamo permetterci che una situazione del genere la peggiori."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	"You can't do that!" Diana yells in protest. "I thought the Free Worlds were supposed to be all about going against the Republic, but you're just going to give in?"|3029|0
units.english: "You can't do that!" Diana yells in protest. "I thought the Free Worlds were supposed to be all about going against the Republic, but you're just going to give in?"
units.italian: "Non puoi farlo!" urla Diana per protesta. "Pensavo che i Free Worlds fossero nati per opporsi alla Repubblica, e invece vi arrendete così?"

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	"Look here, kid," Alondo says in a stern tone. "The Free Worlds were never about being against the Republic, it was only ever about being against Parliament. There's a big difference there. What you've done is a crime, even to the Free Worlds. We are not about to gain a reputation of harboring criminals of the Republic."|3030|0
units.english: "Look here, kid," Alondo says in a stern tone. "The Free Worlds were never about being against the Republic, it was only ever about being against Parliament. There's a big difference there. What you've done is a crime, even to the Free Worlds. We are not about to gain a reputation of harboring criminals of the Republic."
units.italian: "Ascolta, ragazzina," dice Alondo con tono severo. "I Free Worlds non sono mai stati contro la Repubblica, sono sempre stati solo contro il Parlamento. C'è una bella differenza. Quello che hai fatto è un reato, anche per i Free Worlds. Non abbiamo intenzione di guadagnarci la fama di chi dà asilo ai criminali della Repubblica."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	Diana, instead of protesting further, puts her head down. "I'll be in your ship, Captain," she says. Diana storms off, making an effort to create as much noise as possible with the stomps of her feet.|3031|0
units.english: Diana, instead of protesting further, puts her head down. "I'll be in your ship, Captain," she says. Diana storms off, making an effort to create as much noise as possible with the stomps of her feet.
units.italian: Invece di protestare ancora, Diana abbassa la testa. "Ti aspetto sulla nave, Capitano," dice. Se ne va infuriata, facendo di tutto per fare più rumore possibile con i piedi.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	"Spoiled kid," Alondo says quietly. "Attitudes like that are why I joined the Southern Defense Pact. Anyway Captain, I suggest you hand her over to the Navy immediately. I'll contact the Republic if you need me to."|3032|0
units.english: "Spoiled kid," Alondo says quietly. "Attitudes like that are why I joined the Southern Defense Pact. Anyway Captain, I suggest you hand her over to the Navy immediately. I'll contact the Republic if you need me to."
units.italian: "Ragazzina viziata," dice piano Alondo. "Atteggiamenti così sono il motivo per cui mi sono unito al Patto di Difesa Meridionale. Comunque, Capitano, le suggerisco di consegnarla subito alla Marina. Se serve, contatto io la Repubblica."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	"Alright, I'll hand her over."|3034|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll hand her over."
units.italian: "D'accordo, gliela consegno."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	"Sorry, Alondo, but I agree with her cause."|3035|0
units.english: "Sorry, Alondo, but I agree with her cause."
units.italian: "Spiacente, Alondo, ma sono d'accordo con la sua causa."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	Alondo breathes a sigh of relief. "You should probably go check on her. I'll message you where the Navy wants to pick her up."|3040|0
units.english: Alondo breathes a sigh of relief. "You should probably go check on her. I'll message you where the Navy wants to pick her up."
units.italian: Alondo tira un sospiro di sollievo. "Dovresti andare a controllarla. Ti mando un messaggio su dove la Marina vuole prenderla in consegna."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	"I understand. Please, just don't drag the Free Worlds into this."|3044|0
units.english: "I understand. Please, just don't drag the Free Worlds into this."
units.italian: "Ho capito. Ti prego, non trascinare i Free Worlds in questa storia."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	You say goodbye to Alondo and return to your ship. When you arrive and look around, Diana is notably absent. In your pilot's seat she has left her backpack and a written note. The paper has noticeable tear stains in one of the corners.|3047|0
units.english: You say goodbye to Alondo and return to your ship. When you arrive and look around, Diana is notably absent. In your pilot's seat she has left her backpack and a written note. The paper has noticeable tear stains in one of the corners.
units.italian: Saluti Alondo e torni alla tua nave. Quando arrivi e ti guardi intorno, Diana è notevolmente assente. Sul sedile del pilota ha lasciato il suo zaino e un biglietto scritto a mano. Il foglio ha delle evidenti macchie di lacrime in un angolo.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|Dear <first> <last>,|3049|0
units.english: Dear <first> <last>,
units.italian: Gentile <first> <last>,

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	I don't care about the credits anymore, but I can't go back to my family. I'll be too much of a disgrace, and I can't even imagine looking my parents in the eyes after what I've done. I've left the credits with you. You can do with them as you wish.|3050|0
units.english: I don't care about the credits anymore, but I can't go back to my family. I'll be too much of a disgrace, and I can't even imagine looking my parents in the eyes after what I've done. I've left the credits with you. You can do with them as you wish.
units.italian: I crediti non mi interessano più, ma non posso tornare dalla mia famiglia. Sarei una vergogna troppo grande, e non riesco nemmeno a immaginare di guardare i miei genitori negli occhi dopo quello che ho fatto. Ho lasciato i crediti con te. Puoi farne quello che vuoi.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	I've taken this chance to escape from my old life. I want to become my own person in the world, and I want to do it on my own. Please don't come looking for me, because wherever I am I'll be happier than when I was with my parents. I've failed myself today, but I'm still going to strive for the betterment of the less fortunate. Thank you for trying to make my dreams come true, even if you couldn't succeed.|3051|0
units.english: I've taken this chance to escape from my old life. I want to become my own person in the world, and I want to do it on my own. Please don't come looking for me, because wherever I am I'll be happier than when I was with my parents. I've failed myself today, but I'm still going to strive for the betterment of the less fortunate. Thank you for trying to make my dreams come true, even if you couldn't succeed.
units.italian: Ho colto questa occasione per fuggire dalla mia vecchia vita. Voglio diventare una persona mia nel mondo, e voglio farlo da sola. Ti prego di non venirmi a cercare, perché ovunque io sia starò meglio di quando ero con i miei genitori. Oggi ho fallito con me stessa, ma continuerò a impegnarmi per il bene di chi è meno fortunato. Grazie per aver cercato di realizzare il mio sogno, anche se non ci sei riuscito.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	Sincerely,|3052|0
units.english: Sincerely,
units.italian: Con sincerità,

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|				Diana W. Howl|3053|0
units.english: Diana W. Howl
units.italian: Diana W. Howl

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	You stare down at the backpack, stuffed full with over half a billion credits.|3055|0
units.english: You stare down at the backpack, stuffed full with over half a billion credits.
units.italian: Fissi lo zaino, pieno zeppo di oltre mezzo miliardo di crediti.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	(Hand the credits over to the Navy.)|3057|0
units.english: (Hand the credits over to the Navy.)
units.italian: (Consegna i crediti alla Marina.)

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	(Steal the credits.)|3058|0
units.english: (Steal the credits.)
units.italian: (Rubare i crediti.)

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	You fold the note and slip it into the backpack so that you can show it to the Navy to explain why Diana is not with you. You contact the Navy's crime report hotline and tell them that you have the stolen credits. A few minutes later, they respond telling you that a fleet is waiting on <destination> to retrieve the credits.|3063|0
units.english: You fold the note and slip it into the backpack so that you can show it to the Navy to explain why Diana is not with you. You contact the Navy's crime report hotline and tell them that you have the stolen credits. A few minutes later, they respond telling you that a fleet is waiting on <destination> to retrieve the credits.
units.italian: Pieghi il biglietto e lo infili nello zaino, così da poterlo mostrare alla Marina per spiegare perché Diana non è con te. Contatti la linea di segnalazione dei reati della Marina e dici che hai i crediti rubati. Pochi minuti dopo ti rispondono che una flotta ti aspetta su <destination> per ritirare i crediti.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	You fold the note and slip it into the backpack so that you can show it to the Navy to explain why Diana is not with you. Alondo sends you a message, telling you that the Navy says they are waiting on <destination> for the credits.|3069|0
units.english: You fold the note and slip it into the backpack so that you can show it to the Navy to explain why Diana is not with you. Alondo sends you a message, telling you that the Navy says they are waiting on <destination> for the credits.
units.italian: Pieghi il biglietto e lo infili nello zaino, così da poterlo mostrare alla Marina per spiegare perché Diana non è con te. Alondo ti manda un messaggio dicendoti che secondo la Marina ti aspettano su <destination> per i crediti.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	You rip the note apart and begin counting the credits. In total, the backpack contains a whopping 525,894,400 credits. Over half a billion credits richer, you sit down and wonder what you will spend it on.|3073|0
units.english: You rip the note apart and begin counting the credits. In total, the backpack contains a whopping 525,894,400 credits. Over half a billion credits richer, you sit down and wonder what you will spend it on.
units.italian: Strappi il biglietto e cominci a contare i crediti. In tutto lo zaino contiene la bellezza di 525.894.400 crediti. Più ricco di oltre mezzo miliardo di crediti, ti siedi e ti chiedi in che cosa li spenderai.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|log|3081|0
units.english: A teenager who stole half a billion credits from her family's wealth, she decided to start a new life outside the Paradise Planets while you decided to pocket the substantial fortune she left behind to avoid being hunted down.
units.italian: Una ragazzina che aveva rubato mezzo miliardo di crediti dalla ricchezza della sua famiglia: lei ha deciso di cominciare una nuova vita fuori dai Pianeti Paradisiaci, mentre tu hai deciso di intascare la sostanziosa fortuna che ha lasciato per non essere braccato.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|You spot a fleet of docked Navy ships as you come in for a landing. A small squad of troops gather around your ship after you land. You are greeted by a Navy officer upon exiting your ship and explain to him where Diana is, showing him the note she wrote.|3085|0
units.english: You spot a fleet of docked Navy ships as you come in for a landing. A small squad of troops gather around your ship after you land. You are greeted by a Navy officer upon exiting your ship and explain to him where Diana is, showing him the note she wrote.
units.italian: Scorgi una flotta di navi della Marina attraccate mentre ti avvicini per atterrare. Dopo l'atterraggio, una piccola squadra di soldati si raduna intorno alla tua nave. Un ufficiale della Marina ti accoglie all'uscita e gli spieghi dov'è Diana, mostrandogli il biglietto che ha scritto.

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|	"That is unfortunate," he responds with a troubled look on his face. "We'll contact the Howl family about this." Before letting you go, the officer hands you <payment>. "This is the reward that Mr. Howl put out for the return of his credits. Thank you for doing the right thing, Captain."|3086|0
units.english: "That is unfortunate," he responds with a troubled look on his face. "We'll contact the Howl family about this." Before letting you go, the officer hands you <payment>. "This is the reward that Mr. Howl put out for the return of his credits. Thank you for doing the right thing, Captain."
units.italian: "È un peccato," risponde con un'espressione preoccupata. "Contatteremo la famiglia Howl." Prima di lasciarti andare, l'ufficiale ti consegna <payment>. "Questa è la ricompensa che il signor Howl ha messo per la restituzione dei suoi crediti. Grazie per aver fatto la cosa giusta, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Paradise Fortune 4|log|3087|0
units.english: A teenager who stole half a billion credits from her family's wealth, she decided to start a new life outside the Paradise Planets while you dutifully turned in the credits to the authorities to keep the peace. You received a substantial reward for your integrity.
units.italian: Una ragazzina che aveva rubato mezzo miliardo di crediti dalla ricchezza della sua famiglia: lei ha deciso di cominciare una nuova vita fuori dai Pianeti Paradisiaci, mentre tu hai consegnato i crediti alle autorità per mantenere la pace. Hai ricevuto una ricompensa sostanziosa per la tua integrità.

units.id: mission:Northern Blockade|name|3093|0
units.english: Mebsuta Disaster
units.italian: Disastro di Mebsuta

units.id: mission:Northern Blockade|description|3094|0
units.english: <destination> is under attack by pirates. Assist the Republic by delivering <cargo> to the planet as soon as possible.
units.italian: <destination> è sotto attacco dei pirati. Aiuta la Repubblica consegnando <cargo> sul pianeta il prima possibile.

units.id: mission:Northern Blockade|You are approached by a Navy officer. "Are you Captain <last>?" You nod. "Would you be able to assist us? A sizable gang of pirates has occupied <system> and raided the spaceport. A Navy fleet is on its way to eliminate the pirates, but reports from the planet indicate that the spaceport of <planet> is in dire need of supplies. Any building above three stories was badly damaged and everything in the warehouses was either stolen or destroyed. We need a ship to bring <cargo> to them as soon as possible, but there are no available Navy ships capable of doing the job. Would you deliver the supplies for us, Captain?"|3106|0
units.english: You are approached by a Navy officer. "Are you Captain <last>?" You nod. "Would you be able to assist us? A sizable gang of pirates has occupied <system> and raided the spaceport. A Navy fleet is on its way to eliminate the pirates, but reports from the planet indicate that the spaceport of <planet> is in dire need of supplies. Any building above three stories was badly damaged and everything in the warehouses was either stolen or destroyed. We need a ship to bring <cargo> to them as soon as possible, but there are no available Navy ships capable of doing the job. Would you deliver the supplies for us, Captain?"
units.italian: Ti si avvicina un ufficiale della Marina. "È lei il Capitano <last>?" Annuisti. "Potrebbe aiutarci? Una banda consistente di pirati ha occupato <system> e ha saccheggiato lo spazioporto. Una flotta della Marina è in viaggio per eliminarli, ma le segnalazioni dal pianeta indicano che lo spazioporto di <planet> ha un disperato bisogno di rifornimenti. Ogni edificio sopra i tre piani è stato gravemente danneggiato e tutto quello che c'era nei magazzini è stato rubato o distrutto. Ci serve una nave che porti loro <cargo> il prima possibile, ma non abbiamo navi della Marina disponibili in grado di farlo. Ce la farebbe a consegnare i rifornimenti per noi, Capitano?"

units.id: mission:Northern Blockade|	"I'd be glad to help, Officer."|3108|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to help, Officer."
units.italian: "Sarei lieto di aiutare, ufficiale."

units.id: mission:Northern Blockade|	"Sorry, but I'm not traveling in that direction."|3110|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not traveling in that direction."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non vado in quella direzione."

units.id: mission:Northern Blockade|dialog|3136|0
units.english: As the last crate of supplies is loaded off of your ship, the Navy ships defending the system land. The local authorities thank you for helping, and you are paid <payment>.
units.italian: Mentre l'ultima cassa di rifornimenti viene scaricata dalla tua nave, atterrano le navi della Marina che difendono il sistema. Le autorità locali ti ringraziano per l'aiuto e ti pagano <payment>.

units.id: mission:Southern Blockade|name|3142|0
units.english: Spaceport Defenses
units.italian: Difese dello spazioporto

units.id: mission:Southern Blockade|description|3143|0
units.english: <stopovers> are under attack. Drop off <cargo> on these planets and return to <destination> for payment. (<payment>)
units.italian: <stopovers> sono sotto attacco. Scarica <cargo> su questi pianeti e torna su <destination> per il pagamento. (<payment>)

units.id: mission:Southern Blockade|A captain in a Free Worlds uniform enters the spaceport and turns on a megaphone. "Attention! The Free Worlds are in need of volunteers able to carry <cargo> to <stopovers> for fortifying the spaceports nearest to the pirate system of Men. Free Worlds ships are currently preoccupied with fighting off a pirate incursion into those systems, and we are unable to spare enough ships for the job. Our hope is that these defenses will deter any future incursions. Payment will be <payment> for the first captain who accepts." The spaceport falls quiet as captains contemplate this offer.|3159|0
units.english: A captain in a Free Worlds uniform enters the spaceport and turns on a megaphone. "Attention! The Free Worlds are in need of volunteers able to carry <cargo> to <stopovers> for fortifying the spaceports nearest to the pirate system of Men. Free Worlds ships are currently preoccupied with fighting off a pirate incursion into those systems, and we are unable to spare enough ships for the job. Our hope is that these defenses will deter any future incursions. Payment will be <payment> for the first captain who accepts." The spaceport falls quiet as captains contemplate this offer.
units.italian: Un capitano in uniforme dei Free Worlds entra nello spazioporto e accende un megafono. "Attenzione! I Free Worlds cercano volontari in grado di portare <cargo> su <stopovers> per fortificare gli spazioporti più vicini al sistema pirata di Men. Le navi dei Free Worlds sono attualmente impegnate a respingere un'incursione pirata in quei sistemi, e non possiamo distogliere abbastanza navi per il lavoro. Speriamo che queste difese dissuadano future incursioni. Il compenso sarà <payment> per il primo capitano che accetta." Lo spazioporto ammutolisce mentre i capitani valutano l'offerta.

units.id: mission:Southern Blockade|	(Volunteer.)|3161|0
units.english: (Volunteer.)
units.italian: (Offriti volontario.)

units.id: mission:Southern Blockade|	(Ignore.)|3162|0
units.english: (Ignore.)
units.italian: (Ignora.)

units.id: mission:Southern Blockade|	The Free Worlds captain thanks you for offering your help. Spaceport workers load the turrets onto your ship, and the captain tells you to return to <origin> once you have dropped off the turrets for payment.|3165|0
units.english: The Free Worlds captain thanks you for offering your help. Spaceport workers load the turrets onto your ship, and the captain tells you to return to <origin> once you have dropped off the turrets for payment.
units.italian: Il capitano dei Free Worlds ti ringrazia per l'offerta. Gli operai dello spazioporto caricano le torrette sulla tua nave, e il capitano ti dice di tornare su <origin> una volta scaricate le torrette, per il pagamento.

units.id: mission:Southern Blockade|dialog|3210|0
units.english: The last of the defenses are quickly unloaded from your ship, put into place, and activated. A pirate ship attacking the system attempts to follow you down to the surface, but the fire coming from the newly installed spaceport turrets forces the pirate to turn away and flee for orbit. Time to return to <destination>.
units.italian: L'ultima difesa viene scaricata in fretta, installata e attivata. Una nave pirata che sta attaccando il sistema prova a seguirti fino alla superficie, ma il fuoco delle torrette appena installate la costringe a virare e a fuggire in orbita. È ora di tornare su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Southern Blockade|log|3216|0
units.english: Installed spaceport defense turrets on three frontier worlds. The Free Worlds hopes that this will reduce the piracy in the region.
units.italian: Ho installato torrette di difesa negli spazioporti di tre mondi di frontiera. I Free Worlds sperano che questo riduca la pirateria nella regione.

units.id: mission:Southern Blockade|dialog|3217|0
units.english: The Free Worlds captain thanks you for helping to fortify the frontier worlds, and pays you <payment>.
units.italian: Il capitano dei Free Worlds ti ringrazia per aver contribuito a fortificare i mondi di frontiera e ti paga <payment>.

units.id: mission:Core Blockade|name|3223|0
units.english: Bad Harvest
units.italian: Cattivo raccolto

units.id: mission:Core Blockade|description|3224|0
units.english: The pirate world of <destination> is experiencing a famine. Warlords of the planet have threatened the Syndicate into giving them food. Deliver <cargo> to the world for <payment>.
units.italian: Il mondo pirata di <destination> sta vivendo una carestia. I signori della guerra del pianeta hanno minacciato il Sindacato per ottenere cibo. Consegna <cargo> al mondo per <payment>.

units.id: mission:Core Blockade|In the <origin> spaceport, you are approached by a Syndicate employee. By the looks of his uniform, he works for Syndicated Security. "Hello, Captain. You're a competent pilot, correct?" You nod your head. "Excellent. The Syndicate needs <cargo> transported to <destination>. The pirate world has seen a particularly bad harvest this past season, so much of the population is without sufficient food. Pirate warlords have threatened to begin raiding our freighters and frontier worlds if we don't provide them with food. It's cheaper to do what they want, so we've agreed to the deal, but we don't want to risk any of our own ships being destroyed. The Syndicate will pay you <payment> should you accept and complete this job."|3236|0
units.english: In the <origin> spaceport, you are approached by a Syndicate employee. By the looks of his uniform, he works for Syndicated Security. "Hello, Captain. You're a competent pilot, correct?" You nod your head. "Excellent. The Syndicate needs <cargo> transported to <destination>. The pirate world has seen a particularly bad harvest this past season, so much of the population is without sufficient food. Pirate warlords have threatened to begin raiding our freighters and frontier worlds if we don't provide them with food. It's cheaper to do what they want, so we've agreed to the deal, but we don't want to risk any of our own ships being destroyed. The Syndicate will pay you <payment> should you accept and complete this job."
units.italian: Nello spazioporto di <origin> ti si avvicina un dipendente del Sindacato. Dalla divisa sembra che lavori per la Sicurezza del Sindacato. "Salve, Capitano. Lei è un pilota competente, giusto?" Annuisci. "Eccellente. Il Sindacato ha bisogno di trasportare <cargo> su <destination>. Il mondo pirata ha avuto un raccolto particolarmente scarso nell'ultima stagione, e gran parte della popolazione è senza cibo sufficiente. I signori della guerra pirati hanno minacciato di cominciare a saccheggiare i nostri mercantili e i mondi di frontiera se non forniamo loro cibo. È più economico fare quello che vogliono, quindi abbiamo accettato l'accordo, ma non vogliamo rischiare che qualche nostra nave venga distrutta. Il Sindacato Le pagherà <payment> se accetta e porta a termine il lavoro."

units.id: mission:Core Blockade|	"Alright, I'll get my ship ready."|3238|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll get my ship ready."
units.italian: "Va bene, preparo la nave."

units.id: mission:Core Blockade|	"Sorry, but I have better things to be doing."|3240|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I have better things to be doing."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma ho di meglio da fare."

units.id: mission:Core Blockade|dialog|3260|0
units.english: Multiple bands of pirates, each run by a different warlord, are waiting in the spaceport when you land. They take the food from your cargo hold like animals, leaving quite the mess behind. When you return to your ship, you find that the Syndicate has deposited <payment> into your account.
units.italian: Quando atterri, nello spazioporto aspettano diverse bande di pirati, ognuna guidata da un signore della guerra diverso. Prendono il cibo dalla stiva come animali, lasciando dietro un bel disordine. Quando torni alla nave, scopri che il Sindacato ha depositato <payment> sul tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|name|3266|0
units.english: Escape to Freedom
units.italian: Fuga verso la libertà

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|description|3267|0
units.english: Bring <bunks> escaped slaves to freedom on <destination>, far away from their pirate oppressor. The woman on <origin> promised that a person on <planet> would give you <payment>.
units.italian: Porta <bunks> schiavi fuggiti in libertà su <destination>, lontano dal loro oppressore pirata. La donna su <origin> ha promesso che una persona su <planet> ti avrebbe dato <payment>.

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|It is dusk at the <origin> spaceport, and the setting sun casts long shadows across the spaceport deck. You take notice of a slim cloaked figure walking only a few meters behind you who seems to be keeping pace.|3276|0
units.english: It is dusk at the <origin> spaceport, and the setting sun casts long shadows across the spaceport deck. You take notice of a slim cloaked figure walking only a few meters behind you who seems to be keeping pace.
units.italian: È il crepuscolo nello spazioporto di <origin>, e il sole al tramonto proietta ombre lunghe sul ponte. Noti una figura snella in mantello che cammina a pochi metri dietro di te e sembra tenere il tuo passo.

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	(Confront them.)|3278|0
units.english: (Confront them.)
units.italian: (Affrontala.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	(Stop walking and see if they stop as well.)|3280|0
units.english: (Stop walking and see if they stop as well.)
units.italian: (Smetti di camminare e vedi se si ferma anche lei.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	You stop by the entrance to a store that claims to have "the best Polecats!" and lean against the building, trying not to draw attention to yourself. The figure keeps walking at the same pace, and as they pass you, a soft voice says, "Follow me," from under the cloak. The figure bolts off into a dark alleyway next to the building.|3282|0
units.english: You stop by the entrance to a store that claims to have "the best Polecats!" and lean against the building, trying not to draw attention to yourself. The figure keeps walking at the same pace, and as they pass you, a soft voice says, "Follow me," from under the cloak. The figure bolts off into a dark alleyway next to the building.
units.italian: Ti fermi all'ingresso di un negozio che dichiara di avere "i migliori Polecats!" e ti appoggi all'edificio, cercando di non attirare l'attenzione. La figura continua allo stesso passo, e mentre ti passa accanto una voce sommessa dice: "Seguimi," da sotto il mantello. La figura scatta in un vicolo buio accanto all'edificio.

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	You turn around and stare right at the figure, who stops within a foot of you. The shadows cast by the sun make it impossible for you to make out their face under the cloak. "Follow me," a soft voice says from under the cloak, before the figure bolts off into a dark alleyway next to the building.|3286|0
units.english: You turn around and stare right at the figure, who stops within a foot of you. The shadows cast by the sun make it impossible for you to make out their face under the cloak. "Follow me," a soft voice says from under the cloak, before the figure bolts off into a dark alleyway next to the building.
units.italian: Ti volti e fissi la figura, che si ferma a un palmo da te. Le ombre del sole rendono impossibile distinguere il viso sotto il mantello. "Seguimi," dice una voce sommessa da sotto il mantello, prima che la figura scatti in un vicolo buio accanto all'edificio.

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	(Follow the figure.)|3290|0
units.english: (Follow the figure.)
units.italian: (Segui la figura.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	(Return to my ship.)|3291|0
units.english: (Return to my ship.)
units.italian: (Torna alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	You step into the alleyway and find the figure standing under a lamp. The figure removes their cloak, revealing the face of a woman with short dark hair and a distinct, jagged scar across her right cheek. She begins whispering to you. "You're not from this world. I can tell. You're too clean and unscarred. Could you help me?"|3294|0
units.english: You step into the alleyway and find the figure standing under a lamp. The figure removes their cloak, revealing the face of a woman with short dark hair and a distinct, jagged scar across her right cheek. She begins whispering to you. "You're not from this world. I can tell. You're too clean and unscarred. Could you help me?"
units.italian: Entri nel vicolo e trovi la figura sotto un lampione. Si toglie il mantello, rivelando il viso di una donna con i capelli scuri corti e una cicatrice frastagliata ben visibile sulla guancia destra. Comincia a sussurrarti. "Non sei di questo mondo. Si vede. Sei troppo pulito e senza cicatrici. Potresti aiutarmi?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	"What do you want?"|3296|0
units.english: "What do you want?"
units.italian: "Che cosa vuoi?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	"Why would I help a pirate?"|3298|0
units.english: "Why would I help a pirate?"
units.italian: "Perché dovrei aiutare una pirata?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	The woman chuckles. "Not everyone who lives on a pirate world is a pirate, you know. Maybe you need to learn how not to stereotype. Regardless..." She trails off.|3300|0
units.english: The woman chuckles. "Not everyone who lives on a pirate world is a pirate, you know. Maybe you need to learn how not to stereotype. Regardless..." She trails off.
units.italian: La donna ridacchia. "Non tutti quelli che vivono su un mondo pirata sono pirati, sai. Forse dovresti imparare a non fare di tutta l'erba un fascio. Comunque..." Si interrompe.

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	"It isn't what I want, it's what I need," she whispers, putting heavy emphasis on the word "need."|3303|0
units.english: "It isn't what I want, it's what I need," she whispers, putting heavy emphasis on the word "need."
units.italian: "Non è quello che voglio, è quello di cui ho bisogno," sussurra, mettendo forte enfasi sulla parola "bisogno".

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	"You undoubtedly know about the horrendous slave trade that still exists on pirate worlds today. A slave trade that the Republic doesn't care to abolish, leaving innocent people to waste away like rats in a cage, working for their lives. As if the politicians of the Republic aren't vermin themselves..." Her face twists into a hate-filled scorn as she speaks of the Republic. It then returns to normal as she continues. "I'm part of a group of people who have decided to take matters into our own hands. We're mostly people who grew up on pirate worlds, but some of us were born elsewhere.|3304|0
units.english: "You undoubtedly know about the horrendous slave trade that still exists on pirate worlds today. A slave trade that the Republic doesn't care to abolish, leaving innocent people to waste away like rats in a cage, working for their lives. As if the politicians of the Republic aren't vermin themselves..." Her face twists into a hate-filled scorn as she speaks of the Republic. It then returns to normal as she continues. "I'm part of a group of people who have decided to take matters into our own hands. We're mostly people who grew up on pirate worlds, but some of us were born elsewhere.
units.italian: "Saprai senz'altro del terribile commercio di schiavi che esiste ancora oggi sui mondi pirati. Un commercio che alla Repubblica non importa abolire, lasciando persone innocenti a consumarsi come topi in gabbia, a lavorare per la vita. Come se i politici della Repubblica non fossero vermi anche loro..." Il viso le si torce in un disprezzo pieno d'odio mentre parla della Repubblica. Poi torna normale mentre continua. "Faccio parte di un gruppo di persone che ha deciso di prendere la questione in mano. Siamo per lo più gente cresciuta sui mondi pirati, ma alcuni di noi sono nati altrove.

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	"I assassinated a pirate warlord a couple of days ago, and I have been sheltering his slaves ever since. What I need from you is to transport the <bunks> people in my care to <destination>. Another member of my group should be there to pay you <payment> and take the people somewhere far away from here." She cocks her head to the right. "Will you fight for justice and transport these people, Captain?" The look in her eyes suggests that she won't take no for an answer.|3305|0
units.english: "I assassinated a pirate warlord a couple of days ago, and I have been sheltering his slaves ever since. What I need from you is to transport the <bunks> people in my care to <destination>. Another member of my group should be there to pay you <payment> and take the people somewhere far away from here." She cocks her head to the right. "Will you fight for justice and transport these people, Captain?" The look in her eyes suggests that she won't take no for an answer.
units.italian: "Ho assassinato un signore della guerra pirata un paio di giorni fa, e da allora tengo al riparo i suoi schiavi. Quello che mi serve da te è trasportare le <bunks> persone di cui mi occupo su <destination>. Un altro membro del mio gruppo dovrebbe essere là per pagarti <payment> e portare la gente lontano da qui." Inclina la testa a destra. "Combatterai per la giustizia e porterai queste persone, Capitano?" Lo sguardo nei suoi occhi suggerisce che non accetterà un no.

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	"Anything for the freedom of the innocent."|3307|0
units.english: "Anything for the freedom of the innocent."
units.italian: "Qualunque cosa per la libertà degli innocenti."

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	"Sorry, but I'm not going to risk my life for your cause."|3308|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not going to risk my life for your cause."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non rischio la vita per la tua causa."

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	"Good choice, Captain. We'll wait till the sun has fully set, then I will bring the people to your ship. I'll be traveling in my own ship and launch ahead of you, which should hopefully distract the pirates looking for their warlord's assassin and give you enough room to escape. Wait for me after you land on <planet>."|3311|0
units.english: "Good choice, Captain. We'll wait till the sun has fully set, then I will bring the people to your ship. I'll be traveling in my own ship and launch ahead of you, which should hopefully distract the pirates looking for their warlord's assassin and give you enough room to escape. Wait for me after you land on <planet>."
units.italian: "Buona scelta, Capitano. Aspetteremo che il sole sia tramontato del tutto, poi porterò le persone sulla tua nave. Io viaggerò con la mia nave e partirò prima di te, il che dovrebbe distrarre i pirati in cerca dell'assassino del loro signore della guerra e darti abbastanza spazio per fuggire. Aspettami dopo l'atterraggio su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	"Poor choice, Captain." The woman pulls a knife from under her cloak and tilts it to blind you with the glare of the lamp above her. You stumble backward in anticipation of an attack, but the woman does not move. "I'll remember this, Captain," she hisses at you. The woman puts her cloak back up and sprints down the alleyway into darkness.|3317|0
units.english: "Poor choice, Captain." The woman pulls a knife from under her cloak and tilts it to blind you with the glare of the lamp above her. You stumble backward in anticipation of an attack, but the woman does not move. "I'll remember this, Captain," she hisses at you. The woman puts her cloak back up and sprints down the alleyway into darkness.
units.italian: "Cattiva scelta, Capitano." La donna estrae un coltello da sotto il mantello e lo inclina per accecarti con il riflesso del lampione sopra di lei. Indietreggi barcollando, aspettandoti un attacco, ma la donna non si muove. "Me ne ricorderò, Capitano," sibila. Si rimette il mantello e scatta lungo il vicolo nel buio.

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|dialog|3336|0
units.english: You land on <planet> and begin looking around for the man you are supposed to meet, but then you realize that not all of the escaped slaves are here. Better depart and wait for your escorts holding the rest to arrive.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet> e cominci a cercare l'uomo che dovresti incontrare, ma ti accorgi che non tutti gli schiavi fuggiti sono qui. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che arrivino le tue scorte con gli altri.

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|log|3340|0
units.english: Helped members of a group fighting to end slavery on pirate worlds. Safely rescued 19 slaves from Buccaneer Bay and left them with a man who said that they will be brought somewhere safer, but the woman of the group seems to have not made it out.
units.italian: Ho aiutato i membri di un gruppo che lotta per porre fine alla schiavitù sui mondi pirati. Ho tratto in salvo 19 schiavi da Buccaneer Bay e li ho lasciati a un uomo che ha detto che li porteranno in un posto più sicuro, ma la donna del gruppo sembra non essere riuscita a uscirne.

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|Just as was promised, a man approaches you in the spaceport and tells you that he is part of the same group as the woman. Interestingly, the man has a similar scar as the woman on his left cheek. "I'll make sure these people find a safe home somewhere far away from here," he says to you. After greeting each of your former passengers, he thanks you and pays you <payment>.|3342|0
units.english: Just as was promised, a man approaches you in the spaceport and tells you that he is part of the same group as the woman. Interestingly, the man has a similar scar as the woman on his left cheek. "I'll make sure these people find a safe home somewhere far away from here," he says to you. After greeting each of your former passengers, he thanks you and pays you <payment>.
units.italian: Proprio come promesso, nello spazioporto un uomo ti si avvicina e ti dice di far parte dello stesso gruppo della donna. Curiosamente, l'uomo ha una cicatrice simile a quella della donna, sulla guancia sinistra. "Farò in modo che queste persone trovino una casa sicura lontano da qui," ti dice. Dopo aver salutato ciascuno dei tuoi ex passeggeri, ti ringrazia e ti paga <payment>.

units.id: mission:Pirate Blockade|	You and the man, who does not give his name to you in order to "keep us both safe," wait for the woman to arrive in her own ship. Hours pass, but there is no sign of her. The man tries to contact her, but he is unable to reach her. "You can leave now," the man says to you. "I don't think she'll be coming."|3343|0
units.english: You and the man, who does not give his name to you in order to "keep us both safe," wait for the woman to arrive in her own ship. Hours pass, but there is no sign of her. The man tries to contact her, but he is unable to reach her. "You can leave now," the man says to you. "I don't think she'll be coming."
units.italian: Tu e l'uomo, che non ti dice il suo nome per "tenerci entrambi al sicuro", aspettate che la donna arrivi con la sua nave. Passano le ore, ma di lei non c'è traccia. L'uomo prova a contattarla, ma non riesce a raggiungerla. "Puoi andare, ora," ti dice. "Non credo che verrà."

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|name|3348|0
units.english: Capture rogue smuggler
units.italian: Catturare un contrabbandiere ribelle

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|description|3350|0
units.english: A smuggler absconded with his illegal cargo near <system>. The unknown person he stole it from wants it back. Recover the cargo from the <npc> and return both it and the smuggler to <origin> for <payment>.
