units.italian: Un contrabbandiere è fuggito con il suo carico illegale vicino a <system>. La persona sconosciuta a cui l'ha rubato lo rivuole indietro. Recupera il carico dalla <npc> e riporta sia il carico sia il contrabbandiere su <origin> per <payment>.

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|As you step into a dive bar for a quick drink, the largest man you've ever seen stands up and blocks your path. He's well over two meters tall, and his muscles seem to ripple with barely restrained violence when he moves. "<first> <last>," he says in a thick accent. "My employer hears you do certain jobs, take money, do not ask questions. He hears you are reliable. A man, a smuggler, he steals cargo from my employer. My employer very much wants cargo returned, and this man as well."|3361|0
units.english: As you step into a dive bar for a quick drink, the largest man you've ever seen stands up and blocks your path. He's well over two meters tall, and his muscles seem to ripple with barely restrained violence when he moves. "<first> <last>," he says in a thick accent. "My employer hears you do certain jobs, take money, do not ask questions. He hears you are reliable. A man, a smuggler, he steals cargo from my employer. My employer very much wants cargo returned, and this man as well."
units.italian: Mentre entri in un bar di periferia per bere qualcosa in fretta, l'uomo più grosso che tu abbia mai visto si alza e ti sbarra la strada. È alto ben oltre due metri, e i muscoli sembrano fremere di violenza a stento trattenuta quando si muove. "<first> <last>," dice con un accento marcato. "Il mio datore di lavoro sente dire che fai certi lavori, prendi i soldi, non fai domande. Sente dire che sei affidabile. Un uomo, un contrabbandiere, ruba il carico al mio datore di lavoro. Il mio datore di lavoro vuole molto indietro il carico, e anche quest'uomo."

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|	"I'm sorry, sir, but I'm not taking new jobs today. Please give your employer my most gracious thanks for this kind offer."|3363|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, sir, but I'm not taking new jobs today. Please give your employer my most gracious thanks for this kind offer."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, signore, ma oggi non prendo nuovi incarichi. Porga al suo datore di lavoro i miei più sentiti ringraziamenti per l'offerta."

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|	"Of course. I won't say a word."|3364|0
units.english: "Of course. I won't say a word."
units.italian: "Certo. Non dirò una parola."

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|	"Get out of my way. I don't take jobs from any schlub who bothers me when I need a drink."|3366|0
units.english: "Get out of my way. I don't take jobs from any schlub who bothers me when I need a drink."
units.italian: "Togliti di mezzo. Non prendo incarichi da qualunque zoticone che mi importuna quando ho voglia di bere."

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|	The man looks down at you with no change in expression. "My employer, he will not be happy. I will tell him, '<first> <last> is not so reliable.' I hope next time, you are reliable." As the man speaks, you notice that his teeth are filed to vicious points. Every patron in the bar stares at you in shock as you sit down for a badly-needed drink.|3369|0
units.english: The man looks down at you with no change in expression. "My employer, he will not be happy. I will tell him, '<first> <last> is not so reliable.' I hope next time, you are reliable." As the man speaks, you notice that his teeth are filed to vicious points. Every patron in the bar stares at you in shock as you sit down for a badly-needed drink.
units.italian: L'uomo ti guarda dall'alto senza cambiare espressione. "Il mio datore di lavoro, non sarà contento. Gli dirò: '<first> <last> non è così affidabile.' Spero che la prossima volta, tu sia affidabile." Mentre l'uomo parla, noti che i suoi denti sono limati in punte feroci. Ogni avventore del bar ti fissa sconvolto mentre ti siedi per bere quello che ti serve davvero.

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|	The man looks down at you with no change in expression. "This is good. To be reliable, it is a great thing on <origin>." As the man speaks, you notice that his teeth are filed to vicious points. He holds out a round, flat object about the size of your palm. It has a recessed button in the center of one side. "This is gift for this smuggler. Press button, it becomes surprise. Make sure surprise is not on you." He hands you the object and a data chip containing details of the job. As the man leaves, you see every patron in the bar staring warily at his back.|3373|0
units.english: The man looks down at you with no change in expression. "This is good. To be reliable, it is a great thing on <origin>." As the man speaks, you notice that his teeth are filed to vicious points. He holds out a round, flat object about the size of your palm. It has a recessed button in the center of one side. "This is gift for this smuggler. Press button, it becomes surprise. Make sure surprise is not on you." He hands you the object and a data chip containing details of the job. As the man leaves, you see every patron in the bar staring warily at his back.
units.italian: L'uomo ti guarda dall'alto senza cambiare espressione. "Questo è bene. Essere affidabile, è una gran cosa su <origin>." Mentre l'uomo parla, noti che i suoi denti sono limati in punte feroci. Ti porge un oggetto rotondo e piatto, grande quanto il palmo di una mano. Ha un pulsante incassato al centro di un lato. "Questo è regalo per questo contrabbandiere. Premi pulsante, diventa sorpresa. Assicurati che sorpresa non sia su di te." Ti consegna l'oggetto e un chip dati con i dettagli del lavoro. Mentre l'uomo esce, vedi ogni avventore del bar che fissa diffidente la sua schiena.

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|	The man looks down at you with no change in expression. "This is great shame. I will tell my employer, '<first> <last> was not so reliable. I had to make example.'" The man grabs your neck with one monstrous hand. The last thing you see as your vision fades to black is a mouth full of pointed teeth.|3377|0
units.english: The man looks down at you with no change in expression. "This is great shame. I will tell my employer, '<first> <last> was not so reliable. I had to make example.'" The man grabs your neck with one monstrous hand. The last thing you see as your vision fades to black is a mouth full of pointed teeth.
units.italian: L'uomo ti guarda dall'alto senza cambiare espressione. "Questa è grande vergogna. Dirò al mio datore di lavoro: '<first> <last> non è stato così affidabile. Ho dovuto fare esempio.'" L'uomo ti afferra il collo con una mano mostruosa. L'ultima cosa che vedi mentre la vista si fa nera è una bocca piena di denti appuntiti.

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|The smuggler and his crew are ready and waiting when you board. You pull out the "gift" and press the button, then quickly toss it down the hallway. For a moment, you meet the smuggler's eyes. They widen with terror when he sees the "gift." You duck back into cover. A few seconds later, you hear a strangely muted detonation, followed by silence. After a minute, you hazard another peek out of cover. The smuggler and all his men are unconscious on the ground. One crewman has blood dripping from his nose and ears. You tie them all up and stow the smuggler in a locked cabin on your ship.|3381|0
units.english: The smuggler and his crew are ready and waiting when you board. You pull out the "gift" and press the button, then quickly toss it down the hallway. For a moment, you meet the smuggler's eyes. They widen with terror when he sees the "gift." You duck back into cover. A few seconds later, you hear a strangely muted detonation, followed by silence. After a minute, you hazard another peek out of cover. The smuggler and all his men are unconscious on the ground. One crewman has blood dripping from his nose and ears. You tie them all up and stow the smuggler in a locked cabin on your ship.
units.italian: Il contrabbandiere e il suo equipaggio sono pronti e in attesa quando abbordi. Tiri fuori il "regalo" e premi il pulsante, poi lo getti rapidamente lungo il corridoio. Per un momento incroci lo sguardo del contrabbandiere. Gli occhi gli si spalancano dal terrore quando vede il "regalo". Ti rimetti al riparo. Pochi secondi dopo senti un'esplosione stranamente attutita, seguita dal silenzio. Dopo un minuto azzardi un'altra occhiata fuori dal riparo. Il contrabbandiere e tutti i suoi uomini sono a terra privi di sensi. A un membro dell'equipaggio esce sangue dal naso e dalle orecchie. Li leghi tutti e chiudi il contrabbandiere in una cabina chiusa a chiave della tua nave.

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|	Once they're secured, you sweep the ship. Ultimately you find the stolen cargo in the captain's cabin, hidden behind a false panel. The cargo is a nondescript storage container, but upon closer inspection you see that it's code-locked and covered with Interference Plating.|3382|0
units.english: Once they're secured, you sweep the ship. Ultimately you find the stolen cargo in the captain's cabin, hidden behind a false panel. The cargo is a nondescript storage container, but upon closer inspection you see that it's code-locked and covered with Interference Plating.
units.italian: Una volta assicurati, perquisisci la nave. Alla fine trovi il carico rubato nella cabina del capitano, nascosto dietro un pannello falso. Il carico è un anonimo contenitore da stiva, ma a un esame più attento vedi che è chiuso con un codice ed è rivestito di piastre di interferenza.

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|dialog|3393|0
units.english: You have failed to capture the smuggler and recover the stolen cargo. This will probably not be good for your reputation.
units.italian: Non sei riuscito a catturare il contrabbandiere e a recuperare il carico rubato. Probabilmente non gioverà alla tua reputazione.

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|dialog|3396|0
units.english: You land on <origin>, but you don't have the smuggler and the cargo he stole. You should probably be careful not to run into your contact until you do.
units.italian: Atterri su <origin>, ma non hai il contrabbandiere e il carico che ha rubato. Forse è meglio evitare il tuo contatto finché non li avrai.

units.id: mission:Capture Smuggler|The huge man drags the unconscious smuggler out of the cargo container with one hand and carries the cargo box with the other. He stops in front of you. "<first> <last>," he says. "My employer, he will be very happy. Your payment, you will receive soon. Is it not good, to be reliable?" The man leaves your ship, letting the smuggler's legs scrape along the ground as he walks. A moment later, you receive <payment> from an anonymous account.|3400|0
units.english: The huge man drags the unconscious smuggler out of the cargo container with one hand and carries the cargo box with the other. He stops in front of you. "<first> <last>," he says. "My employer, he will be very happy. Your payment, you will receive soon. Is it not good, to be reliable?" The man leaves your ship, letting the smuggler's legs scrape along the ground as he walks. A moment later, you receive <payment> from an anonymous account.
units.italian: L'uomo enorme trascina fuori dal container il contrabbandiere privo di sensi con una mano e porta la cassa del carico con l'altra. Si ferma davanti a te. "<first> <last>," dice. "Il mio datore di lavoro, sarà molto contento. Il tuo pagamento, lo riceverai presto. Non è bene, essere affidabile?" L'uomo lascia la tua nave, lasciando che le gambe del contrabbandiere striscino sul terreno mentre cammina. Un momento dopo ricevi <payment> da un conto anonimo.

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|description|3405|0
units.english: Travel to <destination> to act as heir for the late warlord Limping Pappa.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> per fare da erede al defunto signore della guerra Limping Pappa.

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|You are walking near the spaceport and suddenly a computer terminal starts blinking and beeping when you pass it.|3418|0
units.english: You are walking near the spaceport and suddenly a computer terminal starts blinking and beeping when you pass it.
units.italian: Stai camminando vicino allo spazioporto quando all'improvviso un terminale comincia a lampeggiare e a emettere bip al tuo passaggio.

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	(Check it out.)|3420|0
units.english: (Check it out.)
units.italian: (Controlla di che si tratta.)

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	(Ignore it.)|3421|0
units.english: (Ignore it.)
units.italian: (Ignalo.)

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|When you approach, you are greeted by a voice from the terminal: "Dear Sir or Madam, please respond!"|3423|0
units.english: When you approach, you are greeted by a voice from the terminal: "Dear Sir or Madam, please respond!"
units.italian: Quando ti avvicini, ti accoglie una voce dal terminale: "Gentile signore o signora, La prego di rispondere!"

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"Hello!"|3425|0
units.english: "Hello!"
units.italian: "Pronto?"

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	(Ignore it and walk away.)|3426|0
units.english: (Ignore it and walk away.)
units.italian: (Ignalo e allontanati.)

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"My name is Mr. Smith and I'm contacting you with a highly confidential and urgent proposal. I am, or more accurately was, the financial manager of the recently deceased warlord Limping Pappa. I am looking for a highly trustworthy individual who can help me relocate Mr. Pappa's fortune of 300 million credits."|3428|0
units.english: "My name is Mr. Smith and I'm contacting you with a highly confidential and urgent proposal. I am, or more accurately was, the financial manager of the recently deceased warlord Limping Pappa. I am looking for a highly trustworthy individual who can help me relocate Mr. Pappa's fortune of 300 million credits."
units.italian: "Mi chiamo signor Smith e La contatto per una proposta urgentissima e strettamente riservata. Sono, o più precisamente ero, il gestore finanziario del signore della guerra Limping Pappa, da poco scomparso. Cerco una persona di grande fiducia che mi aiuti a trasferire la fortuna del signor Pappa, 300 milioni di crediti."

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"How did Mr. Pappa acquire his fortune exactly?"|3430|0
units.english: "How did Mr. Pappa acquire his fortune exactly?"
units.italian: "E come avrebbe fatto il signor Pappa ad accumulare quella fortuna, esattamente?"

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"What are you proposing?"|3431|0
units.english: "What are you proposing?"
units.italian: "Che cosa mi sta proponendo?"

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"This sounds like a credits-stealing scam, I will not fall for this!"|3433|0
units.english: "This sounds like a credits-stealing scam, I will not fall for this!"
units.italian: "Sembra una truffa per rubare crediti, non ci casco!"

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"Oh, uh, Mr. Pappa was specialized into tricking rich victims to transfer credits to him.|3435|0
units.english: "Oh, uh, Mr. Pappa was specialized into tricking rich victims to transfer credits to him.
units.italian: "Oh, ehm, il signor Pappa era specializzato nel convincere vittime ricche a trasferirgli dei crediti.

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"I obviously cannot make myself an heir to Mr. Pappa. So what I propose is to present you as an heir and have the inheritance transferred to you.|3437|0
units.english: "I obviously cannot make myself an heir to Mr. Pappa. So what I propose is to present you as an heir and have the inheritance transferred to you.
units.italian: "Ovviamente non posso nominare me stesso erede del signor Pappa. Quindi quello che propongo è presentare Lei come erede e far trasferire l'eredità a Lei.

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"When you receive the inheritance on <destination>, then you send half of it back to me."|3438|0
units.english: "When you receive the inheritance on <destination>, then you send half of it back to me."
units.italian: "Quando riceverà l'eredità su <destination>, mi rimanderà indietro la metà."

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"Okay, let's do this."|3440|0
units.english: "Okay, let's do this."
units.italian: "Va bene, facciamolo."

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"Sounds too good to be true. What's the catch?"|3441|0
units.english: "Sounds too good to be true. What's the catch?"
units.italian: "Sembra troppo bello per essere vero. Dov'è l'inganno?"

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"Sorry, this sounds too fishy for me."|3442|0
units.english: "Sorry, this sounds too fishy for me."
units.italian: "Spiacente, mi sembra troppo losco."

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	Mr. Smith responds: "There is one small problem with the inheritance tax, it needs to be paid upfront. Can you pay 200,000 credits so that I can get the process going?"|3444|0
units.english: Mr. Smith responds: "There is one small problem with the inheritance tax, it needs to be paid upfront. Can you pay 200,000 credits so that I can get the process going?"
units.italian: Il signor Smith risponde: "C'è un piccolo problema con la tassa di successione: va pagata in anticipo. Può pagare 200.000 crediti così posso avviare la pratica?"

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"Sure, no problem."|3446|0
units.english: "Sure, no problem."
units.italian: "Certo, nessun problema."

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"Are you trying to trick me?"|3448|0
units.english: "Are you trying to trick me?"
units.italian: "Sta cercando di imbrogliarmi?"

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"Sounds too risky, I don't want to pay anything upfront."|3449|0
units.english: "Sounds too risky, I don't want to pay anything upfront."
units.italian: "Mi sembra troppo rischioso, non voglio pagare nulla in anticipo."

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"Of course I'm not trying to trick you! Mr. Pappa's victims were all persons that had more credits than common sense. But you look a lot smarter than any of Mr. Pappa's victims.|3451|0
units.english: "Of course I'm not trying to trick you! Mr. Pappa's victims were all persons that had more credits than common sense. But you look a lot smarter than any of Mr. Pappa's victims.
units.italian: "Ma certo che non sto cercando di imbrogliarLa! Le vittime del signor Pappa erano tutte persone con più crediti che buon senso. Ma Lei sembra molto più intelligente di qualsiasi vittima del signor Pappa.

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"Think of the huge amount of credits you will receive just for acting as heir! Can I count on you to pay the tax and make both of us very wealthy?"|3452|0
units.english: "Think of the huge amount of credits you will receive just for acting as heir! Can I count on you to pay the tax and make both of us very wealthy?"
units.italian: "Pensi all'enorme quantità di crediti che riceverà solo per fare da erede! Posso contare su di Lei per pagare la tassa e rendere entrambi molto ricchi?"

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"Sure, no problem."|3454|0
units.english: "Sure, no problem."
units.italian: "Certo, nessun problema."

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	"Sounds too risky, I don't want to pay anything upfront."|3456|0
units.english: "Sounds too risky, I don't want to pay anything upfront."
units.italian: "Mi sembra troppo rischioso, non voglio pagare nulla in anticipo."

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	The terminal suddenly goes black after you transfer 200,000 credits to the account given by Mr. Smith.|3459|0
units.english: The terminal suddenly goes black after you transfer 200,000 credits to the account given by Mr. Smith.
units.italian: Il terminale diventa improvvisamente nero dopo che hai trasferito 200.000 crediti sul conto indicato dal signor Smith.

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	You wonder if you did the right thing.|3460|0
units.english: You wonder if you did the right thing.
units.italian: Ti chiedi se hai fatto la cosa giusta.

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|	The terminal suddenly goes black. Mr. Smith is apparently no longer interested in doing business with you.|3463|0
units.english: The terminal suddenly goes black. Mr. Smith is apparently no longer interested in doing business with you.
units.italian: Il terminale diventa improvvisamente nero. A quanto pare il signor Smith non è più interessato a fare affari con te.

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|dialog|3466|0
units.english: There is no inheritance for Mr. Pappa waiting for you at the bank, but there are many other victims that paid some credits while expecting to earn a larger amount of credits in return. Some make a big fuss about it, until the alerted authorities start fining them for attempted inheritance fraud. You leave the bank in silence.
units.italian: Alla banca non c'è nessuna eredità del signor Pappa che ti aspetta, ma ci sono molte altre vittime che hanno pagato dei crediti aspettandosi di riceverne molti di più. Alcune fanno un gran baccano, finché le autorità allertate non cominciano a multarle per tentata frode sull'eredità. Esci dalla banca in silenzio.

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|log|3467|0
units.english: A mysterious individual who asked for 200,000 credits to process a rich inheritance from the deceased warlord Limping Pappa, but was then proven to be a scam.
units.italian: Una figura misteriosa che ha chiesto 200.000 crediti per avviare una ricca eredità dal defunto signore della guerra Limping Pappa, ma che poi si è rivelata una truffa.

units.id: mission:Inheritance Redirection|log|3469|0
units.english: A mysterious individual who asked for 200,000 credits to process a rich inheritance from the deceased warlord Limping Pappa. You presume he was a scammer and had no part in it.
units.italian: Una figura misteriosa che ha chiesto 200.000 crediti per avviare una ricca eredità dal defunto signore della guerra Limping Pappa. Presumi che fosse un truffatore e che tu non c'entri nulla.

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|name|3474|0

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|description|3475|0

units.italian: Scorta la <npc> fino a <destination> per consegnare del sushi a una cena di gala.

units.english: A lady in a formal business suit walks gracefully over to you. "Captain <last>, Captain <last>! It is so nice to meet you here!"
units.italian: Una signora in un tailleur formale ti si avvicina con eleganza. "Capitano <last>, Capitano <last>! Che piacere incontrarla qui!"

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	"Hello, did we meet before? How do you know my name?"|3490|0
units.english: "Hello, did we meet before? How do you know my name?"
units.italian: "Salve, ci siamo già visti? Come fa a sapere il mio nome?"

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	"Hello, nice to meet you too."|3491|0
units.english: "Hello, nice to meet you too."
units.italian: "Salve, piacere di conoscerla."

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	"Sorry, I don't have time to talk. I'm really busy."|3493|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't have time to talk. I'm really busy."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non ho tempo per parlare. Sono molto impegnato."

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	She smiles and replies, "Well, I actually don't know you, but I just read your name on one of the cargo manifests. And my experience is that this greeting works best if you need something from a spaceship captain."|3495|0
units.english: She smiles and replies, "Well, I actually don't know you, but I just read your name on one of the cargo manifests. And my experience is that this greeting works best if you need something from a spaceship captain."
units.italian: Sorride e risponde: "Beh, in realtà non la conosco, ma ho appena letto il suo nome su uno dei manifesti di carico. E la mia esperienza dice che questo saluto funziona meglio quando hai bisogno di qualcosa da un capitano di nave."

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|label|3496|0
units.english: hello too
units.italian: hello too

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	She says, "My name is Veronica Oxygenpocket, and I'm the lead for a team that's designing the new Hauler VI transport ship series at Southbound Shipyards."|3497|0
units.english: She says, "My name is Veronica Oxygenpocket, and I'm the lead for a team that's designing the new Hauler VI transport ship series at Southbound Shipyards."
units.italian: Dice: "Mi chiamo Veronica Oxygenpocket e sono la responsabile di un gruppo che progetta la nuova serie di navi da trasporto Hauler VI ai cantieri Southbound Shipyards."

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	"'Oxygenpocket' is an uncommon name."|3499|0
units.english: "'Oxygenpocket' is an uncommon name."
units.italian: "'Oxygenpocket' è un cognome insolito."

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	"And what help do you need from me?"|3500|0
units.english: "And what help do you need from me?"
units.italian: "E di che aiuto avrebbe bisogno da me?"

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	Veronica responds, "Well, it might sound uncommon to people from a planet with a breathable atmosphere, but it is actually similar to Vanderberg, which means 'from the mountain,' or Langley, which means 'woodland.'|3502|0
units.english: Veronica responds, "Well, it might sound uncommon to people from a planet with a breathable atmosphere, but it is actually similar to Vanderberg, which means 'from the mountain,' or Langley, which means 'woodland.'
units.italian: Veronica risponde: "Beh, può sembrare insolito a chi viene da un pianeta con un'atmosfera respirabile, ma in realtà è simile a Vanderberg, che significa 'della montagna', o a Langley, che significa 'bosco'.

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	"Oxygenpockets were as much a feature on my home-planet as mountains and woodlands are on more habitable planets."|3503|0
units.english: "Oxygenpockets were as much a feature on my home-planet as mountains and woodlands are on more habitable planets."
units.italian: "Le 'tasche di ossigeno' erano una caratteristica del mio pianeta natale tanto quanto le montagne e i boschi lo sono su pianeti più abitabili."

units.english: help request

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	Veronica pauses for a moment and then continues, "We're testing the VI's cargo refrigeration system using the Testament, a modified Hauler III. This system is one of our biggest achievements. To show how well it works, we plan to throw a formal dinner on <destination> with fresh sushi transported from here. I'm sure everyone at the dinner will be amazed by how well the food has been preserved despite the travel time. I'd like you to escort the ship and its cargo to <planet>."|3505|0
units.english: Veronica pauses for a moment and then continues, "We're testing the VI's cargo refrigeration system using the Testament, a modified Hauler III. This system is one of our biggest achievements. To show how well it works, we plan to throw a formal dinner on <destination> with fresh sushi transported from here. I'm sure everyone at the dinner will be amazed by how well the food has been preserved despite the travel time. I'd like you to escort the ship and its cargo to <planet>."
units.italian: Veronica fa una pausa e poi continua: "Stiamo collaudando il sistema di refrigerazione del carico del VI usando il Testament, un Hauler III modificato. Questo sistema è una delle nostre più grandi conquiste. Per dimostrare quanto funziona bene, abbiamo in programma una cena di gala su <destination> con sushi fresco trasportato da qui. Sono certa che tutti alla cena resteranno stupiti da come il cibo si è conservato nonostante il tempo di viaggio. Vorrei che scortasse la nave e il suo carico fino a <planet>."

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	"Isn't it a bit risky to transport food using a refrigeration system that hasn't been tested yet?"|3507|0
units.english: "Isn't it a bit risky to transport food using a refrigeration system that hasn't been tested yet?"
units.italian: "Non è un po' rischioso trasportare cibo con un sistema di refrigerazione che non è stato ancora collaudato?"

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	"Am I also invited for the dinner?"|3509|0
units.english: "Am I also invited for the dinner?"
units.italian: "Sono anch'io invitato alla cena?"

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	"Why do you need me to escort the ship?"|3511|0
units.english: "Why do you need me to escort the ship?"
units.italian: "Perché ha bisogno di me per scortare la nave?"

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	"Shouldn't you be making the Hauler IV first?"|3513|0
units.english: "Shouldn't you be making the Hauler IV first?"
units.italian: "Non dovrebbe prima fare l'Hauler IV?"

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	"Sure, I'll help you."|3514|0

units.italian: "Certo, la aiuto."

units.english: "Normally we'd look internally to satisfy any escort needs, that's true. But we suspect there is a mole in our organization spying for Syndicated Shipyards. Going externally is safer in this case, and you came recommended when we searched through the list of captains available on short notice. You will be paid well for your time. Will you help us?"
units.italian: "Normalmente guarderemmo all'interno per qualsiasi esigenza di scorta, è vero. Ma sospettiamo che nella nostra organizzazione ci sia una talpa che spia per Syndicated Shipyards. In questo caso è più sicuro rivolgersi all'esterno, e il suo nome è venuto fuori quando abbiamo cercato nell'elenco dei capitani disponibili con poco preavviso. Sarà pagato bene per il suo tempo. Ci aiuterà?"

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	"Sure, I'll help you."|3534|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll help you."
units.italian: "Certo, la aiuto."

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|	"Sorry, I don't have time to help you."|3536|0
units.english: "Sorry, I don't have time to help you."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non ho tempo per aiutarla."

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|dialog|3539|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but the Testament hasn't caught up with you yet. Better take off and wait for it to appear in this system.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma il Testament non ti ha ancora raggiunto. Meglio decollare e aspettare che compaia in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 1|You wait for the Testament to land, but it remains in orbit. There is no response to your hails. Maybe you should take off and investigate.|3542|0
units.english: You wait for the Testament to land, but it remains in orbit. There is no response to your hails. Maybe you should take off and investigate.
units.italian: Aspetti che il Testament atterri, ma resta in orbita. Non c'è risposta ai tuoi segnali. Forse dovresti decollare e andare a controllare.

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 2|name|3545|0
units.english: Escort Hauler prototype to <planet>
units.italian: Scorta il prototipo Hauler su <planet>

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 2|description|3546|0
units.english: Escort the <npc> to <destination> to deliver cooked fish dishes to a streetfood festival.
units.italian: Scorta la <npc> fino a <destination> per consegnare piatti di pesce cotto a un festival di cibo di strada.

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 2|You take off and try to contact Veronica, but you receive an angry message: "Why were you trying to contact me? Does everyone need to know that we're here?"|3558|0
units.english: You take off and try to contact Veronica, but you receive an angry message: "Why were you trying to contact me? Does everyone need to know that we're here?"
units.italian: Decolli e provi a contattare Veronica, ma ricevi un messaggio arrabbiato: "Perché stava cercando di contattarmi? Devono saperlo tutti che siamo qui?"

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 2|	She adds, "The cooling failed and the sushi nearly cooked. Let's go to the Southbound Shipyards on <destination> instead, then we can save face by claiming that we were in time for the dinner, but on the wrong planet due to some miscommunication. We might even be able to hide all evidence of the overheating by giving away the sushi as fish dishes on a streetfood festival."|3559|0
units.english: She adds, "The cooling failed and the sushi nearly cooked. Let's go to the Southbound Shipyards on <destination> instead, then we can save face by claiming that we were in time for the dinner, but on the wrong planet due to some miscommunication. We might even be able to hide all evidence of the overheating by giving away the sushi as fish dishes on a streetfood festival."
units.italian: Aggiunge: "Il raffreddamento è saltato e il sushi si è quasi cotto. Andiamo invece ai cantieri Southbound Shipyards su <destination>, così possiamo salvare la faccia dicendo che siamo arrivati in tempo per la cena, ma sul pianeta sbagliato per un disguido. Potremmo persino riuscire a nascondere ogni prova del surriscaldamento spacciando il sushi per piatti di pesce a un festival di cibo di strada."

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 2|dialog|3561|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but the Testament didn't catch up with you yet.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma il Testament non ti ha ancora raggiunto.

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 2|This time the Testament appears to be landing right behind you, but the ship flies away at full thrust just before touching the landing pad. You receive another message: "The Sushi completely burned. We cannot be seen near the festival or near the shipyard with this burned sushi! Our new destination is the waste processing plant at Longjump."|3564|0
units.english: This time the Testament appears to be landing right behind you, but the ship flies away at full thrust just before touching the landing pad. You receive another message: "The Sushi completely burned. We cannot be seen near the festival or near the shipyard with this burned sushi! Our new destination is the waste processing plant at Longjump."
units.italian: Questa volta il Testament sembra atterrare subito dietro di te, ma la nave schizza via a piena spinta appena prima di toccare la piazzola. Ricevi un altro messaggio: "Il sushi è completamente bruciato. Non possiamo farci vedere vicino al festival né vicino al cantiere con questo sushi bruciato! La nostra nuova destinazione è l'impianto di trattamento dei rifiuti di Longjump."

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 3|name|3567|0
units.english: Escort Hauler prototype to waste plant
units.italian: Scorta il prototipo Hauler all'impianto dei rifiuti

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 3|description|3568|0
units.english: Escort the <npc> to <destination> to deliver charred food waste to a waste-processing plant.
units.italian: Scorta la <npc> fino a <destination> per consegnare rifiuti alimentari carbonizzati a un impianto di trattamento dei rifiuti.

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 3|dialog|3578|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but the Testament didn't catch up with you yet.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma il Testament non ti ha ancora raggiunto.

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 3|The Testament enters the planet's atmosphere at high speed and lands somewhat uncontrolled near a waste processing plant. The cargo hold is glowing red hot and some areas in the cargo hold appear to be on fire.|3582|0
units.english: The Testament enters the planet's atmosphere at high speed and lands somewhat uncontrolled near a waste processing plant. The cargo hold is glowing red hot and some areas in the cargo hold appear to be on fire.
units.italian: Il Testament entra nell'atmosfera del pianeta ad alta velocità e atterra in modo piuttosto incontrollato vicino a un impianto di trattamento dei rifiuti. La stiva brilla di un rosso incandescente e alcune zone sembrano in fiamme.

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 3|	Veronica disembarks, walks over to you, and apologizes for the difficult trip. She explains that the cooling systems failed, causing the sushi calamity you experienced during the multiple legs of your journey.|3583|0
units.english: Veronica disembarks, walks over to you, and apologizes for the difficult trip. She explains that the cooling systems failed, causing the sushi calamity you experienced during the multiple legs of your journey.
units.italian: Veronica sbarca, ti viene incontro e si scusa per il viaggio difficile. Spiega che i sistemi di raffreddamento hanno ceduto, causando il disastro del sushi che hai vissuto nelle varie tappe del viaggio.

units.id: mission:Hauler VI cargo prototype 3|	You are paid <payment> and she asks you not to talk about this escort job to anybody. You leave the docks quickly in order to escape the horrible smell of overheated fish that is coming from Veronica and her ship.|3584|0
units.english: You are paid <payment> and she asks you not to talk about this escort job to anybody. You leave the docks quickly in order to escape the horrible smell of overheated fish that is coming from Veronica and her ship.
units.italian: Ti viene pagato <payment> e lei ti chiede di non parlare con nessuno di questo lavoro di scorta. Lasci in fretta la banchina per sfuggire al terribile odore di pesce surriscaldato che arriva da Veronica e dalla sua nave.

units.id: mission:Antibiotics To South|name|3589|0
units.english: Antibiotics shipment to <planet>
units.italian: Spedizione di antibiotici su <planet>

units.id: mission:Antibiotics To South|description|3590|0
units.english: Deliver <cargo> to <destination>. Payment is <payment>. Expect attacks from a pirate ship known as the "Australis."
units.italian: Consegna <cargo> a <destination>. Il compenso è <payment>. Aspettati gli attacchi di una nave pirata nota come l'"Australis".

units.id: mission:Antibiotics To South|As you wander around the spaceport, you spot a well-dressed man who seems to be eyeing your ship. When you approach him, he turns to you and asks, "Is this your ship? I'm looking for someone in charge of a heavily armed fleet."|3606|0
units.english: As you wander around the spaceport, you spot a well-dressed man who seems to be eyeing your ship. When you approach him, he turns to you and asks, "Is this your ship? I'm looking for someone in charge of a heavily armed fleet."
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto, noti un uomo ben vestito che sembra osservare la tua nave. Quando ti avvicini, si volta verso di te e chiede: "È la sua nave? Sto cercando qualcuno al comando di una flotta ben armata."

units.id: mission:Antibiotics To South|	"It is. Why?"|3608|0
units.english: "It is. Why?"
units.italian: "Sì. Perché?"

units.id: mission:Antibiotics To South|	"Sorry, I think you're mistaken."|3609|0
units.english: "Sorry, I think you're mistaken."
units.italian: "Spiacente, credo che si sbagli."

units.id: mission:Antibiotics To South|	The man begins to explain himself. "I'm arranging a shipment from a pharmaceutical plant here on <origin> to <destination>. Specifically, <cargo>. I'm sure you're aware of the fact that they're in very high demand in the south, so we have a trade deal with that planet. Unfortunately, <commodity> are in even higher demand in pirate territory, so the last two merchants I've sent down there have been attacked by pirate ships. My company won't give the budget for an escort, so anyone I send down there has to be alone. Fortunately, I do have the budget for a high-risk contract, so if you can take one of these shipments to <destination>, I can arrange a payment of <payment>. Does this sound fair so far?"|3611|0
units.english: The man begins to explain himself. "I'm arranging a shipment from a pharmaceutical plant here on <origin> to <destination>. Specifically, <cargo>. I'm sure you're aware of the fact that they're in very high demand in the south, so we have a trade deal with that planet. Unfortunately, <commodity> are in even higher demand in pirate territory, so the last two merchants I've sent down there have been attacked by pirate ships. My company won't give the budget for an escort, so anyone I send down there has to be alone. Fortunately, I do have the budget for a high-risk contract, so if you can take one of these shipments to <destination>, I can arrange a payment of <payment>. Does this sound fair so far?"
units.italian: L'uomo comincia a spiegarsi. "Sto organizzando una spedizione da un impianto farmaceutico qui su <origin> fino a <destination>. Precisamente, <cargo>. Sono certo che Lei sappia che laggiù sono molto richiesti, quindi abbiamo un accordo commerciale con quel pianeta. Purtroppo <commodity> sono ancora più richiesti in territorio pirata, così gli ultimi due mercanti che ho mandato laggiù sono stati attaccati da navi pirata. La mia azienda non finanzia una scorta, quindi chiunque mandi laggiù deve andare da solo. Per fortuna ho il budget per un contratto ad alto rischio: se può portare una di queste spedizioni su <destination>, posso disporre un pagamento di <payment>. Le sembra giusto fin qui?"

units.id: mission:Antibiotics To South|	"Sure, but do you know anything about these pirates?"|3613|0
units.english: "Sure, but do you know anything about these pirates?"
units.italian: "Certo, ma sa qualcosa di questi pirati?"

units.id: mission:Antibiotics To South|	"No thanks, that sounds too risky for me."|3614|0
units.english: "No thanks, that sounds too risky for me."
units.italian: "No grazie, mi sembra troppo rischioso."

units.id: mission:Antibiotics To South|	He seems to have anticipated this question, and quickly responds by saying "Oh, it's mostly just opportunistic raiders, much like the ones you've probably already seen a lot of down there. Pretty sure a ship like this one will make those guys hesitant enough. The problem is a modified medium warship called the <npc>. It's faster than a Bounder and persistent beyond any reasonable measure. Which is, of course, why I'm talking to you. There is no way you're going to avoid a fight with it. However, I think your ship is a match for it. So, is this acceptable?"|3616|0
units.english: He seems to have anticipated this question, and quickly responds by saying "Oh, it's mostly just opportunistic raiders, much like the ones you've probably already seen a lot of down there. Pretty sure a ship like this one will make those guys hesitant enough. The problem is a modified medium warship called the <npc>. It's faster than a Bounder and persistent beyond any reasonable measure. Which is, of course, why I'm talking to you. There is no way you're going to avoid a fight with it. However, I think your ship is a match for it. So, is this acceptable?"
units.italian: Sembra aver previsto la domanda e risponde subito: "Oh, sono per lo più predoni opportunisti, molto simili a quelli che probabilmente ha già visto laggiù. Sono abbastanza sicuro che una nave come questa li renderà esitanti. Il problema è una nave da guerra media modificata che si chiama <npc>. È più veloce di un Bounder e insistente oltre ogni misura ragionevole. Ed è ovviamente per questo che sto parlando con Lei. Non c'è modo di evitare uno scontro con quella nave. Però credo che la sua nave sia alla sua altezza. Allora, le sembra accettabile?"

units.id: mission:Antibiotics To South|	"Of course."|3618|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: mission:Antibiotics To South|	"No thanks, that sounds like too much of a risk."|3619|0
units.english: "No thanks, that sounds like too much of a risk."
units.italian: "No grazie, mi sembra un rischio troppo grande."

units.id: mission:Antibiotics To South|	"Thank you very much, Captain," he says. "I'll take care of everything else from here."|3621|0
units.english: "Thank you very much, Captain," he says. "I'll take care of everything else from here."
units.italian: "Grazie mille, Capitano," dice. "Al resto penso io."

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|name|3640|0
units.english: Fight at Umbral
units.italian: Duello a Umbral

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|description|3641|0
units.english: Head as quickly as you can to the Umbral system, where you will duel with a small militia vessel named the Esca. After fighting, go to <destination> to follow up.
units.italian: Raggiungi il prima possibile il sistema Umbral, dove ti batterai in duello con una piccola nave della milizia chiamata Esca. Dopo lo scontro, vai su <destination> per il seguito.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|While you are walking around the spaceport, you accidentally bump into a sturdily-built man. "Oh, I'm sorry," he responds in a gruff voice. When he takes a closer look at you, his expression changes to shock. "Oh! You're Captain <last>!"|3663|0
units.english: While you are walking around the spaceport, you accidentally bump into a sturdily-built man. "Oh, I'm sorry," he responds in a gruff voice. When he takes a closer look at you, his expression changes to shock. "Oh! You're Captain <last>!"
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto, urti per sbaglio un uomo di corporatura robusta. "Oh, mi scusi," risponde con voce burbera. Quando ti guarda più da vicino, la sua espressione cambia in stupore. "Oh! Lei è il Capitano <last>!"

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	"How did you know my name?"|3665|0
units.english: "How did you know my name?"
units.italian: "Come fa a sapere il mio nome?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	"I don't know who you're talking about."|3667|0
units.english: "I don't know who you're talking about."
units.italian: "Non so di chi stia parlando."

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	The man's expression changes to one of slight disappointment. "Oh. I see." He walks away without another word.|3668|0
units.english: The man's expression changes to one of slight disappointment. "Oh. I see." He walks away without another word.
units.italian: L'espressione dell'uomo si fa leggermente delusa. "Oh. Capisco." Se ne va senza dire altro.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	"I happen to take an interest in young pioneering privateers, and your performance, even in a small vessel like the <ship>, has impressed me greatly. I'll tell you more if you let me take you somewhere."|3671|0
units.english: "I happen to take an interest in young pioneering privateers, and your performance, even in a small vessel like the <ship>, has impressed me greatly. I'll tell you more if you let me take you somewhere."
units.italian: "Mi capita di interessarmi ai giovani corsari intraprendenti, e la tua prestazione, anche su una nave piccola come la <ship>, mi ha impressionato molto. Ti dirò di più se mi lasci portarti da qualche parte."

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	"Sure, I'll follow."|3673|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll follow."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti seguo."

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	"Where are you taking me?"|3675|0
units.english: "Where are you taking me?"
units.italian: "Dove mi stai portando?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	The man chuckles nervously. "Just to somewhere more private. Don't worry, I won't bite."|3676|0
units.english: The man chuckles nervously. "Just to somewhere more private. Don't worry, I won't bite."
units.italian: L'uomo ridacchia nervosamente. "Solo in un posto più riservato. Non preoccuparti, non mordo."

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	"Fine, I'll go."|3678|0
units.english: "Fine, I'll go."
units.italian: "Va bene, vengo."

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	"I still don't buy this. I'm out."|3679|0
units.english: "I still don't buy this. I'm out."
units.italian: "Continuo a non fidarmi. Ci rinuncio."

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	You follow the man into a series of winding alleyways, keeping your eyes alert for any danger. After a while, the man stops. "I suppose I can tell you more about myself now. I... am the leader of the local militia, and I believe that, considering your proficiency in piloting smaller craft, you would be a great candidate to join our team. However, there is a test you must pass. I will use one of our smaller ships in our fleet, the Esca, to challenge you to a duel in the system of Umbral. If you manage to disable me, go to our base in Wayfarer, and I'll let you join."|3682|0
units.english: You follow the man into a series of winding alleyways, keeping your eyes alert for any danger. After a while, the man stops. "I suppose I can tell you more about myself now. I... am the leader of the local militia, and I believe that, considering your proficiency in piloting smaller craft, you would be a great candidate to join our team. However, there is a test you must pass. I will use one of our smaller ships in our fleet, the Esca, to challenge you to a duel in the system of Umbral. If you manage to disable me, go to our base in Wayfarer, and I'll let you join."
units.italian: Segui l'uomo in una serie di vicoli tortuosi, tenendo gli occhi aperti su ogni pericolo. Dopo un po' l'uomo si ferma. "Suppongo di poterti dire qualcosa di più su di me, ora. Io... sono il capo della milizia locale, e credo che, considerata la tua abilità nel pilotare navi piccole, saresti un ottimo candidato per unirti alla nostra squadra. C'è però una prova da superare. Userò una delle nostre navi più piccole, l'Esca, per sfidarti a duello nel sistema di Umbral. Se riesci a neutralizzarmi, vieni alla nostra base su Wayfarer e ti lascerò entrare."

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	"What sort of vessel is the Esca?"|3684|0
units.english: "What sort of vessel is the Esca?"
units.italian: "Che tipo di nave è l'Esca?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	"Why did you need to bring me to here? Couldn't you have made this offer in the spaceport?"|3686|0
units.english: "Why did you need to bring me to here? Couldn't you have made this offer in the spaceport?"
units.italian: "Perché dovevi portarmi fin qui? Non potevi farmi questa offerta allo spazioporto?"

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	The man hesitates for a moment. "Well, being in the open when admitting that you're the leader of the ragtag that hunts down pirates in a potentially pirate-infested spaceport isn't a good idea. You can't ever be too sure about who's listening.|3687|0
units.english: The man hesitates for a moment. "Well, being in the open when admitting that you're the leader of the ragtag that hunts down pirates in a potentially pirate-infested spaceport isn't a good idea. You can't ever be too sure about who's listening.
units.italian: L'uomo esita un momento. "Beh, dichiarare in pubblico di essere il capo di una banda raffazzonata che dà la caccia ai pirati, in uno spazioporto potenzialmente pieno di pirati, non è una buona idea. Non si è mai troppo sicuri di chi ascolta.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	The man hesitates for a moment. "Oh, just some low-end Southbound Shipyards light warship. Nothing to worry about for a captain like you.|3690|0
units.english: The man hesitates for a moment. "Oh, just some low-end Southbound Shipyards light warship. Nothing to worry about for a captain like you.
units.italian: L'uomo esita un momento. "Oh, solo una nave da guerra leggera di fascia bassa dei Southbound Shipyards. Niente di cui preoccuparsi per un capitano come te.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	"Well, I better be going now. Meet me at Umbral as fast as you can if you want to take up my challenge." The man walks away, leaving you to your own devices.|3692|0
units.english: "Well, I better be going now. Meet me at Umbral as fast as you can if you want to take up my challenge." The man walks away, leaving you to your own devices.
units.italian: "Beh, è meglio che vada. Raggiungimi a Umbral il prima possibile se vuoi raccogliere la mia sfida." L'uomo se ne va, lasciandoti solo.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	(Ready my ship for the battle with the Esca.)|3694|0
units.english: (Ready my ship for the battle with the Esca.)
units.italian: (Prepara la mia nave per la battaglia con l'Esca.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	(Ignore the invitation.)|3696|0
units.english: (Ignore the invitation.)
units.italian: (Ignora l'invito.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|dialog|3703|0
units.english: When you take off, you run a quick scan on all other ships that are taking off. You see no sign of the Esca. Maybe it's already waiting for you at Umbral.
units.italian: Quando decolli, fai una rapida scansione di tutte le altre navi che stanno decollando. Non vedi traccia dell'Esca. Forse ti sta già aspettando a Umbral.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|When you enter Umbral, you continue to see no sign of the Esca. Suddenly, an alarm rings out as your sensors detect that a pirate Vanguard has entered the system alongside you. Before you can respond, your ship intercepts a hail, and it opens communication.|3714|0
units.english: When you enter Umbral, you continue to see no sign of the Esca. Suddenly, an alarm rings out as your sensors detect that a pirate Vanguard has entered the system alongside you. Before you can respond, your ship intercepts a hail, and it opens communication.
units.italian: Quando entri in Umbral, continui a non vedere traccia dell'Esca. All'improvviso suona un allarme: i sensori rilevano un Vanguard pirata entrato nel sistema insieme a te. Prima che tu possa reagire, la tua nave intercetta un segnale e apre le comunicazioni.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	The voice of the alleged captain of the Esca shouts out towards you. "Ho ho ho! Did you really think that I was the leader of the militia? Well, considering that you're here, I suppose you did. And now you'll pay for your mistake! Don't bother trying to call for help either, the militia don't patrol this system!"|3715|0
units.english: The voice of the alleged captain of the Esca shouts out towards you. "Ho ho ho! Did you really think that I was the leader of the militia? Well, considering that you're here, I suppose you did. And now you'll pay for your mistake! Don't bother trying to call for help either, the militia don't patrol this system!"
units.italian: La voce del presunto capitano dell'Esca ti grida contro. "Ho ho ho! Credevi davvero che fossi io il capo della milizia? Beh, visto che sei qui, immagino di sì. E ora pagherai il tuo errore! Non perdere tempo a chiedere aiuto: la milizia non pattuglia questo sistema!"

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	The Vanguard powers up its weapons.|3716|0
units.english: The Vanguard powers up its weapons.
units.italian: Il Vanguard carica le armi.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|label|3718|0
units.english: killed anglerfish
units.italian: killed anglerfish

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|You enter Umbral, but see no sign of the Esca, as the "captain of the Esca" was killed. You should head back to Wayfarer to see if you can claim some sort of reward.|3719|0
units.english: You enter Umbral, but see no sign of the Esca, as the "captain of the Esca" was killed. You should head back to Wayfarer to see if you can claim some sort of reward.
units.italian: Entri in Umbral, ma non vedi traccia dell'Esca, perché il "capitano dell'Esca" è stato ucciso. Dovresti tornare su Wayfarer per vedere se riesci a ottenere una ricompensa.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|label|3721|0
units.english: disabled anglerfish
units.italian: disabled anglerfish

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|You enter Umbral, but see no sign of the Esca, as the "captain of the Esca" was on the ship you disabled. You should head back to make sure the Anglerfish has been fully destroyed.|3722|0
units.english: You enter Umbral, but see no sign of the Esca, as the "captain of the Esca" was on the ship you disabled. You should head back to make sure the Anglerfish has been fully destroyed.
units.italian: Entri in Umbral, ma non vedi traccia dell'Esca, perché il "capitano dell'Esca" era sulla nave che hai neutralizzato. Dovresti tornare indietro per assicurarti che l'Anglerfish sia stata distrutta del tutto.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|label|3724|0
units.english: caught anglerfish
units.italian: caught anglerfish

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|As you enter Umbral, the Anglerfish follows behind you, and opens a hail.|3727|0
units.english: As you enter Umbral, the Anglerfish follows behind you, and opens a hail.
units.italian: Mentre entri in Umbral, l'Anglerfish ti segue e apre un segnale.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	"Did you think that if you went to Umbral, I would switch to a smaller ship? Ha!"|3728|0
units.english: "Did you think that if you went to Umbral, I would switch to a smaller ship? Ha!"
units.italian: "Credevi che, se fossi andato a Umbral, sarei passato a una nave più piccola? Ah!"

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	The Anglerfish once again powers up its weapons.|3729|0
units.english: The Anglerfish once again powers up its weapons.
units.italian: L'Anglerfish carica di nuovo le armi.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|As soon as you open fire, the Anglerfish hails you.|3747|0
units.english: As soon as you open fire, the Anglerfish hails you.
units.italian: Appena apri il fuoco, l'Anglerfish ti chiama.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	A voice you recognize as the "captain of the Esca" says, "How did you know that was me? Well, it doesn't matter, because I've paid off the militia. Get ready to die, small-fry."|3748|0
units.english: A voice you recognize as the "captain of the Esca" says, "How did you know that was me? Well, it doesn't matter, because I've paid off the militia. Get ready to die, small-fry."
units.italian: Una voce che riconosci come quella del "capitano dell'Esca" dice: "Come facevi a sapere che ero io? Beh, non importa, perché ho pagato la milizia. Preparati a morire, pivello."

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	The Anglerfish powers up its weapons.|3749|0
units.english: The Anglerfish powers up its weapons.
units.italian: L'Anglerfish carica le armi.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|The Anglerfish and the "captain of the Esca" have been destroyed. You should continue on to Wayfarer to see if you can claim some sort of reward for your effort.|3761|0
units.english: The Anglerfish and the "captain of the Esca" have been destroyed. You should continue on to Wayfarer to see if you can claim some sort of reward for your effort.
units.italian: L'Anglerfish e il "capitano dell'Esca" sono stati distrutti. Dovresti proseguire verso Wayfarer per vedere se riesci a ottenere una ricompensa per il tuo impegno.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|label|3763|0
units.english: passed tarazed
units.italian: passed tarazed

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|The Anglerfish and the "captain of the Esca" have been destroyed. You should head back to Wayfarer to see if you can claim some sort of reward for your effort.|3764|0
units.english: The Anglerfish and the "captain of the Esca" have been destroyed. You should head back to Wayfarer to see if you can claim some sort of reward for your effort.
units.italian: L'Anglerfish e il "capitano dell'Esca" sono stati distrutti. Dovresti tornare a Wayfarer per vedere se riesci a ottenere una ricompensa per il tuo impegno.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|label|3766|0
units.english: orbiting tarazed
units.italian: orbiting tarazed

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|The Anglerfish and the "captain of the Esca" have been destroyed. You should land on Wayfarer to see if you can claim some sort of reward for your effort.|3767|0
units.english: The Anglerfish and the "captain of the Esca" have been destroyed. You should land on Wayfarer to see if you can claim some sort of reward for your effort.
units.italian: L'Anglerfish e il "capitano dell'Esca" sono stati distrutti. Dovresti atterrare su Wayfarer per vedere se riesci a ottenere una ricompensa per il tuo impegno.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|When you land on Wayfarer, you look up bounties and wanted pirate documents, searching for any mention of the Anglerfish and the Esca. Eventually, you find a bounty for the destruction of the Anglerfish.|3773|0
units.english: When you land on Wayfarer, you look up bounties and wanted pirate documents, searching for any mention of the Anglerfish and the Esca. Eventually, you find a bounty for the destruction of the Anglerfish.
units.italian: Quando atterri su Wayfarer, cerchi taglie e documenti di pirati ricercati, in cerca di qualsiasi menzione dell'Anglerfish e dell'Esca. Alla fine trovi una taglia per la distruzione dell'Anglerfish.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	(Take the bounty money.)|3775|0
units.english: (Take the bounty money.)
units.italian: (Prendi il denaro della taglia.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	(Read more about the bounty.)|3777|0
units.english: (Read more about the bounty.)
units.italian: (Leggi di più sulla taglia.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	You decide to read more of the bounty documents. It appears that the pirate that you killed was Enrico Snake, a pirate that mainly dealt in cargo smuggling. However, he also had a curious tick of hunting aspiring privateers by luring them to Umbral, where he easily took them out with his superior ship.|3778|0
units.english: You decide to read more of the bounty documents. It appears that the pirate that you killed was Enrico Snake, a pirate that mainly dealt in cargo smuggling. However, he also had a curious tick of hunting aspiring privateers by luring them to Umbral, where he easily took them out with his superior ship.
units.italian: Decidi di leggere il resto dei documenti della taglia. Sembra che il pirata che hai ucciso fosse Enrico Snake, un pirata che si occupava soprattutto di contrabbando di carico. Aveva però anche la curiosa abitudine di dare la caccia ai corsari alle prime armi attirandoli a Umbral, dove li eliminava facilmente con la sua nave superiore.

units.id: mission:Pirate Duel|	You head to the local authorities, and show them your combat logs of your fight against the Anglerfish. They pay you <payment> for your effort.|3780|0
units.english: You head to the local authorities, and show them your combat logs of your fight against the Anglerfish. They pay you <payment> for your effort.
units.italian: Ti rechi alle autorità locali e mostri i registri di combattimento dello scontro con l'Anglerfish. Ti pagano <payment> per il tuo impegno.

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|name|3801|0
units.english: Retired Family to Earth
units.italian: Famiglia in pensione sulla Terra

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|description|3802|0
units.english: Transport two seniors to <destination>, where they plan to retire. They can only promise you <payment>.
units.italian: Trasporta due anziani su <destination>, dove hanno intenzione di andare in pensione. Possono prometterti solo <payment>.

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|As you wander through the spaceport, you see an elderly man and woman sitting on a bench, talking about something that seems to be causing them some amount of stress.|3813|0
units.english: As you wander through the spaceport, you see an elderly man and woman sitting on a bench, talking about something that seems to be causing them some amount of stress.
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto, vedi un uomo e una donna anziani seduti su una panchina, che parlano di qualcosa che sembra causare loro un certo stress.

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	(Ask them what the problem is.)|3815|0
units.english: (Ask them what the problem is.)
units.italian: (Chiedi loro qual è il problema.)

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	(Ignore them.)|3816|0
units.english: (Ignore them.)
units.italian: (Ignali.)

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	You inquire as to what's troubling them, and the woman begins telling you her life's story. "We were yard workers here on <origin> for nearly fifty years, but we're both starting to get too old for our jobs. So, we've made the hard decision to retire. We've already chosen a location on the best place we could afford, which... well, happened to be on Earth, so Charles and I are looking for someone to transport us. Oh, where are my manners? I'm Donna. Pleased to meet you."|3818|0
units.english: You inquire as to what's troubling them, and the woman begins telling you her life's story. "We were yard workers here on <origin> for nearly fifty years, but we're both starting to get too old for our jobs. So, we've made the hard decision to retire. We've already chosen a location on the best place we could afford, which... well, happened to be on Earth, so Charles and I are looking for someone to transport us. Oh, where are my manners? I'm Donna. Pleased to meet you."
units.italian: Chiedi che cosa li turba, e la donna comincia a raccontarti la storia della sua vita. "Eravamo operai dei cantieri qui su <origin> per quasi cinquant'anni, ma stiamo diventando entrambi troppo vecchi per il nostro lavoro. Così abbiamo preso la difficile decisione di andare in pensione. Abbiamo già scelto una sistemazione nel posto migliore che potevamo permetterci, che... beh, guarda caso è sulla Terra, quindi Charles e io cerchiamo qualcuno che ci porti. Oh, che maleducata: sono Donna. Piacere di conoscerla."

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	Donna was clearly looking for someone besides her husband to talk to, but Charles begins to frown. "I suppose you could put it like that."|3819|0
units.english: Donna was clearly looking for someone besides her husband to talk to, but Charles begins to frown. "I suppose you could put it like that."
units.italian: Donna cercava chiaramente qualcuno con cui parlare oltre a suo marito, ma Charles comincia a imbronciarsi. "Immagino che si possa dire così."

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	"Is that wrong?" Donna replies anxiously, bracing for the response.|3820|0
units.english: "Is that wrong?" Donna replies anxiously, bracing for the response.
units.italian: "È sbagliato?" risponde Donna con ansia, preparandosi alla risposta.

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	The man's look of resignation starts to turn to one of anger. "Of course it's wrong. We've spent our whole lives working for these spoiled brats, and what do we get in return? We get dumped on Earth like we're dead weight!"|3821|0
units.english: The man's look of resignation starts to turn to one of anger. "Of course it's wrong. We've spent our whole lives working for these spoiled brats, and what do we get in return? We get dumped on Earth like we're dead weight!"
units.italian: L'aria rassegnata dell'uomo comincia a diventare rabbia. "Certo che è sbagliato. Abbiamo passato tutta la vita a lavorare per questi ragazzini viziati, e che cosa otteniamo in cambio? Veniamo scaricati sulla Terra come se fossimo un peso morto!"

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	"I know you're upset about this," interrupts Donna, "but just getting angry isn't going to change anything!" Charles remains silent for a long time, and then mutters a reluctant apology.|3822|0
units.english: "I know you're upset about this," interrupts Donna, "but just getting angry isn't going to change anything!" Charles remains silent for a long time, and then mutters a reluctant apology.
units.italian: "So che la cosa ti turba," interviene Donna, "ma arrabbiarsi non cambierà niente!" Charles resta in silenzio a lungo, poi borbotta delle scuse riluttanti.

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	Donna talks to you again. "I'm sorry about that. As you can tell, we're under a lot of stress right now. I can tell that you're a star captain. Can you help take us to Earth? We don't have a lot of money, but we'll be glad to pay <payment>."|3823|0
units.english: Donna talks to you again. "I'm sorry about that. As you can tell, we're under a lot of stress right now. I can tell that you're a star captain. Can you help take us to Earth? We don't have a lot of money, but we'll be glad to pay <payment>."
units.italian: Donna torna a parlarti. "Mi scusi. Come vede, siamo molto stressati in questo momento. Si vede che è un capitano stellare. Può aiutarci a tornare sulla Terra? Non abbiamo molti soldi, ma saremo lieti di pagare <payment>."

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	"I can handle two passengers."|3825|0
units.english: "I can handle two passengers."
units.italian: "Posso portare due passeggeri."

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	"I'm sorry, but I'm not headed to Earth right now."|3826|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but I'm not headed to Earth right now."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma adesso non vado sulla Terra."

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	You show Charles and Donna to their bunks, and they both thank you in advance.|3828|0
units.english: You show Charles and Donna to their bunks, and they both thank you in advance.
units.italian: Accompagni Charles e Donna ai loro posti letto, e entrambi ti ringraziano in anticipo.

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|Once you land on Earth, Donna and Charles pick up their belongings and start to leave your ship. Before he leaves, Charles stops and takes out a large clump of credit chips. "Here you go," he mutters. "I hope your life goes better than ours has."|3835|0
units.english: Once you land on Earth, Donna and Charles pick up their belongings and start to leave your ship. Before he leaves, Charles stops and takes out a large clump of credit chips. "Here you go," he mutters. "I hope your life goes better than ours has."
units.italian: Una volta atterrato sulla Terra, Donna e Charles prendono le loro cose e cominciano a lasciare la nave. Prima di uscire, Charles si ferma e tira fuori un grosso mucchio di chip di credito. "Ecco," borbotta. "Spero che la tua vita vada meglio della nostra."

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	"Thank you. I hope you have the best of luck on Earth."|3837|0
units.english: "Thank you. I hope you have the best of luck on Earth."
units.italian: "Grazie. Vi auguro ogni fortuna sulla Terra."

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	"You can keep those. You sound like you need them more than I do."|3839|0
units.english: "You can keep those. You sound like you need them more than I do."
units.italian: "Puoi tenerteli. Sembra che servano più a te che a me."

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	As you count up the large clump of credits you were handed (the sum comes out to the expected <payment>), they slowly make their way to the train station. Presumably, their new apartment is far from here.|3845|0
units.english: As you count up the large clump of credits you were handed (the sum comes out to the expected <payment>), they slowly make their way to the train station. Presumably, their new apartment is far from here.
units.italian: Mentre conti il grosso mucchio di crediti che ti è stato consegnato (la somma corrisponde ai <payment> previsti), i due si avviano lentamente verso la stazione dei treni. Presumibilmente il loro nuovo appartamento è lontano da qui.

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	Charles looks surprised for a moment, and then, for the first time you've seen, he smiles. "Thank you, Captain <last>. I wish there were more people like you in the Paradise Worlds."|3848|0
units.english: Charles looks surprised for a moment, and then, for the first time you've seen, he smiles. "Thank you, Captain <last>. I wish there were more people like you in the Paradise Worlds."
units.italian: Charles sembra sorpreso per un momento, e poi, per la prima volta, sorride. "Grazie, Capitano <last>. Vorrei che nei Mondi Paradisiaci ci fossero più persone come te."

units.id: mission:Earth Retirement|	You wish the couple the best of luck on Earth, and they slowly make their way to the train station. Presumably, their new apartment is far from here.|3849|0
units.english: You wish the couple the best of luck on Earth, and they slowly make their way to the train station. Presumably, their new apartment is far from here.
units.italian: Auguri alla coppia ogni fortuna sulla Terra, e i due si avviano lentamente verso la stazione dei treni. Presumibilmente il loro nuovo appartamento è lontano da qui.

units.id: mission:Spacediving professionals|name|3856|0
units.english: Spacediving at <planet>
units.italian: Paracadutismo spaziale su <planet>

units.id: mission:Spacediving professionals|description|3857|0
units.english: Head to <destination> with <bunks> professionally equipped skydivers and drop them from the edge of space. They've agreed to pay <payment> when they land.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> con <bunks> paracadutisti equipaggiati professionalmente e falli lanciare dal bordo dello spazio. Hanno accettato di pagare <payment> quando atterrano.

units.id: mission:Spacediving professionals|dialog|3871|0
units.english: As you descend through the upper atmosphere, the skydivers jump from your ship, spectacularly diving until they open their parachutes and land safely near the spaceport. You collect your payment of <payment>.
units.italian: Mentre scendi attraverso l'alta atmosfera, i paracadutisti si lanciano dalla tua nave, precipitando in modo spettacolare finché non aprono i paracadute e atterrano sani e salvi vicino allo spazioporto. Riscuoti il pagamento di <payment>.

units.id: mission:Spacediving professionals accident|name|3878|0
units.english: Spacediving at <planet>
units.italian: Paracadutismo spaziale su <planet>

units.id: mission:Spacediving professionals accident|description|3879|0
units.english: Head to <destination> with <bunks> professionally equipped skydivers and drop them from the edge of space. They've agreed to pay <payment> when they land.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> con <bunks> paracadutisti equipaggiati professionalmente e falli lanciare dal bordo dello spazio. Hanno accettato di pagare <payment> quando atterrano.

units.id: mission:Spacediving professionals accident|dialog|3894|0
units.english: As you descend through the upper atmosphere, the skydivers jump from your ship, spectacularly diving until they try to open their parachutes. Some of the parachutes open only partially and part of the team suffers an uncontrolled hard landing. Medical teams respond quickly, but the skydivers are too preoccupied with their injured teammates to pay you the credits they owe you.
units.italian: Mentre scendi attraverso l'alta atmosfera, i paracadutisti si lanciano dalla tua nave, precipitando in modo spettacolare finché non provano ad aprire i paracadute. Alcuni si aprono solo in parte e una parte della squadra subisce un atterraggio duro e incontrollato. Le squadre mediche intervengono rapidamente, ma i paracadutisti sono troppo presi dai compagni feriti per pagarti i crediti che ti devono.

units.id: mission:Spacediving professionals disaster|name|3901|0
units.english: Spacediving at <planet>
units.italian: Paracadutismo spaziale su <planet>

units.id: mission:Spacediving professionals disaster|description|3902|0
units.english: Head to <destination> with <bunks> professionally equipped skydivers and drop them from the edge of space. They've agreed to pay <payment> when they land.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> con <bunks> paracadutisti equipaggiati professionalmente e falli lanciare dal bordo dello spazio. Hanno accettato di pagare <payment> quando atterrano.

units.id: mission:Spacediving professionals disaster|dialog|3919|0
units.english: As you descend through the upper atmosphere, the skydivers jump from your ship. Some minutes into the jump disaster strikes; the skydivers start moving in an uncontrolled manner. It's unclear if the spacesuits or the oxygen supplies were at fault, but it looks unlikely that any of the skydivers makes it safely to the ground. Authorities investigate the incident and although they don't find serious wrongdoings on your part, they still fine you <payment> for enabling such a dangerous and deadly act.
units.italian: Mentre scendi attraverso l'alta atmosfera, i paracadutisti si lanciano dalla tua nave. Dopo qualche minuto di caduta arriva il disastro: i paracadutisti cominciano a muoversi in modo incontrollato. Non è chiaro se la colpa sia delle tute spaziali o delle riserve di ossigeno, ma sembra improbabile che qualcuno di loro arrivi a terra sano e salvo. Le autorità indagano sull'incidente e, anche se non trovano gravi colpe da parte tua, ti multano comunque di <payment> per aver permesso un atto così pericoloso e mortale.

units.id: mission:Spacediving amateurs|name|3926|0
units.english: Spacediving at <planet>
units.italian: Paracadutismo spaziale su <planet>

units.id: mission:Spacediving amateurs|description|3927|0
units.english: Head to <destination> with <bunks> poorly equipped skydivers and drop them from the edge of space. They've agreed to pay <payment> when they land.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> con <bunks> paracadutisti mal equipaggiati e falli lanciare dal bordo dello spazio. Hanno accettato di pagare <payment> quando atterrano.

units.id: mission:Spacediving amateurs|dialog|3943|0
units.english: As you descend through the upper atmosphere, you inform your skydivers that it's time to jump. However, after being able to see the distances and atmospheric conditions involved, all of them are far less keen on the idea than when you first picked them up. You bring them down to the landing pad, and they pay you a meager <payment> before hopping off.
units.italian: Mentre scendi attraverso l'alta atmosfera, avvisi i tuoi paracadutisti che è ora di lanciarsi. Dopo aver però visto le distanze e le condizioni atmosferiche in gioco, sono tutti molto meno entusiasti dell'idea di quando li hai presi a bordo. Li riporti alla piazzola di atterraggio, e ti pagano una misera somma di <payment> prima di saltare giù.

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space - No Contact|	A young man carrying luggage approaches you. "You look like a knowledgeable captain," he says. "In all your travels, have you ever heard tell of any... intelligent rodents?"|3956|0
units.context: mission:Human to Hai Space - No Contact
units.english: A young man carrying luggage approaches you. "You look like a knowledgeable captain," he says. "In all your travels, have you ever heard tell of any... intelligent rodents?"
units.italian: Un giovane con dei bagagli ti si avvicina. "Lei sembra un capitano esperto," dice. "In tutti i suoi viaggi, ha mai sentito parlare di... roditori intelligenti?"

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space - No Contact|	"What are you talking about?"|3958|0
units.context: mission:Human to Hai Space - No Contact
units.english: "What are you talking about?"
units.italian: "Di che cosa sta parlando?"

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space - No Contact|	"What, like in a zoo?"|3960|0
units.context: mission:Human to Hai Space - No Contact
units.english: "What, like in a zoo?"
units.italian: "Come, tipo allo zoo?"

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space - No Contact|	"Are you high?"|3962|0
units.context: mission:Human to Hai Space - No Contact
units.english: "Are you high?"
units.italian: "Sei fatto?"

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space - No Contact|	"No, I want to go to the high-" He stops once he realizes you have no idea what he's talking about. "Oh, never mind then," he says, with a note of disappointment in his voice. As he leaves, you can't help feeling like you were missing some context.|3963|0
units.context: mission:Human to Hai Space - No Contact
units.english: "No, I want to go to the high-" He stops once he realizes you have no idea what he's talking about. "Oh, never mind then," he says, with a note of disappointment in his voice. As he leaves, you can't help feeling like you were missing some context.
units.italian: "No, voglio andare nell'alto..." Si ferma quando capisce che non hai idea di cosa stia parlando. "Oh, lasci perdere," dice, con una nota di delusione nella voce. Mentre se ne va, non puoi fare a meno di sentire che ti mancava un pezzo di contesto.

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space - No Contact|	"Oh, never mind then," he says, with a note of disappointment in his voice. As he leaves, you can't help feeling like you were missing some context.|3966|0
