units.context: mission:Human to Hai Space - No Contact
units.english: "Oh, never mind then," he says, with a note of disappointment in his voice. As he leaves, you can't help feeling like you were missing some context.
units.italian: "Oh, lasci perdere," dice, con una nota di delusione nella voce. Mentre se ne va, non puoi fare a meno di sentire che ti mancava un pezzo di contesto.

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|description|3972|0
units.english: Bring a human passenger to <destination> in Hai space.
units.italian: Porta un passeggero umano su <destination>, nello spazio degli Hai.

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	A young man carrying luggage approaches you. "You look like a knowledgeable captain," he says. "In all your travels, have you ever heard tell of any... intelligent rodents?"|3984|0
units.english: A young man carrying luggage approaches you. "You look like a knowledgeable captain," he says. "In all your travels, have you ever heard tell of any... intelligent rodents?"
units.italian: Un giovane con dei bagagli ti si avvicina. "Lei sembra un capitano esperto," dice. "In tutti i suoi viaggi, ha mai sentito parlare di... roditori intelligenti?"

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"'Heard tell'? I'm from Hai space!"|3986|0
units.english: "'Heard tell'? I'm from Hai space!"
units.italian: "'Sentito parlare'? Ma se sono dello spazio degli Hai!"

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"You mean the Hai? You'll have to go up north for that."|3990|0
units.english: "You mean the Hai? You'll have to go up north for that."
units.italian: "Intende gli Hai? Per quelli deve andare a nord."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"Ah, I think I know of some large squirrels to the north of here."|3992|0
units.english: "Ah, I think I know of some large squirrels to the north of here."
units.italian: "Ah, credo di conoscere degli scoiattoli giganti a nord di qui."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"What are you talking about?"|3994|0
units.english: "What are you talking about?"
units.italian: "Di che cosa sta parlando?"

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"Oh, never mind then," he says, with a note of disappointment in his voice. You feel good knowing that you are helping to keep the Hai's existence a secret in human space. Better safe than sorry.|3995|0
units.english: "Oh, never mind then," he says, with a note of disappointment in his voice. You feel good knowing that you are helping to keep the Hai's existence a secret in human space. Better safe than sorry.
units.italian: "Oh, lasci perdere," dice, con una nota di delusione nella voce. Ti senti bene sapendo di contribuire a mantenere segreta l'esistenza degli Hai nello spazio umano. Meglio prevenire che curare.

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	He seems shocked. "Really? I can give you <payment> to get to <planet>."|3999|0
units.english: He seems shocked. "Really? I can give you <payment> to get to <planet>."
units.italian: Sembra scioccato. "Davvero? Posso darle <payment> per arrivare su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"If that's the case, could you bring me to <destination>? I'll give you <payment>."|4002|0
units.english: "If that's the case, could you bring me to <destination>? I'll give you <payment>."
units.italian: "Se è così, potrebbe portarmi su <destination>? Le darò <payment>."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"Actually, I'm from <planet>."|4005|0
units.english: "Actually, I'm from <planet>."
units.italian: "In realtà sono di <planet>."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"Alright, I'll take you there."|4008|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll take you there."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti ci porto."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"Sorry, I'm too busy right now."|4010|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm too busy right now."
units.italian: "Spiacente, sono molto impegnato adesso."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"Why would you want to go all the way out to <planet>?"|4012|0
units.english: "Why would you want to go all the way out to <planet>?"
units.italian: "Perché vorresti andare fin lì, su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"No way, you as well?" He stops for a second to process. "They say the universe is a small place, but I never believed any of that. Until now, that is. And to think I'd meet someone like you on my first time out of the wormhole."|4014|0
units.english: "No way, you as well?" He stops for a second to process. "They say the universe is a small place, but I never believed any of that. Until now, that is. And to think I'd meet someone like you on my first time out of the wormhole."
units.italian: "Non dirlo, anche tu?" Si ferma un secondo per elaborare. "Dicono che l'universo sia piccolo, ma non ci ho mai creduto. Fino ad adesso, almeno. E pensare che avrei incontrato uno come te alla mia prima uscita dal wormhole."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"I have family there," he says. "I came out here to do some traveling and see a bit of human space, but now I have to get back home. You see, I was born on <planet>, and this is my first time out of the wormhole."|4017|0
units.english: "I have family there," he says. "I came out here to do some traveling and see a bit of human space, but now I have to get back home. You see, I was born on <planet>, and this is my first time out of the wormhole."
units.italian: "Ho la famiglia là," dice. "Sono venuto fin qui per viaggiare un po' e vedere un pezzo di spazio umano, ma ora devo tornare a casa. Vedi, sono nato su <planet>, e questa è la prima volta che esco dal wormhole."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|label|4018|0
units.english: human space
units.italian: human space

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"Really? How did you like human space?"|4020|0
units.english: "Really? How did you like human space?"
units.italian: "Davvero? Come ti è sembrato lo spazio umano?"

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"You've never been to human space before?"|4022|0
units.english: "You've never been to human space before?"
units.italian: "Non sei mai stato nello spazio umano prima?"

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"Nope, first time! I've never been so far from home before. Now that I think about it, I probably should've arranged transport back to Hai space beforehand. You wouldn't believe how hard it is to find a captain here that knows about the Hai. I had to ask about six others until I found you. They all thought I was crazy, talking about meeting giant squirrels." He laughs and shakes his head. "So anyways, would you be willing to take me to <destination>?"|4023|0
units.english: "Nope, first time! I've never been so far from home before. Now that I think about it, I probably should've arranged transport back to Hai space beforehand. You wouldn't believe how hard it is to find a captain here that knows about the Hai. I had to ask about six others until I found you. They all thought I was crazy, talking about meeting giant squirrels." He laughs and shakes his head. "So anyways, would you be willing to take me to <destination>?"
units.italian: "No, è la prima volta! Non sono mai stato così lontano da casa. Ora che ci penso, avrei dovuto organizzare il trasporto di ritorno verso lo spazio degli Hai in anticipo. Non crederai a quanto sia difficile trovare un capitano qui che sappia degli Hai. Ho dovuto chiedere a circa altre sei persone prima di trovare te. Pensavano tutti che fossi pazzo, a parlare di scoiattoli giganti." Ride e scuote la testa. "Comunque, saresti disposto a portarmi su <destination>?"

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"It was quite the trip! It's a bit odd to see only humans around, and I had to be careful to not mention where I was from. But it was definitely worth it! I got to see Earth, Skymoot, Chiron, and so many other beautiful planets. Seeing human culture with my own eyes was an eye-opening experience, although some of the places there were less... clean than I expected. I was almost robbed on Earth; I'm not used to pickpockets back home. Perhaps human space isn't as safe as Hai space, but I still don't regret coming here. It's about time for me to go back, though."|4027|0
units.english: "It was quite the trip! It's a bit odd to see only humans around, and I had to be careful to not mention where I was from. But it was definitely worth it! I got to see Earth, Skymoot, Chiron, and so many other beautiful planets. Seeing human culture with my own eyes was an eye-opening experience, although some of the places there were less... clean than I expected. I was almost robbed on Earth; I'm not used to pickpockets back home. Perhaps human space isn't as safe as Hai space, but I still don't regret coming here. It's about time for me to go back, though."
units.italian: "È stato un bel viaggio! È un po' strano vedere solo umani in giro, e ho dovuto stare attento a non dire da dove venivo. Ma ne è valsa decisamente la pena! Ho visto la Terra, Skymoot, Chiron e tanti altri pianeti bellissimi. Vedere con i miei occhi la cultura umana è stata un'esperienza illuminante, anche se alcuni posti erano meno... puliti di quanto immaginassi. Mi hanno quasi derubato sulla Terra; a casa mia non sono abituato ai borseggiatori. Forse lo spazio umano non è sicuro come quello degli Hai, ma non mi pento di essere venuto. È però ora che torni indietro."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"Alright, I'll take you there."|4031|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll take you there."
units.italian: "Va bene, ti ci porto."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"Sorry, I'm too busy right now."|4033|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm too busy right now."
units.italian: "Spiacente, sono molto impegnato adesso."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|During the trip, you learn that your passenger is named Benjamin. He gets off your ship, thanks you, and gives you your payment of <payment>. Benjamin then walks over to greet a group of Hai, who embrace him and start talking in a mix of the human and Hai languages.|4038|0
units.english: During the trip, you learn that your passenger is named Benjamin. He gets off your ship, thanks you, and gives you your payment of <payment>. Benjamin then walks over to greet a group of Hai, who embrace him and start talking in a mix of the human and Hai languages.
units.italian: Durante il viaggio scopri che il tuo passeggero si chiama Benjamin. Scende dalla nave, ti ringrazia e ti dà il pagamento di <payment>. Poi si avvicina a un gruppo di Hai per salutarli, e quelli lo abbracciano e cominciano a parlare in un misto di lingua umana e Hai.

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	(Leave.)|4040|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	(Approach them.)|4042|0
units.english: (Approach them.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati a loro.)

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"That's your family?"|4046|0
units.english: "That's your family?"
units.italian: "Quella è la tua famiglia?"

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	The man looks at you. "I'm adopted," he says. One of the Hai notices your confusion, and chitters. "Ah, you have not seen a human-Hai family, have you? Perhaps it is strange, but we are happy together nonetheless. Thank you for transporting our son safely."|4049|0
units.english: The man looks at you. "I'm adopted," he says. One of the Hai notices your confusion, and chitters. "Ah, you have not seen a human-Hai family, have you? Perhaps it is strange, but we are happy together nonetheless. Thank you for transporting our son safely."
units.italian: L'uomo ti guarda. "Sono adottato," dice. Uno degli Hai nota il tuo smarrimento e cinguetta. "Ah, non hai mai visto una famiglia umano-Hai, vero? Forse è strano, ma siamo comunque felici insieme. Grazie per aver trasportato nostro figlio sano e salvo."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"I didn't mean to be rude, I just didn't know that Hai adopted humans here."|4051|0
units.english: "I didn't mean to be rude, I just didn't know that Hai adopted humans here."
units.italian: "Non volevo essere sgarbato, non sapevo che gli Hai adottassero umani, qui."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"No problem, I hope you enjoyed the trip."|4052|0
units.english: "No problem, I hope you enjoyed the trip."
units.italian: "Nessun problema, spero che il viaggio ti sia piaciuto."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	After thanking you once again, they walk off. As they leave, you overhear Benjamin talk to his family about his trip. "They had so many kinds of food there, it was delicious! Although I did get homesick for pickled acorns..."|4054|0
units.english: After thanking you once again, they walk off. As they leave, you overhear Benjamin talk to his family about his trip. "They had so many kinds of food there, it was delicious! Although I did get homesick for pickled acorns..."
units.italian: Dopo averti ringraziato ancora una volta, si allontanano. Mentre se ne vanno, senti Benjamin che parla alla famiglia del suo viaggio. "C'erano così tanti tipi di cibo, era delizioso! Anche se mi è venuta nostalgia delle ghiande sottaceto..."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|label|4056|0
units.english: hai start
units.italian: hai start

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	Benjamin notices you approaching, and says, "These are my parents, Yeerto and Taepip." His father Yeerto then says, "We checked the travel agencies here on Greenwater, but it turned out to be much cheaper to get a merchant to bring Benjamin to human space. I guess we learned why that was cheaper the hard way."|4057|0
units.english: Benjamin notices you approaching, and says, "These are my parents, Yeerto and Taepip." His father Yeerto then says, "We checked the travel agencies here on Greenwater, but it turned out to be much cheaper to get a merchant to bring Benjamin to human space. I guess we learned why that was cheaper the hard way."
units.italian: Benjamin ti vede avvicinarti e dice: "Loro sono i miei genitori, Yeerto e Taepip." Suo padre Yeerto aggiunge: "Avevamo controllato le agenzie di viaggio qui su Greenwater, ma alla fine era molto più economico far portare Benjamin nello spazio umano da un mercante. Immagino che abbiamo scoperto nel modo peggiore perché era più economico."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"You said you used to work at a travel agency, right?" Benjamin adds with a smile on his face. "Funny we almost found each other then."|4058|0
units.english: "You said you used to work at a travel agency, right?" Benjamin adds with a smile on his face. "Funny we almost found each other then."
units.italian: "Ha detto che lavorava in un'agenzia di viaggi, vero?" aggiunge Benjamin con un sorriso. "Divertente che ci siamo quasi trovati, allora."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	Benjamin's mother Taepip softly places her hand on his shoulder before continuing, "If you want, you could come to our home and have a chat. And some pickled acorns, too," she adds with a bright smile.|4059|0
units.english: Benjamin's mother Taepip softly places her hand on his shoulder before continuing, "If you want, you could come to our home and have a chat. And some pickled acorns, too," she adds with a bright smile.
units.italian: La madre di Benjamin, Taepip, gli posa delicatamente una mano sulla spalla prima di continuare: "Se vuoi, potresti venire a casa nostra a fare due chiacchiere. E anche a mangiare qualche ghianda sottaceto," aggiunge con un sorriso raggiante.

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"Sure."|4061|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	"Sorry, I have other pressing matters."|4062|0
units.english: "Sorry, I have other pressing matters."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ho altre cose urgenti."

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	You spend a long evening with them, talking about your upbringing on <planet> and your experiences in human space. Yeerto then tells you about the local news here, and you catch up with what's happened on your home planet since you left.|4064|0
units.english: You spend a long evening with them, talking about your upbringing on <planet> and your experiences in human space. Yeerto then tells you about the local news here, and you catch up with what's happened on your home planet since you left.
units.italian: Passi una lunga serata con loro, parlando della tua infanzia su <planet> e delle tue esperienze nello spazio umano. Poi Yeerto ti racconta le notizie locali, e ti aggiorni su quello che è successo sul tuo pianeta natale da quando te ne sei andato.

units.id: mission:Human to Hai Space|	It begins to get dark, and after a final goodbye you head back to your ship.|4065|0
units.english: It begins to get dark, and after a final goodbye you head back to your ship.
units.italian: Comincia a fare buio, e dopo un ultimo saluto torni alla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|A man in a tailored suit, sunglasses, shiny shoes, and green hair approaches you. "Hey, that's a very nice ship you have there. Would be a shame if anything happened to it."|4081|0
units.english: A man in a tailored suit, sunglasses, shiny shoes, and green hair approaches you. "Hey, that's a very nice ship you have there. Would be a shame if anything happened to it."
units.italian: Un uomo in abito su misura, occhiali da sole, scarpe lucide e capelli verdi ti si avvicina. "Ehi, è davvero una bella nave quella che hai. Sarebbe un peccato se le succedesse qualcosa."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	You notice that he is missing a finger on each hand.|4082|0
units.english: You notice that he is missing a finger on each hand.
units.italian: Noti che gli manca un dito su ciascuna mano.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Thank you. My name is <first> <last>. To whom do I have the pleasure of speaking?"|4084|0
units.english: "Thank you. My name is <first> <last>. To whom do I have the pleasure of speaking?"
units.italian: "Grazie. Mi chiamo <first> <last>. A chi ho il piacere di parlare?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Yes, I'm very happy with my ship."|4085|0
units.english: "Yes, I'm very happy with my ship."
units.italian: "Sì, sono molto contento della mia nave."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"What should I be afraid of happening to my ship?"|4087|0
units.english: "What should I be afraid of happening to my ship?"
units.italian: "Di che cosa dovrei aver paura che succeda alla mia nave?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"You sound like one of those Mafia goons."|4089|0
units.english: "You sound like one of those Mafia goons."
units.italian: "Lei sembra uno di quegli scagnozzi della Mafia."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Are you trying to extort me?"|4091|0
units.english: "Are you trying to extort me?"
units.italian: "Sta cercando di estorcermi?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Yes, it helps me transport goods for some of the most dangerous people on this planet."|4093|0
units.english: "Yes, it helps me transport goods for some of the most dangerous people on this planet."
units.italian: "Sì, mi aiuta a trasportare merci per alcune delle persone più pericolose di questo pianeta."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"I don't have time to talk."|4095|0
units.english: "I don't have time to talk."
units.italian: "Non ho tempo per parlare."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	The man snorts. "Wow, telling everybody you meet your full name. That totally won't end up painting a huge target on your head if said name has a bounty on it. But I digress."|4097|0
units.english: The man snorts. "Wow, telling everybody you meet your full name. That totally won't end up painting a huge target on your head if said name has a bounty on it. But I digress."
units.italian: L'uomo sbuffa. "Caspita, dire il tuo nome completo a tutti quelli che incontri. Così non ti dipingerai affatto un bersaglio enorme sulla testa, se quel nome ha una taglia. Ma divago."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"What should I be afraid of happening to my ship?"|4099|0
units.english: "What should I be afraid of happening to my ship?"
units.italian: "Di che cosa dovrei aver paura che succeda alla mia nave?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"You sound like one of those mafia goons."|4100|0
units.english: "You sound like one of those mafia goons."
units.italian: "Lei sembra uno di quegli scagnozzi della mafia."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Are you trying to extort me?"|4102|0
units.english: "Are you trying to extort me?"
units.italian: "Sta cercando di estorcermi?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	The man responds, "Well, a fleet of unfriendly ships in this system might blow you to pieces when you take off. It's been known to happen from time to time."|4105|0
units.english: The man responds, "Well, a fleet of unfriendly ships in this system might blow you to pieces when you take off. It's been known to happen from time to time."
units.italian: L'uomo risponde: "Beh, una flotta di navi poco amichevoli in questo sistema potrebbe farti saltare in pezzi quando decolli. È successo, di tanto in tanto."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Ha, business as usual around here."|4107|0
units.english: "Ha, business as usual around here."
units.italian: "Ah, il solito tran tran da queste parti."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Are you trying to extort me?"|4109|0
units.english: "Are you trying to extort me?"
units.italian: "Sta cercando di estorcermi?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"And you have a way to prevent this from happening?"|4111|0
units.english: "And you have a way to prevent this from happening?"
units.italian: "E lei avrebbe un modo per evitare che succeda?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"And you're the local goon who takes bribes to keep such ships docked?"|4113|0
units.english: "And you're the local goon who takes bribes to keep such ships docked?"
units.italian: "E lei sarebbe lo scagnozzo locale che prende tangenti per tenere quelle navi attraccate?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"That would be unfortunate. I run jobs for some of the most dangerous people on this planet, and they wouldn't be happy if that happened."|4115|0
units.english: "That would be unfortunate. I run jobs for some of the most dangerous people on this planet, and they wouldn't be happy if that happened."
units.italian: "Sarebbe un peccato. Faccio lavori per alcune delle persone più pericolose di questo pianeta, e non sarebbero contenti se succedesse."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"I really don't have time to talk to you."|4117|0
units.english: "I really don't have time to talk to you."
units.italian: "Davvero non ho tempo per parlare con lei."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	The man responds, "Maybe you want to improve that situation?|4120|0
units.english: The man responds, "Maybe you want to improve that situation?
units.italian: L'uomo risponde: "Magari vuole migliorare la situazione?

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	The man acts shocked by your remark. "No way! I'm just a simple man walking around the spaceport and helping people out. You would be wise to listen to locals with experience, especially in dangerous places like this."|4123|0
units.english: The man acts shocked by your remark. "No way! I'm just a simple man walking around the spaceport and helping people out. You would be wise to listen to locals with experience, especially in dangerous places like this."
units.italian: L'uomo finge di essere sconvolto dalla tua risposta. "Ma figurati! Sono solo un semplice uomo che passeggia per lo spazioporto e aiuta la gente. Farebbe bene ad ascoltare chi il posto lo conosce, soprattutto in luoghi pericolosi come questo."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"If you care about safety, then I could make a donation to the System Safety Foundation on your behalf. 200,000 credits really goes a long way around here."|4125|0
units.english: "If you care about safety, then I could make a donation to the System Safety Foundation on your behalf. 200,000 credits really goes a long way around here."
units.italian: "Se le sta a cuore la sicurezza, potrei fare una donazione a suo nome alla Fondazione per la Sicurezza del Sistema. 200.000 crediti qui servono davvero a molto."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Pay 200,000 credits.)|4127|0
units.english: (Pay 200,000 credits.)
units.italian: (Paga 200.000 crediti.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"How can I be sure the money is spent well?"|4129|0
units.english: "How can I be sure the money is spent well?"
units.italian: "Come faccio a essere sicuro che i soldi siano spesi bene?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Sorry, I already made a donation to the 'Security Support Fund' earlier today, and I don't donate twice in one day."|4130|0
units.english: "Sorry, I already made a donation to the 'Security Support Fund' earlier today, and I don't donate twice in one day."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ho già fatto una donazione al 'Fondo di Sostegno alla Sicurezza' stamattina, e non faccio donazioni due volte al giorno."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"I've already heard enough, I'm going to talk to the authorities."|4131|0
units.english: "I've already heard enough, I'm going to talk to the authorities."
units.italian: "Ne ho sentite abbastanza, vado a parlare con le autorità."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"And what dangers should I be afraid of?"|4133|0
units.english: "And what dangers should I be afraid of?"
units.italian: "E di quali pericoli dovrei aver paura?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Listen, I see that you're missing a finger on each hand. You look like a goon, and not a very successful one."|4134|0
units.english: "Listen, I see that you're missing a finger on each hand. You look like a goon, and not a very successful one."
units.italian: "Senta, vedo che le manca un dito su ciascuna mano. Sembra uno scagnozzo, e nemmeno uno di grande successo."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	The man sounds annoyed. "Listen, I don't have all day to talk! Are you going to pay or not?!"|4136|0
units.english: The man sounds annoyed. "Listen, I don't have all day to talk! Are you going to pay or not?!"
units.italian: L'uomo sembra infastidito. "Senta, non ho tutto il giorno per parlare! Paga o no?!"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Pay 200,000 credits.)|4138|0
units.english: (Pay 200,000 credits.)
units.italian: (Paga 200.000 crediti.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"I don't trust you. You aren't getting any money from me."|4140|0
units.english: "I don't trust you. You aren't getting any money from me."
units.italian: "Non mi fido di lei. Da me non avrà un credito."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"I've heard enough, I'm going to talk to the authorities."|4141|0
units.english: "I've heard enough, I'm going to talk to the authorities."
units.italian: "Basta così, vado a parlare con le autorità."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Listen, I see that you're missing a finger on each hand. You look like a goon, and not a very successful one."|4143|0
units.english: "Listen, I see that you're missing a finger on each hand. You look like a goon, and not a very successful one."
units.italian: "Senta, vedo che le manca un dito su ciascuna mano. Sembra uno scagnozzo, e nemmeno uno di grande successo."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	The man responds "Your funeral, not mine," and turns away from you.|4146|0
units.english: The man responds "Your funeral, not mine," and turns away from you.
units.italian: L'uomo risponde "Sarà il tuo funerale, non il mio," e si volta dall'altra parte.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|label|4148|0
units.english: next steps
units.italian: next steps

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Look, that's not a smart move. Most of them are in on it anyway."|4149|0
units.english: "Look, that's not a smart move. Most of them are in on it anyway."
units.italian: "Guarda, non è una mossa intelligente. Tanto sono quasi tutti d'accordo con loro."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|label|4150|0
units.english: walks away
units.italian: walks away

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	The man walks away. You consider what to do next.|4151|0
units.english: The man walks away. You consider what to do next.
units.italian: L'uomo se ne va. Valuti che cosa fare adesso.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Shrug off the whole thing and take no further action.)|4153|0
units.english: (Shrug off the whole thing and take no further action.)
units.italian: (Manda giù tutto e non fare nulla.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Find the closest thing to a police force that this planet has.)|4155|0
units.english: (Find the closest thing to a police force that this planet has.)
units.italian: (Cerca la cosa più simile a una forza di polizia che questo pianeta abbia.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Go to a bar and ask for whoever is in charge.)|4156|0
units.english: (Go to a bar and ask for whoever is in charge.)
units.italian: (Vai in un bar e chiedi di chi comanda.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	It's not long before you find the ruins of what used to be a police station... you think. The building has been thoroughly destroyed, hopefully not while anybody was inside.|4158|0
units.english: It's not long before you find the ruins of what used to be a police station... you think. The building has been thoroughly destroyed, hopefully not while anybody was inside.
units.italian: Non ci vuole molto per trovare i ruderi di quella che doveva essere una stazione di polizia... credi. L'edificio è stato distrutto a fondo, speriamo non mentre c'era qualcuno dentro.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Go to a bar and ask for whoever is in charge.)|4160|0
units.english: (Go to a bar and ask for whoever is in charge.)
units.italian: (Vai in un bar e chiedi di chi comanda.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Shrug off the whole thing and take no further action.)|4161|0
units.english: (Shrug off the whole thing and take no further action.)
units.italian: (Manda giù tutto e non fare nulla.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	You walk towards the closest bar, but stumble into the green-haired man that you just had a conversation with.|4164|0
units.english: You walk towards the closest bar, but stumble into the green-haired man that you just had a conversation with.
units.italian: Ti incammini verso il bar più vicino, ma vai a sbattere contro l'uomo dai capelli verdi con cui hai appena parlato.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	He looks surprised and asks, "Were you going to rat me out to the local boss?"|4165|0
units.english: He looks surprised and asks, "Were you going to rat me out to the local boss?"
units.italian: Sembra sorpreso e chiede: "Stavi andando a denunciarmi al capo locale?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"What an excellent idea! Yes, I'll just do that."|4167|0
units.english: "What an excellent idea! Yes, I'll just do that."
units.italian: "Che idea eccellente! Sì, farò proprio così."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"What I'm going to do is none of your business."|4168|0
units.english: "What I'm going to do is none of your business."
units.italian: "Quello che farò non sono affari tuoi."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Don't worry, I'm just taking a walk."|4169|0
units.english: "Don't worry, I'm just taking a walk."
units.italian: "Non preoccuparti, sto solo facendo due passi."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	The man is starting to act a bit nervous. "Sorry I bothered you. Can we forget this happened?"|4171|0
units.english: The man is starting to act a bit nervous. "Sorry I bothered you. Can we forget this happened?"
units.italian: L'uomo comincia a innervosirsi. "Scusa se ti ho disturbato. Possiamo dimenticare che è successo?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Well, conversations like this are hard to forget."|4173|0
units.english: "Well, conversations like this are hard to forget."
units.italian: "Beh, conversazioni così sono difficili da dimenticare."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Nice scam you have running here. Would be a shame if somebody told the local godfather about it."|4174|0
units.english: "Nice scam you have running here. Would be a shame if somebody told the local godfather about it."
units.italian: "Bella truffa che hai in piedi qui. Sarebbe un peccato se qualcuno ne parlasse al padrino locale."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Agree.)|4176|0
units.english: (Agree.)
units.italian: (D'accordo.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Well, what do you want? Do I have to do something for you?"|4179|0
units.english: "Well, what do you want? Do I have to do something for you?"
units.italian: "Beh, che cosa vuoi? Devo fare qualcosa per te?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"No, let's just forget it happened."|4181|0
units.english: "No, let's just forget it happened."
units.italian: "No, dimentichiamocene e basta."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Compensation for the time that you've wasted would be excellent."|4183|0
units.english: "Compensation for the time that you've wasted would be excellent."
units.italian: "Un risarcimento per il tempo che mi hai fatto perdere sarebbe eccellente."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	A bead of sweat travels down the man's face as he asks, "How many credits do you need to just forget this whole conversation happened?"|4185|0
units.english: A bead of sweat travels down the man's face as he asks, "How many credits do you need to just forget this whole conversation happened?"
units.italian: Una goccia di sudore scende sul viso dell'uomo mentre chiede: "Quanti crediti ti servono perché tu dimentichi tutta questa conversazione?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"100,000,000."|4187|0
mission:Mafia Extortion|	"1,000,000."|4189|0
mission:Mafia Extortion|	"200,000."|4191|0
mission:Mafia Extortion|	"50,000."|4193|0
mission:Mafia Extortion|	"5,000."|4195|0
mission:Mafia Extortion|	"2,000."|4197|0
mission:Mafia Extortion|	"1,000."|4199|0
mission:Mafia Extortion|	"I don't need your credits, just forget it."|4201|0
units.english: "I don't need your credits, just forget it."
units.italian: "Non mi servono i tuoi crediti, dimentichiamocene."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|label|4202|0
units.english: zero deal
units.italian: zero deal

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	The man walks away without saying a word.|4203|0
units.english: The man walks away without saying a word.
units.italian: L'uomo se ne va senza dire una parola.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"That's too much! 2,389 credits is all I have. Would that be enough?"|4206|0
units.english: "That's too much! 2,389 credits is all I have. Would that be enough?"
units.italian: "È troppo! Tutto quello che ho sono 2.389 crediti. Basterebbero?"

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Sure."|4208|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"No way, I want a lot more."|4209|0
units.english: "No way, I want a lot more."
units.italian: "Niente affatto, ne voglio molti di più."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|label|4211|0
units.english: counter deal
units.italian: counter deal

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	The man hands you a credit chip, nods and walks away. You pocket the chip quickly, more ready to be done with this neighborhood than you want to visibly show.|4212|0
units.english: The man hands you a credit chip, nods and walks away. You pocket the chip quickly, more ready to be done with this neighborhood than you want to visibly show.
units.italian: L'uomo ti porge un chip di credito, annuisce e se ne va. Ti metti il chip in tasca in fretta, più impaziente di levarti da questo quartiere di quanto voglia mostrare.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	A few minutes later you reach into your pocket for the chip... to find it missing. Looks like even a hardened captain like you isn't immune to being pickpocketed on a planet like this.|4213|0
units.english: A few minutes later you reach into your pocket for the chip... to find it missing. Looks like even a hardened captain like you isn't immune to being pickpocketed on a planet like this.
units.italian: Pochi minuti dopo infili la mano in tasca per prendere il chip... e non lo trovi. A quanto pare nemmeno un capitano navigato come te è immune ai borseggiatori su un pianeta come questo.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	The man starts panicking and clumsily reaches into his jacket, maybe to get some money, but more likely reaching for a gun.|4216|0
units.english: The man starts panicking and clumsily reaches into his jacket, maybe to get some money, but more likely reaching for a gun.
units.italian: L'uomo comincia a farsi prendere dal panico e fruga goffamente nella giacca, forse per prendere dei soldi, ma più probabilmente per prendere una pistola.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Try to calm down the man.)|4218|0
units.english: (Try to calm down the man.)
units.italian: (Prova a calmare l'uomo.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Mock the man further.)|4219|0
units.english: (Mock the man further.)
units.italian: (Continua a prenderlo in giro.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Draw my sidearm and shoot the man.)|4220|0
units.english: (Draw my sidearm and shoot the man.)
units.italian: (Estrai la pistola e spara all'uomo.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	The man manages to draw a weapon! You brace for impact, but after a few seconds of waiting, you realize his weapon is only making a clicking sound when he tries to shoot.|4222|0
units.english: The man manages to draw a weapon! You brace for impact, but after a few seconds of waiting, you realize his weapon is only making a clicking sound when he tries to shoot.
units.italian: L'uomo riesce a estrarre un'arma! Ti prepari all'impatto, ma dopo qualche secondo di attesa ti accorgi che la sua arma fa solo un rumore di scatto quando prova a sparare.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	"Ha, ha, you really are a failure of a goon."|4224|0
units.english: "Ha, ha, you really are a failure of a goon."
units.italian: "Ah, ah, sei davvero uno scagnozzo fallito."

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Draw my sidearm and shoot the man.)|4225|0
units.english: (Draw my sidearm and shoot the man.)
units.italian: (Estrai la pistola e spara all'uomo.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	As you finish talking, you see a flash of light come from the muzzle of the man's weapon as a bullet hits you between the eyes. You die almost instantly, but you do have a few microseconds to reflect on the wisdom of mocking a man that is trying to fire a gun at you.|4227|0
units.english: As you finish talking, you see a flash of light come from the muzzle of the man's weapon as a bullet hits you between the eyes. You die almost instantly, but you do have a few microseconds to reflect on the wisdom of mocking a man that is trying to fire a gun at you.
units.italian: Mentre finisci di parlare, vedi un lampo dalla bocca dell'arma dell'uomo e un proiettile ti colpisce in mezzo agli occhi. Muori quasi all'istante, ma hai comunque qualche microsecondo per riflettere sulla saggezza di prendere in giro un uomo che sta cercando di spararti.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	Your bullet hits the man right between the eyes; he dies instantly, and a crowd starts to form around you.|4230|0
units.english: Your bullet hits the man right between the eyes; he dies instantly, and a crowd starts to form around you.
units.italian: Il tuo proiettile colpisce l'uomo proprio in mezzo agli occhi; muore all'istante e intorno a te comincia a radunarsi una folla.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	Most bystanders are surprised, but you also notice an angry sentiment brewing in the (not unarmed) crowd. It might be wise to leave quickly.|4231|0
units.english: Most bystanders are surprised, but you also notice an angry sentiment brewing in the (not unarmed) crowd. It might be wise to leave quickly.
units.italian: La maggior parte dei presenti è sorpresa, ma noti anche un sentimento di rabbia serpeggiare nella folla (non disarmata). Potrebbe essere saggio andarsene in fretta.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Run towards my ship and leave immediately.)|4233|0
units.english: (Run towards my ship and leave immediately.)
units.italian: (Corri verso la mia nave e parti subito.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	(Put away my sidearm and pretend nothing happened.)|4235|0
units.english: (Put away my sidearm and pretend nothing happened.)
units.italian: (Rimetti via la pistola e fai finta che non sia successo nulla.)

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	You walk away nonchalantly, but you don't get far before multiple laser blasts slice through you.|4236|0
units.english: You walk away nonchalantly, but you don't get far before multiple laser blasts slice through you.
units.italian: Ti allontani con noncuranza, ma non vai lontano prima che più colpi di laser ti trapassino.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	You make it to your ship alive and depart under a rain of bullets and laser-weapons fire. This is a pirate planet so there are unlikely to be any lasting consequences, but you might want to stay away for a few days.|4239|0
units.english: You make it to your ship alive and depart under a rain of bullets and laser-weapons fire. This is a pirate planet so there are unlikely to be any lasting consequences, but you might want to stay away for a few days.
units.italian: Riesci a raggiungere la nave vivo e a partire sotto una pioggia di proiettili e colpi di arma laser. Questo è un pianeta pirata, quindi è improbabile che ci siano conseguenze durature, ma forse è meglio stare alla larga per qualche giorno.

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|label|4241|0
units.english: pay up
units.italian: pay up

units.id: mission:Mafia Extortion|	The man takes your credits, responds with a brief "Thank you," and walks away.|4242|0
units.english: The man takes your credits, responds with a brief "Thank you," and walks away.
units.italian: L'uomo prende i tuoi crediti, risponde con un breve "Grazie," e se ne va.

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|You see a small crowd beginning to gather on a street corner. A man in a flamboyant striped suit and matching hat calls, "Come here! Come here! Come see the marvelous magician Mistress Marionette corral the crowded crossroads with her extravagant schemes!"|4258|0
units.english: You see a small crowd beginning to gather on a street corner. A man in a flamboyant striped suit and matching hat calls, "Come here! Come here! Come see the marvelous magician Mistress Marionette corral the crowded crossroads with her extravagant schemes!"
units.italian: Vedi una piccola folla che comincia a radunarsi all'angolo di una strada. Un uomo in un vistoso abito a righe, con un cappello intonato, grida: "Venite qui! Venite qui! Venite a vedere la meravigliosa maga Mistress Marionette domare il crocevia affollato con i suoi stravaganti giochi!"

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	(Check it out.)|4260|0
units.english: (Check it out.)
units.italian: (Guarda di che si tratta.)

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	(Ignore it.)|4262|0
units.english: (Ignore it.)
units.italian: (Ignala.)

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	You join them. A woman in similarly fancy garb sits behind a table, swiftly shuffling three cups before a hulking man. The announcer continues, "For our new guests, the chosen challenger's chance approaches! The current buy-in bet was 7000 credits; yes, we play with the big money here! Double or nothing, bet your bet: are you a player or a puppet?"|4265|0
units.english: You join them. A woman in similarly fancy garb sits behind a table, swiftly shuffling three cups before a hulking man. The announcer continues, "For our new guests, the chosen challenger's chance approaches! The current buy-in bet was 7000 credits; yes, we play with the big money here! Double or nothing, bet your bet: are you a player or a puppet?"
units.italian: Ti unisci a loro. Una donna in abiti altrettanto vistosi siede dietro un tavolo e mescola rapidamente tre tazze davanti a un uomo massiccio. L'annunciatore continua: "Per i nostri nuovi ospiti, si avvicina la possibilità per lo sfidante prescelto! La puntata in corso è di 7.000 crediti; sì, qui si gioca con i soldi veri! Doppio o niente, punta la tua puntata: sei un giocatore o un burattino?"

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	The cups stop. After a brief pause, the man points to the cup on the right.|4266|0
units.english: The cups stop. After a brief pause, the man points to the cup on the right.
units.italian: Le tazze si fermano. Dopo una breve pausa, l'uomo indica la tazza a destra.

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	(Watch what happens.)|4268|0
units.english: (Watch what happens.)
units.italian: (Guarda che cosa succede.)

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"You know these things are scams, right?"|4270|0
units.english: "You know these things are scams, right?"
units.italian: "Lo sai che queste cose sono truffe, vero?"

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	You try to warn him, but someone in the crowd shushes you. He doesn't hear.|4271|0
units.english: You try to warn him, but someone in the crowd shushes you. He doesn't hear.
units.italian: Provi ad avvertirlo, ma qualcuno nella folla ti zittisce. Lui non sente.

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Are you certain in your choice?" the magician asks. "Once you-"|4274|0
units.english: "Are you certain in your choice?" the magician asks. "Once you-"
units.italian: "Sei sicuro della tua scelta?" chiede la maga. "Una volta che..."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Yes, I'm certain," the man interrupts. He draws 7000 credits and tosses them on the table. The magician lifts the cup, and a small red ball rolls from beneath. "And the first challenger proves to be a player!" the announcer says, mustering enthusiasm as the magician counts 14,000 credits to pay the man. "Let us find a new challenger! The next buy-in is a mere 400 credits; if you haven't played before, now's the time to test your skill!"|4275|0
units.english: "Yes, I'm certain," the man interrupts. He draws 7000 credits and tosses them on the table. The magician lifts the cup, and a small red ball rolls from beneath. "And the first challenger proves to be a player!" the announcer says, mustering enthusiasm as the magician counts 14,000 credits to pay the man. "Let us find a new challenger! The next buy-in is a mere 400 credits; if you haven't played before, now's the time to test your skill!"
units.italian: "Sì, ne sono certo," la interrompe l'uomo. Tira fuori 7.000 crediti e li getta sul tavolo. La maga solleva la tazza, e da sotto rotola una pallina rossa. "E il primo sfidante si dimostra un giocatore!" dice l'annunciatore, raccogliendo entusiasmo mentre la maga conta 14.000 crediti per pagare l'uomo. "Troviamo un nuovo sfidante! La prossima puntata è di soli 400 crediti; se non hai mai giocato, è il momento di mettere alla prova la tua abilità!"

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"I'd like to give it a try." (Bet 400 credits.)|4277|0
units.english: "I'd like to give it a try." (Bet 400 credits.)
units.italian: "Vorrei provarci." (Punta 400 crediti.)

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	(Wait and watch.)|4279|0
units.english: (Wait and watch.)
units.italian: (Aspetta e guarda.)

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	(Walk away.)|4281|0
units.english: (Walk away.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|label|4283|0
units.english: first game watch
units.italian: first game watch

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	A short woman volunteers. The game progresses in a similar manner; by the end, you are certain the ball is underneath the center cup. Sure enough, the woman chooses that cup, and she walks away 400 credits richer.|4284|0
units.english: A short woman volunteers. The game progresses in a similar manner; by the end, you are certain the ball is underneath the center cup. Sure enough, the woman chooses that cup, and she walks away 400 credits richer.
units.italian: Una donna bassa si offre volontaria. La partita procede in modo simile; alla fine sei certo che la pallina sia sotto la tazza centrale. E infatti la donna sceglie quella tazza, e se ne va con 400 crediti in più.

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"The next buy-in is a larger prize!" the announcer calls after her before turning to address the crowd. "Six thousand credits, only for the proudest of players." The magician shakes her head softly, frowning at the cups.|4285|0
units.english: "The next buy-in is a larger prize!" the announcer calls after her before turning to address the crowd. "Six thousand credits, only for the proudest of players." The magician shakes her head softly, frowning at the cups.
units.italian: "La prossima puntata è un premio più grande!" grida l'annunciatore dietro di lei, prima di rivolgersi alla folla. "Seimila crediti, solo per i giocatori più orgogliosi." La maga scuote piano la testa, accigliata verso le tazze.

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"I'll do it!" (Bet 6000 credits.)|4287|0
units.english: "I'll do it!" (Bet 6000 credits.)
units.italian: "Ci sto!" (Punta 6.000 crediti.)

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	(Continue watching.)|4289|0
units.english: (Continue watching.)
units.italian: (Continua a guardare.)

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	(Walk away.)|4291|0
units.english: (Walk away.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|label|4293|0
units.english: first game play
units.italian: first game play

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	You pay 400 credits and sit across from the magician. "Double or nothing, bet your bet!" the announcer repeats. "Are you a player or a puppet?"|4294|0
units.english: You pay 400 credits and sit across from the magician. "Double or nothing, bet your bet!" the announcer repeats. "Are you a player or a puppet?"
units.italian: Paghi 400 crediti e ti siedi di fronte alla maga. "Doppio o niente, punta la tua puntata!" ripete l'annunciatore. "Sei un giocatore o un burattino?"

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	The magician places the ball beneath the center and begins moving the cups. This one seems faster, but that might just be from the pressure. units.english: The magician places the ball beneath the center and begins moving the cups. This one seems faster, but that might just be from the pressure. You keep your eyes trained on the cup as it shifts back and forth, around in circles, and occasionally remains untouched. By the end, you're pretty sure it's in the center cup.
units.italian: La maga mette la pallina sotto la tazza centrale e comincia a muovere le tazze. Questa sembra più veloce, ma forse è solo la tensione. Tieni gli occhi fissi sulla tazza mentre si sposta avanti e indietro, gira in cerchio e ogni tanto resta ferma. Alla fine sei abbastanza sicuro che sia nella tazza centrale.

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"What's your choice?" the magician asks, smirking.|4296|0
units.english: "What's your choice?" the magician asks, smirking.
units.italian: "Qual è la tua scelta?" chiede la maga, con un sorriso sfrontato.

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Left."|4298|0
units.english: "Left."
units.italian: "Sinistra."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Center."|4300|0
units.english: "Center."
units.italian: "Centro."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Right."|4302|0
units.english: "Right."
units.italian: "Destra."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Better luck next time," she says as she reveals your incorrect choice. The ball was in the center; you feel silly for not going with your gut.|4305|0
units.english: "Better luck next time," she says as she reveals your incorrect choice. The ball was in the center; you feel silly for not going with your gut.
units.italian: "Meglio la prossima volta," dice scoprendo la tua scelta sbagliata. La pallina era al centro; ti senti sciocco per non aver seguito l'istinto.

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"The next buy-in is a larger prize!" the announcer calls. "Six thousand credits, reserved for the most daring. As the previous player, you have first priority."|4306|0
units.english: "The next buy-in is a larger prize!" the announcer calls. "Six thousand credits, reserved for the most daring. As the previous player, you have first priority."
units.italian: "La prossima puntata è un premio più grande!" annuncia l'annunciatore. "Seimila crediti, riservati ai più audaci. Come giocatore precedente, hai la precedenza."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Let's go again."|4310|0
units.english: "Let's go again."
units.italian: "Facciamo un'altra partita."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"I think I'm done."|4312|0
units.english: "I think I'm done."
units.italian: "Credo di aver finito."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	She asks if you're sure, and you stick with your gut. With a grimace, she lifts the cup to reveal the ball and counts out your winnings. As the previous player, you have first priority."|4315|0
units.english: She asks if you're sure, and you stick with your gut. With a grimace, she lifts the cup to reveal the ball and counts out your winnings. "And the player prevails!" the announcer says. "Earning a small bounty. But wait: the next buy-in is bigger yet! Six thousand credits, reserved for the most daring. As the previous player, you have first priority."
units.italian: Ti chiede se sei sicuro, e tu segui l'istinto. Con una smorfia solleva la tazza per rivelare la pallina e conta le tue vincite. "E il giocatore vince!" dice l'annunciatore. "Guadagnando una piccola fortuna. Ma aspettate: la prossima puntata è ancora più grande! Seimila crediti, riservati ai più audaci. Come giocatore precedente, hai la precedenza."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Let's go again."|4319|0
units.english: "Let's go again."
units.italian: "Facciamo un'altra partita."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"I think I'm done."|4321|0
units.english: "I think I'm done."
units.italian: "Credo di aver finito."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|label|4323|0
units.english: second game play
units.italian: second game play

units.english: You place your 6000 credit bet on the table, and the game begins. The pattern is slightly longer, but once the magician's hands stop, you feel like the ball lies beneath the left cup.
units.italian: Metti sul tavolo la puntata di 6.000 crediti e la partita comincia. Lo schema è un po' più lungo, ma quando le mani della maga si fermano ti sembra che la pallina sia sotto la tazza di sinistra.

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Left."|4326|0
units.english: "Left."
units.italian: "Sinistra."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Center."|4328|0
units.english: "Center."
units.italian: "Centro."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Right."|4330|0
units.english: "Right."
units.italian: "Destra."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	With a grin, she reveals the left cup, and it's... wrong! "Nice try," she says, pocketing your money. "It is a bit tricky."|4335|0
units.english: With a grin, she reveals the left cup, and it's... wrong! "Nice try," she says, pocketing your money. "It is a bit tricky."
units.italian: Con un sorriso scopre la tazza di sinistra, ed è... sbagliata! "Bel tentativo," dice, intascando i tuoi soldi. "È un po' difficile, in effetti."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Well, that's all for today, folks!" the announcer says as you realize you've been conned. Worse still, after they pack up and leave, you notice that the first winner walks away beside them.|4336|0
units.english: "Well, that's all for today, folks!" the announcer says as you realize you've been conned. Worse still, after they pack up and leave, you notice that the first winner walks away beside them.
units.italian: "Bene, per oggi è tutto, gente!" dice l'annunciatore mentre ti rendi conto di essere stato truffato. Peggio ancora: dopo che hanno fatto i bagagli e se ne sono andati, noti che il primo vincitore se ne va al loro fianco.

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	With a raised eyebrow, she reveals the center cup. It's... wrong! "Nice try," she says, pocketing your money. "That one was a bit tricky."|4341|0
units.english: With a raised eyebrow, she reveals the center cup. It's... wrong! "Nice try," she says, pocketing your money. "That one was a bit tricky."
units.italian: Con un sopracciglio alzato scopre la tazza centrale. È... sbagliata! "Bel tentativo," dice, intascando i tuoi soldi. "Quella era un po' difficile."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Well, that's all for today, folks!" the announcer says. As they pack up and leave, you notice that the first winner walks away beside them.|4342|0
units.english: "Well, that's all for today, folks!" the announcer says. As they pack up and leave, you notice that the first winner walks away beside them.
units.italian: "Bene, per oggi è tutto, gente!" dice l'annunciatore. Mentre fanno i bagagli e se ne vanno, noti che il primo vincitore se ne va al loro fianco.

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	With a raised eyebrow, she reveals the right cup. It's... wrong! "Nice try," she says, pocketing your money. "That one was a bit tricky."|4347|0
units.english: With a raised eyebrow, she reveals the right cup. It's... wrong! "Nice try," she says, pocketing your money. "That one was a bit tricky."
units.italian: Con un sopracciglio alzato scopre la tazza di destra. È... sbagliata! "Bel tentativo," dice, intascando i tuoi soldi. "Quella era un po' difficile."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Well, that's all for today, folks!" the announcer says. As they pack up and leave, you notice that the first winner walks away beside them.|4348|0
units.english: "Well, that's all for today, folks!" the announcer says. As they pack up and leave, you notice that the first winner walks away beside them.
units.italian: "Bene, per oggi è tutto, gente!" dice l'annunciatore. Mentre fanno i bagagli e se ne vanno, noti che il primo vincitore se ne va al loro fianco.

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|label|4350|0
units.english: second game watch
units.italian: second game watch

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	Sensing that something's up, you decide to watch the next game. A sprightly young fellow confidently hands over 6000 credits; when the cups stop, you feel like the ball is under the left one. The boy points to it; with a grin, the magician reveals the left cup, and it's... wrong! "Nice try," she says, pocketing the shocked boy's money. "It is a bit tricky."|4351|0
units.english: Sensing that something's up, you decide to watch the next game. A sprightly young fellow confidently hands over 6000 credits; when the cups stop, you feel like the ball is under the left one. The boy points to it; with a grin, the magician reveals the left cup, and it's... wrong! "Nice try," she says, pocketing the shocked boy's money. "It is a bit tricky."
units.italian: Intuendo che c'è qualcosa sotto, decidi di guardare la partita successiva. Un ragazzo vivace consegna con sicurezza 6.000 crediti; quando le tazze si fermano, ti sembra che la pallina sia sotto quella di sinistra. Il ragazzo la indica; con un sorriso la maga scopre la tazza di sinistra, ed è... sbagliata! "Bel tentativo," dice, intascando i soldi del ragazzo sconvolto. "È un po' difficile."

units.id: mission:Street Swindle|	"Well, that's all for today, folks!" the announcer says. You're glad you avoided the con. As they pack up and leave, you notice that the first winner walks away beside them.|4352|0
units.english: "Well, that's all for today, folks!" the announcer says. You're glad you avoided the con. As they pack up and leave, you notice that the first winner walks away beside them.
units.italian: "Bene, per oggi è tutto, gente!" dice l'annunciatore. Sei contento di aver evitato la truffa. Mentre fanno i bagagli e se ne vanno, noti che il primo vincitore se ne va al loro fianco.

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|name|4358|0
units.english: <origin> Emigration
units.italian: Emigrazione da <origin>

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|description|4359|0
units.english: Transport a family from <origin> to <destination>, where they hope to find better employment. They cannot pay you.
units.italian: Trasporta una famiglia da <origin> a <destination>, dove sperano di trovare un lavoro migliore. Non possono pagarti.

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|By the edge of the spaceport at night, you see a thin, sweaty man turn away from a pilot, disheartened. You make eye contact, and he begins hurrying over to you.|4368|0
units.english: By the edge of the spaceport at night, you see a thin, sweaty man turn away from a pilot, disheartened. You make eye contact, and he begins hurrying over to you.
units.italian: Di notte, sul bordo dello spazioporto, vedi un uomo magro e sudato allontanarsi scoraggiato da un pilota. Incroci il suo sguardo, e lui comincia a venirti incontro in fretta.

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	(Wait for him.)|4370|0
units.english: (Wait for him.)
units.italian: (Aspettalo.)

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	(Walk away quickly.)|4371|0
units.english: (Walk away quickly.)
units.italian: (Allontanati in fretta.)

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	"Excuse me! Are you a pilot?" Without waiting for a response, he continues, "I need to go to the Syndicate. I work all day picking cotton with these hands, but my family's still starving. We can't afford transport..."|4373|0
units.english: "Excuse me! Are you a pilot?" Without waiting for a response, he continues, "I need to go to the Syndicate. I work all day picking cotton with these hands, but my family's still starving. We can't afford transport..."
units.italian: "Mi scusi! Lei è un pilota?" Senza aspettare risposta, continua: "Devo andare nel Sindacato. Lavoro tutto il giorno a raccogliere cotone con queste mani, ma la mia famiglia muore ancora di fame. Non possiamo permetterci il trasporto..."

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	You can barely understand him through his accent. The man's teeth look worse than his clothes, and his breath makes you step back. His eyes implore you.|4374|0
units.english: You can barely understand him through his accent. The man's teeth look worse than his clothes, and his breath makes you step back. His eyes implore you.
units.italian: Riesci a malapena a capirlo per via dell'accento. I denti dell'uomo sembrano messi peggio dei vestiti, e il suo alito ti fa fare un passo indietro. I suoi occhi ti supplicano.

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	"I might be able to help you. What planet do you need to reach?"|4376|0
units.english: "I might be able to help you. What planet do you need to reach?"
units.italian: "Potrei riuscire ad aiutarti. Quale pianeta devi raggiungere?"

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	"I'm sorry, I only transport for pay."|4377|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, I only transport for pay."
units.italian: "Spiacente, trasporto solo a pagamento."

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	His eyes brighten with hope. "Oh! I, I heard some people are going to <planet> to be miners. They hire folk like us. I, if you could get me, and my wife and our two sons there, I'd praise you to the high stars. You'd save our lives."|4379|0
units.english: His eyes brighten with hope. "Oh! I, I heard some people are going to <planet> to be miners. They hire folk like us. I, if you could get me, and my wife and our two sons there, I'd praise you to the high stars. You'd save our lives."
units.italian: Gli occhi gli si illuminano di speranza. "Oh! Ho, ho sentito che alcuni vanno su <planet> a fare i minatori. Assumono gente come noi. Se, se potessi portarci là, me, mia moglie e i nostri due figli, ti loderei fino alle stelle. Ci salveresti la vita."

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	"I can take you, but no more."|4381|0
units.english: "I can take you, but no more."
units.italian: "Posso portarvi, ma non di più."

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	"I'd be happy to offer you four transport."|4383|0
units.english: "I'd be happy to offer you four transport."
units.italian: "Sarei felice di offrirvi il trasporto per quattro."

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	"Sorry, I think this won't work out."|4385|0
units.english: "Sorry, I think this won't work out."
units.italian: "Spiacente, credo che non si possa fare."

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	"The two little ones are really small," he persists. "We can cramp together. You'll just notice two of us. I mean, some go themselves and send money back, but..."|4388|0
units.english: "The two little ones are really small," he persists. "We can cramp together. You'll just notice two of us. I mean, some go themselves and send money back, but..."
units.italian: "I due piccoli sono davvero piccoli," insiste. "Possiamo stare stretti. Ti accorgerai solo di due di noi. Cioè, alcuni vanno da soli e mandano i soldi, ma..."

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	He shakes his head. "My wife's already told me we need to stay together, and I agree. I can't leave. Please, nobody else has said yes."|4389|0
units.english: He shakes his head. "My wife's already told me we need to stay together, and I agree. I can't leave. Please, nobody else has said yes."
units.italian: Scuote la testa. "Mia moglie mi ha già detto che dobbiamo restare insieme, e sono d'accordo. Non posso partire. Ti prego, nessun altro ha detto sì."

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	"I guess I can find room."|4391|0
units.english: "I guess I can find room."
units.italian: "Immagino di poter trovare spazio."

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	"Sorry, but that's still too many. Have a nice day."|4393|0
units.english: "Sorry, but that's still too many. Have a nice day."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma sono comunque troppi. Buona giornata."

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	"Oh, thank you, thank you!" he says, vigorously shaking your hand. "I'll get them fast, we can leave tonight! I'm Gaint, by the way." He quickly leaves to get them, turning back at least three times to tip his hat to you and make sure you haven't left.|4396|0
units.english: "Oh, thank you, thank you!" he says, vigorously shaking your hand. "I'll get them fast, we can leave tonight! I'm Gaint, by the way." He quickly leaves to get them, turning back at least three times to tip his hat to you and make sure you haven't left.
units.italian: "Oh, grazie, grazie!" dice, stringendoti vigorosamente la mano. "Li prendo subito, possiamo partire stanotte! Comunque, io sono Gaint." Se ne va in fretta a prenderli, voltandosi almeno tre volte a salutarti toccandosi il cappello e ad assicurarsi che tu non sia andato via.

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	Gaint's family arrives quickly. His wife, Mell, is carrying their infant child, and a toddler clutches her leg. His fingers look like a skeleton, and his eyes look like his dad's. "Thank you so much," Mell says as they enter your ship.|4397|0
units.english: Gaint's family arrives quickly. His wife, Mell, is carrying their infant child, and a toddler clutches her leg. His fingers look like a skeleton, and his eyes look like his dad's. "Thank you so much," Mell says as they enter your ship.
units.italian: La famiglia di Gaint arriva in fretta. Sua moglie, Mell, porta in braccio il loro bambino, e un bimbo più grandicello le si aggrappa alla gamba. Le dita di lui sembrano uno scheletro, e i suoi occhi sono come quelli del padre. "Grazie mille," dice Mell mentre entrano nella nave.

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	You fend off a few more pleas before he understands it's hopeless and begins looking for someone else.|4400|0
units.english: You fend off a few more pleas before he understands it's hopeless and begins looking for someone else.
units.italian: Respingi altre suppliche prima che capisca che è inutile e cominci a cercare qualcun altro.

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	As your ship enters <planet>'s cavernous spaceport, you can sense a mixture of hope and apprehension in Gaint and Mell. "Andrin talks too much," you overhear Gaint saying. "I didn't know it's all underground."|4408|0
units.english: As your ship enters <planet>'s cavernous spaceport, you can sense a mixture of hope and apprehension in Gaint and Mell. "Andrin talks too much," you overhear Gaint saying. "I didn't know it's all underground."
units.italian: Mentre la nave entra nello spazioporto cavernoso di <planet>, percepisci un misto di speranza e timore in Gaint e Mell. "Andrin parla troppo," senti dire da Gaint. "Non sapevo che fosse tutto sottoterra."

units.id: mission:Thrall Emigration|	"We'll figure it out," Mell assures him. When they notice you're listening in, the conversation stops. Your ship lands, and the family collects their things to leave. They thank you again on their way out.|4409|0
units.english: "We'll figure it out," Mell assures him. When they notice you're listening in, the conversation stops. Your ship lands, and the family collects their things to leave. They thank you again on their way out.
units.italian: "Ce la caveremo," lo rassicura Mell. Quando si accorgono che stai ascoltando, la conversazione si interrompe. La nave atterra, e la famiglia raccoglie le sue cose per uscire. Ti ringraziano di nuovo mentre escono.

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|As soon as you touch down on <origin>, you step off your ship and head directly for the job board and trade hub, brushing past several locals on the way. The constant routine of interstellar commerce has been firmly drilled into your brain; you near unconsciously peruse the boards, trying to suss out the most profitable route.|4445|0
units.english: As soon as you touch down on <origin>, you step off your ship and head directly for the job board and trade hub, brushing past several locals on the way. The constant routine of interstellar commerce has been firmly drilled into your brain; you near unconsciously peruse the boards, trying to suss out the most profitable route.
units.italian: Appena tocchi terra su <origin>, scendi dalla nave e vai dritto alla bacheca delle offerte di lavoro e al centro commerciale, sfiorando diversi abitanti lungo il percorso. La routine costante del commercio interstellare ti è stata scolpita in testa; quasi inconsciamente scorri le bacheche, cercando di individuare la rotta più redditizia.

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	You're caught off guard when you hear a voice behind you. "Hey, what's with all the rush, Captain?" You turn and see a dark-haired man in a faded green longcoat approaching you. "You seem awfully focused on getting off-world as soon as possible. Why not take a moment to look around? Admire the sights, try the local cuisine, maybe even talk to some of the people."|4446|0
units.english: You're caught off guard when you hear a voice behind you. "Hey, what's with all the rush, Captain?" You turn and see a dark-haired man in a faded green longcoat approaching you. "You seem awfully focused on getting off-world as soon as possible. Why not take a moment to look around? Admire the sights, try the local cuisine, maybe even talk to some of the people."
units.italian: Sei colto alla sprovvista quando senti una voce alle tue spalle. "Ehi, che fretta c'è, Capitano?" Ti volti e vedi un uomo dai capelli scuri in un logoro cappotto verde che ti si avvicina. "Sembri terribilmente concentrato ad andartene dal pianeta il prima possibile. Perché non prenderti un momento per guardarti intorno? Ammira i panorami, assaggia la cucina locale, magari parla con un po' di gente."

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	"Why should I do that?"|4448|0
units.english: "Why should I do that?"
units.italian: "Perché dovrei?"

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	"I'm a spaceship captain; I don't have time to waste."|4449|0
units.english: "I'm a spaceship captain; I don't have time to waste."
units.italian: "Sono un capitano di nave spaziale, non ho tempo da perdere."

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	"Yes, I know already. I'll take my time later."|4450|0
units.english: "Yes, I know already. I'll take my time later."
units.italian: "Sì, lo so già. Me la prenderò comoda più tardi."

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	He tilts his head to the side. "You know, I'm a captain too. I know how quickly the luster of the galaxy can fade into the weekly grind if you wait for opportunity to come knocking. So why keep waiting? I'm sure you'll find something new to do in the spaceport."|4452|0
units.english: He tilts his head to the side. "You know, I'm a captain too. I know how quickly the luster of the galaxy can fade into the weekly grind if you wait for opportunity to come knocking. So why keep waiting? I'm sure you'll find something new to do in the spaceport."
units.italian: Inclina la testa di lato. "Sai, anch'io sono un capitano. So quanto in fretta lo splendore della galassia possa trasformarsi nella solita routine settimanale se aspetti che l'occasione bussi alla porta. Allora perché continuare ad aspettare? Sono certo che troverai qualcosa di nuovo da fare nello spazioporto."

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	"I'll be sure to check more spaceports in the future."|4454|0
units.english: "I'll be sure to check more spaceports in the future."
units.italian: "Sarò sicuro di controllare più spazioporti in futuro."

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	"Nothing interesting happened the last time I checked a spaceport."|4456|0
units.english: "Nothing interesting happened the last time I checked a spaceport."
units.italian: "L'ultima volta che ho controllato uno spazioporto non è successo niente di interessante."

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	"Why should I listen to you? I can handle myself, thank you very much."|4457|0
units.english: "Why should I listen to you? I can handle myself, thank you very much."
units.italian: "Perché dovrei ascoltarti? So badare a me stesso, grazie mille."

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	The captain sighs. "Yeah, it can feel a little pointless running up against the same loud-mouthed people all the time. But just because a spaceport doesn't have anything to offer one day doesn't mean that it'll never have anything worthwhile. Wait a while, and there might be something new."|4459|0
units.english: The captain sighs. "Yeah, it can feel a little pointless running up against the same loud-mouthed people all the time. But just because a spaceport doesn't have anything to offer one day doesn't mean that it'll never have anything worthwhile. Wait a while, and there might be something new."
units.italian: Il capitano sospira. "Sì, può sembrare un po' inutile scontrarsi sempre con le stesse persone dalla bocca larga. Ma il fatto che uno spazioporto non abbia niente da offrire un giorno non significa che non avrà mai nulla che valga la pena. Aspetta un po', e potrebbe esserci qualcosa di nuovo."

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	"Alright, I'll try to check more spaceports."|4461|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll try to check more spaceports."
units.italian: "Va bene, cercherò di controllare più spazioporti."

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	"And why should I believe you over my own experiences?"|4463|0
units.english: "And why should I believe you over my own experiences?"
units.italian: "E perché dovrei credere a te più che alle mie esperienze?"

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	He raises his hand and holds it open on his chest. "I know that it's only my word against yours, but I promise that you won't regret checking the spaceport every time you're in town."|4465|0
units.english: He raises his hand and holds it open on his chest. "I know that it's only my word against yours, but I promise that you won't regret checking the spaceport every time you're in town."
units.italian: Alza una mano e la tiene aperta sul petto. "So che è solo la mia parola contro la tua, ma ti prometto che non ti pentirai di controllare lo spazioporto ogni volta che sei in città."

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	"Fine, I'll follow your advice."|4467|0
units.english: "Fine, I'll follow your advice."
units.italian: "Va bene, seguirò il tuo consiglio."

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	"I don't need your help."|4469|0
units.english: "I don't need your help."
units.italian: "Non mi serve il tuo aiuto."

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	A frown creeps onto the captain's face as he earnestly says, "Well, I'm sorry that my advice wasn't helpful. Good luck, Captain." He walks off, leaving you alone at the job board.|4470|0
units.english: A frown creeps onto the captain's face as he earnestly says, "Well, I'm sorry that my advice wasn't helpful. Good luck, Captain." He walks off, leaving you alone at the job board.
units.italian: Un cipiglio si fa strada sul viso del capitano mentre dice con sincerità: "Beh, mi dispiace che il mio consiglio non sia stato utile. Buona fortuna, Capitano." Se ne va, lasciandoti solo alla bacheca delle offerte.

units.id: mission:Spaceport Reminder|	He pleasantly smiles and nods. "Well, I wish you the best in your travels." He walks away, leaving you free to explore the rest of <origin>'s facilities.|4473|0
units.english: He pleasantly smiles and nods. "Well, I wish you the best in your travels." He walks away, leaving you free to explore the rest of <origin>'s facilities.
units.italian: Sorride piacevolmente e annuisce. "Beh, ti auguro il meglio nei tuoi viaggi." Se ne va, lasciandoti libero di esplorare il resto delle strutture di <origin>.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|name|4493|0
units.english: Transport to <planet>
units.italian: Trasporto su <planet>

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|description|4494|0
units.english: Bring a young woman who threatened you on <origin> to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta su <destination> una giovane donna che ti ha minacciato su <origin>.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|Your exploration of the spaceport leads you to a dark alley where the number of working lights are far outnumbered by the number of broken ones. The contents of steel bins lining the walls overflow onto the pavement, attracting swarms of flies to them. On the surfaces that are illuminated, you can see a mess of black scrawlings upon bare, cracked concrete, and the few windows present on the towering walls surrounding you are either boarded up or shattered. A dark crimson stains the bottom half of a broken window.|4505|0
units.english: Your exploration of the spaceport leads you to a dark alley where the number of working lights are far outnumbered by the number of broken ones. The contents of steel bins lining the walls overflow onto the pavement, attracting swarms of flies to them. On the surfaces that are illuminated, you can see a mess of black scrawlings upon bare, cracked concrete, and the few windows present on the towering walls surrounding you are either boarded up or shattered. A dark crimson stains the bottom half of a broken window.
units.italian: La tua esplorazione dello spazioporto ti porta in un vicolo buio dove le luci funzionanti sono molto meno numerose di quelle rotte. Il contenuto dei bidoni d'acciaio lungo le pareti trabocca sul marciapiede, attirando nugoli di mosche. Sulle superfici illuminate vedi un guazzabuglio di scarabocchi neri su cemento nudo e crepato, e le poche finestre presenti sulle alte pareti che ti circondano sono o murate o in frantumi. Un cremisi scuro macchia la metà inferiore di una finestra rotta.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	Suddenly, you feel a cold object pushed against your back as a woman speaks softly. "Hands where I can see them, Captain."|4506|0
units.english: Suddenly, you feel a cold object pushed against your back as a woman speaks softly. "Hands where I can see them, Captain."
units.italian: All'improvviso senti un oggetto freddo premuto contro la schiena e una donna parla a bassa voce. "Mani dove posso vederle, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	(Lift my hands up and slowly turn.)|4508|0
units.english: (Lift my hands up and slowly turn.)
units.italian: (Alza le mani e voltati lentamente.)

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	(Spin around and fire.)|4510|0
units.english: (Spin around and fire.)
units.italian: (Girati di scatto e spara.)
