units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	(Try a fancy acrobatic move and disarm the attacker.)|4511|0
units.english: (Try a fancy acrobatic move and disarm the attacker.)
units.italian: (Prova una mossa acrobatica e disarmala.)

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	You turn around as swiftly as you can as your hand grasps for your pistol. Due to surprise, or perhaps nervousness, the woman threatening you fails to fire the shotgun she's holding in the second you spend turning. You manage to land a shot, and your quarry falls while a cry escapes from her body. As you walk away, her body fades into the darkness, blending with the garbage bags around it.|4516|0
units.english: You turn around as swiftly as you can as your hand grasps for your pistol. Due to surprise, or perhaps nervousness, the woman threatening you fails to fire the shotgun she's holding in the second you spend turning. You manage to land a shot, and your quarry falls while a cry escapes from her body. As you walk away, her body fades into the darkness, blending with the garbage bags around it.
units.italian: Ti volti il più rapidamente possibile mentre la mano cerca la pistola. Per la sorpresa, o forse per il nervosismo, la donna che ti minaccia non riesce a sparare con il fucile che tiene in mano nel secondo che impieghi a girarti. Riesci a colpirla, e la tua preda cade mentre un grido le esce dal corpo. Mentre ti allontani, il suo corpo svanisce nel buio, confondendosi con i sacchi della spazzatura intorno.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	You push down as hard as you can with your legs while leaning backwards, rising to the lofty height of two feet above the ground. As you begin to fall back-first uncontrollably, cold metal digs into your spine. A gasp escapes from behind as you land on a soft body. You pick yourself up as fast as possible, and you end up face-to-face with your attacker. In the darkness, you pick out that she's wearing a black hoodie with a bandanna over her mouth, her back hunched over and feet placed apart. As you look down, you spot a sawed-off break-action shotgun held single-handed, the end of which is pointed at your abdomen. "Hands up now, Captain."|4520|0
units.english: You push down as hard as you can with your legs while leaning backwards, rising to the lofty height of two feet above the ground. As you begin to fall back-first uncontrollably, cold metal digs into your spine. A gasp escapes from behind as you land on a soft body. You pick yourself up as fast as possible, and you end up face-to-face with your attacker. In the darkness, you pick out that she's wearing a black hoodie with a bandanna over her mouth, her back hunched over and feet placed apart. As you look down, you spot a sawed-off break-action shotgun held single-handed, the end of which is pointed at your abdomen. "Hands up now, Captain."
units.italian: Spingi con le gambe più che puoi mentre ti inclini all'indietro, sollevandoti fino all'altezza vertiginosa di sessanta centimetri da terra. Mentre cominci a cadere all'indietro senza controllo, del metallo freddo ti affonda nella schiena. Un sussulto ti sfugge da dietro mentre atterri su un corpo morbido. Ti rialzi il più in fretta possibile e ti ritrovi faccia a faccia con la tua aggressora. Nel buio distingui che indossa una felpa nera con un bandana sulla bocca, la schiena curva e i piedi divaricati. Guardando in basso, scorgi un fucile a canne mozze basculante tenuto con una sola mano, con la canna puntata al tuo addome. "Mani in alto, adesso, Capitano."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	(Put my hands up.)|4522|0
units.english: (Put my hands up.)
units.italian: (Alza le mani.)

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	(Draw my gun and fire.)|4524|0
units.english: (Draw my gun and fire.)
units.italian: (Estrai la pistola e spara.)

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	You hand darts for your gun, and you somehow manage to aim and fire before the woman does. She collapses on the ground while a cry escapes from her body. As you walk away, her body fades into the darkness, blending with the garbage bags around it.|4527|0
units.english: You hand darts for your gun, and you somehow manage to aim and fire before the woman does. She collapses on the ground while a cry escapes from her body. As you walk away, her body fades into the darkness, blending with the garbage bags around it.
units.italian: La tua mano scatta verso la pistola e riesci in qualche modo a mirare e sparare prima della donna. Crolla a terra mentre un grido le esce dal corpo. Mentre ti allontani, il suo corpo svanisce nel buio, confondendosi con i sacchi della spazzatura intorno.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	You raise your arms and turn to face the woman. In the darkness, you pick out that she's wearing a black hoodie with a bandanna over her mouth, her back hunched over and feet placed apart. As you look down, you spot a sawed-off break-action shotgun held single-handed, the end of which is pointed at your abdomen.|4531|0
units.english: You raise your arms and turn to face the woman. In the darkness, you pick out that she's wearing a black hoodie with a bandanna over her mouth, her back hunched over and feet placed apart. As you look down, you spot a sawed-off break-action shotgun held single-handed, the end of which is pointed at your abdomen.
units.italian: Alzi le braccia e ti volti verso la donna. Nel buio distingui che indossa una felpa nera con un bandana sulla bocca, la schiena curva e i piedi divaricati. Guardando in basso, scorgi un fucile a canne mozze basculante tenuto con una sola mano, con la canna puntata al tuo addome.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|label|4532|0
units.english: hands up
units.italian: hands up

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"Very good, Captain," she says. "Now, I have a proposal for you. I need transport to <destination>. Take me there, and the both of us can forget this ever happened."|4533|0
units.english: "Very good, Captain," she says. "Now, I have a proposal for you. I need transport to <destination>. Take me there, and the both of us can forget this ever happened."
units.italian: "Molto bene, Capitano," dice. "Ho una proposta per lei. Mi serve un trasporto fino a <destination>. Mi porti là, e possiamo entrambi dimenticare che sia mai successo."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"And if I don't take you there?"|4535|0
units.english: "And if I don't take you there?"
units.italian: "E se non ti ci porto?"

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"Are you going to pay me?"|4536|0
units.english: "Are you going to pay me?"
units.italian: "Hai intenzione di pagarmi?"

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"Why do you want to go there?"|4538|0
units.english: "Why do you want to go there?"
units.italian: "Perché vuoi andare là?"

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	She scoffs. "What do you think? How else might an encounter involving a gun pointed-"|4541|0
units.english: She scoffs. "What do you think? How else might an encounter involving a gun pointed-"
units.italian: Lei sbuffa. "Che cosa credi? In quale altro modo un incontro con una pistola puntata..."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	She scoffs. "Payment? If I wanted to pay you, I wouldn't be in this alley pointing-"|4544|0
units.english: She scoffs. "Payment? If I wanted to pay you, I wouldn't be in this alley pointing-"
units.italian: Lei sbuffa. "Pagare? Se volessi pagarla, non sarei in questo vicolo a puntarle..."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	She scoffs. "All you need to know is that I've got a gun pointed-"|4547|0
units.english: She scoffs. "All you need to know is that I've got a gun pointed-"
units.italian: Lei sbuffa. "Le basta sapere che ho una pistola puntata..."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	The attacker's speech is interrupted by a click as her shotgun swings open. She takes a step back as her eyes widen with panic.|4550|0
units.english: The attacker's speech is interrupted by a click as her shotgun swings open. She takes a step back as her eyes widen with panic.
units.italian: Il discorso dell'aggressora è interrotto da uno scatto mentre il fucile si apre. Fa un passo indietro con gli occhi che si spalancano dal panico.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	(Threaten her with my gun.)|4553|0
units.english: (Threaten her with my gun.)
units.italian: (Minacciala con la pistola.)

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	(Shoot her.)|4555|0
units.english: (Shoot her.)
units.italian: (Sparale.)

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	Before she can move a muscle, you whip out your pistol and fire, watching as the woman collapses onto the ground with a cry. As you walk away, her body fades into the darkness, blending with the garbage bags around it.|4559|0
units.english: Before she can move a muscle, you whip out your pistol and fire, watching as the woman collapses onto the ground with a cry. As you walk away, her body fades into the darkness, blending with the garbage bags around it.
units.italian: Prima che possa muovere un muscolo, estrai la pistola e spari, guardando la donna crollare a terra con un grido. Mentre ti allontani, il suo corpo svanisce nel buio, confondendosi con i sacchi della spazzatura intorno.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	You take out your gun and aim it at the woman's head. "Drop the gun," you say, "or I'll shoot."|4563|0
units.english: You take out your gun and aim it at the woman's head. "Drop the gun," you say, "or I'll shoot."
units.italian: Estrai la pistola e la punti alla testa della donna. "Lascia cadere il fucile," dici, "o sparo."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	She seizes up for a few moments, then she throws her shotgun away and raises her hands. "I'm, um, sorry about threatening you. Would you mind if the both of us just walked this off?"|4564|0
units.english: She seizes up for a few moments, then she throws her shotgun away and raises her hands. "I'm, um, sorry about threatening you. Would you mind if the both of us just walked this off?"
units.italian: Resta bloccata per qualche istante, poi getta via il fucile e alza le mani. "Mi, ehm, dispiace di averti minacciato. Ti spiace se ce ne andiamo ognuno per la sua strada?"

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"Why do you want to go to <planet>?"|4566|0
units.english: "Why do you want to go to <planet>?"
units.italian: "Perché vuoi andare su <planet>?"

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"Get out of my sight, and I'll let you go."|4568|0
units.english: "Get out of my sight, and I'll let you go."
units.italian: "Togliati dalla mia vista e ti lascio andare."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	(Shoot her.)|4570|0
units.english: (Shoot her.)
units.italian: (Sparale.)

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	You pull the trigger and watch as the woman collapses onto the ground with a cry. As you walk away, her body fades into the darkness, blending with the garbage bags around it.|4574|0
units.english: You pull the trigger and watch as the woman collapses onto the ground with a cry. As you walk away, her body fades into the darkness, blending with the garbage bags around it.
units.italian: Premi il grilletto e guardi la donna crollare a terra con un grido. Mentre ti allontani, il suo corpo svanisce nel buio, confondendosi con i sacchi della spazzatura intorno.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	She nods her head and backs away from you, hands still held up. When she disappears around a corner, you holster your gun and walk back to a safer portion of the spaceport.|4578|0
units.english: She nods her head and backs away from you, hands still held up. When she disappears around a corner, you holster your gun and walk back to a safer portion of the spaceport.
units.italian: Annuisce e indietreggia, con le mani ancora alzate. Quando sparisce dietro un angolo, rimetti via la pistola e torni verso una zona più sicura dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	The woman looks at you with a confused expression. "Huh? Why would you want to know that?"|4582|0
units.english: The woman looks at you with a confused expression. "Huh? Why would you want to know that?"
units.italian: La donna ti guarda con un'espressione confusa. "Eh? Perché vorresti saperlo?"

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"Just humor me for a moment," you reply.|4583|0
units.english: "Just humor me for a moment," you reply.
units.italian: "Fammi solo questa cortesia per un momento," rispondi.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	She sighs. "A while ago, I was in a bad situation. My boyfriend had just moved to <planet> for employment, and I was to join him in a year. My father had other plans. He used my boyfriend's absence to justify marrying me into another, richer family. Wanted a chunk of their fortune, I suppose. I tried everything I could to convince him otherwise, but..." She looks down. "So I snuck off to the spaceport and got a merchant to transport me. She forced me to pay upfront, however, and as soon as we landed on <origin>, she kicked me out to make space for another set of passengers."|4584|0
units.english: She sighs. "A while ago, I was in a bad situation. My boyfriend had just moved to <planet> for employment, and I was to join him in a year. My father had other plans. He used my boyfriend's absence to justify marrying me into another, richer family. Wanted a chunk of their fortune, I suppose. I tried everything I could to convince him otherwise, but..." She looks down. "So I snuck off to the spaceport and got a merchant to transport me. She forced me to pay upfront, however, and as soon as we landed on <origin>, she kicked me out to make space for another set of passengers."
units.italian: Sospira. "Un po' di tempo fa ero in una brutta situazione. Il mio ragazzo si era appena trasferito su <planet> per lavoro, e io sarei dovuta andare da lui dopo un anno. Mio padre aveva altri piani. Ha usato l'assenza del mio ragazzo come pretesto per maritarmi a un'altra famiglia, più ricca. Voleva una fetta della loro fortuna, suppongo. Ho provato di tutto per fargli cambiare idea, ma..." Abbassa lo sguardo. "Così sono scappata allo spazioporto e ho convinto un mercante a trasportarmi. Lei però mi ha costretto a pagare in anticipo, e appena atterrati su <origin> mi ha buttata fuori per fare spazio a un altro gruppo di passeggeri."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	Her eyebrows furrow. "Wait, you're not planning to bring me to <planet> after what I've just done, are you?"|4585|0
units.english: Her eyebrows furrow. "Wait, you're not planning to bring me to <planet> after what I've just done, are you?"
units.italian: Aggrotta le sopracciglia. "Aspetta, non avrai intenzione di portarmi su <planet> dopo quello che ho appena fatto, vero?"

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"I can take you there."|4587|0
units.english: "I can take you there."
units.italian: "Posso portarti là."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"I can't transport you."|4588|0
units.english: "I can't transport you."
units.italian: "Non posso trasportarti."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"Really?" she says. "You realize that I can't pay you in any way, right?"|4590|0
units.english: "Really?" she says. "You realize that I can't pay you in any way, right?"
units.italian: "Davvero?" dice. "Ti rendi conto che non posso pagarti in nessun modo, vero?"

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"You don't need to pay me."|4592|0
units.english: "You don't need to pay me."
units.italian: "Non devi pagarmi."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"You can pay me later."|4594|0
units.english: "You can pay me later."
units.italian: "Potrai pagarmi più avanti."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"Actually, I can't take you there without payment."|4595|0
units.english: "Actually, I can't take you there without payment."
units.italian: "In realtà non posso portarti là senza pagamento."

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	The woman's eyes light up. "I can't thank you enough for this." The two of you head out of the alleys and back to the landing pads, and you show her to an empty bunk on your ship.|4600|0
units.english: The woman's eyes light up. "I can't thank you enough for this." The two of you head out of the alleys and back to the landing pads, and you show her to an empty bunk on your ship.
units.italian: Gli occhi della donna si illuminano. "Non so come ringraziarti." Uscite insieme dai vicoli e tornate alle piazzole di atterraggio, e le mostri un posto letto libero sulla tua nave.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	"I understand." She shuffles away with her head hung, and you head back to a brighter area of the spaceport.|4604|0
units.english: "I understand." She shuffles away with her head hung, and you head back to a brighter area of the spaceport.
units.italian: "Capisco." Si allontana a testa bassa, e tu torni verso una zona più illuminata dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|As you tell the woman about the change in travel plans, she sighs with resignation. "I suppose that I shouldn't expect anything after how I treated you." You recall that she doesn't even have a single credit to her name, and without any money, it is unlikely that she will survive for long.|4609|0
units.english: As you tell the woman about the change in travel plans, she sighs with resignation. "I suppose that I shouldn't expect anything after how I treated you." You recall that she doesn't even have a single credit to her name, and without any money, it is unlikely that she will survive for long.
units.italian: Quando dici alla donna del cambio di programma, lei sospira rassegnata. "Immagino di non potermi aspettare nulla, dopo come ti ho trattato." Ti ricordi che non ha nemmeno un credito a suo nome, e senza soldi è improbabile che sopravviva a lungo.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	(Wish her good luck.)|4613|0
units.english: (Wish her good luck.)
units.italian: (Le auguri buona fortuna.)

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	(Give her 15,000 credits before dropping her off.)|4615|0
units.english: (Give her 15,000 credits before dropping her off.)
units.italian: (Le dai 15.000 crediti prima di lasciarla scendere.)

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	(Wish her good luck.)|4619|0
units.english: (Wish her good luck.)
units.italian: (Le auguri buona fortuna.)

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	She nods in response. "I'll try my best," she says solemnly as she prepares to depart your ship.|4621|0
units.english: She nods in response. "I'll try my best," she says solemnly as she prepares to depart your ship.
units.italian: Annuisce in risposta. "Farò del mio meglio," dice solennemente mentre si prepara a lasciare la tua nave.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|log|4627|0
units.english: Was held up by a woman who wanted transport to Maker. Managed to gain the upper hand in the engagement, but decided to pay for her transport anyway.
units.italian: Sono stato rapinato da una donna che voleva un passaggio per Maker. Sono riuscito a prendere il sopravvento nello scontro, ma alla fine ho deciso di pagarle il trasporto lo stesso.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|	She is almost incredulous at your gift. "I really can't thank you enough for helping me out." The two of you say your farewells as she gets ready to depart your ship.|4628|0
units.english: She is almost incredulous at your gift. "I really can't thank you enough for helping me out." The two of you say your farewells as she gets ready to depart your ship.
units.italian: È quasi incredula davanti al tuo regalo. "Non so davvero come ringraziarti per l'aiuto." Vi salutate mentre lei si prepara a lasciare la tua nave.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|log|4632|0
units.english: Was held up by a woman who wanted transport to Maker. Managed to gain the upper hand in the engagement, but decided to take her there anyway.
units.italian: Sono stato rapinato da una donna che voleva un passaggio per Maker. Sono riuscito a prendere il sopravvento nello scontro, ma alla fine ho deciso di portarcela comunque.

units.id: mission:Fumbling Mugger|dialog|4633|0
units.english: The hooded woman prepares to disembark your ship. Just before she steps off, she turns to look at you. "I'm sorry for threatening you back on <origin>, Captain. I'll try to find some way to repay you." She walks off into the bustling spaceport to find her lover.
units.italian: La donna incappucciata si prepara a scendere dalla tua nave. Proprio prima di uscire, si volta a guardarti. "Mi dispiace di averti minacciato su <origin>, Capitano. Cercherò un modo per ripagarti." Si allontana nello spazioporto affollato a cercare il suo uomo.

units.id: mission:Laborer|name|4642|0
units.english: Out of Work
units.italian: Senza lavoro

units.id: mission:Laborer|description|4643|0
units.english: A man down on his luck needs to get to <destination>. He has promised to send you payment as soon as he has it.
units.italian: Un uomo caduto in disgrazia deve arrivare su <destination>. Ha promesso di mandarti il pagamento appena ne avrà.

units.id: mission:Laborer|Upon entering the spaceport, you see a young man in laborer's clothing arguing with a woman in a flight suit.|4656|0
units.english: Upon entering the spaceport, you see a young man in laborer's clothing arguing with a woman in a flight suit.
units.italian: Entrando nello spazioporto, vedi un giovane in abiti da operaio che litiga con una donna in tuta da volo.

units.id: mission:Laborer|	(Go see what the laborer is arguing about.)|4658|0
units.english: (Go see what the laborer is arguing about.)
units.italian: (Vai a vedere per che cosa litiga l'operaio.)

units.id: mission:Laborer|	(Ignore them.)|4659|0
units.english: (Ignore them.)
units.italian: (Ignali.)

units.id: mission:Laborer|	The man is nearly shouting. "Lady, I'm not trying to low-ball you here! I don't have the money! That's the whole point!"|4661|0
units.english: The man is nearly shouting. "Lady, I'm not trying to low-ball you here! I don't have the money! That's the whole point!"
units.italian: L'uomo sta quasi urlando. "Signora, non sto cercando di tirarLe sul prezzo! Non ho i soldi! È tutto qui il punto!"

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"I appreciate your conundrum," replies the woman, her voice clipped. "However, my policy is cash upfront. Good day."|4662|0
units.english: "I appreciate your conundrum," replies the woman, her voice clipped. "However, my policy is cash upfront. Good day."
units.italian: "Capisco il suo dilemma," risponde la donna, con voce secca. "Tuttavia la mia regola è: contanti in anticipo. Buona giornata."

units.id: mission:Laborer|	She turns and walks away briskly, and the man slumps down into a chair.|4663|0
units.english: She turns and walks away briskly, and the man slumps down into a chair.
units.italian: Si volta e se ne va a passo svelto, e l'uomo si lascia cadere su una sedia.

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"What was that all about?"|4665|0
units.english: "What was that all about?"
units.italian: "Che cosa succedeva?"

units.id: mission:Laborer|	(Leave before he notices me.)|4666|0
units.english: (Leave before he notices me.)
units.italian: (Vattene prima che mi noti.)

units.id: mission:Laborer|	He gives you a once-over, and you see a spark of hope in his eyes. "You're a captain? Please, I need to get to <destination>. Work has dried up here, and I need a fresh start."|4668|0
units.english: He gives you a once-over, and you see a spark of hope in his eyes. "You're a captain? Please, I need to get to <destination>. Work has dried up here, and I need a fresh start."
units.italian: Ti squadra da capo a piedi, e vedi una scintilla di speranza nei suoi occhi. "Lei è un capitano? La prego, devo arrivare su <destination>. Qui il lavoro è finito, e ho bisogno di ricominciare."

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"What are you able to pay me?"|4670|0
units.english: "What are you able to pay me?"
units.italian: "Quanto puoi pagarmi?"

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"Work dried up on the whole planet?"|4672|0
units.english: "Work dried up on the whole planet?"
units.italian: "Il lavoro è finito su tutto il pianeta?"

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"This planet is messed up. Everybody likes to talk behind your back. I did a job for one of the big mining companies here, but my boss had it out for me. Told everybody I did it wrong, even though they never gave me any training at all. Then he went and put me on the permanent record. So yeah, sooner I get off this dump, the better."|4673|0
units.english: "This planet is messed up. Everybody likes to talk behind your back. I did a job for one of the big mining companies here, but my boss had it out for me. Told everybody I did it wrong, even though they never gave me any training at all. Then he went and put me on the permanent record. So yeah, sooner I get off this dump, the better."
units.italian: "Questo pianeta è un disastro. A tutti piace parlare alle tue spalle. Ho fatto un lavoro per una delle grandi compagnie minerarie di qui, ma il mio capo ce l'aveva con me. Ha detto a tutti che l'avevo fatto male, anche se non mi hanno mai dato un addestramento. Poi mi ha messo nella fedina. Quindi sì, prima me ne vado da questa fogna, meglio è."

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"What are you able to pay me?" you ask.|4674|0
units.english: "What are you able to pay me?" you ask.
units.italian: "Quanto puoi pagarmi?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Laborer|	His eyes drop. "I can pay you after I earn the money. I've just gotta get to <planet> to get work, and then I'll send the money. I just want to earn a living, same as anyone."|4676|0
units.english: His eyes drop. "I can pay you after I earn the money. I've just gotta get to <planet> to get work, and then I'll send the money. I just want to earn a living, same as anyone."
units.italian: Abbassa gli occhi. "Posso pagarla dopo aver guadagnato i soldi. Devo solo arrivare su <planet> per trovare lavoro, e poi Le manderò il denaro. Voglio solo guadagnarmi da vivere, come chiunque altro."

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"Okay, I can take you to <planet>."|4678|0
units.english: "Okay, I can take you to <planet>."
units.italian: "Va bene, posso portarti su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"How do I know you'll pay?"|4680|0
units.english: "How do I know you'll pay?"
units.italian: "Come faccio a sapere che pagherai?"

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"Sorry, money up front."|4682|0
units.english: "Sorry, money up front."
units.italian: "Spiacente, soldi in anticipo."

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"You don't trust me? Just keep walking, then, if you're gonna be like that."|4685|0
units.english: "You don't trust me? Just keep walking, then, if you're gonna be like that."
units.italian: "Non ti fidi di me? Allora continua pure a camminare, se devi fare così."

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"Sorry, money up front."|4687|0
units.english: "Sorry, money up front."
units.italian: "Spiacente, soldi in anticipo."

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"Fine, I can take you to <planet>."|4689|0
units.english: "Fine, I can take you to <planet>."
units.italian: "E va bene, ti porto su <planet>."

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"I'll be on board. There's no rush, honestly. I need a break from all this stress." He takes his luggage into your ship as you prepare for the trip.|4691|0
units.english: "I'll be on board. There's no rush, honestly. I need a break from all this stress." He takes his luggage into your ship as you prepare for the trip.
units.italian: "Vengo a bordo. Non c'è fretta, onestamente. Ho bisogno di una pausa da tutto questo stress." Porta i suoi bagagli sulla tua nave mentre ti prepari al viaggio.

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"I knew it. You're just like everyone else." He storms off, not waiting for a response.|4694|0
units.english: "I knew it. You're just like everyone else." He storms off, not waiting for a response.
units.italian: "Lo sapevo. Sei come tutti gli altri." Se ne va infuriato, senza aspettare risposta.

units.id: mission:Laborer|The worker you picked up from <origin> spent every possible moment of the voyage telling his story. He's had a tough life, full of unlucky setbacks, unfair treatment, and outright persecution from others. You stopped paying attention to what he was saying after a while as he went on for what felt like forever, often repeating himself.|4699|0
units.english: The worker you picked up from <origin> spent every possible moment of the voyage telling his story. He's had a tough life, full of unlucky setbacks, unfair treatment, and outright persecution from others. You stopped paying attention to what he was saying after a while as he went on for what felt like forever, often repeating himself.
units.italian: L'operaio che hai preso su <origin> ha passato ogni momento possibile del viaggio a raccontare la sua storia. Ha avuto una vita dura, piena di battute d'arresto sfortunate, trattamenti ingiusti e vere e proprie persecuzioni da parte degli altri. A un certo punto hai smesso di ascoltare, mentre andava avanti per quello che sembrava un'eternità, ripetendosi spesso.

units.id: mission:Laborer|	Upon arriving, he carries his bags to the lowered ramp, then turns back before disembarking. "Thanks for the lift. You're one of the good ones, you know?"|4700|0
units.english: Upon arriving, he carries his bags to the lowered ramp, then turns back before disembarking. "Thanks for the lift. You're one of the good ones, you know?"
units.italian: All'arrivo porta le sue borse sulla rampa abbassata, poi si volta prima di scendere. "Grazie per il passaggio. Sei uno dei buoni, sai?"

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"You're welcome. Better luck on this world."|4702|0
units.english: "You're welcome. Better luck on this world."
units.italian: "Prego. Buona fortuna su questo mondo."

units.id: mission:Laborer|	"You have my bank address, right?"|4704|0
units.english: "You have my bank address, right?"
units.italian: "Hai il mio indirizzo bancario, vero?"

units.id: mission:Laborer|	He shoots you a look of thinly masked annoyance. "Yeah. I'll send you the credits when I have them. Bye, now."|4705|0
units.english: He shoots you a look of thinly masked annoyance. "Yeah. I'll send you the credits when I have them. Bye, now."
units.italian: Ti lancia uno sguardo di fastidio a stento mascherato. "Sì. Ti manderò i crediti quando li avrò. Ciao, allora."

units.id: mission:Laborer|	He bobs his head at you in farewell. "I promise I'll send you the payment when I have it. Bye, now."|4708|0
units.english: He bobs his head at you in farewell. "I promise I'll send you the payment when I have it. Bye, now."
units.italian: Ti fa un cenno del capo in segno di saluto. "Ti prometto che ti manderò il pagamento appena l'avrò. Ciao, allora."

units.id: mission:Laborer Payment|You receive a payment of <payment> from the down-on-his-luck laborer that you transported a while back, along with a message. "Hello <last>. Not sure if you remember me. I'm the one that had to deal with my boss bad-talking me to everyone on my home planet. I've been doing better, but my new boss keeps trying to rip me off and make me come in for overtime." He goes into detail about the sordid working conditions in his new job, but you stop reading after the third paragraph.|4721|0
units.english: You receive a payment of <payment> from the down-on-his-luck laborer that you transported a while back, along with a message. "Hello <last>. Not sure if you remember me. I'm the one that had to deal with my boss bad-talking me to everyone on my home planet. I've been doing better, but my new boss keeps trying to rip me off and make me come in for overtime." He goes into detail about the sordid working conditions in his new job, but you stop reading after the third paragraph.
units.italian: Ricevi un pagamento di <payment> dall'operaio caduto in disgrazia che hai trasportato tempo fa, insieme a un messaggio. "Salve <last>. Non so se si ricorda di me. Sono quello che doveva fare i conti con il capo che parlava male di me a tutti sul mio pianeta natale. Le cose sono andate meglio, ma il mio nuovo capo continua a cercare di derubarmi e a farmi fare straordinari." Entra nel dettaglio delle squallide condizioni di lavoro del suo nuovo impiego, ma smetti di leggere dopo il terzo paragrafo.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|log|4752|0
units.english: Was pulled aside by a Navy officer and told to keep the wormhole to the Hai a secret. The Republic doesn't want the knowledge of the wormhole to be widespread, as that could cause chaos for both the Republic and the Hai.
units.italian: Sono stato preso da parte da un ufficiale della Marina e mi è stato detto di mantenere segreto il wormhole per gli Hai. La Repubblica non vuole che la conoscenza del wormhole si diffonda, perché potrebbe causare il caos sia per la Repubblica sia per gli Hai.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|When you open the door to let in the Navy officer on inspection duty, you expect him to produce the usual set of landing papers and bureaucracy. But instead he says, "Captain <last>. I'd like to speak with you for a few minutes. In private." He motions toward a Frigate on the landing pad next to the <ship>.|4754|0
units.english: When you open the door to let in the Navy officer on inspection duty, you expect him to produce the usual set of landing papers and bureaucracy. But instead he says, "Captain <last>. I'd like to speak with you for a few minutes. In private." He motions toward a Frigate on the landing pad next to the <ship>.
units.italian: Quando apri la porta per far entrare l'ufficiale della Marina in ispezione, ti aspetti che tiri fuori le solite carte di atterraggio e la solita burocrazia. Invece dice: "Capitano <last>. Vorrei parlarle per qualche minuto. In privato." Accenna verso una Frigate sulla piazzola accanto alla <ship>.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"What about?"|4756|0
units.english: "What about?"
units.italian: "Di che cosa?"

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"Okay."|4758|0
units.english: "Okay."
units.italian: "Va bene."

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"Sorry, I'm really busy right now."|4760|0
units.english: "Sorry, I'm really busy right now."
units.italian: "Spiacente, sono davvero molto impegnato adesso."

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"No, I'm sorry, but this isn't a matter of whether you're busy or not right now. Come with me."|4761|0
units.english: "No, I'm sorry, but this isn't a matter of whether you're busy or not right now. Come with me."
units.italian: "No, mi dispiace, ma adesso non è questione se Lei è impegnato o no. Venga con me."

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"I did say in private, did I not?" he says, once again motioning to the Frigate.|4764|0
units.english: "I did say in private, did I not?" he says, once again motioning to the Frigate.
units.italian: "Avevo detto in privato, no?" dice, accennando di nuovo alla Frigate.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	The man puts a hand on your shoulder and begins walking you toward the ship. As you approach, you note that the man's uniform doesn't have any Navy markings that you recognize.|4766|0
units.english: The man puts a hand on your shoulder and begins walking you toward the ship. As you approach, you note that the man's uniform doesn't have any Navy markings that you recognize.
units.italian: L'uomo ti mette una mano sulla spalla e comincia a portarti verso la nave. Mentre ti avvicini, noti che l'uniforme dell'uomo non ha nessun distintivo della Marina che tu riconosca.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	You enter the ship with the officer, and despite the decent crew requirement of a Frigate, you don't notice anyone else on board, and the interior of the ship appears more cushy than you would expect out of a military vessel. The officer leads you to what looks like a rather comfy lounge area. "Please, have a seat," he says.|4767|0
units.english: You enter the ship with the officer, and despite the decent crew requirement of a Frigate, you don't notice anyone else on board, and the interior of the ship appears more cushy than you would expect out of a military vessel. The officer leads you to what looks like a rather comfy lounge area. "Please, have a seat," he says.
units.italian: Entri nella nave con l'ufficiale e, nonostante la richiesta di equipaggio non indifferente di una Frigate, non noti nessun altro a bordo, e l'interno della nave sembra più confortevole di quanto ti aspetteresti da un vascello militare. L'ufficiale ti guida verso quella che sembra una saletta piuttosto comoda. "Prego, si sieda," dice.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	(Take a seat.)|4769|0
units.english: (Take a seat.)
units.italian: (Siediti.)

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"No, I like to stand."|4771|0
units.english: "No, I like to stand."
units.italian: "No, preferisco stare in piedi."

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"Suit yourself," the officer says with a shrug while taking a seat himself.|4772|0
units.english: "Suit yourself," the officer says with a shrug while taking a seat himself.
units.italian: "Come vuole," dice l'ufficiale con un'alzata di spalle, sedendosi lui stesso.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	You choose a table to sit at and the officer sits across from you.|4775|0
units.english: You choose a table to sit at and the officer sits across from you.
units.italian: Scegli un tavolo e ti siedi, e l'ufficiale si accomoda di fronte a te.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"So what is it that you brought me here for?" you ask.|4777|0
units.english: "So what is it that you brought me here for?" you ask.
units.italian: "Allora, per che cosa mi ha portato qui?" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	The officer folds his hands together. "You've made contact with an alien species located to the north. Is this correct?"|4778|0
units.english: The officer folds his hands together. "You've made contact with an alien species located to the north. Is this correct?"
units.italian: L'ufficiale intreccia le mani. "Lei è entrato in contatto con una specie aliena situata a nord. È corretto?"

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"It is. Is that a problem?"|4780|0
units.english: "It is. Is that a problem?"
units.italian: "È corretto. È un problema?"

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"Perhaps. Why do you ask?"|4782|0
units.english: "Perhaps. Why do you ask?"
units.italian: "Forse. Perché me lo chiede?"

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"Aliens? I don't know of any aliens up there."|4784|0
units.english: "Aliens? I don't know of any aliens up there."
units.italian: "Alieni? Non conosco nessun alieno laggiù."

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"Hey! That's no way to talk about the pirates in the Far North."|4785|0
units.english: "Hey! That's no way to talk about the pirates in the Far North."
units.italian: "Ehi! Non è modo di parlare dei pirati dell'Estremo Nord."

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"Don't play coy with me, <last>. The Republic is aware that you've made contact with the Hai.|4786|0
units.english: "Don't play coy with me, <last>. The Republic is aware that you've made contact with the Hai.
units.italian: "Non faccia la furba con me, <last>. La Repubblica sa che è entrata in contatto con gli Hai.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	The officer chuckles. "I think the answer you're looking for is 'Yes,' not 'Perhaps.' The Republic is aware that you've made contact with the Hai.|4789|0
units.english: The officer chuckles. "I think the answer you're looking for is 'Yes,' not 'Perhaps.' The Republic is aware that you've made contact with the Hai.
units.italian: L'ufficiale ridacchia. "Credo che la risposta che cerca sia 'Sì', non 'Forse'. La Repubblica sa che è entrata in contatto con gli Hai.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"There is no problem, <last>. I am just letting you know that the Republic is aware that you've made contact with the Hai.|4792|0
units.english: "There is no problem, <last>. I am just letting you know that the Republic is aware that you've made contact with the Hai.
units.italian: "Non c'è nessun problema, <last>. La sto solo informando che la Repubblica sa che è entrata in contatto con gli Hai.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"But you may not be aware of the arrangement that the Republic has with the Hai. The Republic works hard to ensure that the existence of the Hai remains an open secret; they do not disallow captains such as yourself from stumbling upon them, but they will not allow this existence to be widely publicized."|4794|0
units.english: "But you may not be aware of the arrangement that the Republic has with the Hai. The Republic works hard to ensure that the existence of the Hai remains an open secret; they do not disallow captains such as yourself from stumbling upon them, but they will not allow this existence to be widely publicized."
units.italian: "Ma forse non è al corrente dell'accordo che la Repubblica ha con gli Hai. La Repubblica si dà molto da fare perché l'esistenza degli Hai resti un segreto di Pulcinella; non vieta a capitani come lei di imbattersi in loro, ma non permetterà che questa esistenza venga pubblicizzata."

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"Why are you telling me this?"|4796|0
units.english: "Why are you telling me this?"
units.italian: "Perché mi sta dicendo questo?"

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"An arrangement between the Republic and Hai? When did that happen?"|4798|0
units.english: "An arrangement between the Republic and Hai? When did that happen?"
units.italian: "Un accordo fra la Repubblica e gli Hai? Quando sarebbe successo?"

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"So you're threatening me to stay quiet?"|4800|0
units.english: "So you're threatening me to stay quiet?"
units.italian: "Quindi mi sta minacciando perché stia zitto?"

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"No threats. I only provide a... warning, so to say, that you should keep the Hai a secret.|4801|0
units.english: "No threats. I only provide a... warning, so to say, that you should keep the Hai a secret.
units.italian: "Nessuna minaccia. Le fornisco solo un... avvertimento, per così dire, perché tenga segreta l'esistenza degli Hai.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"I'm telling you this as something of a... warning, so to say, that you should keep the Hai a secret.|4804|0
units.english: "I'm telling you this as something of a... warning, so to say, that you should keep the Hai a secret.
units.italian: "Le dico questo come una sorta di... avvertimento, per così dire, perché tenga segreta l'esistenza degli Hai.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"The details of the arrangement are none of your concern. All you need to know is that I am providing a... warning, so to say, that you should keep the Hai a secret.|4807|0
units.english: "The details of the arrangement are none of your concern. All you need to know is that I am providing a... warning, so to say, that you should keep the Hai a secret.
units.italian: "I dettagli dell'accordo non la riguardano. Le basta sapere che le sto fornendo un... avvertimento, per così dire, perché tenga segreta l'esistenza degli Hai.

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"I'm sure that you can imagine that should the existence of the Hai become public, it would cause a great deal of chaos, both for the Republic and for the Hai. Chaos that could easily end badly, particularly for the one who caused it. So it would be in everyone's interest if you kept this knowledge a secret."|4809|0
units.english: "I'm sure that you can imagine that should the existence of the Hai become public, it would cause a great deal of chaos, both for the Republic and for the Hai. Chaos that could easily end badly, particularly for the one who caused it. So it would be in everyone's interest if you kept this knowledge a secret."
units.italian: "Sono certo che può immaginare che, se l'esistenza degli Hai diventasse di pubblico dominio, causerebbe un bel po' di caos, sia per la Repubblica sia per gli Hai. Un caos che potrebbe facilmente finire male, soprattutto per chi lo ha causato. Quindi sarebbe nell'interesse di tutti che lei tenesse segreta questa conoscenza."

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"Alright. I won't let anyone know."|4811|0
units.english: "Alright. I won't let anyone know."
units.italian: "Va bene. Non lo dirò a nessuno."

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"And if I don't?"|4813|0
units.english: "And if I don't?"
units.italian: "E se non lo facessi?"

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	The officer leans back in his chair. "As I said, <last>, I'm giving you a warning that things could end badly for you. The Republic are not the only ones who work hard to maintain this secrecy, so you may want to think twice about revealing such information. Now, if you'll please depart my ship so that I can be on my way."|4814|0
units.english: The officer leans back in his chair. "As I said, <last>, I'm giving you a warning that things could end badly for you. The Republic are not the only ones who work hard to maintain this secrecy, so you may want to think twice about revealing such information. Now, if you'll please depart my ship so that I can be on my way."
units.italian: L'ufficiale si appoggia allo schienale. "Come ho detto, <last>, le sto dando un avvertimento: le cose potrebbero finire male per lei. La Repubblica non è l'unica a darsi da fare per mantenere questo segreto, quindi forse è il caso di pensarci due volte prima di rivelare certe informazioni. Ora, la prego di lasciare la mia nave così posso andarmene."

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	"That's good to hear," the officer responds. "Thank you for your cooperation, <last>. Now, if you'll please depart my ship so that I can be on my way."|4817|0
units.english: "That's good to hear," the officer responds. "Thank you for your cooperation, <last>. Now, if you'll please depart my ship so that I can be on my way."
units.italian: "È bello sentirlo," risponde l'ufficiale. "Grazie per la collaborazione, <last>. Ora, la prego di lasciare la mia nave così posso andarmene."

units.id: mission:Hai Wormhole Warning|	The officer leads you out of the ship and closes the doors behind you, while the actual Navy officer on inspection duty stands beside the <ship>, brandishing a set of landing documents. When you've finished signing them, you turn back to see the Frigate take off, slowly getting smaller in the sky until it finally disappears.|4819|0
units.english: The officer leads you out of the ship and closes the doors behind you, while the actual Navy officer on inspection duty stands beside the <ship>, brandishing a set of landing documents. When you've finished signing them, you turn back to see the Frigate take off, slowly getting smaller in the sky until it finally disappears.
units.italian: L'ufficiale ti accompagna fuori dalla nave e chiude le porte dietro di te, mentre il vero ufficiale della Marina in ispezione sta accanto alla <ship>, sventolando una serie di documenti di atterraggio. Quando hai finito di firmarli, ti volti e vedi la Frigate decollare, diventando sempre più piccola nel cielo finché non scompare.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 1|name|4825|0
units.english: Saving Artifacts
units.italian: Salvare i manufatti

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 1|description|4826|0
units.english: An Earth museum cannot care for these historical artifacts anymore. Bring them to <destination>, where they will be safe.
units.italian: Un museo della Terra non può più occuparsi di questi manufatti storici. Portali su <destination>, dove saranno al sicuro.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 1|As you wander around the spaceport, a harried-looking academic approaches you. "You're a captain, right? Can you take a transport mission to <planet>? A local museum can't care for some priceless historical artifacts anymore due to budget cuts, so they need to be transported somewhere that they can be properly cared for. We can pay you <payment>."|4836|0
units.english: As you wander around the spaceport, a harried-looking academic approaches you. "You're a captain, right? Can you take a transport mission to <planet>? A local museum can't care for some priceless historical artifacts anymore due to budget cuts, so they need to be transported somewhere that they can be properly cared for. We can pay you <payment>."
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto, ti si avvicina un accademico dall'aria affannata. "Lei è un capitano, vero? Può accettare una missione di trasporto su <planet>? Un museo locale non può più occuparsi di alcuni manufatti storici di valore inestimabile per via dei tagli al bilancio, quindi vanno trasportati in un posto dove possano essere curati come si deve. Possiamo pagarle <payment>."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 1|	"Why can't you just bring them to another Earth museum?"|4838|0
units.english: "Why can't you just bring them to another Earth museum?"
units.italian: "Perché non portarli semplicemente in un altro museo della Terra?"

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 1|	"Isn't there some other place planetside that'll take them in?"|4841|0
units.english: "Isn't there some other place planetside that'll take them in?"
units.italian: "Non c'è qualche altro posto sul pianeta disposto a prenderli in custodia?"

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 1|	"Sorry, I can't take on this job right now. Ask someone else."|4844|0
units.english: "Sorry, I can't take on this job right now. Ask someone else."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non posso accettare questo lavoro adesso. Chieda a qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 1|	"Sure, I'll take them there."|4846|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll take them there."
units.italian: "Certo, glieli porto io."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 1|	"These artifacts are extremely delicate. Ancient manuscripts and the like. One needs special equipment to care for them, and all the museums that could possibly provide that care here are underfunded and overloaded. Earth has many items of historical value, but not enough resources to host them. It's not an ideal combination." He sighs. "Alexandria Station has offered to host them, so we of course accepted."|4848|0
units.english: "These artifacts are extremely delicate. Ancient manuscripts and the like. One needs special equipment to care for them, and all the museums that could possibly provide that care here are underfunded and overloaded. Earth has many items of historical value, but not enough resources to host them. It's not an ideal combination." He sighs. "Alexandria Station has offered to host them, so we of course accepted."
units.italian: "Questi manufatti sono estremamente delicati. Manoscritti antichi e cose del genere. Servono attrezzature speciali per curarli, e tutti i musei che qui potrebbero fornirle sono sottofinanziati e sovraccarichi. La Terra ha molti oggetti di valore storico, ma non abbastanza risorse per ospitarli. Non è una combinazione ideale." Sospira. "La Alexandria Station si è offerta di ospitarli, quindi abbiamo naturalmente accettato."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 1|	"Sure, I'll take them there."|4850|0
units.english: "Sure, I'll take them there."
units.italian: "Certo, glieli porto io."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 1|	"Sorry, I can't take on this job right now. Ask someone else."|4851|0
units.english: "Sorry, I can't take on this job right now. Ask someone else."
units.italian: "Spiacente, non posso accettare questo lavoro adesso. Chieda a qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 1|	"Wonderful!" He claps his hands together. "We'll start loading the cargo onto your ship." He turns and walks away considerably happier than when you found him.|4854|0
units.english: "Wonderful!" He claps his hands together. "We'll start loading the cargo onto your ship." He turns and walks away considerably happier than when you found him.
units.italian: "Meraviglioso!" Batte le mani. "Cominciamo a caricare il carico sulla sua nave." Si volta e se ne va molto più felice di come l'hai trovato.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 1|Unloading the cargo takes an excruciatingly long time, as the artifacts must be handled with extreme care. A local librarian comes up to you and thanks you for the transport, paying you <payment>.|4859|0
units.english: Unloading the cargo takes an excruciatingly long time, as the artifacts must be handled with extreme care. A local librarian comes up to you and thanks you for the transport, paying you <payment>.
units.italian: Scaricare il carico richiede un tempo straziante, perché i manufatti vanno maneggiati con estrema cura. Una bibliotecaria locale ti viene incontro, ti ringrazia per il trasporto e ti paga <payment>.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 1|	As he hands you the credit chips, he leans in. "According to our sources, you have some considerable combat experience. We have a task that requires that skillset. I promise you that it's a bit more exciting than transporting musty books, and the pay is much higher too. Meet me in the spaceport if you want to learn more."|4860|0
units.english: As he hands you the credit chips, he leans in. "According to our sources, you have some considerable combat experience. We have a task that requires that skillset. I promise you that it's a bit more exciting than transporting musty books, and the pay is much higher too. Meet me in the spaceport if you want to learn more."
units.italian: Mentre ti porge i chip di credito, si avvicina. "Secondo le nostre fonti, lei ha una notevole esperienza di combattimento. Abbiamo un incarico che richiede quel tipo di competenza. Le prometto che è un po' più emozionante che trasportare libri ammuffiti, e la paga è molto più alta. Mi cerchi nello spazioporto se vuole saperne di più."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|name|4863|0
units.english: Saving Artifacts
units.italian: Salvare i manufatti

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|description|4864|0
units.english: A pirate warlord has captured a collection of ancient statues from Winter. Go to <destination> in order to bring them to <origin>, where they will be safe.
units.italian: Un signore della guerra pirata ha preso una collezione di statue antiche da Winter. Vai su <destination> per riportarle su <origin>, dove saranno al sicuro.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|The librarian you met earlier flags you down in the spaceport. "Glad you could join me, Captain <last>. We've gotten word of a pirate warlord down south who fancies himself an art collector. Calls himself the Lokust, and his gang the Pestilance - names intentionally misspelled." He wrinkles his nose as if he's smelled something repulsive. "Given your history, I trust you're familiar with the Conservatory?" He doesn't wait for a response. "The shipment contained ancient Greek statues and was on its way there as part of a rotating exhibition, but our original transport was... unable to contend with the piracy threat in frontier regions. As a result, the shipment was 'diverted' to Greenrock, where the warlord in question is based. We want you to go to Greenrock and get these statues back any way you can, and then return with them back here. Our payment should cover the cost of any briberies you might have to make."|4872|0
units.english: The librarian you met earlier flags you down in the spaceport. "Glad you could join me, Captain <last>. We've gotten word of a pirate warlord down south who fancies himself an art collector. Calls himself the Lokust, and his gang the Pestilance - names intentionally misspelled." He wrinkles his nose as if he's smelled something repulsive. "Given your history, I trust you're familiar with the Conservatory?" He doesn't wait for a response. "The shipment contained ancient Greek statues and was on its way there as part of a rotating exhibition, but our original transport was... unable to contend with the piracy threat in frontier regions. As a result, the shipment was 'diverted' to Greenrock, where the warlord in question is based. We want you to go to Greenrock and get these statues back any way you can, and then return with them back here. Our payment should cover the cost of any briberies you might have to make."
units.italian: La bibliotecaria che hai conosciuto prima ti ferma nello spazioporto. "Sono contenta che sia venuto, Capitano <last>. Ci è arrivata voce di un signore della guerra pirata, a sud, che si atteggia a collezionista d'arte. Si fa chiamare il Lokust, e la sua banda la Pestilance: nomi volutamente scritti male." Arriccia il naso come se avesse sentito qualcosa di ripugnante. "Vista la sua storia, immagino che conosca il Conservatorio?" Non aspetta risposta. "La spedizione conteneva statue greche antiche ed era diretta là come parte di una mostra itinerante, ma il nostro trasporto originale non è stato... in grado di reggere la minaccia della pirateria nelle regioni di frontiera. Di conseguenza la spedizione è stata 'dirottata' a Greenrock, dove ha base il signore della guerra in questione. Vogliamo che vada su Greenrock e recuperi queste statue in qualsiasi modo, e poi torni qui con loro. Il nostro pagamento dovrebbe coprire il costo di eventuali tangenti che dovesse versare."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"Why can't you get the Navy involved with this?"|4875|0
units.english: "Why can't you get the Navy involved with this?"
units.italian: "Perché non coinvolgete la Marina?"

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"Why should I bring them back to Alexandria? Don't they belong to the Conservatory?"|4876|0
units.english: "Why should I bring them back to Alexandria? Don't they belong to the Conservatory?"
units.italian: "Perché dovrei riportarle alla Alexandria? Non appartengono al Conservatorio?"

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"How am I supposed to find those statues? They could be anywhere on that planet."|4878|0
units.english: "How am I supposed to find those statues? They could be anywhere on that planet."
units.italian: "Come dovrei fare a trovare quelle statue? Potrebbero essere ovunque su quel pianeta."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"I can handle some pirates. I'll get those statues back."|4880|0
units.english: "I can handle some pirates. I'll get those statues back."
units.italian: "So gestire dei pirati. Recupererò quelle statue."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"No way am I risking my life for some hunks of marble. Find someone else."|4882|0
units.english: "No way am I risking my life for some hunks of marble. Find someone else."
units.italian: "Non ci penso nemmeno a rischiare la vita per dei pezzi di marmo. Trovate qualcun altro."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	The librarian squints at you in a manner that suggests that the answer is obvious. "The Navy doesn't consider it worth the risk. Greenrock is 'not in their jurisdiction,' they say. So the most respected library in the galaxy has to resort to hiring privateers."|4884|0
units.english: The librarian squints at you in a manner that suggests that the answer is obvious. "The Navy doesn't consider it worth the risk. Greenrock is 'not in their jurisdiction,' they say. So the most respected library in the galaxy has to resort to hiring privateers."
units.italian: La bibliotecaria ti guarda socchiudendo gli occhi, in un modo che suggerisce che la risposta è ovvia. "La Marina non ritiene che valga il rischio. Greenrock 'non è nella loro giurisdizione', dicono. Così la biblioteca più rispettata della galassia deve ricorrere a dei corsari."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"The rotating exhibition was a new partnership with the Conservatory. Previously we had been hesitant to transport our valuables to frontier regions, but in this new partnership we decided to try shipping some of our artifacts to more distant planets, so that they too could benefit from seeing our collection. Those statues were part of that shipment. Evidently we were mistaken. Those statues are not safe as long as they're in the South."|4887|0
units.english: "The rotating exhibition was a new partnership with the Conservatory. Previously we had been hesitant to transport our valuables to frontier regions, but in this new partnership we decided to try shipping some of our artifacts to more distant planets, so that they too could benefit from seeing our collection. Those statues were part of that shipment. Evidently we were mistaken. Those statues are not safe as long as they're in the South."
units.italian: "La mostra itinerante era una nuova collaborazione con il Conservatorio. Prima eravamo restii a trasportare i nostri beni nelle regioni di frontiera, ma con questa nuova collaborazione abbiamo deciso di provare a spedire alcuni manufatti su pianeti più lontani, perché anche loro potessero trarre vantaggio dal vedere la nostra collezione. Quelle statue facevano parte di quella spedizione. Evidentemente ci siamo sbagliati. Quelle statue non sono al sicuro finché restano nel Sud."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"Lucky for you, Lokust does not seem particularly attached to his 'booty.' If you must, offer him a large sum of money, and he will most likely be willing to part with them. However, if there is something you can do to get those statues back without allowing your money to fall into the hands of a criminal, I would suggest that course of action instead."|4890|0
units.english: "Lucky for you, Lokust does not seem particularly attached to his 'booty.' If you must, offer him a large sum of money, and he will most likely be willing to part with them. However, if there is something you can do to get those statues back without allowing your money to fall into the hands of a criminal, I would suggest that course of action instead."
units.italian: "Per sua fortuna, il Lokust non sembra particolarmente affezionato al suo 'bottino'. Se deve, gli offra una grossa somma di denaro, e molto probabilmente sarà disposto a separarsene. Se però c'è qualcosa che può fare per riavere quelle statue senza far finire i suoi soldi nelle mani di un criminale, le suggerirei quella strada."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"Excellent. You're doing a service to humanity's cultural memory."|4893|0
units.english: "Excellent. You're doing a service to humanity's cultural memory."
units.italian: "Eccellente. Sta rendendo un servizio alla memoria culturale dell'umanità."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|You hustle through the crowded markets, pistol by your side, looking for any sign of the statues. After a while you come across a storefront with a crudely painted sign that reads "Fine Art and Cultural Treasures." Not seeing any better leads, you go in.|4897|0
units.english: You hustle through the crowded markets, pistol by your side, looking for any sign of the statues. After a while you come across a storefront with a crudely painted sign that reads "Fine Art and Cultural Treasures." Not seeing any better leads, you go in.
units.italian: Ti fai largo in fretta fra i mercati affollati, pistola al fianco, in cerca di qualsiasi traccia delle statue. Dopo un po' arrivi davanti a una vetrina con un'insegna dipinta in modo grossolano che recita "Arte pregiata e tesori culturali". Non vedendo piste migliori, entri.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	The inside is damp and poorly lit, but you can make out various paintings, manuscripts, and other expensive-looking items. "How can I help you?" the store clerk asks in a disarmingly friendly voice.|4898|0
units.english: The inside is damp and poorly lit, but you can make out various paintings, manuscripts, and other expensive-looking items. "How can I help you?" the store clerk asks in a disarmingly friendly voice.
units.italian: L'interno è umido e poco illuminato, ma riesci a distinguere vari dipinti, manoscritti e altri oggetti dall'aria costosa. "Come posso aiutarla?" chiede il commesso con una voce amichevole in modo disarmante.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"You don't happen to know of a local warlord named Lokust, do you?"|4900|0
units.english: "You don't happen to know of a local warlord named Lokust, do you?"
units.italian: "Non è che per caso conosce un signore della guerra locale di nome Lokust?"

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"Have you had any Greek statues pass by through here?"|4901|0
units.english: "Have you had any Greek statues pass by through here?"
units.italian: "Sono passate di qui delle statue greche?"

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	The clerk laughs. "You're trying to get Alexandria's shipment back, aren't you?" Before you can answer, he continues. "If you want my client Lokust's statues, I'm afraid you're gonna have to pay a pretty penny for them. 500,000 credits is his asking price."|4902|0
units.english: The clerk laughs. "You're trying to get Alexandria's shipment back, aren't you?" Before you can answer, he continues. "If you want my client Lokust's statues, I'm afraid you're gonna have to pay a pretty penny for them. 500,000 credits is his asking price."
units.italian: Il commesso ride. "Stai cercando di recuperare la spedizione di Alexandria, vero?" Prima che tu possa rispondere, continua. "Se vuoi le statue del mio cliente Lokust, temo che dovrai pagarle un bel po'. Il suo prezzo è 500.000 crediti."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"Alright, I'll pay."|4904|0
units.english: "Alright, I'll pay."
units.italian: "Va bene, pago."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"Can't we negotiate?"|4906|0
units.english: "Can't we negotiate?"
units.italian: "Non possiamo trattare?"

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"I can't pay that much!"|4907|0
units.english: "I can't pay that much!"
units.italian: "Non posso pagare tanto!"

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"Sorry, his price is firm. I'm just the dealer - I don't make those decisions." A smirk begins to crawl across his face, and he leans in. "Look, I have no love for Lokust. Always jacking up his cut of the sale, threatening my customers, you get the idea. Not to mention my debts to him." The last part he says in a less bold tone. "What I'm saying is, I wouldn't mind if someone like you took him out. He's a real wacko, always going on about duels and other bull. If I were you, I'd challenge him to one. If he doesn't accept, call him a coward. That's sure to get him riled up." He wheezes in a way vaguely reminiscent of a laugh. "As a reward, I'll give you the statues for free if you come back, but you gotta take out his whole crew, right? Don't want any of his underlings coming for me."|4908|0
units.english: "Sorry, his price is firm. I'm just the dealer - I don't make those decisions." A smirk begins to crawl across his face, and he leans in. "Look, I have no love for Lokust. Always jacking up his cut of the sale, threatening my customers, you get the idea. Not to mention my debts to him." The last part he says in a less bold tone. "What I'm saying is, I wouldn't mind if someone like you took him out. He's a real wacko, always going on about duels and other bull. If I were you, I'd challenge him to one. If he doesn't accept, call him a coward. That's sure to get him riled up." He wheezes in a way vaguely reminiscent of a laugh. "As a reward, I'll give you the statues for free if you come back, but you gotta take out his whole crew, right? Don't want any of his underlings coming for me."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, il suo prezzo è fisso. Io sono solo il rivenditore, non prendo queste decisioni." Un sorriso sfrontato comincia a farsi strada sul suo viso, e si avvicina. "Senti, il Lokust non mi è per niente simpatico. Alza sempre la sua parte sulla vendita, minaccia i miei clienti, hai capito l'idea. Per non parlare dei miei debiti con lui." Quest'ultima parte la dice con un tono meno baldanzoso. "Quello che voglio dire è che non mi dispiacerebbe se uno come te lo togliesse di mezzo. È un vero squilibrato, parla sempre di duelli e altre scemenze. Se fossi in te, lo sfiderei. Se non accetta, dagli del codardo. Così di sicuro lo fai arrabbiare." Sbuffa in un modo che ricorda vagamente una risata. "Come ricompensa, ti darò le statue gratis se torni, ma devi eliminare tutto il suo equipaggio, intesi? Non voglio che qualcuno dei suoi scagnozzi venga a cercarmi."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"Never mind, I'll pay."|4910|0
units.english: "Never mind, I'll pay."
units.italian: "Lascia perdere, pago."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"All right, I'll fight him."|4912|0
units.english: "All right, I'll fight him."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo affronterò."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"Heh, good choice. If you're worried about his crew, don't be. I'm sure if Alexandria thinks you're good enough to hire, you can handle it. I'll call him up so you don't have to go chasing him down." He pulls up a hologram communicator and noticeably stiffens up. "Hello Lokust. Hope you're not too busy right now, because someone wants to see you." He turns the communicator towards you, and you see a man in clothes more befitting of a prince than a pirate.|4913|0
units.english: "Heh, good choice. If you're worried about his crew, don't be. I'm sure if Alexandria thinks you're good enough to hire, you can handle it. I'll call him up so you don't have to go chasing him down." He pulls up a hologram communicator and noticeably stiffens up. "Hello Lokust. Hope you're not too busy right now, because someone wants to see you." He turns the communicator towards you, and you see a man in clothes more befitting of a prince than a pirate.
units.italian: "Eh, buona scelta. Se ti preoccupa il suo equipaggio, non farlo. Sono certo che se Alexandria ti ritiene all'altezza di essere assunta, saprai cavartela. Lo chiamo io, così non devi andarlo a cercare." Apre un comunicatore olografico e si irrigidisce visibilmente. "Salve Lokust. Spero che non sia troppo impegnato, perché qualcuno vuole vederla." Gira il comunicatore verso di te, e vedi un uomo in abiti più adatti a un principe che a un pirata.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"Fight me."|4915|0
units.english: "Fight me."
units.italian: "Affrontami."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"I've heard you're willing to duel over those statues you stole from the Library of Alexandria?"|4916|0
units.english: "I've heard you're willing to duel over those statues you stole from the Library of Alexandria?"
units.italian: "Ho sentito che è disposto a duellare per quelle statue che ha rubato alla Biblioteca di Alessandria?"

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	The communicator's audio quality is evidently not the highest, as his laugh is barely more than static. "I don't just throw hands with anyone, you see. That would make me little better than some barroom drunk. I have standards. Why should I waste my time with you?"|4917|0
units.english: The communicator's audio quality is evidently not the highest, as his laugh is barely more than static. "I don't just throw hands with anyone, you see. That would make me little better than some barroom drunk. I have standards. Why should I waste my time with you?"
units.italian: La qualità audio del comunicatore evidentemente non è delle migliori, visto che la sua risata è poco più che una scarica statica. "Non faccio a botte con chiunque, sai. Mi renderebbe poco meglio di un ubriaco da taverna. Ho dei principi. Perché dovrei perdere tempo con te?"

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"Oh, I see. You're too cowardly to fight."|4919|0
units.english: "Oh, I see. You're too cowardly to fight."
units.italian: "Oh, capisco. Sei troppo codardo per combattere."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	"I didn't realize 'The Great Lokust' was such a weakling."|4920|0
units.english: "I didn't realize 'The Great Lokust' was such a weakling."
units.italian: "Non sapevo che 'il Grande Lokust' fosse così debole."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	He becomes visibly enraged the moment you're finished talking. "I will not stand these insults to my honor! We meet in the sky. Bring all of your weaponry to bear, for it is the last time you will use them."|4921|0
units.english: He becomes visibly enraged the moment you're finished talking. "I will not stand these insults to my honor! We meet in the sky. Bring all of your weaponry to bear, for it is the last time you will use them."
units.italian: Diventa visibilmente furioso appena hai finito di parlare. "Non tollererò questi insulti al mio onore! Ci vediamo in cielo. Porta tutte le tue armi, perché sarà l'ultima volta che le userai."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	The communication cuts off. "He always uses that same line," the clerk says, rolling his eyes.|4922|0
units.english: The communication cuts off. "He always uses that same line," the clerk says, rolling his eyes.
units.italian: La comunicazione si interrompe. "Usa sempre la stessa battuta," dice il commesso, alzando gli occhi al cielo.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 2|	He looks almost disappointed. "Alright, here's the statues. Don't forget to tell any friends that might be redecorating about our low prices."|4928|0
units.english: He looks almost disappointed. "Alright, here's the statues. Don't forget to tell any friends that might be redecorating about our low prices."
units.italian: Sembra quasi deluso. "Va bene, ecco le statue. Non dimenticare di dire ai tuoi amici che stanno rinnovando gli arredi dei nostri prezzi bassi."

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 3|name|4932|0
units.english: Duel Lokust
units.italian: Duello con Lokust

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 3|description|4933|0
units.english: Defeat Lokust as part of a bargain to acquire the stolen statues.
units.italian: Sconfiggi Lokust nell'ambito di un accordo per ottenere le statue rubate.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 3|The clerk rushes up to your ship as soon as it finishes landing on the tarmac. He begins to shake your hand vigorously. "You got rid of all his cronies, yeah?" You nod. "Good. Take the statues into your ship and don't draw attention to yourself. Don't want them stolen, y'know." A sarcastic grin emerges on his face.|4967|0
units.english: The clerk rushes up to your ship as soon as it finishes landing on the tarmac. He begins to shake your hand vigorously. "You got rid of all his cronies, yeah?" You nod. "Good. Take the statues into your ship and don't draw attention to yourself. Don't want them stolen, y'know." A sarcastic grin emerges on his face.
units.italian: Il commesso si precipita verso la tua nave appena questa finisce di atterrare sulla pista. Comincia a stringerti la mano con vigore. "Ti sei sbarazzato di tutti i suoi sgherri, eh?" Annuisti. "Bene. Porta le statue sulla tua nave e non attirare l'attenzione. Non voglio che me le rubino, sai." Sul suo viso compare un sorriso sarcastico.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 3|	You load up the statues, taking care not to attract unwanted attention as well as attempting to avoid creating any new damage. From what you can tell, they're in remarkable condition considering that they were in the hands of a pirate warlord just a few hours ago.|4968|0
units.english: You load up the statues, taking care not to attract unwanted attention as well as attempting to avoid creating any new damage. From what you can tell, they're in remarkable condition considering that they were in the hands of a pirate warlord just a few hours ago.
units.italian: Carichi le statue, facendo attenzione a non attirare attenzioni indesiderate e cercando di non causare nuovi danni. Da quanto puoi vedere, sono in condizioni notevoli, considerando che solo poche ore fa erano nelle mani di un signore della guerra pirata.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 4|name|4972|0
units.english: Saving Artifacts
units.italian: Salvare i manufatti

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 4|description|4973|0
units.english: Bring the statues back to <planet>.
units.italian: Riporta le statue su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 4|dialog|4987|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize you haven't acquired the statues from Greenrock yet. Better return to Shaula to make sure Lokust is defeated before claiming them on the planet.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi di non aver ancora preso le statue da Greenrock. Meglio tornare su Shaula per assicurarti che Lokust sia stato sconfitto prima di reclamarle sul pianeta.

units.id: mission:Saving Artifacts 4|You dock on the station and the librarian from earlier comes to greet you almost immediately. "Get the dockworkers, stat!" he calls, then turns to you. "You did get the statues, right?" He relaxes once he sees you nod. As the cargo is unloaded, the librarian hurries up to inspect your haul and shakes his head. "There's damage, but I suppose it's the best we could've hoped for considering the circumstances." He sighs. "Thank you for your help, Captain <last>. You've provided an invaluable service." After paying you <payment>, he turns back towards the statues, focusing his attention on their safe unloading.|4991|0
units.english: You dock on the station and the librarian from earlier comes to greet you almost immediately. "Get the dockworkers, stat!" he calls, then turns to you. "You did get the statues, right?" He relaxes once he sees you nod. As the cargo is unloaded, the librarian hurries up to inspect your haul and shakes his head. "There's damage, but I suppose it's the best we could've hoped for considering the circumstances." He sighs. "Thank you for your help, Captain <last>. You've provided an invaluable service." After paying you <payment>, he turns back towards the statues, focusing his attention on their safe unloading.
units.italian: Attracchi alla stazione e la bibliotecaria di prima viene quasi subito a salutarti. "Chiamate gli scaricatori, subito!" grida, poi si volta verso di te. "Le hai prese le statue, vero?" Si rilassa quando ti vede annuire. Mentre il carico viene scaricato, la bibliotecaria si affretta a ispezionare il bottino e scuote la testa. "Ci sono dei danni, ma suppongo sia il meglio che potessimo sperare, considerate le circostanze." Sospira. "Grazie per l'aiuto, Capitano <last>. Ha reso un servizio inestimabile." Dopo averti pagato <payment>, si volta di nuovo verso le statue, concentrandosi sul loro scarico in sicurezza.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|name|4998|0
units.english: Dragonriders
units.italian: Cavalcaladri

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|description|4999|0
units.english: A lively man named Karengo and a few passionate youths are traveling to see the dragons on <stopovers>. Take the group there, then return them to <destination> once they've finished.
units.italian: Un uomo vivace di nome Karengo e alcuni giovani appassionati viaggiano per vedere i draghi su <stopovers>. Porta il gruppo là, poi riportali su <destination> quando hanno finito.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|Upon entering the spaceport, you notice that the local bar seems to be more active than usual. The moment you pass through the bar door, a strong drink is pressed into your hand. You look at it, dumbfounded, and then look up to the waiter who gave it to you. "Compliments of Mr. Karengo," he says, nodding his head towards a crowd of people, mostly young men, before moving on.|5010|0
units.english: Upon entering the spaceport, you notice that the local bar seems to be more active than usual. The moment you pass through the bar door, a strong drink is pressed into your hand. You look at it, dumbfounded, and then look up to the waiter who gave it to you. "Compliments of Mr. Karengo," he says, nodding his head towards a crowd of people, mostly young men, before moving on.
units.italian: Entrando nello spazioporto, noti che il bar locale sembra più animato del solito. Appena varchi la porta del bar, ti mettono in mano un drink forte. Lo guardi, esterrefatto, poi alzi gli occhi sul cameriere che te l'ha dato. "Omaggio del signor Karengo," dice, accennando con il capo verso un capannello di persone, in gran parte giovani, prima di allontanarsi.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	(Head over to "Mr. Karengo.")|5012|0
