units.english: (Head over to "Mr. Karengo.")
units.italian: (Vai dal "signor Karengo".)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	(Leave.)|5013|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	As you make your way over, you note that nearly everyone in the bar has the same drink you do. In the middle of the crowd, a large, heavily muscled, and tattooed man is gesticulating wildly, apparently telling a story.|5015|0
units.english: As you make your way over, you note that nearly everyone in the bar has the same drink you do. In the middle of the crowd, a large, heavily muscled, and tattooed man is gesticulating wildly, apparently telling a story.
units.italian: Mentre ti avvicini, noti che quasi tutti nel bar hanno il tuo stesso drink. Al centro del capannello, un uomo grande, molto muscoloso e tatuato gesticola con veemenza, evidentemente intento a raccontare una storia.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	(Go listen to the man.)|5017|0
units.english: (Go listen to the man.)
units.italian: (Vai ad ascoltare l'uomo.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	(Leave.)|5018|0
units.english: (Leave.)
units.italian: (Vattene.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	"... so then he asks me, 'Have you ever ridden one?' And I look back at this crazy joithead and I say, 'You're a crazy joithead.' But he's got me thinking, y'know? Nobody has ever ridden one. Least, not nobody that could talk after." He lets out a sharp laugh, then raises his voice. "So I ask you all: who wants to join Karengo to make history? Who wants to ride a dragon? I'll supply the jetpacks, you supply the courage."|5020|0
units.english: "... so then he asks me, 'Have you ever ridden one?' And I look back at this crazy joithead and I say, 'You're a crazy joithead.' But he's got me thinking, y'know? Nobody has ever ridden one. Least, not nobody that could talk after." He lets out a sharp laugh, then raises his voice. "So I ask you all: who wants to join Karengo to make history? Who wants to ride a dragon? I'll supply the jetpacks, you supply the courage."
units.italian: "... e allora mi fa: 'Ne hai mai cavalcato uno?' E io guardo questo pazzoide e gli dico: 'Sei un pazzoide.' Ma mi ha fatto pensare, sai? Nessuno ne ha mai cavalcato uno. Almeno, nessuno che poi potesse ancora parlare." Scoppia in una risata secca, poi alza la voce. "Quindi ve lo chiedo: chi vuole unirsi a Karengo per fare la storia? Chi vuole cavalcare un drago? Io metto gli zainetti a reazione, voi mettete il coraggio."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	You've heard the stories of the dragons flying through Skymoot's skies as a child. Great beasts; graceful and dangerous, the apex predators of the air; they are strikingly similar to the dragons described in ancient legends. Skymoot is host to many dangerous creatures, and these living myths hold a place at the top of that list.|5021|0
units.english: You've heard the stories of the dragons flying through Skymoot's skies as a child. Great beasts; graceful and dangerous, the apex predators of the air; they are strikingly similar to the dragons described in ancient legends. Skymoot is host to many dangerous creatures, and these living myths hold a place at the top of that list.
units.italian: Da bambino hai sentito le storie dei draghi che solcano i cieli di Skymoot. Bestie enormi; eleganti e pericolose, predatori al vertice dell'aria; sono straordinariamente simili ai draghi descritti nelle leggende antiche. Skymoot ospita molte creature pericolose, e questi miti viventi occupano il primo posto della lista.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	A cheer goes up from the men, especially the drunk ones. Karengo starts to hand out death and accident waivers and collect money for the expedition. Suddenly, his expression darkens as he cocks his head, listening to an earpiece. "Listen up!" he yells. "Seems my regular pilot got in the way of some less reputable folk, and my replacement pilot lost his balls this evening and can't find 'em! We need ourselves a ship and a captain to bring this lot to <stopovers>! Who's brave enough? Who else wants to make history?"|5022|0
units.english: A cheer goes up from the men, especially the drunk ones. Karengo starts to hand out death and accident waivers and collect money for the expedition. Suddenly, his expression darkens as he cocks his head, listening to an earpiece. "Listen up!" he yells. "Seems my regular pilot got in the way of some less reputable folk, and my replacement pilot lost his balls this evening and can't find 'em! We need ourselves a ship and a captain to bring this lot to <stopovers>! Who's brave enough? Who else wants to make history?"
units.italian: Un boato di approvazione si alza dagli uomini, soprattutto da quelli ubriachi. Karengo comincia a distribuire liberatorie per morte e infortuni e a raccogliere soldi per la spedizione. All'improvviso la sua espressione si incupisce mentre inclina la testa, in ascolto di un auricolare. "Ascoltate!" urla. "A quanto pare il mio pilota di fiducia si è messo in mezzo a gente poco raccomandabile, e il pilota sostituto stasera ha perso le palle e non le trova più! Ci serve una nave e un capitano per portare questa gente su <stopovers>! Chi è abbastanza coraggioso? Chi altro vuole fare la storia?"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	"Captain <last>, at your service. We leave at dawn!"|5024|0
units.english: "Captain <last>, at your service. We leave at dawn!"
units.italian: "Capitano <last>, a rapporto. Partiamo all'alba!"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	"Am I getting paid?"|5026|0
units.english: "Am I getting paid?"
units.italian: "Vengo pagato?"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	(Stay silent.)|5028|0
units.english: (Stay silent.)
units.italian: (Resta in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	You remain silent as Karengo surveys the crowd. "What, nobody with a ship has the cojones to make history? I didn't know this bar was full of a bunch of sissies."|5029|0
units.english: You remain silent as Karengo surveys the crowd. "What, nobody with a ship has the cojones to make history? I didn't know this bar was full of a bunch of sissies."
units.italian: Resti in silenzio mentre Karengo scruta la folla. "Che c'è, nessuno con una nave ha le palle per fare la storia? Non sapevo che questo bar fosse pieno di mammolette."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	One captain in the back of the bar jumps up. "Mama didn't raise no sissy! I'll bring you all to Skymoot." A cheer rises up from the crowd and the captain is treated to several rounds of drinks. After the captain and all the passengers are sufficiently drunk, they saunter their way out of the bar, drunkenly singing about adventure as they go.|5030|0
units.english: One captain in the back of the bar jumps up. "Mama didn't raise no sissy! I'll bring you all to Skymoot." A cheer rises up from the crowd and the captain is treated to several rounds of drinks. After the captain and all the passengers are sufficiently drunk, they saunter their way out of the bar, drunkenly singing about adventure as they go.
units.italian: Un capitano in fondo al bar salta su. "Mia madre non ha cresciuto una mammoletta! Vi porto tutti su Skymoot." Un boato si alza dalla folla e il capitano si vede offrire diversi giri di drink. Dopo che il capitano e tutti i passeggeri sono ubriachi a sufficienza, si avviano fuori dal bar, cantando ubriachi di avventura mentre vanno.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	After a cheer rises up from the crowd, you're treated to several rounds of drinks by your passengers; you sense any attempt to refuse would be ignored. You're unsure of how much you drank, but it was enough to make sure that you didn't remember. You wake up significantly after dawn with empty bottles and unconscious men strewn all over the ship's mess hall. Karengo peels himself off the floor and gives you a crooked smile, shielding his eyes from the light. "Alright, <last>," he says, "let's do this."|5033|0
units.english: After a cheer rises up from the crowd, you're treated to several rounds of drinks by your passengers; you sense any attempt to refuse would be ignored. You're unsure of how much you drank, but it was enough to make sure that you didn't remember. You wake up significantly after dawn with empty bottles and unconscious men strewn all over the ship's mess hall. Karengo peels himself off the floor and gives you a crooked smile, shielding his eyes from the light. "Alright, <last>," he says, "let's do this."
units.italian: Dopo che un boato si alza dalla folla, i tuoi passeggeri ti offrono diversi giri di drink; capisci che qualsiasi tentativo di rifiutare sarebbe ignorato. Non sei sicuro di quanto hai bevuto, ma è bastato a farti dimenticare. Ti svegli ben dopo l'alba con bottiglie vuote e uomini privi di sensi sparsi per la mensa della nave. Karengo si stacca dal pavimento e ti rivolge un sorriso storto, riparandosi gli occhi dalla luce. "Bene, <last>," dice, "facciamolo."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	The crowd's eyes turn to you. Karengo squints, then laughs. "Ha! What kind of question is that? Of course you're getting paid. <payment> to bring myself and these other fine folks to <stopovers> and back - <bunks> of us total. What say you?" The crowd watches you with eager anticipation.|5036|0
units.english: The crowd's eyes turn to you. Karengo squints, then laughs. "Ha! What kind of question is that? Of course you're getting paid. <payment> to bring myself and these other fine folks to <stopovers> and back - <bunks> of us total. What say you?" The crowd watches you with eager anticipation.
units.italian: Gli occhi della folla si voltano verso di te. Karengo strizza gli occhi, poi ride. "Ah! Che razza di domanda è? Certo che vieni pagato. <payment> per portare me e questi altri bravi ragazzi su <stopovers> e ritorno, <bunks> in tutto. Che ne dici?" La folla ti osserva con impazienza.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	"Works for me. We leave tomorrow."|5038|0
units.english: "Works for me. We leave tomorrow."
units.italian: "Per me va bene. Partiamo domani."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	"<payment> won't be enough. I'm out."|5040|0
units.english: "<payment> won't be enough. I'm out."
units.italian: "<payment> non basta. Ci rinuncio."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	You're treated to some jeering and rude looks as you leave the bar.|5041|0
units.english: You're treated to some jeering and rude looks as you leave the bar.
units.italian: Ti becchi qualche fischio e qualche sguardo ostile mentre esci dal bar.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|Karengo directs you down through the atmosphere of Skymoot, steering clear of the usual tourist areas and, you realize, of the local law enforcement. As you're putting down in a clearing halfway up a mountain, you hear an otherworldly screech as your ship lurches violently to one side. You would have been thrown to the floor if you hadn't been strapped in.|5047|0
units.english: Karengo directs you down through the atmosphere of Skymoot, steering clear of the usual tourist areas and, you realize, of the local law enforcement. As you're putting down in a clearing halfway up a mountain, you hear an otherworldly screech as your ship lurches violently to one side. You would have been thrown to the floor if you hadn't been strapped in.
units.italian: Karengo ti guida giù attraverso l'atmosfera di Skymoot, tenendosi lontano dalle solite zone turistiche e, capisci, dalle forze dell'ordine locali. Mentre atterri in una radura a metà di una montagna, senti uno stridio ultraterreno e la nave si inclina violentemente da un lato. Saresti finito a terra se non fossi stato allacciato.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	"Look lively, lads!" shouts Karengo, the only person still standing. "Your chariot awaits!" He double-checks the jetpacks on the backs of each of the eight men, or "Dragonriders," as they creatively branded themselves during the first night of the voyage, then opens the side hatch and hurls the Dragonriders out the door before jumping himself.|5048|0
units.english: "Look lively, lads!" shouts Karengo, the only person still standing. "Your chariot awaits!" He double-checks the jetpacks on the backs of each of the eight men, or "Dragonriders," as they creatively branded themselves during the first night of the voyage, then opens the side hatch and hurls the Dragonriders out the door before jumping himself.
units.italian: "Svegli, ragazzi!" grida Karengo, l'unico ancora in piedi. "Il vostro carro vi aspetta!" Ricontrolla gli zainetti a reazione sulla schiena di ciascuno degli otto uomini, o "Cavalcaladri", come si sono creativamente ribattezzati durante la prima notte di viaggio, poi apre il portello laterale e scaraventa fuori i Cavalcaladri prima di saltare lui stesso.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	After the group has left, you land - this time undisturbed - and pull up every external camera you have to watch the action.|5049|0
units.english: After the group has left, you land - this time undisturbed - and pull up every external camera you have to watch the action.
units.italian: Dopo che il gruppo se n'è andato, atterri, questa volta senza disturbi, e attivi tutte le telecamere esterne per guardare l'azione.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	The dragons of Skymoot you learned about on the "Xenofauna and Flora" channel were different from the dragons of mythology, but the beasts you see today aren't quite what you learned about, either. For one, the creatures flying outside your window are faster than you thought possible, or perhaps the ones on the show had been drugged to make them easier to film.|5050|0
units.english: The dragons of Skymoot you learned about on the "Xenofauna and Flora" channel were different from the dragons of mythology, but the beasts you see today aren't quite what you learned about, either. For one, the creatures flying outside your window are faster than you thought possible, or perhaps the ones on the show had been drugged to make them easier to film.
units.italian: I draghi di Skymoot che avevi conosciuto sul canale "Xenofauna e Flora" erano diversi dai draghi della mitologia, ma le bestie che vedi oggi non sono proprio quelle che avevi imparato a conoscere. Tanto per cominciare, le creature che volano fuori dal tuo finestrino sono più veloci di quanto pensavi fosse possibile, o forse quelle del programma erano drogate per renderle più facili da filmare.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	A quick survey of the scene shows that Karengo has tagged three dragons with some sort of harmless marker gun to make them easier to track. Eight of the Dragonriders, Karengo included, are chasing the largest one, which is missing part of a tooth and has blackened scales from where it hit your ship's shields. The last Dragonrider is nowhere in sight.|5051|0
units.english: A quick survey of the scene shows that Karengo has tagged three dragons with some sort of harmless marker gun to make them easier to track. Eight of the Dragonriders, Karengo included, are chasing the largest one, which is missing part of a tooth and has blackened scales from where it hit your ship's shields. The last Dragonrider is nowhere in sight.
units.italian: Una rapida occhiata alla scena mostra che Karengo ha marcato tre draghi con una specie di fucile a vernice innocuo per renderli più facili da seguire. Otto dei Cavalcaladri, Karengo compreso, stanno inseguendo il più grande, a cui manca parte di un dente e che ha le squame annerite nel punto in cui ha colpito gli scudi della tua nave. Dell'ultimo Cavalcaladro non c'è traccia.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	Suddenly, proximity sensors go off on the starboard side and a camera shows something - or someone - bounce off your shield and tumble down the mountain.|5052|0
units.english: Suddenly, proximity sensors go off on the starboard side and a camera shows something - or someone - bounce off your shield and tumble down the mountain.
units.italian: All'improvviso scattano i sensori di prossimità sul lato di dritta e una telecamera mostra qualcosa, o qualcuno, che rimbalza contro il tuo scudo e rotola giù per la montagna.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	(Announce that I'm leaving.)|5054|0
units.english: (Announce that I'm leaving.)
units.italian: (Annuncia che me ne vado.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	(Stay and watch the Dragonriders.)|5056|0
units.english: (Stay and watch the Dragonriders.)
units.italian: (Resta e guarda i Cavalcaladri.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	(Take off and leave everybody else behind.)|5057|0
units.english: (Take off and leave everybody else behind.)
units.italian: (Decolla e lascia tutti gli altri indietro.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	Checking your camera feeds again, you see that object rolling down the hill is indeed a body. On another monitor, one of the Dragonriders is keeping just above a dragon, attempting to lower himself down. The dragon rolls in midair, its wing catching the man and sending him flying out of control. Fortunately, a leafy tree branch prevents any further physical harm. Meanwhile, a second dragon is pursuing another one of the Dragonriders.|5059|0
units.english: Checking your camera feeds again, you see that object rolling down the hill is indeed a body. On another monitor, one of the Dragonriders is keeping just above a dragon, attempting to lower himself down. The dragon rolls in midair, its wing catching the man and sending him flying out of control. Fortunately, a leafy tree branch prevents any further physical harm. Meanwhile, a second dragon is pursuing another one of the Dragonriders.
units.italian: Controllando di nuovo le telecamere, vedi che l'oggetto che rotola giù per la collina è davvero un corpo. Su un altro monitor, uno dei Cavalcaladri si tiene appena sopra un drago, cercando di calarsi su di esso. Il drago si gira in aria, l'ala colpisce l'uomo e lo manda a volare fuori controllo. Per fortuna un ramo frondoso gli risparmia altri danni fisici. Nel frattempo, un secondo drago sta inseguendo un altro dei Cavalcaladri.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	(Get everyone out of there.)|5061|0
units.english: (Get everyone out of there.)
units.italian: (Tira fuori tutti da lì.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	(Take off and leave everybody else behind.)|5063|0
units.english: (Take off and leave everybody else behind.)
units.italian: (Decolla e lascia tutti gli altri indietro.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	The ship takes off with a roar at your touch. Between the cries of the dragons, the sound of the engines, and the air rushing past, you can barely hear the fear and betrayal in the voices of the men you've left behind.|5067|0
units.english: The ship takes off with a roar at your touch. Between the cries of the dragons, the sound of the engines, and the air rushing past, you can barely hear the fear and betrayal in the voices of the men you've left behind.
units.italian: La nave decolla con un ruggito al tuo tocco. Fra i versi dei draghi, il suono dei motori e l'aria che passa, riesci a malapena a sentire la paura e il tradimento nelle voci degli uomini che hai lasciato indietro.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	You turn on the external speakers. "We are leaving," you blast to the survivors. "Get on board."|5070|0
units.english: You turn on the external speakers. "We are leaving," you blast to the survivors. "Get on board."
units.italian: Accendi gli altoparlanti esterni. "Ce ne andiamo," tuoni ai superstiti. "Salite a bordo."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	The defeated Dragonriders need no further encouragement. They beeline for the hatch and you flicker the shield to let them on deck, where they collapse, wide-eyed and panting. Karengo isn't with them. You turn to ask about him when a flicker of motion on a monitor catches your eye.|5071|0
units.english: The defeated Dragonriders need no further encouragement. They beeline for the hatch and you flicker the shield to let them on deck, where they collapse, wide-eyed and panting. Karengo isn't with them. You turn to ask about him when a flicker of motion on a monitor catches your eye.
units.italian: I Cavalcaladri sconfitti non hanno bisogno di altri incoraggiamenti. Corrono dritti verso il portello e fai lampeggiare lo scudo per farli salire sul ponte, dove crollano, con gli occhi sbarrati e il fiato corto. Karengo non è con loro. Ti volti per chiedere di lui quando un guizzo di movimento su un monitor ti cattura l'attenzione.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	Karengo is riding a dragon, gripping the ridge of scales around its neck. The dragon frantically tries to get him off, but deft application of his jetpack keeps him on top of the beast for now. He lets out wild screams of triumph as they soar through the sky and at last you can understand the appeal of this whole expedition. Your admiration is cut short by two catastrophic crashes on either side of the ship and accompanying sirens. The dragons are trying to get through.|5072|0
units.english: Karengo is riding a dragon, gripping the ridge of scales around its neck. The dragon frantically tries to get him off, but deft application of his jetpack keeps him on top of the beast for now. He lets out wild screams of triumph as they soar through the sky and at last you can understand the appeal of this whole expedition. Your admiration is cut short by two catastrophic crashes on either side of the ship and accompanying sirens. The dragons are trying to get through.
units.italian: Karengo sta cavalcando un drago, aggrappato alla cresta di squame intorno al collo. Il drago cerca freneticamente di scrollarselo di dosso, ma l'uso abile dello zainetto a reazione lo tiene per ora in cima alla bestia. Lascia uscire urla selvagge di trionfo mentre sfrecciano nel cielo, e alla fine riesci a capire il fascino di tutta questa spedizione. La tua ammirazione è interrotta da due schianti catastrofici sui due lati della nave e dalle sirene che li accompagnano. I draghi stanno cercando di passare.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	You activate your engines, and the ship takes off quickly enough to make you light-headed. "Get on board!" shouts one of the men over the external speakers as you position the ship just below Karengo and lower the shields. Scales bounce off the roof like diamonds. Karengo releases his grip on the dragon and free falls toward you, slowing at the last possible moment before dropping through the top hatch. You flick on the shields and hit the engines, hard. They respond enthusiastically, rocketing you away from the mountain and into the safety of patrolled airspace. From the cabin comes the sound of back-slapping and, surprisingly, a sob.|5073|0
units.english: You activate your engines, and the ship takes off quickly enough to make you light-headed. "Get on board!" shouts one of the men over the external speakers as you position the ship just below Karengo and lower the shields. Scales bounce off the roof like diamonds. Karengo releases his grip on the dragon and free falls toward you, slowing at the last possible moment before dropping through the top hatch. You flick on the shields and hit the engines, hard. They respond enthusiastically, rocketing you away from the mountain and into the safety of patrolled airspace. From the cabin comes the sound of back-slapping and, surprisingly, a sob.
units.italian: Attivi i motori, e la nave decolla così in fretta da farti girare la testa. "Salga a bordo!" grida uno degli uomini dagli altoparlanti esterni mentre posizioni la nave appena sotto Karengo e abbassi gli scudi. Le squame rimbalzano sul tetto come diamanti. Karengo lascia la presa sul drago e cade in caduta libera verso di te, rallentando all'ultimo momento possibile prima di infilarsi dal portello superiore. Riattivi gli scudi e dai tutto sui motori. Rispondono con entusiasmo, lanciandoti via dalla montagna verso la sicurezza dello spazio aereo pattugliato. Dalla cabina arriva il suono di pacche sulle spalle e, sorprendentemente, un singhiozzo.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|As you land and fuel up, Karengo herds the seven surviving men out of the ship. "Meet us at the bar, yeah?" he says to you. "This day deserves a celebration." You nod, but can't help but notice red eyes and wet cheeks among the rest of the Dragonriders as they shuffle off.|5077|0
units.english: As you land and fuel up, Karengo herds the seven surviving men out of the ship. "Meet us at the bar, yeah?" he says to you. "This day deserves a celebration." You nod, but can't help but notice red eyes and wet cheeks among the rest of the Dragonriders as they shuffle off.
units.italian: Mentre atterri e fai rifornimento, Karengo fa scendere dalla nave i sette uomini sopravvissuti. "Ci vediamo al bar, eh?" ti dice. "Questa giornata merita un festeggiamento." Annuisci, ma non puoi fare a meno di notare occhi rossi e guance bagnate fra gli altri Cavalcaladri mentre si allontanano strascicando i piedi.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	Later that day, you spot the Dragonriders at a corner table of the bar. The men, with the exception of Karengo, appear subdued.|5078|0
units.english: Later that day, you spot the Dragonriders at a corner table of the bar. The men, with the exception of Karengo, appear subdued.
units.italian: Più tardi quel giorno, scorgi i Cavalcaladri a un tavolo d'angolo del bar. Gli uomini, tranne Karengo, sembrano abbattuti.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	"How goes it, <last>?" he asks. "We were just raising a glass to mission success - made possible by you, of course. Great flying, Captain." The bartender arrives with a round of drinks and Karengo raises one. "To the Dragonriders!" he says.|5079|0
units.english: "How goes it, <last>?" he asks. "We were just raising a glass to mission success - made possible by you, of course. Great flying, Captain." The bartender arrives with a round of drinks and Karengo raises one. "To the Dragonriders!" he says.
units.italian: "Come va, <last>?" chiede. "Stavamo giusto alzando un bicchiere al successo della missione, reso possibile da te, naturalmente. Gran volo, Capitano." Il barista arriva con un giro di drink e Karengo ne alza uno. "Ai Cavalcaladri!" dice.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	"To the Dragonriders!"|5081|0
units.english: "To the Dragonriders!"
units.italian: "Ai Cavalcaladri!"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	"To our fallen friend!"|5082|0
units.english: "To our fallen friend!"
units.italian: "Al nostro amico caduto!"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	"I'm good, thanks."|5083|0
units.english: "I'm good, thanks."
units.italian: "Sto bene, grazie."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	Karengo gives you an unreadable look, lowers his glass, and says, "Your payment, plus Jarek's signup fees: <payment>."|5084|0
units.english: Karengo gives you an unreadable look, lowers his glass, and says, "Your payment, plus Jarek's signup fees: <payment>."
units.italian: Karengo ti lancia uno sguardo indecifrabile, abbassa il bicchiere e dice: "Il tuo pagamento, più la quota d'iscrizione di Jarek: <payment>."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	"Thanks."|5086|0
units.english: "Thanks."
units.italian: "Grazie."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	"I can't accept his money. It's not right."|5088|0
units.english: "I can't accept his money. It's not right."
units.italian: "Non posso accettare i suoi soldi. Non è giusto."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	Karengo shrugs and doesn't take it back.|5089|0
units.english: Karengo shrugs and doesn't take it back.
units.italian: Karengo alza le spalle e non se li riprende.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 1|	"Maybe I'll see you again sometime, yeah? I'm always in need of a pilot with some guts." He nods in your direction, clearly dismissing you.|5091|0
units.english: "Maybe I'll see you again sometime, yeah? I'm always in need of a pilot with some guts." He nods in your direction, clearly dismissing you.
units.italian: "Magari ci rivediamo, eh? Ho sempre bisogno di un pilota con un po' di fegato." Ti fa un cenno del capo, congedandoti chiaramente.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|name|5096|0
units.english: Karengo's Galactic Adventures
units.italian: Avventure Galattiche di Karengo

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|description|5097|0
units.english: The adventurer Karengo and five others are traveling with you as part of his "Galactic Adventures." Bring Karengo and crew to <destination> for <payment>.
units.italian: L'avventuriero Karengo e altri cinque viaggiano con te come parte delle sue "Avventure Galattiche". Porta Karengo e il suo gruppo su <destination> per <payment>.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|A boisterous laugh sounds from somewhere behind you. You haven't heard that voice since your ship was attacked by dragons.|5109|0
units.english: A boisterous laugh sounds from somewhere behind you. You haven't heard that voice since your ship was attacked by dragons.
units.italian: Una risata fragorosa arriva da qualche parte alle tue spalle. Non sentivi quella voce da quando la tua nave è stata attaccata dai draghi.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"<first>!" A huge hand claps you on the shoulder and spins you around, where you find yourself facing a large, widely grinning man.|5110|0
units.english: "<first>!" A huge hand claps you on the shoulder and spins you around, where you find yourself facing a large, widely grinning man.
units.italian: "<first>!" Una mano enorme ti colpisce la spalla e ti fa girare, e ti ritrovi davanti un uomo grande, con un sorriso larghissimo.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Remember me? Yer the best pilot I've had - that stunt to get us out of Skymoot, right out of the dragon's nest? Epic."|5111|0
units.english: "Remember me? Yer the best pilot I've had - that stunt to get us out of Skymoot, right out of the dragon's nest? Epic."
units.italian: "Ti ricordi di me? Sei il miglior pilota che abbia mai avuto: quella manovra per tirarci fuori da Skymoot, dritto dal nido dei draghi? Epica."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	A crude sign behind him reads, "Dangerous Games - Karengo's Galactic Adventures."|5112|0
units.english: A crude sign behind him reads, "Dangerous Games - Karengo's Galactic Adventures."
units.italian: Dietro di lui un'insegna rozza recita: "Giochi pericolosi - Avventure Galattiche di Karengo."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Like it?" Karengo follows your gaze. "Decided to make this an official thing. Well... an unofficial official thing. Feds wouldn't understand. Doesn't matter; I need a pilot again, and a good one. Your ship's waterproof, right?"|5113|0
units.english: "Like it?" Karengo follows your gaze. "Decided to make this an official thing. Well... an unofficial official thing. Feds wouldn't understand. Doesn't matter; I need a pilot again, and a good one. Your ship's waterproof, right?"
units.italian: "Ti piace?" Karengo segue il tuo sguardo. "Ho deciso di farne una cosa ufficiale. Beh... una cosa ufficiale non ufficiale. I federali non capirebbero. Non importa; mi serve di nuovo un pilota, e uno bravo. La tua nave è a tenuta stagna, vero?"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Uh, yeah. I think so."|5115|0
units.english: "Uh, yeah. I think so."
units.italian: "Ehm, sì. Credo di sì."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Of course."|5116|0
units.english: "Of course."
units.italian: "Certamente."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Sorry, mate. You'll have to find another pilot."|5117|0
units.english: "Sorry, mate. You'll have to find another pilot."
units.italian: "Spiacente, amico. Dovrai trovare un altro pilota."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Karengo laughs. "If they can handle space, I think they can handle some water. I've got a group of lads and ladies here rarin' to see some quoijuu in heat, right up close'n'personal. They've all got their own subpods, so how's about we load up and head out in the next few hours. Good? Good."|5119|0
units.english: Karengo laughs. "If they can handle space, I think they can handle some water. I've got a group of lads and ladies here rarin' to see some quoijuu in heat, right up close'n'personal. They've all got their own subpods, so how's about we load up and head out in the next few hours. Good? Good."
units.italian: Karengo ride. "Se se la cavano nello spazio, credo che se la caveranno anche sott'acqua. Ho qui un gruppo di ragazzi e ragazze impazienti di vedere dei quoijuu in calore, da vicino e di persona. Hanno tutti i loro sottopodi, quindi che ne dici se carichiamo e partiamo fra un paio d'ore? Bene? Bene."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	You spot someone behind Karengo working on one of the subpods; your time on the aquatic world of <home planet> lets you identify the sub's manufacturer as one more well known for scandal than reliability.|5120|0
units.english: You spot someone behind Karengo working on one of the subpods; your time on the aquatic world of <home planet> lets you identify the sub's manufacturer as one more well known for scandal than reliability.
units.italian: Scorgi qualcuno dietro Karengo che lavora su uno dei sottopodi; il tuo tempo sul mondo acquatico di <home planet> ti permette di riconoscere il produttore del sommergibile come uno più noto per gli scandali che per l'affidabilità.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Oh, nearly forgot. We're headed to <destination>, and you'll get <payment> for taking us there. Ain't sure if those in charge are gonna like what I'm doing, so we might need to grease some palms. Best to keep your eyes open and your shields up. We leave at noon!"|5123|0
units.english: "Oh, nearly forgot. We're headed to <destination>, and you'll get <payment> for taking us there. Ain't sure if those in charge are gonna like what I'm doing, so we might need to grease some palms. Best to keep your eyes open and your shields up. We leave at noon!"
units.italian: "Oh, quasi dimenticavo. Andiamo su <destination>, e riceverai <payment> per portarci là. Non sono sicuro che a chi comanda piacerà quello che faccio, quindi potremmo dover ungere qualche mano. Meglio tenere gli occhi aperti e gli scudi alzati. Partiamo a mezzogiorno!"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|As before on Skymoot, Karengo guides you down to a landing spot far away from the local government. "Don't want no interruptions," he says.|5128|0
units.english: As before on Skymoot, Karengo guides you down to a landing spot far away from the local government. "Don't want no interruptions," he says.
units.italian: Come prima su Skymoot, Karengo ti guida verso un punto di atterraggio lontano dal governo locale. "Non voglio interruzioni," dice.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Despite days of pressuring, you've been unable to get Karengo to tell you exactly what a quoijuu is, other than a slightly ominous "the biggest fish." He sends a file to your ship computer and grins. "Since it's too late to back out now, it's time to fill you in. Quoijuu aren't the only thing down there; you've also got scyllae, taniwhales, morgawrii, plus some hydrothermal vents, none of which will benefit us if we run into them."|5129|0
units.english: Despite days of pressuring, you've been unable to get Karengo to tell you exactly what a quoijuu is, other than a slightly ominous "the biggest fish." He sends a file to your ship computer and grins. "Since it's too late to back out now, it's time to fill you in. Quoijuu aren't the only thing down there; you've also got scyllae, taniwhales, morgawrii, plus some hydrothermal vents, none of which will benefit us if we run into them."
units.italian: Nonostante giorni di pressioni, non sei riuscito a farti dire da Karengo che cosa sia esattamente un quoijuu, se non un leggermente inquietante "il pesce più grosso". Manda un file al computer della nave e sorride. "Visto che ormai è troppo tardi per tirarsi indietro, è ora di metterti al corrente. Laggiù non ci sono solo i quoijuu: ci sono anche scille, taniwhale, morgawrii, più qualche fonte idrotermale, e nessuno di loro ci farà comodo se li incontriamo."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"The good news is that there's a path to follow. The bad news is the only person to traverse the path was a bit of a nut. It's all in riddles, and I haven't been able to make heads or tails of them. Look them over and we'll follow your lead. And don't worry too much about it - what's the worst that could happen?"|5130|0
units.english: "The good news is that there's a path to follow. The bad news is the only person to traverse the path was a bit of a nut. It's all in riddles, and I haven't been able to make heads or tails of them. Look them over and we'll follow your lead. And don't worry too much about it - what's the worst that could happen?"
units.italian: "La buona notizia è che c'è un percorso da seguire. La cattiva è che l'unica persona che l'ha attraversato era un po' fuori di testa. È tutto in indovinelli, e non sono riuscito a cavarne un ragno dal buco. Dagli un'occhiata e seguiremo te. E non preoccuparti troppo: che cosa può mai succedere di peggio?"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Okay, I'll take a look."|5132|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll take a look."
units.italian: "Va bene, ci do un'occhiata."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"We could get lost and then die."|5134|0
units.english: "We could get lost and then die."
units.italian: "Potremmo perderci e poi morire."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Karengo laughs. "You worry too much," he says.|5135|0
units.english: Karengo laughs. "You worry too much," he says.
units.italian: Karengo ride. "Ti preoccupi troppo," dice.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	The adventure seekers, who you've spent the trip getting to know, are getting ready. You watch a nearby pair, Daciana and Mussie, helping each other get their wetsuits on. Daciana catches your gaze and grins. "Bafta, mate. Safe sailing, see you on the other side." Karengo gives you a signal and you hurry back to the cockpit to fly out, away from safe shoals and over the watery abyss.|5137|0
units.english: The adventure seekers, who you've spent the trip getting to know, are getting ready. You watch a nearby pair, Daciana and Mussie, helping each other get their wetsuits on. Daciana catches your gaze and grins. "Bafta, mate. Safe sailing, see you on the other side." Karengo gives you a signal and you hurry back to the cockpit to fly out, away from safe shoals and over the watery abyss.
units.italian: Gli avventurieri, che hai conosciuto durante il viaggio, si stanno preparando. Guardi una coppia vicina, Daciana e Mussie, che si aiutano a vicenda a infilarsi le mute. Daciana incrocia il tuo sguardo e sorride. "Bafta, amico. Buona navigazione, ci vediamo dall'altra parte." Karengo ti fa un segnale e ti affretti a tornare in cabina di pilotaggio per volare via, lontano dai banchi sicuri e sopra l'abisso d'acqua.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	At your touch, the ship slowly sinks below the waves. As Karengo warned, most of your navigation systems quickly flash red warnings, then go offline; there is some unknown interference that overwhelms your ship's sensors, which were designed for space first and water second, or fifth, or not at all. Minutes tick by as the crew silently watches one of the few sensors still working.|5138|0
units.english: At your touch, the ship slowly sinks below the waves. As Karengo warned, most of your navigation systems quickly flash red warnings, then go offline; there is some unknown interference that overwhelms your ship's sensors, which were designed for space first and water second, or fifth, or not at all. Minutes tick by as the crew silently watches one of the few sensors still working.
units.italian: Al tuo tocco la nave affonda lentamente sotto le onde. Come aveva avvertito Karengo, quasi tutti i sistemi di navigazione lampeggiano rapidamente in rosso, poi si spengono; c'è qualche interferenza sconosciuta che sovrasta i sensori della nave, progettati prima per lo spazio e poi per l'acqua, o per il quinto posto, o per niente. I minuti passano mentre l'equipaggio guarda in silenzio uno dei pochi sensori ancora funzionanti.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	EIGHT HUNDRED KILOPASCALS, the pressure gauge reads.|5139|0
units.english: EIGHT HUNDRED KILOPASCALS, the pressure gauge reads.
units.italian: OTTOCCENTO CHILOPASCAL, dice il manometro.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	ONE THOUSAND KILOPASCALS.|5140|0
units.english: ONE THOUSAND KILOPASCALS.
units.italian: MILLE CHILOPASCAL.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	ONE THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED KILOPASCALS. A loud, metallic creak echoes through the ship and Mussie jumps, startled.|5141|0
units.english: ONE THOUSAND TWO HUNDRED KILOPASCALS. A loud, metallic creak echoes through the ship and Mussie jumps, startled.
units.italian: MILLEDUECENTO CHILOPASCAL. Uno scricchiolio metallico echeggia per la nave e Mussie sobbalza, spaventato.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Karengo claps him on the back and gives him a signature grin. "Maybe <first> can keep you aboard after this in case they need anything from a high shelf!" Mussie smiles weakly, but his eyes don't leave the readout.|5142|0
units.english: Karengo claps him on the back and gives him a signature grin. "Maybe <first> can keep you aboard after this in case they need anything from a high shelf!" Mussie smiles weakly, but his eyes don't leave the readout.
units.italian: Karengo gli dà una pacca sulla schiena e gli regala il suo sorriso inconfondibile. "Magari <first> potrà tenerti a bordo dopo questa, in caso gli serva qualcosa da uno scaffale alto!" Mussie sorride debolmente, ma i suoi occhi non lasciano il quadrante.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	ONE THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED KILOPASCALS. "This's it," Karengo announces, "Sub up! Let's see what there is to see. And <first>, keep it to passive sensors. Don't want to attract any undue attention." The ship smoothly descends into the mouth of a massive cave and your visibility, clouded by dark sulfide emissions from the hydrothermal vents at the floor, drops to less than eight meters. 6 personal subpods fan out behind you, their communication equipment syncing with yours to display them as blips on your screen.|5143|0
units.english: ONE THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED KILOPASCALS. "This's it," Karengo announces, "Sub up! Let's see what there is to see. And <first>, keep it to passive sensors. Don't want to attract any undue attention." The ship smoothly descends into the mouth of a massive cave and your visibility, clouded by dark sulfide emissions from the hydrothermal vents at the floor, drops to less than eight meters. 6 personal subpods fan out behind you, their communication equipment syncing with yours to display them as blips on your screen.
units.italian: MILLECINQUECENTO CHILOPASCAL. "Ci siamo," annuncia Karengo, "sottopodi fuori! Vediamo che c'è da vedere. E <first>, tieni solo i sensori passivi. Non voglio attirare attenzioni indesiderate." La nave scende dolcemente nella bocca di una caverna enorme e la tua visibilità, offuscata dalle scure emissioni di solfuro delle fonti idrotermali sul fondo, scende a meno di otto metri. Sei sottopodi personali si aprono a ventaglio dietro di te, con le loro apparecchiature di comunicazione sincronizzate alle tue per mostrarli come puntini sullo schermo.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Ok, <first>," Karengo crackles over the radio. "I'll read you the first clue."|5144|0
units.english: "Ok, <first>," Karengo crackles over the radio. "I'll read you the first clue."
units.italian: "Ok, <first>," gracchia Karengo alla radio. "Ti leggo il primo indizio."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|"No other path may you take"|5145|0
units.english: "No other path may you take"
units.italian: "Nessun'altra via ti è concessa"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|"Oiled skins flash and flicker"|5146|0
units.english: "Oiled skins flash and flicker"
units.italian: "Oliate pelli guizzano e lampeggiano"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|"Razor spikes grow from the deep"|5147|0
units.english: "Razor spikes grow from the deep"
units.italian: "Rasoi di spine sorgono dal profondo"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|"Titanic walls crush and smash"|5148|0
units.english: "Titanic walls crush and smash"
units.italian: "Titaniche pareti schiacciano e frantumano"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|"Heed the beginnings to live"|5149|0
units.english: "Heed the beginnings to live"
units.italian: "Hai da badare agli inizi, se vuoi vivere"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	(Go east.)|5151|0
units.english: (Go east.)
units.italian: (Vai a est.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	(Go north.)|5153|0
units.english: (Go north.)
units.italian: (Vai a nord.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	(Go south.)|5155|0
units.english: (Go south.)
units.italian: (Vai a sud.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	(Go west.)|5157|0
units.english: (Go west.)
units.italian: (Vai a ovest.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Small schools of fish flit past as you guide your small fleet to the west. Minutes pass with no sign of danger, and finally Karengo broadcasts, "Good work, <first>. Looks like this is the way forward."|5160|0
units.english: Small schools of fish flit past as you guide your small fleet to the west. Minutes pass with no sign of danger, and finally Karengo broadcasts, "Good work, <first>. Looks like this is the way forward."
units.italian: Piccoli banchi di pesci guizzano via mentre guidi la tua piccola flotta verso ovest. Passano i minuti senza alcun segno di pericolo, e infine Karengo trasmette: "Bel lavoro, <first>. Sembra che la strada sia questa."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Last one there's a rotten fish eye!" shouts Elias, and your screen shows his subpod leap forward and gain on you, followed quickly by Taddese.|5161|0
units.english: "Last one there's a rotten fish eye!" shouts Elias, and your screen shows his subpod leap forward and gain on you, followed quickly by Taddese.
units.italian: "L'ultimo arrivato è un occhio di pesce marcio!" grida Elias, e sullo schermo vedi il suo sottopodo scattare in avanti e guadagnare terreno su di te, seguito subito da Taddese.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Then, without warning, a proximity sensor goes off. At the same time, your external lights illuminate a wall directly in front, stretching for as far as you can see. "Stop!" shouts Karengo, "It's the end of the cavern! Stop and go back!"|5162|0
units.english: Then, without warning, a proximity sensor goes off. At the same time, your external lights illuminate a wall directly in front, stretching for as far as you can see. "Stop!" shouts Karengo, "It's the end of the cavern! Stop and go back!"
units.italian: Poi, senza preavviso, scatta un sensore di prossimità. Nello stesso momento le tue luci esterne illuminano una parete proprio davanti, che si estende a perdita d'occhio. "Fermi!" grida Karengo, "È la fine della caverna! Fermatevi e tornate indietro!"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Shuddering, your ship comes to a halt mere meters from the endless stone face. With a sinking feeling that has nothing to do with the depth, you turn the ship around and head back the way you came.|5163|0
units.english: Shuddering, your ship comes to a halt mere meters from the endless stone face. With a sinking feeling that has nothing to do with the depth, you turn the ship around and head back the way you came.
units.italian: Sussultando, la tua nave si ferma a pochi metri dall'infinita parete di pietra. Con una sensazione di vuoto che non ha niente a che fare con la profondità, giri la nave e torni indietro da dove sei venuto.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Small schools of fish flit past as you guide your small fleet to the east. Out of the darkness, some sort of small whale crashes into your ship, setting off a couple of proximity alarms but causing no damage. It isn't until you hear screaming, distorted by the speakers, that it becomes clear what you just saw; the "small whale" was a just a flipper of something much, much larger.|5168|0
units.english: Small schools of fish flit past as you guide your small fleet to the east. Out of the darkness, some sort of small whale crashes into your ship, setting off a couple of proximity alarms but causing no damage. It isn't until you hear screaming, distorted by the speakers, that it becomes clear what you just saw; the "small whale" was a just a flipper of something much, much larger.
units.italian: Piccoli banchi di pesci guizzano via mentre guidi la tua piccola flotta verso est. Dal buio, una specie di piccola balena si schianta contro la tua nave, facendo scattare un paio di allarmi di prossimità ma senza causare danni. Solo quando senti delle urla, distorte dagli altoparlanti, diventa chiaro che cosa hai appena visto: la "piccola balena" era solo una pinna di qualcosa di molto, molto più grande.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Morgawrii!" shouts Karengo, "Turn around! Turn around!"|5169|0
units.english: "Morgawrii!" shouts Karengo, "Turn around! Turn around!"
units.italian: "Morgawrii!" grida Karengo, "Gira! Gira!"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Hauling on the controls, you spin your ship around. Leviathan shapes rise from below, stirring the water around your ship as it speeds to safety.|5170|0
units.english: Hauling on the controls, you spin your ship around. Leviathan shapes rise from below, stirring the water around your ship as it speeds to safety.
units.italian: Tirando i comandi, fai ruotare la nave. Forme di leviatani si alzano dal basso, agitando l'acqua intorno alla tua nave mentre accelera verso la salvezza.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Small schools of fish flit past as you guide your small fleet to the south. The swirling clouds of emissions seem to get thicker and thicker, until there's no reason to look at anything but the ship compass. The screen beeps once and a blip disappears.|5175|0
units.english: Small schools of fish flit past as you guide your small fleet to the south. The swirling clouds of emissions seem to get thicker and thicker, until there's no reason to look at anything but the ship compass. The screen beeps once and a blip disappears.
units.italian: Piccoli banchi di pesci guizzano via mentre guidi la tua piccola flotta verso sud. Le nubi vorticose di emissioni sembrano farsi sempre più dense, finché non c'è più motivo di guardare altro che la bussola della nave. Lo schermo emette un bip e un puntino scompare.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Elias?" Karengo asks. "Your transmitter just cut out." When there's no response, he swears. "Everybody go back." he broadcasts. "Something's wrong."|5176|0
units.english: "Elias?" Karengo asks. "Your transmitter just cut out." When there's no response, he swears. "Everybody go back." he broadcasts. "Something's wrong."
units.italian: "Elias?" chiede Karengo. "Il tuo trasmettitore si è appena spento." Quando non arriva risposta, impreca. "Tornate tutti indietro," trasmette. "Qualcosa non va."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	You spin your ship around and hear a loud crunch come from outside - your shields have just impacted something large and solid. The outer lights shine off falling stone and, suddenly, it all comes together; you've led everybody through a field of hydrothermal vents that rise dozens of meters off the bottom, obscured by their own noxious clouds. You guide your ship back to safety, toppling more underwater smokestacks as you go.|5177|0
units.english: You spin your ship around and hear a loud crunch come from outside - your shields have just impacted something large and solid. The outer lights shine off falling stone and, suddenly, it all comes together; you've led everybody through a field of hydrothermal vents that rise dozens of meters off the bottom, obscured by their own noxious clouds. You guide your ship back to safety, toppling more underwater smokestacks as you go.
units.italian: Giri la nave e senti un forte scricchiolio venire da fuori: i tuoi scudi hanno appena urtato qualcosa di grande e solido. Le luci esterne illuminano pietra che cade e, all'improvviso, tutto diventa chiaro: hai guidato tutti attraverso un campo di fonti idrotermali che si alzano per decine di metri dal fondo, nascoste dalle loro stesse nubi tossiche. Riporti la nave in salvo, rovesciando altre ciminiere sottomarine lungo il percorso.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	You turn the ship to the north and guide it through the abyssal depths. The subpods race forward, each vying to outdo the other, seemingly heedless of the dangers that Karengo hinted at. With bated breath, you watch the sensors until at last the comms flare.|5180|0
units.english: You turn the ship to the north and guide it through the abyssal depths. The subpods race forward, each vying to outdo the other, seemingly heedless of the dangers that Karengo hinted at. With bated breath, you watch the sensors until at last the comms flare.
units.italian: Giri la nave a nord e la guidi attraverso gli abissi. I sottopodi sfrecciano in avanti, ciascuno a gara per superare gli altri, apparentemente incuranti dei pericoli che Karengo aveva lasciato intendere. Con il fiato sospeso guardi i sensori, finché finalmente le comunicazioni si accendono.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Woah!" comes Karengo's voice. "I think that's far enough. Which way do we go next, <first>?"|5181|0
units.english: "Woah!" comes Karengo's voice. "I think that's far enough. Which way do we go next, <first>?"
units.italian: "Wow!" arriva la voce di Karengo. "Credo che siamo arrivati abbastanza lontano. Da che parte andiamo adesso, <first>?"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|label|5182|0
units.english: riddle two
units.italian: riddle two

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	After everyone arrives and is accounted for, Karengo reads the riddle to you.|5185|0
units.english: After everyone arrives and is accounted for, Karengo reads the riddle to you.
units.italian: Dopo che tutti sono arrivati e sono stati contati, Karengo ti legge l'indovinello.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|"There are stingers in the deep"|5186|0
units.english: "There are stingers in the deep"
units.italian: "Ci sono pungiglioni nel profondo"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|"A certain death, a dreamless sleep."|5187|0
units.english: "A certain death, a dreamless sleep."
units.italian: "Una morte certa, un sonno senza sogni."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|"Go to beast that has no bee."|5188|0
units.english: "Go to beast that has no bee."
units.italian: "Va' dalla bestia che ape non ha."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|"No danger there, just open sea."|5189|0
units.english: "No danger there, just open sea."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Small schools of fish flit past as you guide your small fleet to the west. Minutes pass with no sign of danger, and finally Karengo broadcasts, "Good work, <first>. Looks like this is the way forward."|5198|0
units.english: Small schools of fish flit past as you guide your small fleet to the west. Minutes pass with no sign of danger, and finally Karengo broadcasts, "Good work, <first>. Looks like this is the way forward."
units.italian: Piccoli banchi di pesci guizzano via mentre guidi la tua piccola flotta verso ovest. Passano i minuti senza alcun segno di pericolo, e infine Karengo trasmette: "Bel lavoro, <first>. Sembra che la strada sia questa."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Last one there's a rotten fish eye!" shouts Mussie, and your screen shows his subpod leap forward and gain on you, followed quickly by others'.|5199|0
units.english: "Last one there's a rotten fish eye!" shouts Mussie, and your screen shows his subpod leap forward and gain on you, followed quickly by others'.
units.italian: "L'ultimo arrivato è un occhio di pesce marcio!" grida Mussie, e sullo schermo vedi il suo sottopodo scattare in avanti e guadagnare terreno su di te, seguito subito da altri.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Then, without warning, a proximity sensor goes off at the same time your outer lights show a wall directly in front, stretching for as far as you can see. "Stop!" shouts Karengo, "It's the end of the cavern! Stop and go back!"|5200|0
units.english: Then, without warning, a proximity sensor goes off at the same time your outer lights show a wall directly in front, stretching for as far as you can see. "Stop!" shouts Karengo, "It's the end of the cavern! Stop and go back!"
units.italian: Poi, senza preavviso, scatta un sensore di prossimità nello stesso momento in cui le tue luci esterne mostrano una parete proprio davanti, che si estende a perdita d'occhio. "Fermi!" grida Karengo, "È la fine della caverna! Fermatevi e tornate indietro!"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Shuddering, your ship comes to a halt mere meters from the endless stone face. With a sinking feeling that has nothing to do with the depth, you turn the ship around and head back the way you came.|5201|0
units.english: Shuddering, your ship comes to a halt mere meters from the endless stone face. With a sinking feeling that has nothing to do with the depth, you turn the ship around and head back the way you came.
units.italian: Sussultando, la tua nave si ferma a pochi metri dall'infinita parete di pietra. Con una sensazione di vuoto che non ha niente a che fare con la profondità, giri la nave e torni indietro da dove sei venuto.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"A bee-less beast," you mutter to yourself. "A poet, this writer was not." Turning east, the ship powers forward, cautious but confident.|5204|0
units.english: "A bee-less beast," you mutter to yourself. "A poet, this writer was not." Turning east, the ship powers forward, cautious but confident.
units.italian: "Una bestia senza ape," mormori fra te. "Un poeta, questo scrittore, proprio no." Voltandoti a est, la nave avanza, cauta ma sicura.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Subpods fly ahead, exulting in their agility in the face of the dangerous ocean. It isn't long until Karengo again radios you. "Knew I chose ya for a reason. What's the next direction?"|5205|0
units.english: Subpods fly ahead, exulting in their agility in the face of the dangerous ocean. It isn't long until Karengo again radios you. "Knew I chose ya for a reason. What's the next direction?"
units.italian: I sottopodi sfrecciano avanti, esultando nella loro agilità di fronte all'oceano pericoloso. Non passa molto prima che Karengo ti chiami di nuovo alla radio. "Sapevo di averti scelto per un motivo. Qual è la prossima direzione?"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Bubbles rush past the thick windows as the group's subpods scout to the north at your direction. At first, all is quiet. Just as you start to exhale a sigh of relief, twin lightning bolts arc across the waterscape ahead and the ship sensors overload, blinded by an apparent release of electricity. The systems recover, showing subpods returning quickly back to the ship.|5210|0
units.english: Bubbles rush past the thick windows as the group's subpods scout to the north at your direction. At first, all is quiet. Just as you start to exhale a sigh of relief, twin lightning bolts arc across the waterscape ahead and the ship sensors overload, blinded by an apparent release of electricity. The systems recover, showing subpods returning quickly back to the ship.
units.italian: Le bolle sfrecciano oltre le spesse finestre mentre i sottopodi del gruppo esplorano verso nord, come hai indicato. All'inizio è tutto tranquillo. Proprio quando cominci a emettere un sospiro di sollievo, due fulmini gemelli si aprono ad arco nel paesaggio acquatico davanti e i sensori della nave vanno in sovraccarico, accecati da un apparente rilascio di elettricità. I sistemi si riprendono, mostrando i sottopodi che tornano in fretta verso la nave.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	One is missing: Mussie.|5211|0
units.english: One is missing: Mussie.
units.italian: Ne manca uno: Mussie.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	You turn the ship back the way you came and pull up the sensor recording to see what happened. The flash of light came from viney seaweed, stretching as far up and down as the ship can detect. Evidently, contact with it released a jolt of electricity that lit up both the vine and Mussie's subpod.|5212|0
units.english: You turn the ship back the way you came and pull up the sensor recording to see what happened. The flash of light came from viney seaweed, stretching as far up and down as the ship can detect. Evidently, contact with it released a jolt of electricity that lit up both the vine and Mussie's subpod.
units.italian: Giri la nave e torni indietro, poi richiami la registrazione dei sensori per vedere che cosa è successo. Il lampo di luce è venuto da un'alga a viticci che si estende su e giù per quanto i sensori della nave riescano a rilevare. Evidentemente il contatto ha liberato una scarica elettrica che ha illuminato sia l'alga sia il sottopodo di Mussie.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	After making a roll call, you find out that Elias and Taddese have not returned. Karengo seems unfazed as he reads the second riddle to you. "There are stingers in the deep \ A certain death, a dreamless sleep. \ Go to beast that has no bee \ No danger there, just open sea."|5215|0
units.english: After making a roll call, you find out that Elias and Taddese have not returned. Karengo seems unfazed as he reads the second riddle to you. "There are stingers in the deep \ A certain death, a dreamless sleep. \ Go to beast that has no bee \ No danger there, just open sea."
units.italian: Dopo l'appello, scopri che Elias e Taddese non sono tornati. Karengo sembra imperturbabile mentre ti legge il secondo indovinello. "Ci sono pungiglioni nel profondo \ Una morte certa, un sonno senza sogni. \ Va' dalla bestia che ape non ha \ Là non c'è pericolo, solo mare aperto."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	The proximity alarm wails and you bring your ship to a halt... but Mussie isn't so lucky. His subpod smashes straight into a rock wall, leaving little doubt as to his fate.|5224|0
units.english: The proximity alarm wails and you bring your ship to a halt... but Mussie isn't so lucky. His subpod smashes straight into a rock wall, leaving little doubt as to his fate.
units.italian: L'allarme di prossimità ulula e fermi la nave... ma Mussie non è così fortunato. Il suo sottopodo si schianta dritto contro una parete di roccia, lasciando pochi dubbi sul suo destino.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Again, you put the ship into reverse and turn around. This is not going at all how it was supposed to.|5225|0
units.english: Again, you put the ship into reverse and turn around. This is not going at all how it was supposed to.
units.italian: Di nuovo, metti la nave in retromarcia e ti giri. Non sta andando affatto come doveva.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Cautiously, you turn to the east and power forward. Subpods fly ahead, exulting in their agility in the face of the dangerous ocean.|5228|0
units.english: Cautiously, you turn to the east and power forward. Subpods fly ahead, exulting in their agility in the face of the dangerous ocean.
units.italian: Con cautela ti volti a est e accendi i motori. I sottopodi sfrecciano avanti, esultando nella loro agilità di fronte all'oceano pericoloso.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	After holding your breath for what feels like hours, Karengo radios you. "Knew you'd find your way eventually. What's the next direction?"|5229|0
units.english: After holding your breath for what feels like hours, Karengo radios you. "Knew you'd find your way eventually. What's the next direction?"
units.italian: Dopo aver trattenuto il fiato per quello che sembrano ore, Karengo ti chiama. "Sapevo che prima o poi avresti trovato la strada. Qual è la prossima direzione?"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Karengo sounds a roll call over the radio. Mussie never reports in, and his subpod beacon isn't responding. "Ah, well." says Karengo, without much sympathy. "You all stay here and I'll scout ahead."|5241|0

units.italian: Karengo fa l'appello alla radio. Mussie non risponde, e il segnale del suo sottopodo non reagisce. "Ah, beh." dice Karengo, senza molta compassione. "Voi restate qui, io vado in avanscoperta."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Only minutes later, he's found a clear path east, and you morosely trail the ship behind.|5242|0

units.italian: Solo pochi minuti dopo ha trovato un passaggio libero verso est, e tu segui la nave con aria cupa.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	The subpods, as usual, race ahead of the ship despite all logic. "Wall to the east!" calls out Daciana, whose beacon on the ship display starts to move north-west, presumably avoiding the undersea hazard, and joining up with Jorma. "Hmm," radios in Karengo. "We should be right about on top of it. Send out a ping." It's almost a relief to send out a pulse to map the surroundings after flying dark for so long.|5270|0
units.english: The subpods, as usual, race ahead of the ship despite all logic. "Wall to the east!" calls out Daciana, whose beacon on the ship display starts to move north-west, presumably avoiding the undersea hazard, and joining up with Jorma. "Hmm," radios in Karengo. "We should be right about on top of it. Send out a ping." It's almost a relief to send out a pulse to map the surroundings after flying dark for so long.
units.italian: I sottopodi, come al solito, sfrecciano avanti alla nave contro ogni logica. "Parete a est!" segnala Daciana, il cui segnale sul display della nave comincia a spostarsi verso nord-ovest, presumibilmente per evitare il pericolo sottomarino, e si ricongiunge con Jorma. "Hmm," interviene Karengo alla radio. "Dovremmo essere proprio sopra. Lancia un ping." È quasi un sollievo emettere un impulso per mappare i dintorni dopo aver volato al buio così a lungo.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	The result is not what you were hoping for. The display maps two leviathan-sized things ahead, each over 200 meters long. Dozens of sets of flippers run along each 80-meter-tall side and hundreds of teeth the size of an adult human line their jaws.|5271|0
units.english: The result is not what you were hoping for. The display maps two leviathan-sized things ahead, each over 200 meters long. Dozens of sets of flippers run along each 80-meter-tall side and hundreds of teeth the size of an adult human line their jaws.
units.italian: Il risultato non è quello che speravi. Il display mappa due cose grandi come leviatani davanti a voi, ciascuna lunga più di 200 metri. Decine di file di pinne corrono lungo ciascun fianco alto 80 metri e centinaia di denti grandi come un uomo adulto ne rivestono le mascelle.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	You goggle at the display for a moment, taking it in, and draw breath to call out the alarm when an eye appears through the ship window, yellow, glowing, alien, and massive.|5276|0
units.english: You goggle at the display for a moment, taking it in, and draw breath to call out the alarm when an eye appears through the ship window, yellow, glowing, alien, and massive.
units.italian: Resti a bocca aperta davanti al display per un momento, assimilando la cosa, e prendi fiato per dare l'allarme quando un occhio appare oltre il finestrino della nave: giallo, luminoso, alieno ed enorme.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	All at once, you turn and accelerate, shouting the alarm to any who hadn't already realized, and hoping that you're leaving the leviathan beasts behind. A quick glance at the display shows at least one subpod following behind. Good enough. If one of those rams the ship, nobody is going home anyway.|5278|0
units.english: All at once, you turn and accelerate, shouting the alarm to any who hadn't already realized, and hoping that you're leaving the leviathan beasts behind. A quick glance at the display shows at least one subpod following behind. Good enough. If one of those rams the ship, nobody is going home anyway.
units.italian: Tutto in una volta ti giri e acceleri, gridando l'allarme a chi non l'avesse già capito, e sperando di lasciarti alle spalle le bestie leviatano. Una rapida occhiata al display mostra almeno un sottopodo che segue dietro. Basta così. Se una di quelle cose sperona la nave, nessuno torna a casa comunque.

units.italian: Passa molto tempo prima che rallenti e ti giri. Nessun mostro marino mammut esce dal buio, e tiri un respiro.
