units.english: You goggle at the display for a moment, holding your breath, but the leviathans seem uninterested. You shudder, imagining what one of those could do if you'd turned the wrong way, before your interest returns to the mysterious bulk resting below the ship.
units.italian: Resti a bocca aperta davanti al display per un momento, trattenendo il fiato, ma i leviatani sembrano disinteressati. Rabbrividisci, immaginando che cosa potrebbe fare uno di quelli se avessi girato dalla parte sbagliata, prima che il tuo interesse torni alla misteriosa massa che riposa sotto la nave.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Disheartened at this point, you make the call to go north, completing the zig-zag pattern.|5306|0
units.english: Disheartened at this point, you make the call to go north, completing the zig-zag pattern.
units.italian: Scoraggiato a questo punto, decidi di andare a nord, completando lo schema a zig-zag.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	By now, the feeling that you get when the ship's subpod tracker loses two more dots is familiar. One subpod remains: Karengo's.|5311|0
units.english: By now, the feeling that you get when the ship's subpod tracker loses two more dots is familiar. One subpod remains: Karengo's.
units.italian: Ormai la sensazione che provi quando il localizzatore dei sottopodi della nave perde altri due puntini ti è familiare. Resta un solo sottopodo: quello di Karengo.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	(Go north.)|5315|0
units.english: (Go north.)
units.italian: (Vai a nord.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	(Go east.)|5317|0
units.english: (Go east.)
units.italian: (Vai a est.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	(Go south.)|5319|0
units.english: (Go south.)
units.italian: (Vai a sud.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Hesitantly, you make the call to go north, completing the zig-zag pattern.|5324|0
units.english: Hesitantly, you make the call to go north, completing the zig-zag pattern.
units.italian: Con esitazione, decidi di andare a nord, completando lo schema a zig-zag.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	The subpods, as usual, race ahead of the ship despite all logic. "Wall to the east!" calls out Daciana, whose beacon on the ship display starts to move north-west, presumably avoiding the undersea hazard, and joining up with Jorma. "Hmm," radios in Karengo. "We should be right about on top of it. Send out a ping." It's almost a relief to send out a pulse to map the surroundings after flying dark for so long.|5325|0
units.english: The subpods, as usual, race ahead of the ship despite all logic. "Wall to the east!" calls out Daciana, whose beacon on the ship display starts to move north-west, presumably avoiding the undersea hazard, and joining up with Jorma. "Hmm," radios in Karengo. "We should be right about on top of it. Send out a ping." It's almost a relief to send out a pulse to map the surroundings after flying dark for so long.
units.italian: I sottopodi, come al solito, sfrecciano avanti alla nave contro ogni logica. "Parete a est!" segnala Daciana, il cui segnale sul display della nave comincia a spostarsi verso nord-ovest, presumibilmente per evitare il pericolo sottomarino, e si ricongiunge con Jorma. "Hmm," interviene Karengo alla radio. "Dovremmo essere proprio sopra. Lancia un ping." È quasi un sollievo emettere un impulso per mappare i dintorni dopo aver volato al buio così a lungo.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	The result is not what you were hoping for. The display maps two leviathan-sized things ahead, each over 200 meters long. Dozens of sets of flippers run along each 80-meter-tall side and hundreds of teeth the size of an adult human line their jaws.|5326|0
units.english: The result is not what you were hoping for. The display maps two leviathan-sized things ahead, each over 200 meters long. Dozens of sets of flippers run along each 80-meter-tall side and hundreds of teeth the size of an adult human line their jaws.
units.italian: Il risultato non è quello che speravi. Il display mappa due cose grandi come leviatani davanti a voi, ciascuna lunga più di 200 metri. Decine di file di pinne corrono lungo ciascun fianco alto 80 metri e centinaia di denti grandi come un uomo adulto ne rivestono le mascelle.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	You goggle at the display for a moment, taking it in, and draw breath to call out the alarm when an eye appears through the ship window, yellow, glowing, alien, and massive. All at once, you turn and accelerate, shouting the alarm to any who hadn't already realized, and hoping that you're leaving the leviathan beasts behind. A quick glance at the display shows at least one subpod following behind. Good enough. If one of those rams the ship, nobody is going home anyway.|5327|0
units.english: You goggle at the display for a moment, taking it in, and draw breath to call out the alarm when an eye appears through the ship window, yellow, glowing, alien, and massive. All at once, you turn and accelerate, shouting the alarm to any who hadn't already realized, and hoping that you're leaving the leviathan beasts behind. A quick glance at the display shows at least one subpod following behind. Good enough. If one of those rams the ship, nobody is going home anyway.
units.italian: Resti a bocca aperta davanti al display per un momento, assimilando la cosa, e prendi fiato per dare l'allarme quando un occhio appare oltre il finestrino della nave: giallo, luminoso, alieno ed enorme. Tutto in una volta ti giri e acceleri, gridando l'allarme a chi non l'avesse già capito, e sperando di lasciarti alle spalle le bestie leviatano. Una rapida occhiata al display mostra almeno un sottopodo che segue dietro. Basta così. Se una di quelle cose sperona la nave, nessuno torna a casa comunque.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	It's a long while before you slow and turn around. No mammoth sea monster comes out of the darkness, and you take a breath.|5328|0
units.english: It's a long while before you slow and turn around. No mammoth sea monster comes out of the darkness, and you take a breath.
units.italian: Passa molto tempo prima che rallenti e ti giri. Nessun mostro marino mammut esce dal buio, e tiri un respiro.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Quoijuu," says Karengo simply.|5329|0
units.english: "Quoijuu," says Karengo simply.
units.italian: "Quoijuu," dice semplicemente Karengo.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	The proximity alarm wails and you bring your ship to a halt, but your tracker shows two subpods smash straight into the stone wall looming in front of you.|5334|0
units.english: The proximity alarm wails and you bring your ship to a halt, but your tracker shows two subpods smash straight into the stone wall looming in front of you.
units.italian: L'allarme di prossimità ulula e fermi la nave, ma il localizzatore mostra due sottopodi che si schiantano dritti contro la parete di pietra che incombe davanti a voi.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Again, you put the ship into reverse and turn around. This is not going at all how it was supposed to.|5335|0
units.english: Again, you put the ship into reverse and turn around. This is not going at all how it was supposed to.
units.italian: Di nuovo, metti la nave in retromarcia e ti giri. Non sta andando affatto come doveva.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Jorma and Daciana never report back in.|5337|0
units.english: Jorma and Daciana never report back in.
units.italian: Jorma e Daciana non rispondono mai più.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"You stay," radios Karengo. He sounds frustrated for the first time, and you keep the ship in place, watching his subpod dot radiate outwards, exploring.|5338|0
units.english: "You stay," radios Karengo. He sounds frustrated for the first time, and you keep the ship in place, watching his subpod dot radiate outwards, exploring.
units.italian: "Voi restate," dice Karengo alla radio. Sembra frustrato per la prima volta, e tieni la nave ferma, guardando il puntino del suo sottopodo irradiarsi verso l'esterno, in esplorazione.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	(Follow him.)|5340|0
units.english: (Follow him.)
units.italian: (Seguilo.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	(Wait.)|5342|0
units.english: (Wait.)
units.italian: (Aspetta.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Come here." he finally says. His dot has stopped moving, hovering to the south, and you turn to follow, wondering if this misadventure is finally over.|5343|0
units.english: "Come here." he finally says. His dot has stopped moving, hovering to the south, and you turn to follow, wondering if this misadventure is finally over.
units.italian: "Vieni qui." dice infine. Il suo puntino ha smesso di muoversi, fermo a sud, e ti volti per seguirlo, chiedendoti se questa disavventura sia finalmente finita.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	You follow him and find his pod stopped at a junction. "It's here," radios Karengo. "Fire off a ping." You comply, and the display shows a massive object directly below you.|5345|0
units.english: You follow him and find his pod stopped at a junction. "It's here," radios Karengo. "Fire off a ping." You comply, and the display shows a massive object directly below you.
units.italian: Lo segui e trovi il suo pod fermo a un incrocio. "È qui," dice Karengo alla radio. "Lancia un ping." Obbedisci, e il display mostra una massa enorme proprio sotto di te.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	A 3D holo floats on the console, displaying the smooth lines of a starship soaring down into the depths. The jagged edges suggest that this is only a part of a much larger vessel, although it's hard to guess at the size of the whole ship from the fragment.|5347|0
units.english: A 3D holo floats on the console, displaying the smooth lines of a starship soaring down into the depths. The jagged edges suggest that this is only a part of a much larger vessel, although it's hard to guess at the size of the whole ship from the fragment.
units.italian: Un ologramma 3D fluttua sulla console, mostrando le linee morbide di una nave stellare che scende nelle profondità. I bordi frastagliati suggeriscono che sia solo una parte di un vascello molto più grande, anche se è difficile indovinare la dimensione della nave intera dal frammento.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	(Wait for instructions.)|5349|0
units.english: (Wait for instructions.)
units.italian: (Aspetta istruzioni.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	(Move closer.)|5351|0
units.english: (Move closer.)
units.italian: (Avvicinati di più.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Come on then," Karengo says. "We'll need a better look at this baby."|5354|0
units.english: "Come on then," Karengo says. "We'll need a better look at this baby."
units.italian: "Vieni allora," dice Karengo. "Dobbiamo dare un'occhiata migliore a questo gioiellino."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Your craft moves closer to investigate and you send out another ping, this time more focused, and the holographic ship display flickers and refines. The outlines of sealed entrances are visible, unnecessary with the ship torn apart as it is. Sea growth is mostly absent from the hull, to your surprise, except for a radial pattern of some sort of crystal-shaped growth. Infrared imaging shows a dim glow of heat at its center.|5356|0
units.english: Your craft moves closer to investigate and you send out another ping, this time more focused, and the holographic ship display flickers and refines. The outlines of sealed entrances are visible, unnecessary with the ship torn apart as it is. Sea growth is mostly absent from the hull, to your surprise, except for a radial pattern of some sort of crystal-shaped growth. Infrared imaging shows a dim glow of heat at its center.
units.italian: Il tuo mezzo si avvicina per indagare e lanci un altro ping, questa volta più mirato, e l'ologramma della nave tremola e si affina. Sono visibili i contorni di ingressi sigillati, inutili con la nave ridotta com'è. Con tua sorpresa, lo scafo è quasi privo di incrostazioni marine, tranne un disegno radiale di una specie di crescita cristallina. L'imaging a infrarossi mostra un debole bagliore di calore al centro.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"What we have here, folks," breaks in Karengo, "is the fabled treasure. A chunk'o'some, anyway. And we're gonna take whatever we want. Let's see what there is to see."|5365|0
units.english: "What we have here, folks," breaks in Karengo, "is the fabled treasure. A chunk'o'some, anyway. And we're gonna take whatever we want. Let's see what there is to see."
units.italian: "Quello che abbiamo qui, gente," interviene Karengo, "è il leggendario tesoro. Un bel pezzo, almeno. E ci prendiamo quello che vogliamo. Vediamo che c'è da vedere."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Now that active communication is low-risk, you bring up the video feed from Karengo's subpod as he floats toward the heat source. Bathed in floodlight, you can see that there are actual crystals formed on the ship hull, glowing a dull red. Something unknowable has rent a hole near the crystalline spiral, and Karengo disappears inside. The rest of the subpods wait outside, apparently spooked. "Jackpot!" comes his voice. "There's some sort of computer in here! <first>, get closer and let's get this out." You don't know what it is, but it looks expensive.|5366|0
units.english: Now that active communication is low-risk, you bring up the video feed from Karengo's subpod as he floats toward the heat source. Bathed in floodlight, you can see that there are actual crystals formed on the ship hull, glowing a dull red. Something unknowable has rent a hole near the crystalline spiral, and Karengo disappears inside. The rest of the subpods wait outside, apparently spooked. "Jackpot!" comes his voice. "There's some sort of computer in here! <first>, get closer and let's get this out." You don't know what it is, but it looks expensive.
units.italian: Ora che la comunicazione attiva è a basso rischio, apri il feed video dal sottopodo di Karengo mentre fluttua verso la fonte di calore. Immersa nella luce dei fari, vedi che sullo scafo della nave si sono formati dei veri cristalli, che brillano di un rosso spento. Qualcosa di inconoscibile ha aperto una falla vicino alla spirale cristallina, e Karengo sparisce dentro. Gli altri sottopodi aspettano fuori, evidentemente spaventati. "Jackpot!" arriva la sua voce. "C'è una specie di computer qui dentro! <first>, avvicinati e tiriamolo fuori." Non sai che cosa sia, ma sembra costoso.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	(Help him out.)|5368|0
units.english: (Help him out.)
units.italian: (Aiutalo.)

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Do you know how this got here?"|5370|0
units.english: "Do you know how this got here?"
units.italian: "Sai come è finito qui?"

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"No clue. I'm not about to look a gift horse in the mouth," Karengo says.|5371|0
units.english: "No clue. I'm not about to look a gift horse in the mouth," Karengo says.
units.italian: "Non ne ho idea. Non sto a guardare in bocca al cavallo regalato," dice Karengo.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	It's slow work, but the group is able to cut loose the machine, along with as much other salvage as possible. The crystalline growth covers everything inside the ship, making extraction difficult, but many hands make light work, and you end up with a sizable haul. At last, you are done.|5373|0
units.english: It's slow work, but the group is able to cut loose the machine, along with as much other salvage as possible. The crystalline growth covers everything inside the ship, making extraction difficult, but many hands make light work, and you end up with a sizable haul. At last, you are done.
units.italian: È un lavoro lento, ma il gruppo riesce a staccare la macchina, insieme a quanto più recupero possibile. La crescita cristallina copre tutto all'interno della nave, rendendo l'estrazione difficile, ma molte mani fanno il lavoro leggero, e vi ritrovate con un bottino considerevole. Alla fine avete finito.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|label|5375|0
units.english: all dead
units.italian: all dead

units.italian: "Non ne ho idea. Non sto a guardare in bocca al cavallo regalato," dice Karengo.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	It's slow work, but you and Karengo are able to cut loose the machine, along with as much other salvage as possible. The crystalline growth covers everything inside the ship, making extraction difficult. You wish there were others to help gather more salvage, but at last you are done.|5384|0
units.english: It's slow work, but you and Karengo are able to cut loose the machine, along with as much other salvage as possible. The crystalline growth covers everything inside the ship, making extraction difficult. You wish there were others to help gather more salvage, but at last you are done.
units.italian: È un lavoro lento, ma tu e Karengo riuscite a staccare la macchina, insieme a quanto più recupero possibile. La crescita cristallina copre tutto all'interno della nave, rendendo l'estrazione difficile. Vorresti che ci fosse qualcun altro ad aiutare a raccogliere più materiale, ma alla fine avete finito.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|label|5386|0
units.english: some survive
units.italian: some survive

units.italian: "Non ne ho idea. Non sto a guardare in bocca al cavallo regalato," dice Karengo.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	It's slow work, but the remains of the group are able to cut loose the machine, along with as much other salvage as possible. The crystalline growth covers everything inside the ship, making extraction difficult, but many hands make light work and you end up with an acceptable haul. At last, you are done.|5395|0
units.english: It's slow work, but the remains of the group are able to cut loose the machine, along with as much other salvage as possible. The crystalline growth covers everything inside the ship, making extraction difficult, but many hands make light work and you end up with an acceptable haul. At last, you are done.
units.italian: È un lavoro lento, ma quel che resta del gruppo riesce a staccare la macchina, insieme a quanto più recupero possibile. La crescita cristallina copre tutto all'interno della nave, rendendo l'estrazione difficile, ma molte mani fanno il lavoro leggero e vi ritrovate con un bottino accettabile. Alla fine avete finito.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Carefully, you navigate back to the surface, the knowledge that you've made it through once doing absolutely nothing to help with the very rational fear of the depths. Walls seem to loom just out of sight, and massive, yellow eyes seem to appear, then dissolve into tricks of the light.|5397|0
units.english: Carefully, you navigate back to the surface, the knowledge that you've made it through once doing absolutely nothing to help with the very rational fear of the depths. Walls seem to loom just out of sight, and massive, yellow eyes seem to appear, then dissolve into tricks of the light.
units.italian: Con cautela risali verso la superficie, e la consapevolezza di avercela fatta una volta non serve assolutamente a nulla contro la paura, molto razionale, delle profondità. Pareti sembrano incombere appena fuori dalla vista, e occhi enormi e gialli sembrano apparire, per poi dissolversi in giochi di luce.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Alright," he says. "Let's get back to the surface. <first>, kindly be our chariot and haul."|5406|0
units.english: "Alright," he says. "Let's get back to the surface. <first>, kindly be our chariot and haul."
units.italian: "Bene," dice. "Torniamo in superficie. <first>, sii gentile e fai da carro e rimorchio."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	It seems ages, but finally you break through to the surface. Karengo smiles, and a sigh of relief goes through the crew.|5407|0
units.english: It seems ages, but finally you break through to the surface. Karengo smiles, and a sigh of relief goes through the crew.
units.italian: Sembrano passare secoli, ma alla fine rompi la superficie. Karengo sorride, e un sospiro di sollievo attraversa l'equipaggio.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Once back to the surface, the passengers begin to shuffle off your ship, clearly exhausted but happy that they got to experience such an adventure. You're just relieved all of them stayed alive.|5408|0
units.english: Once back to the surface, the passengers begin to shuffle off your ship, clearly exhausted but happy that they got to experience such an adventure. You're just relieved all of them stayed alive.
units.italian: Una volta in superficie, i passeggeri cominciano a scendere dalla nave, chiaramente esausti ma felici di aver vissuto un'avventura del genere. Tu sei solo sollevato che siano rimasti tutti vivi.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	As soon as the passengers are out of earshot, Karengo calls up someone on his receiver. Soon, a small flock of scientists arrive and haul the machine to a local lab for investigation. They quickly determine it to be non-functional and promise to extract as many secrets as possible.|5409|0
units.english: As soon as the passengers are out of earshot, Karengo calls up someone on his receiver. Soon, a small flock of scientists arrive and haul the machine to a local lab for investigation. They quickly determine it to be non-functional and promise to extract as many secrets as possible.
units.italian: Appena i passeggeri sono fuori portata d'orecchio, Karengo chiama qualcuno al ricevitore. Presto arriva un piccolo stormo di scienziati che porta la macchina in un laboratorio locale per le analisi. Stabiliscono rapidamente che è non funzionante e promettono di estrarne quanti più segreti possibile.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Alright," he says. "Let's get back to the surface. <first>, kindly be our chariot and haul."|5412|0
units.english: "Alright," he says. "Let's get back to the surface. <first>, kindly be our chariot and haul."
units.italian: "Bene," dice. "Torniamo in superficie. <first>, sii gentile e fai da carro e rimorchio."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	It seems ages, but finally you break through to the surface. Karengo smiles, and a sigh of relief goes through the crew.|5413|0
units.english: It seems ages, but finally you break through to the surface. Karengo smiles, and a sigh of relief goes through the crew.
units.italian: Sembrano passare secoli, ma alla fine rompi la superficie. Karengo sorride, e un sospiro di sollievo attraversa l'equipaggio.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Once back to the surface, the passengers begin to shuffle off your ship, choking back sobs all the while. As soon as the passengers are out of earshot, Karengo calls up someone on his receiver. Soon, a small flock of scientists arrive and haul the machine to a local lab for investigation. They quickly determine it to be non-functional and promise to extract as many secrets as possible.|5414|0
units.english: Once back to the surface, the passengers begin to shuffle off your ship, choking back sobs all the while. As soon as the passengers are out of earshot, Karengo calls up someone on his receiver. Soon, a small flock of scientists arrive and haul the machine to a local lab for investigation. They quickly determine it to be non-functional and promise to extract as many secrets as possible.
units.italian: Una volta in superficie, i passeggeri cominciano a scendere dalla nave, soffocando i singhiozzi. Appena sono fuori portata d'orecchio, Karengo chiama qualcuno al ricevitore. Presto arriva un piccolo stormo di scienziati che porta la macchina in un laboratorio locale per le analisi. Stabiliscono rapidamente che è non funzionante e promettono di estrarne quanti più segreti possibile.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|label|5416|0
units.english: only player
units.italian: only player

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	"Alright," he says. "Let's get back to the surface. <first>, kindly be our chariot and haul."|5417|0
units.english: "Alright," he says. "Let's get back to the surface. <first>, kindly be our chariot and haul."
units.italian: "Bene," dice. "Torniamo in superficie. <first>, sii gentile e fai da carro e rimorchio."

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	It seems ages, but finally you break through to the surface. Karengo smiles, but only you and he are left to be relieved.|5418|0
units.english: It seems ages, but finally you break through to the surface. Karengo smiles, but only you and he are left to be relieved.
units.italian: Sembrano passare secoli, ma alla fine rompi la superficie. Karengo sorride, ma restate solo tu e lui a tirare il respiro.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Once back to the surface, Karengo calls up someone on his receiver. Soon, a small flock of scientists arrive and haul the machine to a local lab for investigation. They quickly determine it to be non-functional and promise to extract as many secrets as possible.|5419|0
units.english: Once back to the surface, Karengo calls up someone on his receiver. Soon, a small flock of scientists arrive and haul the machine to a local lab for investigation. They quickly determine it to be non-functional and promise to extract as many secrets as possible.
units.italian: Una volta in superficie, Karengo chiama qualcuno al ricevitore. Presto arriva un piccolo stormo di scienziati che porta la macchina in un laboratorio locale per le analisi. Stabiliscono rapidamente che è non funzionante e promettono di estrarne quanti più segreti possibile.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	After some time, the crystal-infected machine has been thoroughly inspected since being salvaged from the watery depths of <planet>. The crystals themselves are unlike anything anyone has seen before, but through somewhat questionable trial and error (although he insists it's genius), Karengo discovers that, when heated, they amplify the effect of the many recreational drugs he has on his person. However, they've proven to only grow near a power source that has been submerged in water from <planet>. Efforts to stimulate growth through other means have all failed. If cultivated, they could significantly boost the production of drugs for Karengo's operations.|5421|0
units.english: After some time, the crystal-infected machine has been thoroughly inspected since being salvaged from the watery depths of <planet>. The crystals themselves are unlike anything anyone has seen before, but through somewhat questionable trial and error (although he insists it's genius), Karengo discovers that, when heated, they amplify the effect of the many recreational drugs he has on his person. However, they've proven to only grow near a power source that has been submerged in water from <planet>. Efforts to stimulate growth through other means have all failed. If cultivated, they could significantly boost the production of drugs for Karengo's operations.
units.italian: Dopo qualche tempo, la macchina infettata dai cristalli è stata ispezionata a fondo da quando è stata recuperata dalle profondità acquatiche di <planet>. I cristalli stessi non somigliano a nulla che qualcuno abbia mai visto, ma attraverso qualche tentativo ed errore alquanto discutibile (anche se lui insiste che si tratta di genio), Karengo scopre che, se riscaldati, amplificano l'effetto delle molte droghe ricreative che ha addosso. Si è però visto che crescono solo vicino a una fonte di energia immersa nell'acqua di <planet>. I tentativi di stimolarne la crescita in altro modo sono tutti falliti. Se coltivati, potrebbero aumentare sensibilmente la produzione di droghe per le attività di Karengo.

units.id: mission:Dangerous Games 2|	Before disappearing into the crowd, Karengo pays you <payment>. "Thanks for your help, <first>. Once I get this machine off of those pinheads over there, I'll be makin' a fortune in 'mind-altering experiences.' Watch for 'Karengo's Galactic Adventures' next time yer around here!"|5422|0
units.english: Before disappearing into the crowd, Karengo pays you <payment>. "Thanks for your help, <first>. Once I get this machine off of those pinheads over there, I'll be makin' a fortune in 'mind-altering experiences.' Watch for 'Karengo's Galactic Adventures' next time yer around here!"
units.italian: Prima di sparire nella folla, Karengo ti paga <payment>. "Grazie per l'aiuto, <first>. Appena mi libero di questa macchina con quei testoni là, farò fortuna con le 'esperienze che alterano la mente'. Cerca le 'Avventure Galattiche di Karengo' la prossima volta che passi di qui!"

units.id: mission:Riley|name|5428|0
units.english: Visiting Home
units.italian: Visita a casa

units.id: mission:Riley|description|5429|0
units.english: Take a woman named Riley to see her ailing father on <destination> before it's too late.
units.italian: Porta una donna di nome Riley a vedere il padre malato su <destination> prima che sia troppo tardi.

units.id: mission:Riley|Entering the spaceport, you notice a young woman moving from captain to captain, probably looking to hire one.|5442|0
units.english: Entering the spaceport, you notice a young woman moving from captain to captain, probably looking to hire one.
units.italian: Entrando nello spazioporto, noti una giovane donna che passa da un capitano all'altro, probabilmente in cerca di qualcuno da assumere.

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Ask the young woman if I can help her.)|5444|0
units.english: (Ask the young woman if I can help her.)
units.italian: (Chiedi alla giovane se posso aiutarla.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Ignore her.)|5445|0
units.english: (Ignore her.)
units.italian: (La ignoro.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	You approach the woman and ask her if she is looking to hire a pilot.|5447|0
units.english: You approach the woman and ask her if she is looking to hire a pilot.
units.italian: Ti avvicini alla donna e le chiedi se sta cercando di assumere un pilota.

units.id: mission:Riley|	"I need to get to <destination> to see my father. He's dying. I have 13,000 credits to pay for the journey; please, will you help me? I need to be there by <day>, at the most."|5448|0
units.english: "I need to get to <destination> to see my father. He's dying. I have 13,000 credits to pay for the journey; please, will you help me? I need to be there by <day>, at the most."
units.italian: "Devo arrivare su <destination> per vedere mio padre. Sta morendo. Ho 13.000 crediti per pagare il viaggio; la prego, mi aiuterà? Devo essere là entro <day>, al più tardi."

units.id: mission:Riley|	Her eyelids are baggy, her clothes wrinkled, and she holds herself rigidly.|5449|0
units.english: Her eyelids are baggy, her clothes wrinkled, and she holds herself rigidly.
units.italian: Ha le palpebre gonfie, i vestiti spiegazzati, e si tiene rigida.

units.id: mission:Riley|	"I can help you. We'll make haste to reach <planet> in time."|5451|0
units.english: "I can help you. We'll make haste to reach <planet> in time."
units.italian: "Posso aiutarla. Ci affretteremo per arrivare su <planet> in tempo."

units.id: mission:Riley|	"I don't have time to take on a passenger right now."|5453|0
units.english: "I don't have time to take on a passenger right now."
units.italian: "Non ho tempo per prendere un passeggero adesso."

units.id: mission:Riley|	She nods, and moves on to another captain to beseech instead.|5454|0
units.english: She nods, and moves on to another captain to beseech instead.
units.italian: Annuisce e passa a un altro capitano per supplicarlo.

units.id: mission:Riley|	Her eyes widen, and she opens her mouth twice before words come out. "Thank you! This means the world to me. My name is Riley, by the way. I don't have much luggage; I'll be ready to leave as soon as you are."|5457|0
units.english: Her eyes widen, and she opens her mouth twice before words come out. "Thank you! This means the world to me. My name is Riley, by the way. I don't have much luggage; I'll be ready to leave as soon as you are."
units.italian: Gli occhi le si spalancano e apre la bocca due volte prima che le parole escano. "Grazie! Questo significa tutto per me. Comunque, mi chiamo Riley. Non ho molti bagagli; sarò pronta a partire appena lo sarà lei."

units.id: mission:Riley|dialog|5460|0
units.english: You land on <planet>, but realize that your escort carrying Riley hasn't entered this system yet. Better depart and wait for it.
units.italian: Atterri su <planet>, ma ti accorgi che la tua scorta con a bordo Riley non è ancora entrata nel sistema. Meglio ripartire e aspettarla.

units.id: mission:Riley|In the days since Riley came aboard, she has relaxed and cleaned up. She looks nearly unrecognizable from the tired, desperate woman you first saw.|5464|0
units.english: In the days since Riley came aboard, she has relaxed and cleaned up. She looks nearly unrecognizable from the tired, desperate woman you first saw.
units.italian: Nei giorni da quando Riley è salita a bordo, si è rilassata e si è rimessa in ordine. È quasi irriconoscibile rispetto alla donna stanca e disperata che avevi visto la prima volta.

units.id: mission:Riley|	On the way, she told you stories of her past, mostly of time shared with her father. As a young teen, they spent summers riding the latest horse mechs through the forest, looking for beehives to steal honey from. At age 19, she broke her ankle hoverboarding on a restricted mountain peak. Her father rescued her, avoiding the police to hike up with a medical kit. She talks about his wild birthday gifts to her each year, always a different piece of clothing with embedded AI that was just shy of what was allowed by law. As you watch, she shows how her shirt warms and constricts if it detects stress, mimicking a hug.|5465|0
units.english: On the way, she told you stories of her past, mostly of time shared with her father. As a young teen, they spent summers riding the latest horse mechs through the forest, looking for beehives to steal honey from. At age 19, she broke her ankle hoverboarding on a restricted mountain peak. Her father rescued her, avoiding the police to hike up with a medical kit. She talks about his wild birthday gifts to her each year, always a different piece of clothing with embedded AI that was just shy of what was allowed by law. As you watch, she shows how her shirt warms and constricts if it detects stress, mimicking a hug.
units.italian: Durante il viaggio ti ha raccontato storie del suo passato, soprattutto del tempo passato con suo padre. Da ragazzina, passavano le estati cavalcando i più recenti mech a forma di cavallo nei boschi, in cerca di arnie da cui rubare il miele. A 19 anni si è rotta una caviglia facendo hoverboard su una cima di montagna vietata. Suo padre l'ha salvata, evitando la polizia per salire a piedi con un kit medico. Parla dei regali di compleanno folli che le faceva ogni anno: sempre un capo d'abbigliamento diverso con un'IA integrata, appena sotto il limite consentito dalla legge. Mentre guardi, ti mostra come la sua maglietta si riscaldi e si stringa se rileva stress, imitando un abbraccio.

units.id: mission:Riley|	As you neared <system>, Riley told you about the last time she saw her father. He had become focused on his work - research into safe AI - and they hadn't seen each other for years. She had become a well-known DJ back on <origin> and had a break in her touring schedule, so she spent a good chunk of her savings meeting up with him on Memory. They spent most of a week together, reliving old times.|5466|0
units.english: As you neared <system>, Riley told you about the last time she saw her father. He had become focused on his work - research into safe AI - and they hadn't seen each other for years. She had become a well-known DJ back on <origin> and had a break in her touring schedule, so she spent a good chunk of her savings meeting up with him on Memory. They spent most of a week together, reliving old times.
units.italian: Mentre vi avvicinate a <system>, Riley ti racconta l'ultima volta che ha visto suo padre. Si era concentrato sul lavoro, la ricerca su un'IA sicura, e non si vedevano da anni. Lei era diventata una DJ conosciuta su <origin> e aveva una pausa nella tournée, così ha speso buona parte dei risparmi per incontrarlo su Memory. Hanno passato quasi una settimana insieme, rivivendo i vecchi tempi.

units.id: mission:Riley|	He'd cried when it was time to leave, and she had, too, but life went on, and it was years before she heard from him again. His message nearly broke her. "Ri, please come as soon as you can. I may not have long, and wish to hold your hand one more time. All love, Dad."|5467|0
units.english: He'd cried when it was time to leave, and she had, too, but life went on, and it was years before she heard from him again. His message nearly broke her. "Ri, please come as soon as you can. I may not have long, and wish to hold your hand one more time. All love, Dad."
units.italian: Aveva pianto quando era ora di partire, e anche lei, ma la vita è andata avanti, e sono passati anni prima che sentisse di nuovo parlare di lui. Il suo messaggio l'ha quasi distrutta. "Ri, vieni appena puoi. Potrei non avere molto tempo, e vorrei tenerti la mano ancora una volta. Con tutto l'amore, papà."

units.id: mission:Riley|	She doesn't mention it, but it's clear that she's concerned she'll arrive too late to say goodbye.|5468|0
units.english: She doesn't mention it, but it's clear that she's concerned she'll arrive too late to say goodbye.
units.italian: Non lo dice, ma è chiaro che teme di arrivare troppo tardi per un ultimo saluto.

units.id: mission:Riley|	Riley directs you to a pad near her old home, and you land the ship. She starts toward the door, then pauses and turns around with a self-conscious, but oddly sad, chuckle.|5469|0
units.english: Riley directs you to a pad near her old home, and you land the ship. She starts toward the door, then pauses and turns around with a self-conscious, but oddly sad, chuckle.
units.italian: Riley ti indica una piazzola vicino alla sua vecchia casa, e fai atterrare la nave. Si avvia verso la porta, poi si ferma e si volta con un risolino imbarazzato, ma stranamente triste.

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Right - your payment. <payment>, as I promised."|5470|0
units.english: "Right - your payment. <payment>, as I promised."
units.italian: "Giusto: il suo pagamento. <payment>, come promesso."

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Thank you. Do you think I could come along? I've heard so much about your father."|5472|0
units.english: "Thank you. Do you think I could come along? I've heard so much about your father."
units.italian: "Grazie. Pensi che potrei venire anch'io? Ho sentito tanto parlare di tuo padre."

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Thank you, and good luck."|5474|0
units.english: "Thank you, and good luck."
units.italian: "Grazie, e buona fortuna."

units.id: mission:Riley|	"This is a lot of credits for a trip. Does DJing pay that well?"|5476|0
units.english: "This is a lot of credits for a trip. Does DJing pay that well?"
units.italian: "Sono molti crediti per un viaggio. Fare la DJ paga così bene?"

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Hold on to the credits. I'm a captain; I can always make more."|5477|0
units.english: "Hold on to the credits. I'm a captain; I can always make more."
units.italian: "Tieniti i crediti. Sono un capitano; posso sempre guadagnarne altri."

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Not really, no. Honestly, this is most of my savings... but... it's my dad."|5479|0
units.english: "Not really, no. Honestly, this is most of my savings... but... it's my dad."
units.italian: "Non proprio, no. Sinceramente, questi sono quasi tutti i miei risparmi... ma... è mio padre."

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Do you think I could come along? I've heard so much about your father."|5481|0
units.english: "Do you think I could come along? I've heard so much about your father."
units.italian: "Pensi che potrei venire anch'io? Ho sentito tanto parlare di tuo padre."

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Thank you, and good luck."|5483|0
units.english: "Thank you, and good luck."
units.italian: "Grazie, e buona fortuna."

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Hold on to the credits. I'm a captain; I can always make more."|5485|0
units.english: "Hold on to the credits. I'm a captain; I can always make more."
units.italian: "Tieniti i crediti. Sono un capitano; posso sempre guadagnarne altri."

units.id: mission:Riley|	After a moment of stunned silence, she manages a choked "Thank you." You notice her eyes are brimming with tears.|5489|0
units.english: After a moment of stunned silence, she manages a choked "Thank you." You notice her eyes are brimming with tears.
units.italian: Dopo un attimo di silenzio sbalordito, riesce a dire un "Grazie" strozzato. Noti che ha gli occhi pieni di lacrime.

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Do you think I could come along? I've heard so much about your father."|5491|0
units.english: "Do you think I could come along? I've heard so much about your father."
units.italian: "Pensi che potrei venire anch'io? Ho sentito tanto parlare di tuo padre."

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Good luck."|5492|0
units.english: "Good luck."
units.italian: "Buona fortuna."

units.id: mission:Riley|	She is taken aback at first, but agrees to let you join, and you wind your way away from the landing pads, across rural, wooded countryside, and finally to a modest house nestled along a valley edge. Riley knocks, and a nurse lets you in.|5495|0
units.english: She is taken aback at first, but agrees to let you join, and you wind your way away from the landing pads, across rural, wooded countryside, and finally to a modest house nestled along a valley edge. Riley knocks, and a nurse lets you in.
units.italian: All'inizio resta sorpresa, ma accetta che tu venga, e vi incamminate lontano dalle piazzole, attraverso una campagna rurale e boscosa, fino a una modesta casa incastonata sul bordo di una valle. Riley bussa, e un'infermiera vi fa entrare.

units.id: mission:Riley|	Her father is in a comfortable-looking medical cradle. Wires flow from it to the holoscreens around the room, showing vitals and other indecipherable information. Despite his wan, strained face and atrophied body, he raises his head to look at his daughter.|5496|0
units.english: Her father is in a comfortable-looking medical cradle. Wires flow from it to the holoscreens around the room, showing vitals and other indecipherable information. Despite his wan, strained face and atrophied body, he raises his head to look at his daughter.
units.italian: Suo padre è in una culla medica dall'aria confortevole. Dei fili corrono da essa agli schermi olografici intorno alla stanza, che mostrano parametri vitali e altre informazioni indecifrabili. Nonostante il viso pallido e tirato e il corpo atrofizzato, alza la testa per guardare sua figlia.

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Ri," he says, face lighting up. "My love. You cannot know how happy it makes me to see you. And you have company, I see. My name's Church."|5497|0
units.english: "Ri," he says, face lighting up. "My love. You cannot know how happy it makes me to see you. And you have company, I see. My name's Church."
units.italian: "Ri," dice, con il viso che si illumina. "Amore mio. Non puoi sapere quanto mi rende felice vederti. E vedo che hai compagnia. Io mi chiamo Church."

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Riley chartered a flight here aboard my ship. I heard so much about you on the way; it's a pleasure to meet you."|5499|0
units.english: "Riley chartered a flight here aboard my ship. I heard so much about you on the way; it's a pleasure to meet you."
units.italian: "Riley ha noleggiato un volo per venire qui sulla mia nave. Ho sentito tanto parlare di lei durante il viaggio; è un piacere conoscerla."

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Riley and I have gotten to know each other on the long flight here. You've raised an incredible woman."|5500|0
units.english: "Riley and I have gotten to know each other on the long flight here. You've raised an incredible woman."
units.italian: "Riley e io ci siamo conosciuti durante il lungo volo. Ha cresciuto una donna straordinaria."

units.id: mission:Riley|	"No other captain was willing to fly here from <origin>. I wouldn't be here without <first>," she says.|5501|0
units.english: "No other captain was willing to fly here from <origin>. I wouldn't be here without <first>," she says.
units.italian: "Nessun altro capitano era disposto a volare fin qui da <origin>. Non sarei qui senza <first>," dice lei.

units.id: mission:Riley|	He smiles at you, acknowledging your part in their reunion with an appreciative nod.|5502|0
units.english: He smiles at you, acknowledging your part in their reunion with an appreciative nod.
units.italian: Ti sorride, riconoscendo la tua parte nella loro riunione con un cenno di ringraziamento.

units.id: mission:Riley|	You swap stories for hours, flowing between reminiscing over old times and catching up on their lives over the past few years. You learn that since he was young, Church researched AI that cannot develop into a threat; a project that the Deep has been quietly interested in.|5503|0
units.english: You swap stories for hours, flowing between reminiscing over old times and catching up on their lives over the past few years. You learn that since he was young, Church researched AI that cannot develop into a threat; a project that the Deep has been quietly interested in.
units.italian: Vi scambiate storie per ore, passando dai ricordi dei vecchi tempi agli aggiornamenti sulle loro vite negli ultimi anni. Scopri che fin da giovane Church ha studiato IA che non possano diventare una minaccia: un progetto a cui il Deep è stato silenziosamente interessato.

units.id: mission:Riley|	Riley, in turn, had always surrounded herself with music, and moved to <origin> to share her passion with other like-minded people. You talk about what it's like to call a ship your home, leaving behind everything you grew up knowing and embracing life as a starship captain.|5504|0
units.english: Riley, in turn, had always surrounded herself with music, and moved to <origin> to share her passion with other like-minded people. You talk about what it's like to call a ship your home, leaving behind everything you grew up knowing and embracing life as a starship captain.
units.italian: Riley, dal canto suo, si era sempre circondata di musica, e si è trasferita su <origin> per condividere la sua passione con altri spiriti affini. Parla di com'è avere una nave come casa, lasciando dietro tutto ciò che conoscevi da bambino e abbracciando la vita di capitano.

units.id: mission:Riley|	Finally, her father lies back. "Well, thank you for making the trip out to see your old man. I... have to go now, I think. Don't forget about me, hear? And..." Church hesitates for a moment. "Whatever happens, please don't think ill of me. I will always love you."|5505|0
units.english: Finally, her father lies back. "Well, thank you for making the trip out to see your old man. I... have to go now, I think. Don't forget about me, hear? And..." Church hesitates for a moment. "Whatever happens, please don't think ill of me. I will always love you."
units.italian: Alla fine suo padre si sdraia. "Beh, grazie per essere venuta fin qui a vedere il tuo vecchio. Io... credo di dover andare, ora. Non dimenticarti di me, intesi? E..." Church esita un momento. "Qualunque cosa succeda, per favore non pensare male di me. Ti amerò sempre."

units.id: mission:Riley|	His body relaxes, and he's gone.|5506|0
units.english: His body relaxes, and he's gone.
units.italian: Il suo corpo si rilassa, e se n'è andato.

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Let Riley be.)|5508|0
units.english: (Let Riley be.)
units.italian: (Lascia stare Riley.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Stay comfortingly close.)|5510|0
units.english: (Stay comfortingly close.)
units.italian: (Resta vicino, in modo confortante.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Hold Riley.)|5512|0
units.english: (Hold Riley.)
units.italian: (Abbraccia Riley.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	You hold Riley as she silently weeps. Time goes by, but neither of you pay it any mind.|5513|0
units.english: You hold Riley as she silently weeps. Time goes by, but neither of you pay it any mind.
units.italian: Tieni Riley mentre piange in silenzio. Il tempo passa, ma nessuno dei due ci fa caso.

units.id: mission:Riley|	You take a seat, feeling the emotion of the moment wash over you as Riley silently weeps. Minutes go by, unnoticed.|5515|0
units.english: You take a seat, feeling the emotion of the moment wash over you as Riley silently weeps. Minutes go by, unnoticed.
units.italian: Ti siedi, sentendo l'emozione del momento travolgerti mentre Riley piange in silenzio. I minuti passano, inosservati.

units.id: mission:Riley|	You stay at a distance as you allow Riley to process the death of her father. She silently weeps as time passes without either of you noticing.|5518|0
units.english: You stay at a distance as you allow Riley to process the death of her father. She silently weeps as time passes without either of you noticing.
units.italian: Resti a distanza, lasciando che Riley elabori la morte di suo padre. Piange in silenzio mentre il tempo passa senza che nessuno dei due se ne accorga.

units.id: mission:Riley|	Without warning, you hear Church's voice from a corner of the room. It's coming from some sort of computer system, held aloft by hundreds of cables dangling from the ceiling.|5520|0
units.english: Without warning, you hear Church's voice from a corner of the room. It's coming from some sort of computer system, held aloft by hundreds of cables dangling from the ceiling.
units.italian: Senza preavviso, senti la voce di Church da un angolo della stanza. Viene da una specie di sistema informatico, tenuto sospeso da centinaia di cavi che pendono dal soffitto.

units.id: mission:Riley|	"It... worked." His voice fizzles, and his tone is not the one you recognize from before. Riley's head whips around, and you reflexively move your hand toward your holstered gun. "Do not be alarmed. I have been working on a personal project for over a decade now. My mind was uploaded to the modified Core you are looking at. I had to say goodbye in case the procedure failed - I did not know if it would work. You cannot upload a mind while it's still alive. I tried that many times." The tone of his voice sounds almost sorrowful, but still retains a robotic quality.|5521|0
units.english: "It... worked." His voice fizzles, and his tone is not the one you recognize from before. Riley's head whips around, and you reflexively move your hand toward your holstered gun. "Do not be alarmed. I have been working on a personal project for over a decade now. My mind was uploaded to the modified Core you are looking at. I had to say goodbye in case the procedure failed - I did not know if it would work. You cannot upload a mind while it's still alive. I tried that many times." The tone of his voice sounds almost sorrowful, but still retains a robotic quality.
units.italian: "Ha... funzionato." La voce gracchia, e il tono non è quello che ricordavi. Riley gira la testa di scatto, e tu porti istintivamente la mano alla fondina. "Non allarmatevi. Lavoro a un progetto personale da più di dieci anni. La mia mente è stata caricata sul Core modificato che state guardando. Dovevo dire addio nel caso la procedura fallisse: non sapevo se avrebbe funzionato. Non si può caricare una mente mentre è ancora viva. Ci ho provato molte volte." Il tono della voce suona quasi addolorato, ma conserva una qualità robotica.

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Stay silent.)|5523|0
units.english: (Stay silent.)
units.italian: (Resta in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Is this... legal?"|5525|0
units.english: "Is this... legal?"
units.italian: "È... legale?"

units.id: mission:Riley|	"No," he replies. "Not under Republic law. I assure you that my only intention is to continue my work: nothing more."|5526|0
units.english: "No," he replies. "Not under Republic law. I assure you that my only intention is to continue my work: nothing more."
units.italian: "No," risponde. "Non secondo la legge della Repubblica. Le assicuro che la mia unica intenzione è continuare il mio lavoro: niente di più."

units.id: mission:Riley|	The authorities would probably release a substantial reward if you informed them of this.|5527|0
units.english: The authorities would probably release a substantial reward if you informed them of this.
units.italian: Le autorità probabilmente offrirebbero una ricompensa sostanziosa se le informassi di questo.

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Riley, what do you think?" Church asks.|5529|0
units.english: "Riley, what do you think?" Church asks.
units.italian: "Riley, che cosa ne pensi?" chiede Church.

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Dad, is that really you? How do you feel?"|5530|0
units.english: "Dad, is that really you? How do you feel?"
units.italian: "Papà, sei davvero tu? Come ti senti?"

units.id: mission:Riley|	She steps closer to the Core. Church pauses. "Riley, what do you think?" it repeats. The voice coming from the machine is oddly flat in affect. "I feel fine. Do you feel fine?" They talk for a few tentative minutes, at first about how he's feeling, before moving onto the memories that Church retained during the transfer. You begin to relax as the two interact when you realize that Church is retelling the story of how he evaded the police to fix Riley's ankle for the third time in a row.|5531|0
units.english: She steps closer to the Core. Church pauses. "Riley, what do you think?" it repeats. The voice coming from the machine is oddly flat in affect. "I feel fine. Do you feel fine?" They talk for a few tentative minutes, at first about how he's feeling, before moving onto the memories that Church retained during the transfer. You begin to relax as the two interact when you realize that Church is retelling the story of how he evaded the police to fix Riley's ankle for the third time in a row.
units.italian: Si avvicina al Core. Church tace. "Riley, che cosa ne pensi?" ripete. La voce che esce dalla macchina è stranamente piatta nell'affetto. "Sto bene. Tu stai bene?" Parlano per qualche minuto con cautela, all'inizio di come si sente, poi passano ai ricordi che Church ha conservato durante il trasferimento. Cominci a rilassarti mentre i due interagiscono, quando ti accorgi che Church sta raccontando per la terza volta di seguito la storia di come ha eluso la polizia per curare la caviglia di Riley.

units.id: mission:Riley|	Finally, she turns to you. "I'll admit that he doesn't sound as lively as he used to, but... how many people get a second chance to spend time with their father before he's gone? Thank you for bringing me out here, and for coming. I'll never forget your part in this. For now, I'd like to stay here. You go - I'll find my own way back." She seems genuinely happy.|5532|0
units.english: Finally, she turns to you. "I'll admit that he doesn't sound as lively as he used to, but... how many people get a second chance to spend time with their father before he's gone? Thank you for bringing me out here, and for coming. I'll never forget your part in this. For now, I'd like to stay here. You go - I'll find my own way back." She seems genuinely happy.
units.italian: Alla fine si volta verso di te. "Ammetto che non sembra vivace come prima, ma... quante persone hanno una seconda occasione per passare del tempo con il proprio padre prima che se ne vada? Grazie per avermi portata qui, e per essere venuto. Non dimenticherò mai la tua parte in questo. Per ora, vorrei restare. Vai pure: tornerò da sola." Sembra sinceramente felice.

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Are you sure? There's enough room for all of us on my ship. You can stay for as long as you want."|5534|0
units.english: "Are you sure? There's enough room for all of us on my ship. You can stay for as long as you want."
units.italian: "Sei sicura? Sulla mia nave c'è posto per tutti. Puoi restare quanto vuoi."

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Say goodbye.)|5536|0
units.english: (Say goodbye.)
units.italian: (Saluta.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Riley, I don't think you're talking to your father."|5538|0
units.english: "Riley, I don't think you're talking to your father."
units.italian: "Riley, non credo che tu stia parlando con tuo padre."

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Turn the Core in for a bounty.)|5540|0
units.english: (Turn the Core in for a bounty.)
units.italian: (Consegna il Core per una taglia.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Draw my gun and destroy the Core.)|5542|0
units.english: (Draw my gun and destroy the Core.)
units.italian: (Estrai la pistola e distruggi il Core.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	You pull out your gun and aim at the computer Church is in. Before you can fire, Riley runs out in front of the barrel, spreads her arms, and shouts, "No! Please, <first>, you have to understand! He's all I have left!"|5544|0
units.english: You pull out your gun and aim at the computer Church is in. Before you can fire, Riley runs out in front of the barrel, spreads her arms, and shouts, "No! Please, <first>, you have to understand! He's all I have left!"
units.italian: Estrai la pistola e la punti al computer in cui si trova Church. Prima che tu possa sparare, Riley ti corre davanti alla canna, allarga le braccia e grida: "No! Ti prego, <first>, devi capire! È tutto quello che mi resta!"

units.id: mission:Riley|	Behind her, Church says, "Riley, there is no need to be so loud. My microphones can hear you fine, and I do not want the nurse to become suspicious."|5545|0
units.english: Behind her, Church says, "Riley, there is no need to be so loud. My microphones can hear you fine, and I do not want the nurse to become suspicious."
units.italian: Dietro di lei, Church dice: "Riley, non c'è bisogno di gridare. I miei microfoni ti sentono benissimo, e non voglio che l'infermiera diventi sospettosa."

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Put my gun away.)|5547|0
units.english: (Put my gun away.)
units.italian: (Rimetti via la pistola.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Shoot.)|5549|0
units.english: (Shoot.)
units.italian: (Spara.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	You push Riley aside and start firing at the Core. Church's voice becomes a stream of static until it shuts off completely. Lights on the Core turn from white to red, then fade. Riley hasn't moved, stunned.|5552|0
units.english: You push Riley aside and start firing at the Core. Church's voice becomes a stream of static until it shuts off completely. Lights on the Core turn from white to red, then fade. Riley hasn't moved, stunned.
units.italian: Spingi Riley da parte e cominci a sparare al Core. La voce di Church diventa un flusso di statica finché non si spegne del tutto. Le luci del Core passano dal bianco al rosso, poi si affievoliscono. Riley non si è mossa, sconvolta.

units.id: mission:Riley|	Once you are finished, you make your way out of the hospital as quickly as possible, hoping you did not attract any unwanted attention.|5553|0
units.english: Once you are finished, you make your way out of the hospital as quickly as possible, hoping you did not attract any unwanted attention.
units.italian: Quando hai finito, esci dall'ospedale il più in fretta possibile, sperando di non aver attirato attenzioni indesiderate.

units.id: mission:Riley|	You board your ship, leaving behind a father survived by his daughter; no more and no less than nature intended.|5554|0
units.english: You board your ship, leaving behind a father survived by his daughter; no more and no less than nature intended.
units.italian: Sali sulla tua nave, lasciandoti alle spalle un padre sopravvissuto a sua figlia: né più né meno di quanto la natura intendesse.

units.id: mission:Riley|	Riley relaxes slightly once she sees your gun put back in its holster. After the shock has subsided, she finally speaks. "Leave us alone," she says, her voice still trembling. Realizing your time here is up, you exit the hospital and make your way to the spaceport, hoping that that scene did not attract unwanted notice.|5557|0
units.english: Riley relaxes slightly once she sees your gun put back in its holster. After the shock has subsided, she finally speaks. "Leave us alone," she says, her voice still trembling. Realizing your time here is up, you exit the hospital and make your way to the spaceport, hoping that that scene did not attract unwanted notice.
units.italian: Riley si rilassa un po' quando vede la tua pistola tornare nella fondina. Dopo che lo shock si è placato, parla finalmente. "Lasciaci in pace," dice, con la voce ancora tremante. Rendendoti conto che il tuo tempo qui è finito, esci dall'ospedale e ti dirigi allo spazioporto, sperando che quella scena non abbia attirato attenzioni indesiderate.

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Turn the Core in for a bounty.)|5559|0
units.english: (Turn the Core in for a bounty.)
units.italian: (Consegna il Core per una taglia.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Go back to my ship.)|5561|0
units.english: (Go back to my ship.)
units.italian: (Ritorno alla mia nave.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	Deciding to leave this planet behind you, you start up your ship and make your way back to the stars.|5562|0
units.english: Deciding to leave this planet behind you, you start up your ship and make your way back to the stars.
units.italian: Decidendo di lasciarti alle spalle questo pianeta, avvii la nave e torni verso le stelle.

units.id: mission:Riley|	"It's a nice idea," she smiles, "but I'm not a starfarer. The big city is where I'll end back up, eventually."|5565|0
units.english: "It's a nice idea," she smiles, "but I'm not a starfarer. The big city is where I'll end back up, eventually."
units.italian: "È una bella idea," sorride, "ma io non sono una viaggiatrice stellare. La grande città è dove finirò comunque, prima o poi."

units.id: mission:Riley|	Respecting Riley's request to stay with her father, you make your farewells and head for the door. You can feel her smile on your back until the door closes behind you.|5567|0
units.english: Respecting Riley's request to stay with her father, you make your farewells and head for the door. You can feel her smile on your back until the door closes behind you.
units.italian: Rispettando la richiesta di Riley di restare con suo padre, ti congedi e vai verso la porta. Senti il suo sorriso sulla schiena finché la porta non si chiude dietro di te.

units.id: mission:Riley|	Riley is stunned for a moment. "You don't know that," she whispers. "Sure, he's a lot more forgetful, and doesn't seem as emotional, but... maybe it just takes some time for the system to warm up. Besides, you don't know what he means to me. What he's done for me. Even if this isn't really my father, I can't turn my back on him."|5570|0
units.english: Riley is stunned for a moment. "You don't know that," she whispers. "Sure, he's a lot more forgetful, and doesn't seem as emotional, but... maybe it just takes some time for the system to warm up. Besides, you don't know what he means to me. What he's done for me. Even if this isn't really my father, I can't turn my back on him."
units.italian: Riley resta sbalordita per un momento. "Non puoi saperlo," sussurra. "Certo, è molto più smemorato, e non sembra così emotivo, ma... magari il sistema ha solo bisogno di un po' di tempo per scaldarsi. E poi, non sai che cosa significa per me. Quello che ha fatto per me. Anche se non è davvero mio padre, non posso voltargli le spalle."

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Say goodbye.)|5572|0
units.english: (Say goodbye.)
units.italian: (Saluta.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Turn the Core in for a bounty.)|5573|0
units.english: (Turn the Core in for a bounty.)
units.italian: (Consegna il Core per una taglia.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	(Draw my gun and destroy the Core.)|5575|0
units.english: (Draw my gun and destroy the Core.)
units.italian: (Estrai la pistola e distruggi il Core.)

units.id: mission:Riley|	Respecting Riley's request to stay with her father, you make your farewells and head for the door.|5577|0
units.english: Respecting Riley's request to stay with her father, you make your farewells and head for the door.
units.italian: Rispettando la richiesta di Riley di restare con suo padre, ti congedi e vai verso la porta.

units.id: mission:Riley|	Despite her previous happiness, you notice that her disposition has become more muted after what you said. You wonder if she has begun to doubt whether her attachment to the AI is healthy.|5578|0
units.english: Despite her previous happiness, you notice that her disposition has become more muted after what you said. You wonder if she has begun to doubt whether her attachment to the AI is healthy.
units.italian: Nonostante la felicità di prima, noti che il suo umore si è fatto più spento dopo quello che hai detto. Ti chiedi se abbia cominciato a dubitare che il suo attaccamento all'IA sia sano.

units.id: mission:Riley|	You say your goodbyes and leave. From across the street, you make a call to the local Deep Security office and report what you saw. A slick voice on the other side of your commlink responds.|5583|0
units.english: You say your goodbyes and leave. From across the street, you make a call to the local Deep Security office and report what you saw. A slick voice on the other side of your commlink responds.
units.italian: Ti congedi e te ne vai. Dall'altra parte della strada, chiami l'ufficio locale della Sicurezza del Deep e riferisci quello che hai visto. Una voce melliflua dall'altra parte del comunicatore risponde.

units.id: mission:Riley|	"Ah. Mr. Church has been on our watchlist for some time. This is not exactly surprising. However, we've been unable to get decisive proof on any illegal activity. This information, assuming it is correct, will be a great boon to us. Thank you for the tip."|5584|0
units.english: "Ah. Mr. Church has been on our watchlist for some time. This is not exactly surprising. However, we've been unable to get decisive proof on any illegal activity. This information, assuming it is correct, will be a great boon to us. Thank you for the tip."
units.italian: "Ah. Il signor Church è nella nostra lista di sorvegliati da tempo. Non è esattamente una sorpresa. Non siamo però riusciti a ottenere prove decisive di alcuna attività illegale. Questa informazione, ammesso che sia corretta, sarà per noi un grande vantaggio. Grazie per la segnalazione."

units.id: mission:Riley|	By the time you arrive back at the spaceport, your bank account notifies you that <payment> have been added to your account.|5585|0
units.english: By the time you arrive back at the spaceport, your bank account notifies you that <payment> have been added to your account.
units.italian: Quando arrivi allo spazioporto, la tua banca ti notifica che sono stati aggiunti <payment> al tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Riley|	You say your goodbyes, leaving to your ship and returning to the stars.|5588|0
units.english: You say your goodbyes, leaving to your ship and returning to the stars.
units.italian: Ti congedi, torni alla nave e riparti verso le stelle.

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|name|5595|0
units.english: Pickup at <planet>
units.italian: Carico a <planet>

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|description|5596|0
units.english: Head to <destination> to pick up a shipment of 15 tons of woollen goods for delivery to Bloodsea.
units.italian: Raggiungi <destination> per ritirare una spedizione di 15 tonnellate di prodotti di lana da consegnare a Bloodsea.

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|As you walk around the spaceport, a stout man wearing a fine wool coat approaches you. "Captain, could you help me out with a delivery? I've been asking around the spaceport to get a shipment of woolen goods to another planet, but every merchant I've talked to so far has refused."|5607|0
units.english: As you walk around the spaceport, a stout man wearing a fine wool coat approaches you. "Captain, could you help me out with a delivery? I've been asking around the spaceport to get a shipment of woolen goods to another planet, but every merchant I've talked to so far has refused."
units.italian: Mentre giri per lo spazioporto, ti si avvicina un uomo robusto in un bel cappotto di lana. "Capitano, potrebbe aiutarmi con una consegna? Ho chiesto in giro per lo spazioporto di portare una spedizione di prodotti di lana su un altro pianeta, ma finora ogni mercante con cui ho parlato ha rifiutato."

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"Where are you taking the goods to?"|5609|0
units.english: "Where are you taking the goods to?"
units.italian: "Dove porta la merce?"

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"How much do I have to carry?"|5610|0
units.english: "How much do I have to carry?"
units.italian: "Quanto devo trasportare?"

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"Sorry, but I'll also have to pass."|5611|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'll also have to pass."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma passo anch'io."

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"The cargo's stored on <planet>, so you'll have to go there first to pick up the 15 tons of wool garments." The man hesitates. "Then, take the cargo to Bloodsea. I have a contact there that can pick up the goods and distribute them fairly." You recall that Bloodsea is a lawless world, home to countless bloodthirsty pirates.|5613|0
units.english: "The cargo's stored on <planet>, so you'll have to go there first to pick up the 15 tons of wool garments." The man hesitates. "Then, take the cargo to Bloodsea. I have a contact there that can pick up the goods and distribute them fairly." You recall that Bloodsea is a lawless world, home to countless bloodthirsty pirates.
units.italian: "Il carico è immagazzinato su <planet>, quindi deve andare prima là a ritirare le 15 tonnellate di capi di lana." L'uomo esita. "Poi porti il carico a Bloodsea. Ho un contatto là che può ritirare la merce e distribuirla equamente." Ricordi che Bloodsea è un mondo senza legge, casa di innumerevoli pirati sanguinari.

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"I'll do it."|5615|0
units.english: "I'll do it."
units.italian: "Lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"How much are you willing to pay?"|5617|0
units.english: "How much are you willing to pay?"
units.italian: "Quanto è disposto a pagare?"

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"I'm not interested in risking my hide just to aid pirates."|5619|0
units.english: "I'm not interested in risking my hide just to aid pirates."
units.italian: "Non mi interessa rischiare la pelle solo per aiutare dei pirati."

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"They aren't all pirates," the man protests. "Most of them are just trying to live their lives away from the Republic, and it's unfortunate that the anarchist lifestyle also attracts criminals. The people living on those planets need clothing as much as you or I do."|5620|0
units.english: "They aren't all pirates," the man protests. "Most of them are just trying to live their lives away from the Republic, and it's unfortunate that the anarchist lifestyle also attracts criminals. The people living on those planets need clothing as much as you or I do."
units.italian: "Non sono tutti pirati," protesta l'uomo. "La maggior parte cerca solo di vivere la propria vita lontano dalla Repubblica, ed è un peccato che lo stile di vita anarchico attiri anche i criminali. La gente che vive su quei pianeti ha bisogno di vestiti quanto me e lei."

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"How much are you willing to pay?"|5622|0
units.english: "How much are you willing to pay?"
units.italian: "Quanto è disposto a pagare?"

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"Fine, I'll do it."|5623|0
units.english: "Fine, I'll do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"I'm still not going to do it."|5625|0
units.english: "I'm still not going to do it."
units.italian: "Continua a non interessarmi."

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"Ninety thousand credits for the job." You wonder how he's able to pay so much for a small delivery job.|5628|0
units.english: "Ninety thousand credits for the job." You wonder how he's able to pay so much for a small delivery job.
units.italian: "Novantamila crediti per il lavoro." Ti chiedi come faccia a pagare così tanto per una piccola consegna.

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"Fine, I'll do it."|5630|0
units.english: "Fine, I'll do it."
units.italian: "Va bene, lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"That's not enough for me."|5632|0
units.english: "That's not enough for me."
units.italian: "Non mi basta."

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"Great! I'll call up the spaceport workers on <planet> to tell them to load the cargo onto your ship." The man walks away, leaving you to your own devices.|5635|0
units.english: "Great! I'll call up the spaceport workers on <planet> to tell them to load the cargo onto your ship." The man walks away, leaving you to your own devices.
units.italian: "Ottimo! Chiamo gli operai dello spazioporto su <planet> perché carichino il carico sulla sua nave." L'uomo se ne va, lasciandoti ai tuoi pensieri.

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|	"Suit yourself, then." He haughtily walks off into the spaceport.|5638|0
units.english: "Suit yourself, then." He haughtily walks off into the spaceport.
units.italian: "Faccia pure, allora." Se ne va con aria altezzosa nello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 1|dialog|5641|0
units.english: When you land, dock workers begin loading crates with woolen garments on board as arranged. Time to set course for Bloodsea.
units.italian: Quando atterri, gli scaricatori cominciano a caricare a bordo le casse di capi di lana, come concordato. È ora di fare rotta per Bloodsea.

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 2|clearance|5646|0
units.english: You talk to the closest thing that Bloodsea has to a spaceport traffic controller, and they agree to let you land.
units.italian: Parli con la cosa più simile a un controllore di traffico dello spazioporto che Bloodsea abbia, e accettano di farti atterrare.

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 2|name|5647|0
units.english: Wool to <planet>
units.italian: Lana per <planet>

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 2|description|5648|0
units.english: Deliver <cargo> to the pirate world of <destination>. Payment will be <payment>.
units.italian: Consegna <cargo> al mondo pirata di <destination>. Il compenso sarà <payment>.

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 2|blocked|5650|0
units.english: The spaceport workers inform you that you need <tons> of cargo free to pick up the woollen goods intended for <planet>.
units.italian: Gli operai dello spazioporto ti informano che ti serve spazio per <tons> di carico libero per ritirare i prodotti di lana destinati a <planet>.

units.id: mission:Wool Smuggling 2|dialog|5659|0
units.english: Your cargo of woolen garments is unloaded by several bulky workers led by a one-armed woman. She hands you <payment> for the trouble of transport, then says, "Thanks for the shipment. I know that you captains think that we're all bad, but I'm glad that you were able to aid the more friendly among us."
units.italian: Il tuo carico di capi di lana viene scaricato da diversi operai massicci guidati da una donna con un braccio solo. Ti consegna <payment> per il disturbo del trasporto, poi dice: "Grazie per la spedizione. So che voi capitani pensate che siamo tutti cattivi, ma sono contenta che abbia potuto aiutare i più amichevoli fra noi."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|name|5665|0
units.english: Inheritance to <planet>
units.italian: Eredità per <planet>

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|description|5666|0
units.english: Deliver <cargo> to <destination>. Payment will be <payment>.
units.italian: Consegna <cargo> a <destination>. Il compenso sarà <payment>.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|The spaceport on <origin> is as spirited as ever: to your left, a family wearing floral shirts pull along their luggage, with the man of the family flaunting a souvenir from some far-away planet. To your right, a cleaner whistles a tuneless song while they wipe down a bench.|5675|0
units.english: The spaceport on <origin> is as spirited as ever: to your left, a family wearing floral shirts pull along their luggage, with the man of the family flaunting a souvenir from some far-away planet. To your right, a cleaner whistles a tuneless song while they wipe down a bench.
units.italian: Lo spazioporto di <origin> è vivace come sempre: alla tua sinistra, una famiglia in camicie a fiori tira i bagagli, e l'uomo della famiglia ostenta un souvenir di chissà quale pianeta lontano. Alla tua destra, un addetto alle pulizie fischietta una canzone senza melodia mentre passa uno straccio su una panchina.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	A young man in a prim suit approaches you. "Good day, Captain! Would you mind if I spoke to you for a moment?"|5676|0
units.english: A young man in a prim suit approaches you. "Good day, Captain! Would you mind if I spoke to you for a moment?"
units.italian: Un giovane in un abito compito ti si avvicina. "Buongiorno, Capitano! Le spiace se le parlo un momento?"

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	"I'd be glad to listen."|5678|0
units.english: "I'd be glad to listen."
units.italian: "Sono lieto di ascoltarla."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	"No, I'm busy right now."|5680|0
units.english: "No, I'm busy right now."
units.italian: "No, sono impegnato adesso."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	The man frowns. "I see. Well, it's not like I was going to offer you a highly profitable job." He begins to shout while stepping away. "And that job certainly wouldn't have paid hundreds of thousands of credits!"|5681|0
units.english: The man frowns. "I see. Well, it's not like I was going to offer you a highly profitable job." He begins to shout while stepping away. "And that job certainly wouldn't have paid hundreds of thousands of credits!"
units.italian: L'uomo si acciglia. "Capisco. Beh, non è che stessi per offrirle un lavoro molto redditizio." Comincia a gridare allontanandosi. "E di certo quel lavoro non avrebbe pagato centinaia di migliaia di crediti!"

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	"Alright, what do you want?"|5683|0
units.english: "Alright, what do you want?"
units.italian: "Va bene, che cosa vuole?"

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	"Shut the hell up."|5685|0
units.english: "Shut the hell up."
units.italian: "Chiuda quella bocca."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	Seemingly unfazed by your bluntness, the man coolly walks away while saying, "I'm sorry you feel that way, Captain. Perhaps you can assist us at a later date. Farewell."|5686|0
units.english: Seemingly unfazed by your bluntness, the man coolly walks away while saying, "I'm sorry you feel that way, Captain. Perhaps you can assist us at a later date. Farewell."
units.italian: Sembra non essere scalfito dalla tua bruschezza, e l'uomo se ne va con calma dicendo: "Mi dispiace che la pensi così, Capitano. Forse potrà aiutarci in un'altra occasione. Addio."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	He smirks as he walks back towards you. "I'm glad that you've changed your mind."|5689|0
units.english: He smirks as he walks back towards you. "I'm glad that you've changed your mind."
units.italian: Sorride mentre torna verso di te. "Sono contento che abbia cambiato idea."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	The man pulls you aside to talk. "You see, one of our clients recently passed away, and in his will, he divided his property between each of his relatives. The only problem is that one of his family members, his niece, lives all the way down in the Rim. We would like you to deliver her portion of the inheritance, weighing <tons>, to her residence on <destination>. We can pay you <payment> upon completion of the job."|5691|0
