units.english: The man pulls you aside to talk. "You see, one of our clients recently passed away, and in his will, he divided his property between each of his relatives. The only problem is that one of his family members, his niece, lives all the way down in the Rim. We would like you to deliver her portion of the inheritance, weighing <tons>, to her residence on <destination>. We can pay you <payment> upon completion of the job."
units.italian: L'uomo ti prende da parte per parlare. "Vede, uno dei nostri clienti è recentemente scomparso, e nel suo testamento ha diviso i suoi beni fra tutti i parenti. L'unico problema è che uno dei membri della famiglia, sua nipote, vive laggiù nel Rim. Vorremmo che lei consegnasse la sua parte di eredità, che pesa <tons>, alla sua residenza su <destination>. Possiamo pagarle <payment> al completamento del lavoro."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	"I'll do it."|5693|0
units.english: "I'll do it."
units.italian: "Lo faccio."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	"What did she inherit?"|5695|0
units.english: "What did she inherit?"
units.italian: "Che cosa ha ereditato?"

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	"Sorry, but I don't want to do this job."|5696|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I don't want to do this job."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non voglio fare questo lavoro."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	"My sincerest apologies, but I'm afraid that is confidential information. Our prioritization of privacy is one of our main selling points."|5698|0
units.english: "My sincerest apologies, but I'm afraid that is confidential information. Our prioritization of privacy is one of our main selling points."
units.italian: "Le mie più sentite scuse, ma temo che sia un'informazione riservata. La nostra attenzione alla privacy è uno dei nostri principali punti di forza."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	"I'll take the job."|5700|0
units.english: "I'll take the job."
units.italian: "Prendo il lavoro."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	"I don't like the idea of carrying unknown cargo. Count me out."|5701|0
units.english: "I don't like the idea of carrying unknown cargo. Count me out."
units.italian: "Non mi piace l'idea di trasportare un carico sconosciuto. Non contate su di me."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	The man smiles. "I'm glad to hear that. We'll have the cargo loaded onto your ship by sundown." He walks away into the spaceport, leaving you to prepare for the journey.|5704|0
units.english: The man smiles. "I'm glad to hear that. We'll have the cargo loaded onto your ship by sundown." He walks away into the spaceport, leaving you to prepare for the journey.
units.italian: L'uomo sorride. "Sono lieto di sentirlo. Faremo caricare il carico sulla sua nave entro il tramonto." Si allontana nello spazioporto, lasciandoti a preparare il viaggio.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	The man frowns. "I see. Well, I appreciate that you listened to our offer, and I hope that you may assist us at a later date. Farewell." He walks away into the spaceport but doesn't appear to seek out any other captains.|5707|0
units.english: The man frowns. "I see. Well, I appreciate that you listened to our offer, and I hope that you may assist us at a later date. Farewell." He walks away into the spaceport but doesn't appear to seek out any other captains.
units.italian: L'uomo si acciglia. "Capisco. Beh, apprezzo che abbia ascoltato la nostra offerta, e spero che potrà aiutarci in un'altra occasione. Addio." Se ne va nello spazioporto ma non sembra cercare altri capitani.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|You step off your ship and order the spaceport crew to unload your cargo. As you do, a large, fat-lipped woman walks up to you and says in the most exaggerated manner possible, "Oh, thank you so much, Captain! You must have gone through so much trouble to help little old me!" She gasps. "Oh, silly old me! I forgot to tell you who I am! I'm the recipient of the inheritance from <origin>, of course! You have truly made a great contribution to the galaxy!" She chuckles.|5715|0
units.english: You step off your ship and order the spaceport crew to unload your cargo. As you do, a large, fat-lipped woman walks up to you and says in the most exaggerated manner possible, "Oh, thank you so much, Captain! You must have gone through so much trouble to help little old me!" She gasps. "Oh, silly old me! I forgot to tell you who I am! I'm the recipient of the inheritance from <origin>, of course! You have truly made a great contribution to the galaxy!" She chuckles.
units.italian: Scendi dalla nave e ordini all'equipaggio dello spazioporto di scaricare il carico. Mentre lo fai, una donna grande e con le labbra grosse ti si avvicina e dice nel modo più esagerato possibile: "Oh, grazie mille, Capitano! Deve essersi data un gran da fare per aiutare la piccola me!" Sussulta. "Oh, che sbadata! Ho dimenticato di dirle chi sono! Sono io la destinataria dell'eredità da <origin>, naturalmente! Ha davvero dato un grande contributo alla galassia!" Ridacchia.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	"Thank you?"|5717|0
units.english: "Thank you?"
units.italian: "Grazie?"

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	"Could you tell me what the inheritance is?"|5718|0
units.english: "Could you tell me what the inheritance is?"
units.italian: "Potrebbe dirmi che cos'è l'eredità?"

units.id: mission:Deal Change 1|	Before you can get a single word out, the woman exclaims, "I'll be sure to inform your employers of the wonderful work you've done. Ta ta!" She begins to swagger towards a cream-colored car as her inheritance is loaded into a truck beside it. When you return to your ship's cockpit, you find that <payment> have been deposited into your account.|5719|0
units.english: Before you can get a single word out, the woman exclaims, "I'll be sure to inform your employers of the wonderful work you've done. Ta ta!" She begins to swagger towards a cream-colored car as her inheritance is loaded into a truck beside it. When you return to your ship's cockpit, you find that <payment> have been deposited into your account.
units.italian: Prima che tu possa dire una sola parola, la donna esclama: "Mi assicurerò di informare i suoi datori di lavoro del meraviglioso lavoro che ha fatto. Ciao ciao!" Comincia a pavoneggiarsi verso un'auto color crema mentre l'eredità viene caricata su un camion lì accanto. Quando torni nell'abitacolo della nave, scopri che <payment> sono stati depositati sul tuo conto.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|name|5725|0
units.english: Inheritance to <planet>
units.italian: Eredità per <planet>

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|description|5726|0
units.english: Instead of bringing the inheritance to Skymoot, deliver it to <destination>. You were promised <payment> for doing so. To bypass the spaceport toll, hail <planet> and read out the code to the spaceport authority.
units.italian: Invece di portare l'eredità su Skymoot, consegnala su <destination>. Ti sono stati promessi <payment> per farlo. Per evitare il pedaggio dello spazioporto, chiama <planet> e leggi il codice all'autorità dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|clearance|5731|0
units.english: You read out the code on the back of the paper you received and get a green light from Greenrock's authorities, along with a set of coordinates.
units.italian: Leggi il codice sul retro del foglio che hai ricevuto e ottieni il via libera dalle autorità di Greenrock, insieme a una serie di coordinate.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|You touch down on <origin>'s surface and step out into the open air. The landing docks are emptier than usual, with only a handful of people walking around. Suddenly, you feel the wind knocked out of you as you collide with another person and fall on the pavement with a thud.|5736|0
units.english: You touch down on <origin>'s surface and step out into the open air. The landing docks are emptier than usual, with only a handful of people walking around. Suddenly, you feel the wind knocked out of you as you collide with another person and fall on the pavement with a thud.
units.italian: Tocchi terra su <origin> ed esci all'aria aperta. Le banchine di atterraggio sono più vuote del solito, con solo una manciata di persone in giro. All'improvviso senti l'aria uscirti dai polmoni: vai a sbattere contro un'altra persona e cadi sul selciato con un tonfo.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	(Get up and apologize.)|5738|0
units.english: (Get up and apologize.)
units.italian: (Alzati e scusati.)

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	(Get up and demand the other person's apology.)|5739|0
units.english: (Get up and demand the other person's apology.)
units.italian: (Alzati e pretendi le scuse dell'altra persona.)

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	You open your mouth as you lift yourself up, only to find that the other person is already gone. As you look around, you spot a piece of paper with writing lying on the ground beside you. You pick up the note and read it:|5740|0
units.english: You open your mouth as you lift yourself up, only to find that the other person is already gone. As you look around, you spot a piece of paper with writing lying on the ground beside you. You pick up the note and read it:
units.italian: Apri la bocca mentre ti rialzi, solo per scoprire che l'altra persona è già sparita. Guardandoti intorno, scorgi per terra accanto a te un foglietto con della scrittura. Raccogli il biglietto e leggi:

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|<first> <last>,|5742|0
units.english: <first> <last>,
units.italian: <first> <last>,

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|		You are currently carrying five tons of cargo to Skymoot. This cargo has been described to you as an "inheritance," and you have been promised 100,000 credits as payment for the job. Under no circumstances should you allow the cargo to reach the destination. Instead, bring it to <destination>. You will be paid <payment> if you do so. The back of this note has a code you can use to gain clearance to land without the usual toll.|5743|0
units.english: You are currently carrying five tons of cargo to Skymoot. This cargo has been described to you as an "inheritance," and you have been promised 100,000 credits as payment for the job. Under no circumstances should you allow the cargo to reach the destination. Instead, bring it to <destination>. You will be paid <payment> if you do so. The back of this note has a code you can use to gain clearance to land without the usual toll.
units.italian: Stai trasportando cinque tonnellate di carico su Skymoot. Questo carico ti è stato descritto come un'"eredità", e ti sono stati promessi 100.000 crediti come pagamento per il lavoro. Non devi in nessun caso permettere che il carico raggiunga la destinazione. Portalo invece su <destination>. Ti saranno pagati <payment> se lo farai. Sul retro di questo biglietto c'è un codice che puoi usare per ottenere il permesso di atterrare senza il pedaggio abituale.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	You flip the paper over and see a string of letters and numbers. The note has no signature, nor anything else to identify the person who wrote it.|5745|0
units.english: You flip the paper over and see a string of letters and numbers. The note has no signature, nor anything else to identify the person who wrote it.
units.italian: Giri il foglio e vedi una sequenza di lettere e numeri. Il biglietto non ha firma, né altro che identifichi chi l'ha scritto.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	(Keep the note.)|5747|0
units.english: (Keep the note.)
units.italian: (Tieni il biglietto.)

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	(Throw the note away.)|5749|0
units.english: (Throw the note away.)
units.italian: (Butta via il biglietto.)

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	You stand up and crumple the note in your hand before throwing it into a bin. You think you catch a glance of a cloaked figure, but don't meet any more trouble on your way to the spaceport.|5750|0
units.english: You stand up and crumple the note in your hand before throwing it into a bin. You think you catch a glance of a cloaked figure, but don't meet any more trouble on your way to the spaceport.
units.italian: Ti alzi e accartocci il biglietto in mano prima di buttarlo in un cestino. Ti sembra di intravedere una figura incappucciata, ma non incontri altri guai sulla strada per lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	You stand up and stuff the note in your pocket before continuing towards the spaceport.|5753|0
units.english: You stand up and stuff the note in your pocket before continuing towards the spaceport.
units.italian: Ti alzi e infili il biglietto in tasca prima di proseguire verso lo spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|You follow the coordinates to a clearing within the forests of Greenrock. Several other ships are present near the landing site, all of which wear pirate colors. A person wearing a cloak steps out of one of the vessels to greet you. "I am glad that you were able to trust us," they say. "My name is not Ci, but you may refer to me as such." A gang of pirates emerges from the foliage around your ship and begin to unload the cargo from your ship.|5770|0
units.english: You follow the coordinates to a clearing within the forests of Greenrock. Several other ships are present near the landing site, all of which wear pirate colors. A person wearing a cloak steps out of one of the vessels to greet you. "I am glad that you were able to trust us," they say. "My name is not Ci, but you may refer to me as such." A gang of pirates emerges from the foliage around your ship and begin to unload the cargo from your ship.
units.italian: Segui le coordinate fino a una radura nei boschi di Greenrock. Vicino al punto di atterraggio ci sono altre navi, tutte con i colori dei pirati. Una persona in mantello esce da uno dei vascelli per salutarti. "Sono contento che tu abbia saputo fidarti di noi," dice. "Il mio nome non è Ci, ma puoi chiamarmi così." Una banda di pirati emerge dal fogliame intorno alla tua nave e comincia a scaricare il carico.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	(Stay silent.)|5772|0
units.english: (Stay silent.)
units.italian: (Resta in silenzio.)

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	"Can I ask you some questions?"|5774|0
units.english: "Can I ask you some questions?"
units.italian: "Posso farti qualche domanda?"

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	One of the pirates near you bares his pointy teeth, but Ci steps forward and raises their hand. "Please forgive the naivety of this captain," they say to the pirate before turning towards you. "I apologize, but I am afraid that I cannot answer your questions. This is a very volatile matter, and any misplaced information could spell death. You are safer knowing as little as possible."|5775|0
units.english: One of the pirates near you bares his pointy teeth, but Ci steps forward and raises their hand. "Please forgive the naivety of this captain," they say to the pirate before turning towards you. "I apologize, but I am afraid that I cannot answer your questions. This is a very volatile matter, and any misplaced information could spell death. You are safer knowing as little as possible."
units.italian: Uno dei pirati vicino a te mostra i denti appuntiti, ma Ci fa un passo avanti e alza la mano. "Perdona l'ingenuità di questo capitano," dice al pirata prima di voltarsi verso di te. "Mi scuso, ma temo di non poter rispondere alle tue domande. È una faccenda molto delicata, e qualsiasi informazione fuori posto potrebbe significare la morte. Sei più al sicuro sapendone il meno possibile."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	"I understand."|5777|0
units.english: "I understand."
units.italian: "Ho capito."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	"I'm taking back the cargo if you're not answering me."|5779|0
units.english: "I'm taking back the cargo if you're not answering me."
units.italian: "Mi riprendo il carico se non mi rispondi."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	Ci gestures towards the pirates around them. "Are you sure that is a wise choice, Captain?" They step closer. "The only reason you are still alive is because it is more convenient than killing you. It would be in your best interests to keep it that way."|5780|0
units.english: Ci gestures towards the pirates around them. "Are you sure that is a wise choice, Captain?" They step closer. "The only reason you are still alive is because it is more convenient than killing you. It would be in your best interests to keep it that way."
units.italian: Ci accenna ai pirati intorno. "Sei sicuro che sia una scelta saggia, Capitano?" Si avvicina. "L'unico motivo per cui sei ancora vivo è che è più comodo che ucciderti. Sarebbe nel tuo interesse che resti così."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	"Okay, I'll stay quiet."|5782|0
units.english: "Okay, I'll stay quiet."
units.italian: "Va bene, resto zitto."

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	(Pull out my gun.)|5784|0
units.english: (Pull out my gun.)
units.italian: (Estrai la pistola.)

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	The moment your hand touches the handle of your gun, you are blinded by bright lights and searing pain. You die before your body falls to the ground.|5785|0
units.english: The moment your hand touches the handle of your gun, you are blinded by bright lights and searing pain. You die before your body falls to the ground.
units.italian: Appena la tua mano tocca il calcio della pistola, sei accecato da luci brillanti e da un dolore lancinante. Muori prima che il tuo corpo tocchi terra.

units.id: mission:Deal Change 2|	After a few minutes, the pirates finish unloading the cargo, and Ci steps forward, holding out a credit chip. "<payment>, for making the right choice." Ci and the pirates return to their ships as you take off and head towards the main spaceport of <planet>.|5788|0
units.english: After a few minutes, the pirates finish unloading the cargo, and Ci steps forward, holding out a credit chip. "<payment>, for making the right choice." Ci and the pirates return to their ships as you take off and head towards the main spaceport of <planet>.
units.italian: Dopo qualche minuto i pirati finiscono di scaricare il carico, e Ci fa un passo avanti, porgendo un chip di credito. "<payment>, per aver fatto la scelta giusta." Ci e i pirati tornano alle loro navi mentre tu decolli e ti dirigi verso lo spazioporto principale di <planet>.

units.id: mission:Escort offer (Betrayal)|name|5795|0
units.english: Cargo to <planet>
units.italian: Carico per <planet>

units.id: mission:Escort offer (Betrayal)|description|5796|0
units.english: Transport <tons> of cargo to <destination> by <date>. You will be paid <payment>. The captain of the <npc> has offered to protect you from any pirates along the way in exchange for a cut of the profits.
units.italian: Trasporta <tons> di carico su <destination> entro <date>. Ti saranno pagati <payment>. Il capitano della <npc> si è offerto di proteggerti dai pirati lungo il percorso in cambio di una parte del guadagno.

units.id: mission:Escort offer (Betrayal)|As you land, a heavily modified Firebird with oversized guns follows you down, settling on the pad next to you. A young man with short hair steps out, walks over to your ship, and says, "Hey, you've got a lot of cargo space there. I bet you make loads of dough with it, trading or running jobs. Say, I know somebody who could use a ship like yours. He needs to get <tons> of cargo to <destination> by <day>, you see. Payment's about 350,000 credits. Lot of pirates round there, though. I can fight 'em, but there's not much money to be made hauling cargo in this thing." He gestures to his ship. "Tell you what, for 20% of the payment, I'll see to it that you arrive there safely. What do you think?"|5808|0
units.english: As you land, a heavily modified Firebird with oversized guns follows you down, settling on the pad next to you. A young man with short hair steps out, walks over to your ship, and says, "Hey, you've got a lot of cargo space there. I bet you make loads of dough with it, trading or running jobs. Say, I know somebody who could use a ship like yours. He needs to get <tons> of cargo to <destination> by <day>, you see. Payment's about 350,000 credits. Lot of pirates round there, though. I can fight 'em, but there's not much money to be made hauling cargo in this thing." He gestures to his ship. "Tell you what, for 20% of the payment, I'll see to it that you arrive there safely. What do you think?"
units.italian: Mentre atterri, un Firebird pesantemente modificato con cannoni sovradimensionati ti segue giù e si posa sulla piazzola accanto a te. Ne scende un giovane con i capelli corti, che si avvicina alla tua nave e dice: "Ehi, hai un sacco di spazio per il carico. Scommetto che fai un sacco di soldi, commerciando o facendo lavoretti. Senti, conosco uno a cui servirebbe una nave come la tua. Deve portare <tons> di carico su <destination> entro <day>, capito. Il compenso è sui 350.000 crediti. Però da quelle parti ci sono un sacco di pirati. Io posso combatterli, ma con questa non si guadagna granché trasportando carichi." Fa un cenno verso la sua nave. "Ti dico cosa: per il 20% del compenso, faccio in modo che tu arrivi là sano e salvo. Che ne pensi?"

units.id: mission:Escort offer (Betrayal)|	"Sounds like a plan. You'll be taking 70,000 credits, then?"|5810|0
units.english: "Sounds like a plan. You'll be taking 70,000 credits, then?"
units.italian: "Mi sembra un piano. Ti prendi 70.000 crediti, allora?"

units.id: mission:Escort offer (Betrayal)|	"Sorry, that just sounds too dangerous for me."|5811|0
units.english: "Sorry, that just sounds too dangerous for me."
units.italian: "Spiacente, mi sembra troppo pericoloso."

units.id: mission:Escort offer (Betrayal)|	"That's right. Now, let's go! The cargo'll be loaded on your ship by sundown. Oh, and if you didn't already know, you can get to <planet> from here in just four jumps. North, west, southwest, then south."|5813|0
units.english: "That's right. Now, let's go! The cargo'll be loaded on your ship by sundown. Oh, and if you didn't already know, you can get to <planet> from here in just four jumps. North, west, southwest, then south."
units.italian: "Esatto. Ora andiamo! Il carico sarà sulla tua nave entro il tramonto. Oh, e se non lo sapevi, si arriva su <planet> da qui in quattro salti. Nord, ovest, sud-ovest, poi sud."

units.id: mission:Escort offer (Betrayal)|dialog|5816|0
units.english: As expected, there are pirates waiting for you in Moktar. Unfortunately, the <npc> makes no attempt to attack them, instead turning its guns on you.
units.italian: Come previsto, a Moktar ci sono pirati che ti aspettano. Purtroppo la <npc> non fa alcun tentativo di attaccarli: punta invece le armi contro di te.

units.id: mission:Escort offer (Betrayal)|dialog|5817|0
units.english: You receive a hail from the <npc>: "Gotcha, you didn't suspect a thing!"
units.italian: Ricevi un segnale dalla <npc>: "Preso, non hai sospettato niente!"

units.id: mission:Escort offer (Betrayal)|dialog|5821|0
units.english: The <npc> hails you: "Wrong way, mate! You'll miss the deadline if you go the whole way round. Head back up to Mirfak, then north, west, southwest and south."
units.italian: La <npc> ti chiama: "Strada sbagliata, amico! Perderai la scadenza se fai tutto il giro. Torna su a Mirfak, poi nord, ovest, sud-ovest e sud."

units.id: mission:Escort offer (Betrayal)|dialog|5823|0
units.english: The <npc> hails you again: "Figured it out, did you? Bit late for that now, mate. You're still going down."
units.italian: La <npc> ti chiama di nuovo: "L'hai capito, eh? Un po' tardi ormai, amico. Sei comunque finito."

units.id: mission:Escort offer (Betrayal)|dialog|5827|0
units.english: You receive a message from the <npc>, which is now several systems away: "Hello? You still there? I don't know what just happened, but on the off chance you're still alive, I thought I'd just let you know that the deal's off." You open up the cargo that he wanted you to carry, and find nothing but worthless barrels of water.
units.italian: Ricevi un messaggio dalla <npc>, che ormai è a diversi sistemi di distanza: "Pronto? Ci sei ancora? Non so cosa sia appena successo, ma se per caso sei ancora vivo, ho pensato di farti sapere che l'accordo è saltato." Apri il carico che voleva farti trasportare e non trovi altro che barili d'acqua senza valore.

units.id: mission:Escort offer (Betrayal)|dialog|5830|0
units.english: The <npc> hails you: "Figured it out, did you? Bit late for that now, mate. You're still going down."
units.italian: La <npc> ti chiama: "L'hai capito, eh? Un po' tardi ormai, amico. Sei comunque finito."

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 0|name|5846|0
units.english: Package to Silver
units.italian: Pacco per Silver

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 0|description|5847|0
units.english: Deliver a package to <planet> by <date>. Payment is <payment>.
units.italian: Consegna un pacco su <planet> entro <date>. Il compenso è <payment>.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 0|You're looking at some job listings when a man with a harried face approaches you, carrying a package.|5858|0
units.english: You're looking at some job listings when a man with a harried face approaches you, carrying a package.
units.italian: Stai guardando gli annunci di lavoro quando ti si avvicina un uomo dall'aria affannata, con un pacco in mano.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 0|	"Excuse me, Captain," he says. "I need this package delivered in the next four days. Details are on the package. I'll pay you <payment> once it's done." Without waiting for a response, he shoves the package into your hands and runs off to attend to whatever business has gotten him in such a hurry. The package is addressed to a location on <planet>.|5859|0
units.english: "Excuse me, Captain," he says. "I need this package delivered in the next four days. Details are on the package. I'll pay you <payment> once it's done." Without waiting for a response, he shoves the package into your hands and runs off to attend to whatever business has gotten him in such a hurry. The package is addressed to a location on <planet>.
units.italian: "Mi scusi, Capitano," dice. "Devo far consegnare questo pacco entro i prossimi quattro giorni. I dettagli sono sul pacco. Le pagherò <payment> a consegna fatta." Senza aspettare risposta, ti mette il pacco in mano e corre via a occuparsi di qualunque faccenda lo abbia messo così in fretta. Il pacco è indirizzato a un luogo su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 0|	It's going to be close to his deadline, but it's possible.|5862|0
units.english: It's going to be close to his deadline, but it's possible.
units.italian: Sarà vicinissimo alla sua scadenza, ma è possibile.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 0|label|5864|0
units.english: can't make it in time
units.italian: can't make it in time

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 0|	How he expects you to deliver that package in four days is beyond you, seeing as <planet> is not within three jumps of <origin>, but you might as well try and get there as soon as possible.|5865|0
units.english: How he expects you to deliver that package in four days is beyond you, seeing as <planet> is not within three jumps of <origin>, but you might as well try and get there as soon as possible.
units.italian: Come pensi che il pacco possa arrivare in quattro giorni è per te un mistero, visto che <planet> non è entro tre salti da <origin>, ma tanto vale provarci e arrivare il prima possibile.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 0|	(Deliver the package.)|5868|0
units.english: (Deliver the package.)
units.italian: (Consegna il pacco.)

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 0|	(Find another pilot to give the package to.)|5869|0
units.english: (Find another pilot to give the package to.)
units.italian: (Trova un altro pilota a cui dare il pacco.)

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 0|	You take the package to your ship, leave it in the cargo bay, and prepare for the flight to <planet>.|5871|0
units.english: You take the package to your ship, leave it in the cargo bay, and prepare for the flight to <planet>.
units.italian: Porti il pacco sulla nave, lo lasci nella stiva e ti prepari al volo verso <planet>.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 0|	It takes a while searching for a pilot who can handle the delivery, but you do eventually find one. You hand them the package, explain the situation, thank them, and leave.|5875|0
units.english: It takes a while searching for a pilot who can handle the delivery, but you do eventually find one. You hand them the package, explain the situation, thank them, and leave.
units.italian: Ci vuole un po' per trovare un pilota che possa occuparsi della consegna, ma alla fine lo trovi. Gli consegni il pacco, spieghi la situazione, lo ringrazi e te ne vai.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|name|5881|0
units.english: Redirect Package to <planet>
units.italian: Reindirizza il pacco a <planet>

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|description|5882|0
units.english: Apparently the package labeled for <origin> was actually intended for <planet>. You'll have missed the deadline, so you probably won't be paid the <payment> offered.
units.italian: A quanto pare il pacco etichettato per <origin> era in realtà destinato a <planet>. Avrai mancato la scadenza, quindi probabilmente non riceverai i <payment> offerti.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|Barely making the deadline, you take the package to the post office in <origin>'s spaceport. The service clerk immediately lets out a sigh of frustration before setting the package down on the counter in front of you.|5896|0
units.english: Barely making the deadline, you take the package to the post office in <origin>'s spaceport. The service clerk immediately lets out a sigh of frustration before setting the package down on the counter in front of you.
units.italian: Arrivando a malapena in tempo, porti il pacco all'ufficio postale nello spazioporto di <origin>. L'impiegato emette subito un sospiro di frustrazione prima di appoggiare il pacco sul bancone davanti a te.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|Despite missing the deadline, you take the package to the post office in <origin>'s spaceport. The service clerk immediately lets out a sigh of frustration before setting the package down on the counter in front of you.|5900|0
units.english: Despite missing the deadline, you take the package to the post office in <origin>'s spaceport. The service clerk immediately lets out a sigh of frustration before setting the package down on the counter in front of you.
units.italian: Nonostante la scadenza mancata, porti il pacco all'ufficio postale nello spazioporto di <origin>. L'impiegato emette subito un sospiro di frustrazione prima di appoggiare il pacco sul bancone davanti a te.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|label|5902|0
units.english: can't take package
units.italian: can't take package

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	"I'm sorry, but we can't take this package," they say.|5903|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, but we can't take this package," they say.
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, ma non possiamo prendere questo pacco," dice.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	"Is something wrong?"|5905|0
units.english: "Is something wrong?"
units.italian: "C'è qualcosa che non va?"

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	"What do you mean? Surely you can."|5907|0
units.english: "What do you mean? Surely you can."
units.italian: "Che vuole dire? Certo che potete."

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	"Again, I'm sorry, but we can't send the package," they reiterate. "It's got an incorrect address.|5908|0
units.english: "Again, I'm sorry, but we can't send the package," they reiterate. "It's got an incorrect address.
units.italian: "Di nuovo, mi dispiace, ma non possiamo spedire il pacco," ripete. "L'indirizzo è sbagliato.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	"This package is addressed to 2081 Amethyst Avenue, Mercury City, <origin>. Mercury City is <planet>'s capital. Y'know, that planet out east in Algol. Syndicate space. Not a place on <origin>. The package was posted to the wrong planet."|5910|0
units.english: "This package is addressed to 2081 Amethyst Avenue, Mercury City, <origin>. Mercury City is <planet>'s capital. Y'know, that planet out east in Algol. Syndicate space. Not a place on <origin>. The package was posted to the wrong planet."
units.italian: "Questo pacco è indirizzato a 2081 Amethyst Avenue, Mercury City, <origin>. Mercury City è la capitale di <planet>. Sai, quel pianeta a est nell'Algol. Spazio del Sindacato. Non un posto su <origin>. Il pacco è stato spedito al pianeta sbagliato."

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	"Oh," you say.|5911|0
units.english: "Oh," you say.
units.italian: "Oh," dici.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	"I've lost count of how many times this has happened just this month. <origin>, <planet>, I wonder what's the difference! At this point, I don't know why no one's started to regularly meet with <planet>'s postmaster to exchange all this wrongly-posted mail. Alright, here's a word of advice: I highly recommend you take a picture of the incorrect address. I've had plenty of captains get put on blast 'cause of an error the sender made. Not your fault it got addressed to the wrong planet."|5912|0
units.english: "I've lost count of how many times this has happened just this month. <origin>, <planet>, I wonder what's the difference! At this point, I don't know why no one's started to regularly meet with <planet>'s postmaster to exchange all this wrongly-posted mail. Alright, here's a word of advice: I highly recommend you take a picture of the incorrect address. I've had plenty of captains get put on blast 'cause of an error the sender made. Not your fault it got addressed to the wrong planet."
units.italian: "Ho perso il conto di quante volte è successo solo questo mese. <origin>, <planet>, mi chiedo quale sia la differenza! A questo punto non capisco perché nessuno abbia cominciato a incontrarsi regolarmente con il direttore delle poste di <planet> per scambiarsi tutta questa posta spedita male. Va bene, un consiglio: le raccomando caldamente di fotografare l'indirizzo sbagliato. Ho visto molti capitani finire sulla graticola per un errore del mittente. Non è colpa sua se è stato indirizzato al pianeta sbagliato."

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	You thank the clerk and take the package back to your ship.|5913|0
units.english: You thank the clerk and take the package back to your ship.
units.italian: Ringrazi l'impiegato e riporti il pacco alla nave.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	(Take a picture of the incorrect address.)|5915|0
units.english: (Take a picture of the incorrect address.)
units.italian: (Fotografa l'indirizzo sbagliato.)

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	(Don't bother taking a picture.)|5916|0
units.english: (Don't bother taking a picture.)
units.italian: (Non ti disturbare a fotografare.)

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	You take a few photographs of the address label, just to be sure that you've got a clear picture of the wrong address.|5920|0
units.english: You take a few photographs of the address label, just to be sure that you've got a clear picture of the wrong address.
units.italian: Fotografi l'etichetta dell'indirizzo un paio di volte, giusto per essere sicuro di avere un'immagine chiara dell'indirizzo sbagliato.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|When you talk to a post officer in <planet>'s spaceport and point out the incorrect address before handing it over, you note that he exhibits the same frustration the clerk on <origin> did regarding the frequent switch-ups. He takes the package, muttering something about off-worlders "not knowing the difference even if it smacked 'em in the face" as he did.|5928|0
units.english: When you talk to a post officer in <planet>'s spaceport and point out the incorrect address before handing it over, you note that he exhibits the same frustration the clerk on <origin> did regarding the frequent switch-ups. He takes the package, muttering something about off-worlders "not knowing the difference even if it smacked 'em in the face" as he did.
units.italian: Quando parli con un impiegato postale nello spazioporto di <planet> e gli fai notare l'indirizzo sbagliato prima di consegnarlo, noti che manifesta la stessa frustrazione dell'impiegato di <origin> per questi frequenti scambi. Prende il pacco, borbottando qualcosa sugli stranieri che "non saprebbero riconoscere la differenza nemmeno se gliela stampassi in faccia".

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	Once you return to your ship, you notice that the man who gave you that package had sent you a message. Or, to be more precise, a series of messages. An angry series of messages.|5929|0
units.english: Once you return to your ship, you notice that the man who gave you that package had sent you a message. Or, to be more precise, a series of messages. An angry series of messages.
units.italian: Una volta tornato alla nave, noti che l'uomo che ti ha dato il pacco ti ha mandato un messaggio. O, per essere più precisi, una serie di messaggi. Una serie di messaggi arrabbiati.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	"WHAT TOOK YOU SO LONG???"|5930|0
units.english: "WHAT TOOK YOU SO LONG???"
units.italian: "PERCHÉ CI HAI MESSO TANTO???"

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	"I NEEDED THAT DELIVERED DAYS AGO!!!"|5931|0
units.english: "I NEEDED THAT DELIVERED DAYS AGO!!!"
units.italian: "DOVEVA ARRIVARE GIORNI FA!!!"

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	You send the man the picture you took of his error and point out that it was his mistake that got the package sent to the wrong place. You politely inform him that, had he wanted a smoother delivery, he should've filed a proper job listing and made sure that he placed the correct address.|5936|0
units.english: You send the man the picture you took of his error and point out that it was his mistake that got the package sent to the wrong place. You politely inform him that, had he wanted a smoother delivery, he should've filed a proper job listing and made sure that he placed the correct address.
units.italian: Mandi all'uomo la foto del suo errore e gli fai notare che è stato un suo sbaglio a far spedire il pacco nel posto sbagliato. Gli spieghi con cortesia che, se avesse voluto una consegna più fluida, avrebbe dovuto pubblicare un annuncio di lavoro come si deve e assicurarsi di mettere l'indirizzo giusto.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|label|5940|0
units.english: picture failure
units.italian: picture failure

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	He doesn't respond.|5943|0
units.english: He doesn't respond.
units.italian: Non risponde.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|label|5946|0
units.english: picture success
units.italian: picture success

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	He sees the message, but doesn't send a reply. Just before you walk away from your ship's terminal, you see a new message appear:|5949|0
units.english: He sees the message, but doesn't send a reply. Just before you walk away from your ship's terminal, you see a new message appear:
units.italian: Vede il messaggio, ma non manda risposta. Proprio prima che ti allontani dal terminale della nave, vedi comparire un nuovo messaggio:

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	"I am so sorry."|5950|0
units.english: "I am so sorry."
units.italian: "Mi dispiace tanto."

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	The man then proceeds to apologize profusely for his mistake and his outburst, offering to pay an extra 5,000 credits for the trouble. You gladly accept.|5951|0
units.english: The man then proceeds to apologize profusely for his mistake and his outburst, offering to pay an extra 5,000 credits for the trouble. You gladly accept.
units.italian: L'uomo poi si profonde in scuse per il suo errore e per lo sfogo, offrendo di pagare 5.000 crediti in più per il disturbo. Accetti volentieri.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|label|5954|0
units.english: didn't take picture
units.italian: didn't take picture

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	You try to defend yourself, but the man remains adamant that it was your mistake that got the package sent so late. After a frustrating back-and-forth, you decide to relent and (reluctantly) offer an apology. He ignores it and threatens to get spaceport authorities to "STOP OFFERING JOBS TO INCOMPETENTS LIKE YOU."|5957|0
units.english: You try to defend yourself, but the man remains adamant that it was your mistake that got the package sent so late. After a frustrating back-and-forth, you decide to relent and (reluctantly) offer an apology. He ignores it and threatens to get spaceport authorities to "STOP OFFERING JOBS TO INCOMPETENTS LIKE YOU."
units.italian: Provi a difenderti, ma l'uomo resta fermo nel dire che è stato il tuo errore a far arrivare il pacco così in ritardo. Dopo un botta e risposta frustrante, decidi di cedere e (con riluttanza) porgi le tue scuse. Lui le ignora e minaccia di chiamare le autorità dello spazioporto perché "SMETTANO DI OFFRIRE LAVORI A INCOMPETENTI COME TE".

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 1|	You don't bother to reply.|5958|0
units.english: You don't bother to reply.
units.italian: Non ti disturbi a rispondere.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|name|5965|0
units.english: Misposted Mail Delivery
units.italian: Consegna di posta spedita male

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|description|5966|0
units.english: Deliver <tons> of misposted mail from <origin> to <planet> by <date> and then come back with the return shipment. You will be paid <payment> after you return from <planet>.
units.italian: Consegna <tons> di posta spedita male da <origin> a <planet> entro <date> e poi torna indietro con la spedizione di ritorno. Ti saranno pagati <payment> dopo il rientro da <planet>.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|As you walk through <origin>'s spaceport, somebody wearing office attire and carrying a tablet power walks up to you after ending a hurried conversation with another pilot.|5978|0
units.english: As you walk through <origin>'s spaceport, somebody wearing office attire and carrying a tablet power walks up to you after ending a hurried conversation with another pilot.
units.italian: Mentre attraversi lo spazioporto di <origin>, qualcuno in abiti da ufficio con un tablet in mano ti viene incontro a passo svelto dopo aver concluso una conversazione frettolosa con un altro pilota.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	"Captain! I work for the postmaster's office. The regular pilot who carries misposted mail to <planet> and back couldn't make it this month - some mechanical issues with his ship, I'm told. Would you be willing to carry this month's load there by <day> and then return with the mail from <planet>? We'll pay you what he'd be paid: <payment>."|5979|0
units.english: "Captain! I work for the postmaster's office. The regular pilot who carries misposted mail to <planet> and back couldn't make it this month - some mechanical issues with his ship, I'm told. Would you be willing to carry this month's load there by <day> and then return with the mail from <planet>? We'll pay you what he'd be paid: <payment>."
units.italian: "Capitano! Lavoro per l'ufficio del direttore delle poste. Il pilota abituale che porta la posta spedita male su <planet> e ritorno non ha potuto questo mese: problemi meccanici alla nave, mi dicono. Sarebbe disposto a portare il carico di questo mese là entro <day> e poi tornare con la posta da <planet>? Le pagheremo quello che avrebbero pagato a lui: <payment>."

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	"Oh, so you guys did set up that regular shipment after all!"|5981|0
units.english: "Oh, so you guys did set up that regular shipment after all!"
units.italian: "Oh, quindi alla fine avete organizzato quella spedizione regolare!"

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	"Sure, how much mail are we talking about?"|5984|0
units.english: "Sure, how much mail are we talking about?"
units.italian: "Certo, di quanta posta stiamo parlando?"

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	"Sorry, but I'm not heading in that direction."|5987|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not heading in that direction."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non sono diretto in quella direzione."

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	The mail employee appears confused for a moment, leaning his head to the side slightly.|5991|0
units.english: The mail employee appears confused for a moment, leaning his head to the side slightly.
units.italian: L'impiegato postale sembra confuso per un momento, inclinando leggermente la testa di lato.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	"I once delivered a misposted package like that, and the clerk mentioned that it happened so often somebody should set up a regular delivery."|5993|0
units.english: "I once delivered a misposted package like that, and the clerk mentioned that it happened so often somebody should set up a regular delivery."
units.italian: "Una volta ho consegnato un pacco spedito male così, e l'impiegato ha detto che succedeva così spesso che qualcuno avrebbe dovuto organizzare una consegna regolare."

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	"Never mind. What's the size of the shipment?"|5994|0
units.english: "Never mind. What's the size of the shipment?"
units.italian: "Non importa. Di che dimensioni è la spedizione?"

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	The post employee smiles and responds, "Oh! That was me, actually, back when I worked as a clerk for the post office. I was sick of always having that same conversation with so many pilots a day, so I went out and found a captain to set up a regular delivery with and made the proposal to my boss, who was just as sick of my and the <planet> postmaster's endless reports. Got a bonus and promotion for it; I'm now responsible for the delivery's management, instead! Anyways, are you interested in covering for them?"|5996|0
units.english: The post employee smiles and responds, "Oh! That was me, actually, back when I worked as a clerk for the post office. I was sick of always having that same conversation with so many pilots a day, so I went out and found a captain to set up a regular delivery with and made the proposal to my boss, who was just as sick of my and the <planet> postmaster's endless reports. Got a bonus and promotion for it; I'm now responsible for the delivery's management, instead! Anyways, are you interested in covering for them?"
units.italian: L'impiegato postale sorride e risponde: "Oh! Quello ero io, in realtà, quando lavoravo come impiegato all'ufficio postale. Ero stanco di fare sempre la stessa conversazione con tanti piloti al giorno, così sono andato a cercare un capitano con cui organizzare una consegna regolare e ho fatto la proposta al mio capo, che era altrettanto stanco delle mie infinite relazioni e di quelle del direttore delle poste di <planet>. Ho avuto un bonus e una promozione; ora mi occupo della gestione delle consegne, invece! Comunque, le interessa coprire il suo turno?"

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	"Yeah, what's the size of the shipment?"|5998|0
units.english: "Yeah, what's the size of the shipment?"
units.italian: "Sì, di che dimensioni è la spedizione?"

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	"Sorry, but I'm not able to work that into my plans."|6000|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm not able to work that into my plans."
units.italian: "Spiacente, ma non riesco a inserirlo nei miei piani."

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	The man takes a look at his tablet and says, "This week, it totaled... <tons> of letters and miscellaneous packages here, and then 29 tons to be brought back from Quicksilver."|6004|0
units.english: The man takes a look at his tablet and says, "This week, it totaled... <tons> of letters and miscellaneous packages here, and then 29 tons to be brought back from Quicksilver."
units.italian: L'uomo dà un'occhiata al tablet e dice: "Questa settimana erano in totale... <tons> di lettere e pacchi vari qui, e poi 29 tonnellate da riportare indietro da Quicksilver."

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	"<tons> of misposted packages? Just this month?!" you ask.|6005|0
units.english: "<tons> of misposted packages? Just this month?!" you ask.
units.italian: "<tons> di pacchi spediti male? Solo questo mese?!" chiedi.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	He nods. "Told you it happened often. And only a few of these packages even weigh over a kilo! Big shipments hardly get misposted; it's mostly private citizens who make these kinds of mistakes. Mostly. You'd be amazed!"|6006|0
units.english: He nods. "Told you it happened often. And only a few of these packages even weigh over a kilo! Big shipments hardly get misposted; it's mostly private citizens who make these kinds of mistakes. Mostly. You'd be amazed!"
units.italian: Annuisce. "Te l'avevo detto che succedeva spesso. E solo pochi di questi pacchi pesano più di un chilo! Le spedizioni grandi vengono spedite male raramente; sono per lo più privati cittadini a fare questi errori. Per lo più. Resteresti stupito!"

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	You two shake hands and arrange for the misposted packages to be loaded onto the <ship>. Time to head to <planet>.|6007|0
units.english: You two shake hands and arrange for the misposted packages to be loaded onto the <ship>. Time to head to <planet>.
units.italian: Vi stringete la mano e concordate che i pacchi spediti male vengano caricati sulla <ship>. È ora di andare su <planet>.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|	The mail employee thanks you for your time, and continues his search for a willing captain. At least pilots that get hired to deliver such wrongly-posted packages, like you once did, won't have to finish those deliveries themselves in the future.|6011|0
units.english: The mail employee thanks you for your time, and continues his search for a willing captain. At least pilots that get hired to deliver such wrongly-posted packages, like you once did, won't have to finish those deliveries themselves in the future.
units.italian: L'impiegato postale ti ringrazia per il tempo e riprende la ricerca di un capitano disposto. Almeno i piloti assunti per consegnare quei pacchi spediti male, come te una volta, non dovranno più portare a termine quelle consegne da soli in futuro.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|dialog|6014|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but your escort, loaded with the shipment, has not arrived. Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la tua scorta, carica della spedizione, non è arrivata. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 2|dialog|6016|0
units.english: You contact the spaceport authorities and they direct you to the respective landing pad, where the post office staff is already waiting. They transfer the cargo and you prepare to head back to <origin>. Again, you have 10 days to make the delivery.
units.italian: Contatti le autorità dello spazioporto e ti indicano la piazzola di atterraggio corrispondente, dove il personale dell'ufficio postale sta già aspettando. Trasferiscono il carico e ti prepari a tornare su <origin>. Anche questa volta hai 10 giorni per fare la consegna.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 3|name|6020|0
units.english: Misposted Mail Delivery
units.italian: Consegna di posta spedita male

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 3|description|6023|0
units.english: Return to <planet> with <cargo>. You will be paid <payment>.
units.italian: Torna su <planet> con <cargo>. Ti saranno pagati <payment>.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 3|dialog|6030|0
units.english: You have reached <planet>, but your escort carrying the misposted mail has not arrived. Better depart and wait for your escorts to arrive in this star system.
units.italian: Hai raggiunto <planet>, ma la tua scorta che porta la posta spedita male non è arrivata. Meglio ripartire e aspettare che le tue scorte arrivino in questo sistema.

units.id: mission:Quicksilver Mixup 3|dialog|6033|0
units.english: The same manager from before is waiting with the unloading crew, and thanks you for covering for the other pilot before handing you the credit chip for payment. It's nice to know that captains who get hired to deliver such wrongly-posted packages, like you once did, won't have to finish those deliveries themselves in the future.
units.italian: Lo stesso responsabile di prima aspetta con la squadra di scarico, e ti ringrazia per aver coperto l'altro pilota prima di consegnarti il chip di credito del pagamento. È bello sapere che i capitani assunti per consegnare quei pacchi spediti male, come te una volta, non dovranno più portare a termine quelle consegne da soli in futuro.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|name|6040|0
units.english: Stop Ship Hijacking
units.italian: Fermare un dirottamento

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|description|6041|0
units.english: The <npc> was hijacked on <origin>; disable it and return to <origin>. Do not board, capture, or destroy it; Syndicated Security will deal with the hijackers in space after you have disabled it.
units.italian: La <npc> è stata dirottata su <origin>; neutralizzala e torna su <origin>. Non abbordarla, catturarla o distruggerla: la Sicurezza del Sindacato si occuperà dei dirottatori nello spazio dopo che l'avrai neutralizzata.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|You're signing the standard Syndicate landing papers with an officer on <origin>. "Everything seems to be in order. And of course, we'll have your ship refueled promptly. Have a good day, Captain <last>." He nods his head at you and starts to move off towards the next ship.|6056|0
units.english: You're signing the standard Syndicate landing papers with an officer on <origin>. "Everything seems to be in order. And of course, we'll have your ship refueled promptly. Have a good day, Captain <last>." He nods his head at you and starts to move off towards the next ship.
units.italian: Stai firmando i documenti di atterraggio standard del Sindacato con un ufficiale su <origin>. "Sembra tutto in ordine. E naturalmente faremo rifornire subito la sua nave. Buona giornata, Capitano <last>." Ti fa un cenno del capo e comincia ad allontanarsi verso la nave successiva.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	Before he can make it there, you hear a commotion by the <npc>, the <npc model> on the landing pad next to you.|6057|0
units.english: Before he can make it there, you hear a commotion by the <npc>, the <npc model> on the landing pad next to you.
units.italian: Prima che riesca ad arrivarci, senti un trambusto vicino alla <npc>, il <npc model> sulla piazzola accanto a te.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	(Turn around to see what's going on.)|6059|0
units.english: (Turn around to see what's going on.)
units.italian: (Voltati per vedere che cosa succede.)

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	(Ignore the commotion.)|6061|0
units.english: (Ignore the commotion.)
units.italian: (Ignora il trambusto.)

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	Both of you turn your heads towards the <npc> to see what's happening, but as you do you hear the deafening blare of warning sirens through <origin>'s spaceport; at the same time, the <npc> suddenly jolts up with its loading ramp still extended.|6064|0
units.english: Both of you turn your heads towards the <npc> to see what's happening, but as you do you hear the deafening blare of warning sirens through <origin>'s spaceport; at the same time, the <npc> suddenly jolts up with its loading ramp still extended.
units.italian: Voltate entrambi la testa verso la <npc> per vedere che succede, ma mentre lo fate sentite lo stridio assordante delle sirene d'allarme nello spazioporto di <origin>; nello stesso momento la <npc> sobbalza di colpo con la rampa di carico ancora estesa.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	You turn back towards the <ship> only to hear the deafening blares of warning sirens through <origin>'s spaceport. Looking around instinctively, you notice the <npc> jolting up with its loading ramp still extended.|6068|0
units.english: You turn back towards the <ship> only to hear the deafening blares of warning sirens through <origin>'s spaceport. Looking around instinctively, you notice the <npc> jolting up with its loading ramp still extended.
units.italian: Ti volti di nuovo verso la <ship> solo per sentire gli stridi assordanti delle sirene d'allarme nello spazioporto di <origin>. Guardandoti intorno istintivamente, noti la <npc> che sobbalza con la rampa di carico ancora estesa.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"Hey, what's going on here?" the officer tries to shout over the noise of the sirens and the repulsors, but the rogue <npc model> veers rapidly and uncertainly towards you and the officer.|6071|0
units.english: "Hey, what's going on here?" the officer tries to shout over the noise of the sirens and the repulsors, but the rogue <npc model> veers rapidly and uncertainly towards you and the officer.
units.italian: "Ehi, che cosa succede qui?" l'ufficiale prova a gridare sopra il rumore delle sirene e dei repulsori, ma il <npc model> ribelle vira rapidamente e in modo incerto verso di te e l'ufficiale.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	(Jump for cover.)|6073|0
units.english: (Jump for cover.)
units.italian: (Buttati al riparo.)

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	(Take a shot at the <npc model> with my sidearm.)|6074|0
units.english: (Take a shot at the <npc model> with my sidearm.)
units.italian: (Spara al <npc model> con la pistola.)

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	Both of you barely jump down for cover before the ship clips a stack of cargo crates, sending them flying into the refueling platform. The Quad Blaster Turret mounted on the top of the <npc model> swivels around aimlessly, then fires without warning, its energy bolts scattering some of the startled onlookers nearby and sending up debris where they hit the ground. It comes dangerously close to colliding with the <ship> before it veers off to the side and sends its repulsors into full thrust, fleeing away into the sky.|6076|0
units.english: Both of you barely jump down for cover before the ship clips a stack of cargo crates, sending them flying into the refueling platform. The Quad Blaster Turret mounted on the top of the <npc model> swivels around aimlessly, then fires without warning, its energy bolts scattering some of the startled onlookers nearby and sending up debris where they hit the ground. It comes dangerously close to colliding with the <ship> before it veers off to the side and sends its repulsors into full thrust, fleeing away into the sky.
units.italian: Voi due riuscite a malapena a buttarvi al riparo prima che la nave sfiori una pila di casse di carico, mandandole a volare contro la piattaforma di rifornimento. La torretta Quad Blaster montata sopra il <npc model> ruota senza meta, poi spara senza preavviso: i suoi colpi di energia disperdono alcuni dei curiosi spaventati lì vicino e sollevano detriti dove colpiscono il terreno. Arriva pericolosamente vicino a scontrarsi con la <ship> prima di virare di lato e mandare i repulsori a piena spinta, fuggendo nel cielo.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	You fire a shot right at the cockpit with your pistol but the shot is absorbed by the <npc model>'s shield matrix, rendering it useless. The <npc> flies right over you, sending you backwards and into the ground.|6080|0
units.english: You fire a shot right at the cockpit with your pistol but the shot is absorbed by the <npc model>'s shield matrix, rendering it useless. The <npc> flies right over you, sending you backwards and into the ground.
units.italian: Sparò un colpo dritto verso l'abitacolo con la pistola, ma il colpo viene assorbito dalla matrice di scudi del <npc model>, rendendolo inutile. La <npc> ti passa sopra e ti manda all'indietro, a terra.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	You prop yourself up to hear the <npc model>'s Quad Blaster Turret fire aimlessly around the spaceport, shortly replaced by the sounds of its repulsors being sent up to full thrust. By the time you get up, the <npc> has already started fleeing off into the sky.|6081|0
units.english: You prop yourself up to hear the <npc model>'s Quad Blaster Turret fire aimlessly around the spaceport, shortly replaced by the sounds of its repulsors being sent up to full thrust. By the time you get up, the <npc> has already started fleeing off into the sky.
units.italian: Ti rialzi sui gomiti e senti la torretta Quad Blaster del <npc model> sparare senza meta per lo spazioporto, presto sostituita dal suono dei suoi repulsori portati a piena spinta. Quando ti alzi, la <npc> ha già cominciato a fuggire nel cielo.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	The Syndicated Security officer, dazed and coated in dust kicked up from the unpermitted departure, only just pulls himself up before another person runs up to accost him. "Oi, those kids, they just hijacked my <npc model>! Get someone on their tail!"|6084|0
units.english: The Syndicated Security officer, dazed and coated in dust kicked up from the unpermitted departure, only just pulls himself up before another person runs up to accost him. "Oi, those kids, they just hijacked my <npc model>! Get someone on their tail!"
units.italian: L'ufficiale della Sicurezza del Sindacato, stordito e coperto di polvere sollevata dalla partenza non autorizzata, si rialza appena prima che un'altra persona gli corra addosso. "Ehi, quei ragazzini, mi hanno appena dirottato il <npc model>! Mandate qualcuno alle loro calcagna!"

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"I'll do it!"|6086|0
units.english: "I'll do it!"
units.italian: "Ci penso io!"

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	(Let Syndicated Security deal with it.)|6087|0
units.english: (Let Syndicated Security deal with it.)
units.italian: (Lascia che se ne occupi la Sicurezza del Sindacato.)

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	The captain of the stolen <npc model> turns towards you. "Thank you, Captain! Don't destroy the <npc>, I'm already late for my bloody contract. Agh, this doesn't help at all," he mutters to himself.|6089|0
units.english: The captain of the stolen <npc model> turns towards you. "Thank you, Captain! Don't destroy the <npc>, I'm already late for my bloody contract. Agh, this doesn't help at all," he mutters to himself.
units.italian: Il capitano del <npc model> rubato si volta verso di te. "Grazie, Capitano! Non distruggere la <npc>, sono già in ritardo per il mio contratto, porca miseria. Agh, questo non aiuta per niente," borbotta fra sé.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	The officer looks back at you, having dusted himself off and regained his senses. "Yes, go and deal with his ship now. Don't board it, we'll have Syndicated Security ships come after you to board the hijacked ship and tug it down. Go!"|6090|0
units.english: The officer looks back at you, having dusted himself off and regained his senses. "Yes, go and deal with his ship now. Don't board it, we'll have Syndicated Security ships come after you to board the hijacked ship and tug it down. Go!"
units.italian: L'ufficiale ti guarda di nuovo, essendosi spolverato e ripreso i sensi. "Sì, vai a occuparti della sua nave, adesso. Non abbordarla: manderemo le navi della Sicurezza del Sindacato a inseguirti per abbordare la nave dirottata e rimorchiarla giù. Vai!"

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	You run towards the <ship> and take off after the hijacked <npc>...|6091|0
units.english: You run towards the <ship> and take off after the hijacked <npc>...
units.italian: Corri verso la <ship> e decolli all'inseguimento della <npc> dirottata...

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|label|6094|0
units.english: security job
units.italian: security job

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	The officer, slightly flustered, calls for a small squadron of Syndicated Security ships to chase the hijacked <npc>, then runs off to one of <origin>'s spaceport terminals to file the paperwork with the captain.|6095|0
units.english: The officer, slightly flustered, calls for a small squadron of Syndicated Security ships to chase the hijacked <npc>, then runs off to one of <origin>'s spaceport terminals to file the paperwork with the captain.
units.italian: L'ufficiale, un po' frastornato, chiama uno squadrone di navi della Sicurezza del Sindacato per inseguire la <npc> dirottata, poi corre verso uno dei terminali dello spazioporto di <origin> per compilare le scartoffie con il capitano.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|dialog|6108|0
units.english: The <npc> has been disabled. Syndicated Security will now deal with the hijackers, but you should go back and report to the captain of the ship.
units.italian: La <npc> è stata neutralizzata. La Sicurezza del Sindacato si occuperà ora dei dirottatori, ma dovresti tornare a riferire al capitano della nave.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|dialog|6111|0
units.english: You've boarded the Moonshake Express, against the orders of the Syndicated Security officer. The ship's captain won't be impressed.
units.italian: Hai abbordato il Moonshake Express, contro gli ordini dell'ufficiale della Sicurezza del Sindacato. Il capitano della nave non ne sarà entusiasta.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|dialog|6115|0
units.english: You have destroyed the Moonshake Express. The ship's captain won't be impressed.
units.italian: Hai distrutto il Moonshake Express. Il capitano della nave non ne sarà entusiasta.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|You've landed without disabling the <npc>. It's probably gone now, but you might want to report to its captain.|6123|0
units.english: You've landed without disabling the <npc>. It's probably gone now, but you might want to report to its captain.
units.italian: Sei atterrato senza neutralizzare la <npc>. Probabilmente ormai è andata, ma forse dovresti riferire al suo capitano.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	(Find the captain.)|6125|0
units.english: (Find the captain.)
units.italian: (Trova il capitano.)

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	(Don't worry about it.)|6126|0
units.english: (Don't worry about it.)
units.italian: (Non preoccupartene.)

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	You find him in the spaceport lounge. As you walk in, he recognizes you and calls you over. "How are you doing? Did you recover the <npc>?"|6128|0
units.english: You find him in the spaceport lounge. As you walk in, he recognizes you and calls you over. "How are you doing? Did you recover the <npc>?"
units.italian: Lo trovi nella sala d'attesa dello spazioporto. Mentre entri, ti riconosce e ti chiama. "Come va? Hai recuperato la <npc>?"

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"No, I wasn't able to."|6130|0
units.english: "No, I wasn't able to."
units.italian: "No, non ci sono riuscito."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"It fled before I could disable it."|6131|0
units.english: "It fled before I could disable it."
units.italian: "È fuggita prima che potessi neutralizzarla."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"I blew it up, just like you wanted."|6132|0
units.english: "I blew it up, just like you wanted."
units.italian: "L'ho fatta saltare in aria, proprio come volevi."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	He frowns at this and lets out a sigh. "Well, I'll contact security and let them deal with this. Don't worry, they'll sort it out. But thanks for getting back to me about it." He walks off towards the Syndicated Security offices.|6134|0
units.english: He frowns at this and lets out a sigh. "Well, I'll contact security and let them deal with this. Don't worry, they'll sort it out. But thanks for getting back to me about it." He walks off towards the Syndicated Security offices.
units.italian: Si acciglia e sospira. "Beh, contatto la sicurezza e li lascio gestire la cosa. Non preoccuparti, risolveranno. Ma grazie per avermelo riferito." Si allontana verso gli uffici della Sicurezza del Sindacato.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	He jolts his head back. "What'd you say?"|6138|0
units.english: He jolts his head back. "What'd you say?"
units.italian: Sobbalza all'indietro. "Che cosa hai detto?"

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"Yeah, I blew it up."|6140|0
units.english: "Yeah, I blew it up."
units.italian: "Sì, l'ho fatta saltare in aria."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"The hijackers got away, sorry."|6142|0
units.english: "The hijackers got away, sorry."
units.italian: "I dirottatori sono scappati, mi dispiace."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	He sighs and says, "Man, I don't have time for this. Tell me what actually happened."|6143|0
units.english: He sighs and says, "Man, I don't have time for this. Tell me what actually happened."
units.italian: Sospira e dice: "Amico, non ho tempo per questo. Dimmi che cosa è successo davvero."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"I blew it up, didn't you hear me?"|6145|0
units.english: "I blew it up, didn't you hear me?"
units.italian: "L'ho fatta saltare in aria, non mi hai sentito?"

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"Your ship got away. That's what happened."|6146|0
units.english: "Your ship got away. That's what happened."
units.italian: "La tua nave è scappata. Ecco che cosa è successo."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"If you're going to waste my time, get out of here." Before you can react, he storms off towards the Syndicated Security offices.|6147|0
units.english: "If you're going to waste my time, get out of here." Before you can react, he storms off towards the Syndicated Security offices.
units.italian: "Se devi farmi perdere tempo, vattene." Prima che tu possa reagire, se ne va infuriato verso gli uffici della Sicurezza del Sindacato.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|When you land, the captain of the <npc> comes up to you, his face rather red.|6151|0
units.english: When you land, the captain of the <npc> comes up to you, his face rather red.
units.italian: Quando atterri, il capitano della <npc> ti viene incontro, con il viso piuttosto rosso.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	He grabs your shoulders and shakes you hard, shouting, "Didn't I tell you not to board my ship? Do you know how many credits I've just lost because of you?"|6157|0
units.english: He grabs your shoulders and shakes you hard, shouting, "Didn't I tell you not to board my ship? Do you know how many credits I've just lost because of you?"
units.italian: Ti afferra per le spalle e ti scuote con forza, gridando: "Non ti avevo detto di non abbordare la mia nave? Sai quanti crediti ho appena perso per colpa tua?"

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"I'm sorry, I was just trying to help!"|6159|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, I was just trying to help!"
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, stavo solo cercando di aiutare!"

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"I'm sure whatever you lost wasn't worth all that much."|6160|0
units.english: "I'm sure whatever you lost wasn't worth all that much."
units.italian: "Sono sicuro che quello che hai perso non valesse poi così tanto."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	He stops shaking you for a moment to say, "Well, you didn't need to shoot up the insides of my <npc model> while you were trying to help, weren't you? Fat lot of help that was, even if you tried to do the right thing. Oh, well..."|6162|0
units.english: He stops shaking you for a moment to say, "Well, you didn't need to shoot up the insides of my <npc model> while you were trying to help, weren't you? Fat lot of help that was, even if you tried to do the right thing. Oh, well..."
units.italian: Smette di scuoterti per un momento per dire: "Beh, non avevi bisogno di crivellare di colpi l'interno del mio <npc model> mentre cercavi di aiutare, no? Un bell'aiuto, davvero, anche se provavi a fare la cosa giusta. Oh, beh..."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	The captain lets you go with a push and turns around to walk off towards the direction of the bar, leaving you to contemplate your actions.|6163|0
units.english: The captain lets you go with a push and turns around to walk off towards the direction of the bar, leaving you to contemplate your actions.
units.italian: Il capitano ti lascia andare con una spinta e si volta per andarsene verso il bar, lasciandoti a riflettere sulle tue azioni.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	He grabs your shoulders and shakes you hard, shouting, "Didn't I tell you not to destroy my ship? Do you know how many credits I've just lost because of you?"|6167|0
units.english: He grabs your shoulders and shakes you hard, shouting, "Didn't I tell you not to destroy my ship? Do you know how many credits I've just lost because of you?"
units.italian: Ti afferra per le spalle e ti scuote con forza, gridando: "Non ti avevo detto di non distruggere la mia nave? Sai quanti crediti ho appena perso per colpa tua?"

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"I'm sorry, I was just trying to help!"|6169|0
units.english: "I'm sorry, I was just trying to help!"
units.italian: "Mi dispiace, stavo solo cercando di aiutare!"

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"I'm sure whatever you lost wasn't worth all that much."|6170|0
units.english: "I'm sure whatever you lost wasn't worth all that much."
units.italian: "Sono sicuro che quello che hai perso non valesse poi così tanto."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	He stops shaking you for a moment to say, "Well, you shouldn't have blown up my <npc model> while you were trying to help, weren't you? Fat lot of help that was, even if you tried to do the right thing. Oh, well..."|6172|0
units.english: He stops shaking you for a moment to say, "Well, you shouldn't have blown up my <npc model> while you were trying to help, weren't you? Fat lot of help that was, even if you tried to do the right thing. Oh, well..."
units.italian: Smette di scuoterti per un momento per dire: "Beh, non avresti dovuto far saltare il mio <npc model> mentre cercavi di aiutare, no? Un bell'aiuto, davvero, anche se provavi a fare la cosa giusta. Oh, beh..."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	The captain lets you go with a push and turns around to walk off towards the direction of the bar, leaving you to contemplate your actions.|6173|0
units.english: The captain lets you go with a push and turns around to walk off towards the direction of the bar, leaving you to contemplate your actions.
units.italian: Il capitano ti lascia andare con una spinta e si volta per andarsene verso il bar, lasciandoti a riflettere sulle tue azioni.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	He looks at you incredulously, scrunching up his face. "Not--not that much? Is that what you just said?" He pauses for a moment to look at the wall above you with a lost look in his eyes. "That was my life's work up there, an <npc model> that had served me for 14 years, and you have the audacity to say it was all for nothing?!"|6177|0
units.english: He looks at you incredulously, scrunching up his face. "Not--not that much? Is that what you just said?" He pauses for a moment to look at the wall above you with a lost look in his eyes. "That was my life's work up there, an <npc model> that had served me for 14 years, and you have the audacity to say it was all for nothing?!"
units.italian: Ti guarda incredulo, con il viso contratto. "Non... non così tanto? È questo che hai appena detto?" Si ferma un momento a fissare la parete sopra di te con lo sguardo perso. "Quella era l'opera della mia vita, lì sopra: un <npc model> che mi ha servito per 14 anni, e tu hai la faccia tosta di dire che era tutto per niente?!"

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"Well, yeah."|6179|0
units.english: "Well, yeah."
units.italian: "Beh, sì."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	"No, that's not what I meant."|6180|0
units.english: "No, that's not what I meant."
units.italian: "No, non era quello che intendevo."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	The captain scoffs, staring you down again with even more intensity than before, and lets you go with a rough push. "I don't need your explanation, and I don't think you could give me one. I just can't understand how you can walk away feeling alright that you've set back one man's life so much."|6181|0
units.english: The captain scoffs, staring you down again with even more intensity than before, and lets you go with a rough push. "I don't need your explanation, and I don't think you could give me one. I just can't understand how you can walk away feeling alright that you've set back one man's life so much."
units.italian: Il capitano sbuffa, fissandoti di nuovo con un'intensità ancora maggiore di prima, e ti lascia andare con una spinta brusca. "Non mi serve una tua spiegazione, e non credo che sapresti darmela. Proprio non capisco come tu possa andartene sentendoti a posto dopo aver mandato all'aria la vita di un uomo così tanto."

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	Suddenly, he turns around and walks off towards the direction of the bar, leaving you to contemplate your actions.|6182|0
units.english: Suddenly, he turns around and walks off towards the direction of the bar, leaving you to contemplate your actions.
units.italian: All'improvviso si volta e se ne va verso il bar, lasciandoti a riflettere sulle tue azioni.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|log|6189|0
units.english: Helped an unfortunate captain recover his Argosy after a bunch of delinquents hijacked it.
units.italian: Ho aiutato uno sfortunato capitano a recuperare la sua Argosy dopo che un gruppo di teppisti l'aveva dirottata.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|As you land, Syndicated Security have the <npc> in tow, escorted by a trio of Quicksilvers. The formation lands on one of the larger pads reserved for Syndicated Security vessels, fenced off from the rest of the spaceport.|6192|0
units.english: As you land, Syndicated Security have the <npc> in tow, escorted by a trio of Quicksilvers. The formation lands on one of the larger pads reserved for Syndicated Security vessels, fenced off from the rest of the spaceport.
units.italian: Mentre atterri, la Sicurezza del Sindacato ha la <npc> al traino, scortata da tre Quicksilver. La formazione atterra su una delle piazzole più grandi riservate ai vascelli della Sicurezza del Sindacato, recintata rispetto al resto dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	The hijackers, just a raucous group of young kids, are hauled out of the <npc model> by Syndicated Security personnel towards an armored van. Multiple times the kids try to run away, but after a few minutes they're finally detained; the van drives off towards the spaceport terminal.|6193|0
units.english: The hijackers, just a raucous group of young kids, are hauled out of the <npc model> by Syndicated Security personnel towards an armored van. Multiple times the kids try to run away, but after a few minutes they're finally detained; the van drives off towards the spaceport terminal.
units.italian: I dirottatori, solo un gruppo rumoroso di ragazzini, vengono trascinati fuori dal <npc model> dal personale della Sicurezza del Sindacato verso un furgone blindato. Più volte i ragazzi provano a scappare, ma dopo qualche minuto vengono finalmente fermati; il furgone parte verso il terminal dello spazioporto.

units.id: mission:Argosy Hijacking|	After the incident is wrapped up, the captain of the <npc> sends you <payment>, and a message thanking you for helping him recover his ship.|6194|0
units.english: After the incident is wrapped up, the captain of the <npc> sends you <payment>, and a message thanking you for helping him recover his ship.
units.italian: Chiuso l'incidente, il capitano della <npc> ti manda <payment> e un messaggio in cui ti ringrazia per averlo aiutato a recuperare la nave.

units.id: mission:Blind Man from Martini|name|6199|0
